TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALISAIE_000_001: There's no going back once we cross this bridge─and the gods only know what awaits us on the other side.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_KRILE_000_005: Minfilia would have given anything for a chance to liberate her homeland. Were she still with us, I know she'd be the one leading the way.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_YSHTOLA_000_010: ...In our absence, Urianger and Thancred will handle administrative affairs. Continue to coordinate your operations with Alianne and the others, and report to them directly should you receive word of primal activity.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RIOL_000_015: Aye, aye, Cap'n. Ye can count on us.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_TATARU_000_020: You remember M'naago, don't you? The messenger who brought word of the Griffin's attack on Baelsar's Wall? Well, she left not long ago, having made a full recovery. If you see her in Gyr Abania, be sure to send my love!
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_025:
So, it's finally happening... Don't tell anyone, but I'm feeling a little bit nervous. Only a bit, mind. I'll be fine once we get going.
...Hopefully.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_GOSETSU_000_030: You are ready, shadow walker? There can be no turning back once we depart.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_YUGIRI_000_035: Almost. There is but one thing that remains undone...
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_040: A thousand malms apart, yet united in purpose... Let us pray both our endeavors meet with success. Shall we, then?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_TATARU_000_042: Wait, wait, not just yet! I knew I'd forgotten something important! Lyse, could you come with me?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_043: (-Lyse-)...Me? What, now? Um...all right, then. If you insist...
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_044: (-Lyse-)Heh heh heh... What do you think?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_TATARU_000_045: As you can see, I designed it to be light and loose─an outfit tailor-made to the needs of a skilled fighter like Lyse.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Your work never ceases to impress. Much more of this, and I may have to stop introducing you as the Scions' receptionist and start referring to you as our preeminent seamstress...
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_047: It's lovely, Tataru. Thank you. I feel like I could take on a legion...
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_TATARU_000_048: I'm glad you like it. And with that, I'll delay you no longer. Safe travels!
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_049: Then onward, to Gyr Abania! Our first stop will be at Amarissaix's Spire, in the East Shroud.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALISAIE_000_060: Papalymo had to know it would only be temporary. If Grandfather couldn't contain Bahamut with the power of a thousand thousand prayers, then what chance did his disciple stand, armed only with a broken staff...
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_YSHTOLA_000_065: Though it may not be apparent to the naked eye, the aether here is in turmoil. Not since the Calamity has this land been subjected to forces of the magnitude unleashed by Shinryu and Omega.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_KRILE_000_070: Was it always his plan to sacrifice his life to complete the ritual? To bring forth the arbiter of his vengeance, but not remain to see the aftermath?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_075: ...I won't let you down, Papalymo. I promise.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: The Alliance holds the Wall, . You may cross at your leisure.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_090: All are present and accounted for. When you are ready, my friend, pray inform the officer that we wish to proceed into Gyr Abania.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_100: We should depart as soon as possible─for Lyse's sake. Staring at the Wall will do little to improve her state of mind.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Ah, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. We were told to expect you. Shall I summon someone to escort you to the Wall?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALISAIE_000_130: So this is East End. Not too different from the rest of the Shroud, is it? Though, truth be told, I'm not sure why I thought it would be.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_YSHTOLA_000_135: The Alliance has done well to repurpose these imperial facilities for their own use so quickly.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_KRILE_000_140: Quite an atmosphere here, isn't there? Everyone seems to be on pins and needles...though one can hardly blame them, given recent events.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_145: The General's in high spirits, don't you think? I know the feeling!
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_150: To see the colors of so many nations─Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, Ul'dah, and now Ishgard─well nigh brings a tear to my eye... We have much to be proud of, .
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_160: Greetings, Scions. On behalf of the Eorzean Alliance, I welcome you to Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_161: Thank you, General. We were relieved to hear that your forces secured the Wall without incident. Have the imperials made any attempt to retake the castrum since then?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_162: None. Save for a few skirmishes between our scouts and their patrols, we've had barely any contact with them. But we all know it's only a matter of time before things escalate.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_163: As if attacking Baelsar's Wall weren't enough, Ilberd summoned a primal right on their doorstep─and Garlemald is not like to let such shows of defiance go unanswered.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_164:
'Twas a declaration of war, even if it was not Ilberd's to make. And now we are bound by it, for weal or for woe.
The Scions stand ready to serve, General. What would you ask of us?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_165: As stated in my message, the Alliance will not proceed without the support and cooperation of the Ala Mhigan people. We would have you serve as our emissaries and make contact with the Resistance.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_166: Consider it done, General. We won't let you down, I swear.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_167: Then I'll leave you to it. Godsspeed!
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_CID_000_168: Hah! Of all the castra in all the world, you walk into mine.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_ALPHINAUD_000_169: Master Garlond! What brings you here?
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_CID_000_170: A certain missing Allagan weapon and draconic primal. Omega and─Shinryu, I think the shinobi called it? Anyway, we've been studying their trail of destruction, hoping it might lead us somewhere─which it has singularly failed to do.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_171: Then 'tis like Omega fell to earth in occupied territory...meaning it may already be in imperial hands.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_CID_000_172: Even so, it bears repeating that we engaged the stasis systems. Assuming the command was received and executed successfully, the weapon will be of no use to them. Assuming. We should hurry up and find it, regardless.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_RAUBAHN_000_173: All the more reason to reach out to the Resistance. If we want to press on into Gyr Abania, we'll need their blessing.
TEXT_STMBDA101_02446_LYSE_000_174: Everyone's counting on us. Let's not waste any more time talking!
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALISAIE_000_001: If anyone can determine the fate of Shinryu and Omega, it's Master Garlond. For now, let us remain focused on our current mission.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_YSHTOLA_000_005: Were Omega not a threat to us all, its effectiveness in subduing draconic foes would seem almost admirable. But such weapons are doomed to be misused. Let us pray we never have need of its services again.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_010: I do hope you're not thinking about running off to help Master Garlond. It is not your duty to solve all of the world's problems, you know!
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_015: The bridge over the Velodyna River has always held great strategic importance, hence the Garleans' decision to transform it into a fortified installation. Needless to say, we will not be crossing there.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_030: As you've probably heard, there are plenty of factions in the Resistance, so I'm taking us to see the one with the most influence.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_031: Their headquarters are located in a place called Rhalgr's Reach─an old temple, to the east of here, across the Velodyna River.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_032: I learned a route that should allow us to avoid imperial patrols. Stick with me and we'll be there before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALISAIE_000_040: It's so quiet. Almost as though the imperials haven't been here for some time...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_YSHTOLA_000_045: On your guard. The imperials know these lands better than we.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_050: At the risk of upsetting the cartographic fraternity, I can't help observing that “East End” depends entirely on one's perspective. I mean, people don't even think of it as Gridania anymore, do they?
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_055: They call it East End because it marks the end of the Black Shroud. Note the sparser vegetation.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_060: Still with me? Good. From here, we'll head northeast towards the river. The water's not too deep, so we won't have to swim.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALISAIE_000_070:
Heh heh... See, Brother? Nothing to worry about.
...Though no one would blame you for donning your buoyancy aids, just in case.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_YSHTOLA_000_075: We should not linger out here in the open.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_080: Y'shtola's right. We need to cross before the imperials spot us.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_085: At a glance, it certainly seems shallow enough...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_090: I don't see any soldiers. Good. Let's cross.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_091: You're wondering about the tower to the south?
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_092: It's part of Castellum Velodyna. That's what the imperials decided to call the old bridge after they fortified it.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_093: I call it a great big eyesore. Honestly, you can see that rotten banner from absolutely malms away. <sigh> They never miss a chance to rub our noses in it, do they... Come on, we should keep moving.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_110: And we didn't run afoul of even a single patrol! What a pleasant surprise─in that there were no surprises.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_115: So, the Reach lies beyond? But I do not see a path...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_120: We're here. On the other side of this pass is Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_121: So you say, but all I see are rocks. I presume there is some sort of trick to this?
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_124: I take it they have a talented mage in their ranks─or mayhap an artificer trained in the modification of glamour prisms...?
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_125: Something like that. The important thing is that it fools the Garleans.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_126: Oh, before we go in─I don't know if Tataru told you, but my friend Naago, the messenger who came to the Rising Stones, is a member of this faction.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_127: So they know us, and they shouldn't attack us on sight. That said, they can be a bit jumpy, so let me lead the way, and, uh...don't go reaching for your weapons or anything.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_128: And with a sprinkle of demasking dust, all is laid bare!
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Seeing it now, I feel rather foolish for not having deduced it earlier.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_131: All clear! Let's go, let's go!
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_YSHTOLA_000_132: Impressive or no, twenty years is a long time for even so complex a glamour to escape the Empire's notice...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALISAIE_000_133: I suppose you could disguise almost anything with a glamour prism, if you really wanted to. Have you ever used one? Why am I asking─of course you haven't.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_134: Let us pray that they are amenable to our proposal. United, we stand to accomplish so much more...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALISAIE_000_140: It's hard to feel at ease with that giant statue looking down on you...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_YSHTOLA_000_145: Fascinating... A massive, nigh-imperceptible glamour encompassing the entire valley... I see now how the settlement was able to escape the watchful eyes of imperial airships.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_KRILE_000_150: Ordinarily, I'd shudder at the thought of armed rebels trampling about in an ancient temple of immense historical importance─but Rhalgr is the breaker of worlds, so it seems rather appropriate, if anything.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_ALPHINAUD_000_155: This temple was once home to the Fist of Rhalgr, as I recall. Yes...there is no mistaking that statue.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_LYSE_000_160: It's good to see Naago up and moving again. I wasn't there when she headed home, so I naturally assumed she'd left too soon. Always overdoing it, that one.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_MNAAGO_000_165: A pleasure to see you again─and Krile and Y'shtola, without whose help I might not be standing here today. At least, not so soon.
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_MEFFRID_000_170: Ho, so you really came. I never thought I'd see you here, but I'm glad. I'm glad...
TEXT_STMBDA102_02447_CONRAD_000_180: You'll forgive us our precautions, but we couldn't be sure who had crossed the barrier. We see you now for who you are, though─the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_ALISAIE_000_001: It's hard to feel at ease with that giant statue looking down on you...
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_YSHTOLA_000_005: Fascinating... A massive, nigh-imperceptible glamour encompassing the entire valley... I see now how the settlement was able to escape the watchful eyes of imperial airships.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_KRILE_000_010: Ordinarily, I'd shudder at the thought of armed rebels trampling about in an ancient temple of immense historical importance─but Rhalgr is the breaker of worlds, so it seems rather appropriate, if anything.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_ALPHINAUD_000_015: This temple was once home to the Fist of Rhalgr, as I recall. Yes...there is no mistaking that statue.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_LYSE_000_020: It's good to see Naago up and moving again. I wasn't there when she headed home, so I naturally assumed she'd left too soon. Always overdoing it, that one.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_MNAAGO_000_025: A pleasure to see you again─and Krile and Y'shtola, without whose help I might not be standing here today. At least, not so soon.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_MEFFRID_000_030: Ho, so you really came. I never thought I'd see you here, but I'm glad. I'm glad...
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_CONRAD_000_040: Now, I know you would not have come all this way unless you had something important to discuss, and I'm eager to hear what it is you have to say...
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_CONRAD_000_041: But let's not do this on our doorstep, eh? Come with me.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_MNAAGO_000_050: We plan operations here─when we're not entertaining important guests like yourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA103_02448_MEFFRID_000_055: When we first met back in the Shroud, I took you for just another adventurer. By Rhalgr, I still can't believe how far you've come...
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_YSHTOLA_000_005: So they would have us wait. Very well.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_KRILE_000_010: I can't imagine that they would refuse. But if they did...
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALPHINAUD_000_040: So...it would seem we find ourselves with a surfeit of free time─
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_CONRAD_000_041: Ah, forgive me. You are free to look around Rhalgr's Reach. In fact, I would encourage you to do so. It'll give you a better grasp of our current circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Thank you, Master Kemp. I believe we will do just that.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Let us make the most of this opportunity and assess the Resistance's capabilities.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALISAIE_000_044: Free to poke our noses wheresoever we will, eh? I like the sound of that.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_045: Well, I already know this place inside out. I can show you around if you like, ?
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALISAIE_000_050: Ah, excellent. They've no shortage of sutlers here, should we have need of their services.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Hardly surprising. Where there is war, there is profit to be had.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_070: I'll bet you think the Resistance is mostly made up of Ala Mhigan Highlanders like me, but the truth is that we don't even account for half.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_071: We've got Hellsguard from all the way over by the Spine in here, and plenty of Seekers of the Sun like Naago.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_072: There's even some beastmen─well, beastwomen, I suppose─like that one over there. She's an Ananta. They've been with us for a while now.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_073: Well, one of the smaller factions has. The rest won't have anything to do with us. We're no different from the Garleans to them.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_074: They keep to themselves, spending all their time crafting. Ananta make the most amazing jewelry, by the way. They use magicks to twist metals and crystal into shapes you wouldn't believe. It's a pity people hardly ever get to see their work. But then most don't even know they exist.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_075: That's enough about them, anyway. Let's take a closer look at the statue of Rhalgr, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_080: When you've seen one aetheryte, you've seen them all, right? Not quite. This one's an older design, dating back decades, to when the Fist of Rhalgr was still here.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_081: It may look a little different, but it works just as well as any other. I'll show you where the sutlers are next─but don't forget to attune to the aetheryte before we go!
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_090: Pretty awe-inspiring, isn't it? The breaker of worlds, who guided our ancestors to these lands all those centuries ago.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_100_090: Yda used to tell me the story on stormy nights. She wanted me to understand. To remember...
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_091: "At the end of the Fifth Astral Era, when the waters rose higher and higher, people all across Eorzea beseeched the heavens for a sign. And lo, a burning star appeared in the eastern sky, and led the way to these mountains of Gyr Abania...“
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_092: “They who were saved by His grace pledged to honor and revere Him. To devote themselves to great works without and within...”
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_093:
“A storm of blood approaches fast,
Hells open, Heavens weep.
For no one soul doth lie beyond
The measure of His Reach.”
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_094: That last part was inscribed on this stone by a monk of the Fist of Rhalgr. Yda explained it to me: “A day will come bringing strife and sorrow that none may escape. Waste not these precious hours, but in quiet preparation make strong the body and mind.”
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_095: I don't know if that “storm of blood” is finally upon us. But if it is, I have to believe that everything we've been through, everything that has led us to this point, will see us through in the end.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_096: ...Agh! Sorry. That was all a bit melodramatic, wasn't it? Let's keep moving, shall we? Off to the infirmary!
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_100: This is the infirmary, as you can probably tell. Here's where the Resistance healers patch up the wounded and tend to the sick.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_101: No matter how carefully we planned our operations, casualties were inevitable. It's a sad thing to think about, but...it's also important to remember the cost, as Conrad would say.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_102: We should go. I'll show you the aetheryte plaza next.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_110: Arms, armor, potions─you name it, these folks've got it. The Resistance would be in a bad way without brave merchants to keep it provisioned.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_111: If you're short on anything, or you need something repaired, these are the people to speak to.
TEXT_STMBDA104_02449_LYSE_000_112: Oh, Alphinaud and Alisaie are here. Why don't we see how they're getting on?
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Hardly surprising. Where there is war, there is profit to be had.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_LYSE_100_015: If you need to buy anything, now might be a good time.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALISAIE_000_020: Come to take the measure of our friendly neighborhood merchants?
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALISAIE_000_021: They're a bold lot, that much is plain. If the imperials found out they were peddling their wares to the Resistance, they would be lucky to escape with their lives.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALPHINAUD_000_022: 'Tis a gamble, aye, and I admire their courage. But their motives could hardly be said to be altruistic...
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MNAAGO_000_023: Ah, here you are. I've been looking all over for you.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MNAAGO_100_023: We've finished discussing your proposal, and we're ready to receive you all back at the tent.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MNAAGO_000_024: I've sent someone to fetch Y'shtola and Krile, so if you'd like to follow me...
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MNAAGO_000_030: We'll begin once the others arrive.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MEFFRID_000_035: Sorry to have kept you waiting, but matters such as these demand due deliberation.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_LYSE_000_040: What a relief! For a moment there, I really wasn't sure which way it was going to go...
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_YSHTOLA_000_045: Krile and I shall remain here for now. Should you have need of us, you are welcome to visit.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_KRILE_000_050: I briefly dabbled with similar methods involving distillations and infusions of herbal extracts, but I must confess to knowing little and less of Ala Mhigan traditional medicine. Would that I knew more, for its effectiveness exceeds all expectations...
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_CONRAD_000_055: Now that we've dealt with the formalities, we can get to work. I'm glad you're with us, friend.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MNAAGO_000_060: Heh! As if there were any doubt!
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_MEFFRID_000_065: Pinch me if I'm dreaming, because I'd swear it's finally happening. The whole of Eorzea, committed at last to the liberation of Ala Mhigo!
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALISAIE_000_070: Right, then. M'naago and Meffrid are to be our keepers.
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_ALISAIE_000_071: Knowing naught of what they require, one task is as good as the other. Make your choice, .
TEXT_STMBDA105_02450_SYSTEM_000_080: Your aether compass may now be used to locate aether currents in new regions! The aether compass can be found under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_020: Before we begin, I'd like to thank you and the Scions again for patching me up after I bled all over your floor. I owe you my life, and I won't forget that.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_021: Furthermore, it was rude of me to run off without saying a word. It's all well and good me claiming my duties here couldn't wait, but a parting thank-you was the very least you deserved. My apologies.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_023: Commander Kemp's entrusted me with a formal reply to be hand-delivered to the Alliance leadership. It covers everything we discussed, as well as detailing the disposition of our forces.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_024: What I need is an escort─one or two men at most, so we can make it to the Wall swiftly and without attracting undue attention.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_025: Very well. I shall join you in this.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_026: General Aldynn commands the forces at Castrum Oriens. It should be simple enough to see it into his hands.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_027: Great! That's just what I wanted to hear! When you're ready to depart, meet me at the pass leading out of the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_030: Let us defer to M'naago with regards to the route. While we could just as easily head back the way we came, there could be any number of reasons why we should not.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_040: Got everything you need? Good. Then let us be off.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_050: Why have we stopped? Is aught amiss?
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_060: Quiet! ...Hear that? That was a ceruleum engine backfiring. Imperials.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_061: Ye gods, you have preternatural senses. I didn't hear a thing.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_062: When you grow up hunting in these lands, you learn to discern the sounds that could mean life and death, be they of a predator or a patrol. From what I'm hearing...we have a seven-man patrol augmented with a single magitek armor. Wide search pattern. Divided into two─no, three teams. I don't think they know we're here...
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_063: It's risky, but we should split up and try to take them all by surprise at the same time. We don't want them calling reinforcements.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_064: Three teams, three of us. Nothing for it, then. Where are they?
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_065: Head north. You should see them long before they see you. I'll deal with the ones to the south. The armor should be just to the west─'s best equipped to deal with that. We attack in five─that should be enough time to get into position. Rendezvous on the east bank after. Any questions? No? Then good luck!
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_ALISAIE_000_070: I'm pleased to report that the Empire is short three soldiers─not that any self-respecting legatus would be sorry to lose them.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_080: It looks like everything went to plan. Not that I'm surprised─the three soldiers I faced didn't put up much of a fight.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_081: Most of the imperials we get out here are conscripts from other provinces with little training and even less conviction. It's grim work, killing men and women like that, but don't doubt that they'd do the same to you if the roles were reversed.
TEXT_STMBDA111_02451_MNAAGO_000_082: And don't you dare pity a man in armor. Conscript or no, a soldier piloting one of those can kill a dozen good men in the blink of an eye. Not that I need to tell you that, after what happened at the Wall...
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_ALISAIE_000_001: I'm pleased to report that the Empire is short three soldiers─not that any self-respecting legatus would be sorry to lose them.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_010: Right. I believe we've rested long enough. We should resume our journey before someone notices their missing patrol.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_ALISAIE_000_020: More soldiers? I didn't think they'd come this far west, but better to be safe than sorry...
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_031: You said the forces at Castrum Oriens were under the command of Flame General Raubahn Aldynn, did you not?
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_032: By Rhalgr! The Bull of Ala Mhigo himself! I never dreamed I'd have a chance to meet the legend...
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_100_030: I returned from a survey of the Wall but a moment ago. We have yet to recover Papalymo's personal effects, I am sorry to say, but you may rest assured that we will notify you and yours the moment we do.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_000_033: Our scouts recently informed me of an interesting development at Castellum Velodyna. Namely, the arrival of a shipment rumored to have come from the research and development facilities near the capital, containing prototype magitek armor.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_000_035: It is our assessment that this armor is to be field-tested here, most likely against Alliance forces. Mayhap before the day is out.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_036: Damn it all, more magitek weapons? That's the last thing we need!
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_000_037: Your concern is not unwarranted, but we needn't despair just yet. The shipment is thought to have contained a single heavy unit and one or two support units. With a well-laid ambush, we are confident we can destroy them all, hindering their development and delaying future deployment.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_RAUBAHN_000_038: And should we carry this out as a joint endeavor with the Resistance, they will have their rallying cry.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_039: It would mean dropping all pretense about the Alliance not wanting to go to war with the Empire...but you'd have a lot more folk willing to stand up and fight if they knew they weren't alone. And you were going to have to do it eventually anyway.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_000_040: Exactly. And so what I propose is simple: we harry their patrols to bait them into bringing their prototype weapons to East End, where our Resistance allies will take them from behind.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_RAUBAHN_000_041: Simple indeed, and well within our capabilities. I see no reason to delay, especially if a field test is imminent. What say you?
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_MNAAGO_000_042: Assuming the vice marshal's intelligence is accurate, I agree with his assessment and fully support his plan. I shall notify my comrades at once.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_PIPIN_000_043: Understood. I shall have one of my men bring you the details of the plan anon.
TEXT_STMBDA112_02452_ALISAIE_000_044: And we for our part will be fighting with the Alliance, yes? I somehow doubt you were intending to sit this one out.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_000_001: Prototype magitek armor, eh? This may prove a challenge.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_PIPIN_000_015: Fate has a way of leading one into the most unexpected alliances, does it not?
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_020: We've been careful to avoid needless shows of force this side of the Wall. But that's all about to change─and when it does, you may be sure they'll send their new toys out to entertain us.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_021: I would ask you to participate in this operation...but from that look I see it is a foregone conclusion. My thanks.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_022: Per Pipin's plan, we need to turn East End into an imperial graveyard. You're a dab hand at this, and I'd be a fool not to use you.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_023: Head to this spot on your map─right here, aye. A patrol should be along shortly. Deal with them, then rendezvous with the rest of us at this location. Go well, .
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_025: You know what to do. Be messy, be loud, and rejoin us when you've finished.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_000_040: My information was inaccurate, it would seem. The patrol never came...
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_PIPIN_000_045: We will have Flames and Adders with us for this operation. The Maelstrom and the Temple Knights will wait in reserve at the castrum.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_050: All went to plan, then? Good.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_051: Our scouts report that a unit escorting the prototype weapons has left Castellum Velodyna. The Resistance is already in position, so we have but to wait for our guests to arrive.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_100_060: He who fights and runs─ What the─? Who in the hells are you lot!?
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_MNAAGO_100_061: For Ala Mhigo! Let none escape!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_060: Well done, all of you. I'd call this operation a resounding success.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_CONRAD_000_061: Can't say I'm surprised. The “Bull of Ala Mhigo” had an impressive military record before he went west, as I recall.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_062: Credit where it's due, Master Kemp. 'Twas Marshal Tarupin who made this plan, and all of you, Resistance and Alliance alike, who carried it out to perfection.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_CONRAD_000_063: Aye, that they did. Not a single casualty, for which I'm grateful beyond words. I've no doubt our comrades back at the Reach will feel the same.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_CONRAD_000_065:
It's been a pleasure, General. Until the next battle.
M'naago─I leave the Scions in your care.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_066: We shall return to the castrum, then. , Mistress Leveilleur─once more you have my thanks. As Master Kemp said, until the next battle.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_000_070: That brute of an imperial officer was a force to be reckoned with, wasn't he? A fool, mayhap, but he held his own against the Flame General...
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_MNAAGO_000_080: I'd heard the stories, but to actually see you in action... I almost found myself pitying the imperials. Seriously, though─it was inspirational.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_MNAAGO_000_081: Ah, but you must be tired of hearing that, eh? I'll keep it simple, then─thanks for the help out there!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_000_090: 'Twas a good battle, and we have much to show for it. Pipin should be proud─I know I am.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_PIPIN_000_091: We couldn't have done it without you. Thank you, . Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: Adders, Flames, deal with the escort! Leave the armor to !
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: Bugger me! Is that General Aldynn!? Bwahahaha! A chance to get my revenge on , and test our new weapons, and kill an Alliance commander! Ohhh, it doesn't get much better than this!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: One would almost think he harbored a grudge against you, . Whatever did you do to him?
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: Hurry up and KILL THE BASTARDS! We've got 'em outnumbered!
What are you idiots doing? Give them everything we've got!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: There's no end to them... I'm here if you need healing, !
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: Looks like there's only the one prototype. Whatever else we do this day, I want it destroyed!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: Enough! We have secret weapons of great power, don't we? Let's bloody well use 'em!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: On your guard, ! He's up to something!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: Keep it up, lads! That thing won't take much more!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: Damn it all! Haven't we got anything else!? More armor or weapons or something!?
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: More of them!? I'm going to have to have a word with our scouts...
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: This can't be happening! Not again!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: We have them now! Forward! Forward!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: You think you've won, eh? Heh heh heh... THEN WE GO TOGETHER!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_MAGITEKVANGUARD_BAT: Self-destruct sequence initiated... Sixty... Fifty-nine... Fifty-eight...
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_RAUBAHN_BATTLETALK_: Seven hells! There's no time to get to safety! We must disable it before it blows!
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_MAGITEKVANGUARD_BAT:
Initiating self-destruct in:
Five... Four... Three... Two... One...
TEXT_STMBDA113_02453_GRYNEWAHT_BATTLETAL: No... No, no, NO! My secret weapon!
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_ALISAIE_000_001: That brute of an imperial officer was a force to be reckoned with, wasn't he? A fool, mayhap, but he held his own against the Flame General...
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_PIPIN_000_005: We couldn't have done it without you. Thank you, . Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_010: Well, there's no reason to remain here any longer. Let's get back to the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_030: You didn't have to take part in the operation, but you did. You went above and beyond what was asked of you, without hesitation, and for that we owe you a debt.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_031: Our victory may not count for much in practical terms, but its symbolic value can't be overstated.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_032: Alliance and Resistance fighters came together to face an imperial unit equipped with Garlemald's newest weapons─and smashed them. The people will remember this day.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_CONRAD_000_033: Aye, that they will, for it marks the beginning of something far greater than any single victory: the beginning of a campaign by a united Eorzea to drive the Garleans from our lands.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_CONRAD_000_034: Promises and platitudes mean naught without action. But the Alliance took the field and risked their lives for our cause.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_CONRAD_000_035: Hah, to think that the last time Gridanian troops trod this soil was more than a century ago, during the Autumn War─and that was to defend against our invasion.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_CONRAD_000_036: Ours is a long and bloody history, to be sure, and it gives me heart to see that despite our acrimonious past, we can still come together for the sake of the future.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_037: Well said, Commander! Which is why I intend to go from village to village and spread word of our victory and our new alliance.
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_100_037: The people will flock to our banners. Just you wait and see!
TEXT_STMBDA114_02454_MNAAGO_000_038: , Alisaie, I cannot thank you enough for your assistance!
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_020: At the risk of repeating myself, it's still hard for me to believe that we'd meet again here, of all places... Though I reckon you probably don't remember me after all this time, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_022: I'm impressed! Given everything you went on to accomplish, you'd be forgiven for forgetting all about your time in Quarrymill. Suffice it to say, we didn't forget about you, either─nor the lives you saved.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_023: No, no, 'twas a lifetime ago. There is no need to apologize. But know that down in Quarrymill, we didn't forget about you─nor the lives you saved.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_024: As for me...I went to Little Ala Mhigo while Gallien was recovering. Gundobald was my former commander and an old friend, and I had a lot on my mind...
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_025: In the end, I decided to disband our unit. I told the men to live their lives as they saw fit. Some chose to remain in Little Ala Mhigo, and others went to Ul'dah for work.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_026: But, as you can see, I chose to come back to Gyr Abania and join Conrad and the others.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_027: I've kept busy since then, ferrying people and provisions across the border and back. It's not been easy, but it's been fulfilling.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_028: Today, however, we'll be heading east into the Peaks. Conrad thinks we might have luck finding new recruits in the village of Ala Gannha.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_029: Ala Gannha!? If you're going there, you're taking me with you!
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_030: Ah, that's right─you're from Ala Gannha, aren't you, Lyse? By all means, we'd welcome the company.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_031: There'll be more to it than just asking around, but we can talk about it on the way. Make your preparations and meet me by the tunnel to the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_040: Yda and I were born in Ala Gannha, though I can't say I remember much about it...
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_050: This tunnel will take us all the way to the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_051: We're on a mission for Conrad to Ala Gannha. Clear the barricade, if you would.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_ALAMHIGANGATEMAN024: Aye, sir. Shouldn't take more than a moment.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_052: There're more villages there than out here─but also more imperials keeping a close eye on things. We'll need to tread carefully...
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_ALAMHIGANGATEMAN024: Do be careful out there, . Wouldn't do to lose a soldier like you so early in the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_070: This wasn't the work of the Garleans, but of Theodoric. His army massacred the monks here decades ago. By the time the Black Wolf arrived with his legion, it was already a ruin...
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_080: We've a glamour in place here too, as you may have noticed. So far as the imperials are concerned, this is naught more than a testament to the savage impulses of a lesser race...
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_081: Remember, though: once we leave these ruins, we'll have no glamours to conceal us. The village is to the east; keep watch for patrols as we move.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_090: Gods, look at that tower to the southeast. How long did it take them to build it...?
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_100: Nary an imperial in sight. That's a mercy.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_101: Ala Gannha's due east, past that bridge. Follow me, it's not much further.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_110: I couldn't have been older than five when we left this place. My memories are...hazy at best.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_120: You can rest easy─we made it. This is Ala Gannha.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_121: It feels strange coming home like this. I always imagined it would be... Oh, sorry. That has nothing to do with why we're here. We need recruits.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_122: Aye, we do, but as I said back at the Reach, it's a little more complicated than just asking for volunteers these days.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_123: As you know, we're shorthanded because many of our people were taken in by the Griffin's promises and went to the Wall, never to return. It wasn't just them, though─folks from all over, including some of my former comrades, answered his call to arms.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_124: As for why we came to this particular village... It's rumored that Ala Gannha lost a few youths as well.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_125: If there's truth to that, then there could be others sympathetic to the cause. Then again, after the Griffin's betrayal, they may be suspicious of outsiders claiming allegiance to the Resistance─and rightfully so.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_126: So with all that in mind, how are we supposed to convince them to join? I mean, I knew it wouldn't be as simple as giving a speech in the village square─
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_127: Not if you didn't want the place to be burned to the ground, no. You might as well piss in the viceroy's eye. We'll need to be a good deal more circumspect than that. You never know when an imperial spy is listening.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_MEFFRID_000_128: We must speak with the elder first. I know for a fact he can be trusted. We'll listen to what he has to say and decide what to do after.
TEXT_STMBDA121_02455_LYSE_000_129: Sounds like a plan! Let's hope there are still some brave men and women here willing to fight.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_001: I couldn't have been older than five when we left this place. My memories are...hazy at best.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_010: Raganfrid, the village elder, is over by the shore. No time like the present─let's have a word.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_011: ...Don't know you, traveler. You a merchant? You'll not find much custom here.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_012: Greetings and well met, elder, and sincerest apologies that I did not send word ahead of our arrival. Too long have I been away from Ala Gannha, and I would know of your recent troubles.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_013: Ah, you are comrades of Meffrid. I see, I see...
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_100_013: Speak on, though I suspect I know your purpose.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_014: The Griffin came with many men, and left with many more. Such is the rumor. Is it true?
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_015: He lit a fire in their hearts and then dangled a dream before their tired eyes. And now you come to steal away what few remain.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_016: The Griffin was a traitor and a madman, and we had no part in his schemes. We have made an agreement with the Alliance─this time it will be different!
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_017: This time? This time!? Cold comfort to the dead and the ones they left behind! How much more must we give before you've had your fill?
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_018: But...but surely you hate the Empire as much as we do!?
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_019: They took our lands, our traditions, even our god. And they demand a fifth of what little we've got left. Aye, I hate the bastards. With every fiber of my being.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_020: But hate's not enough, Meffrid. I can't...we can't keep doing this. I'll not tell anyone you came, but you need to go. Now. Leave us be, and never return.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_021: You've got no right to speak to us like that─
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_022: I've got a quarry that was producing barely enough to keep us fed, and that was before half our young men and women went off to die for your bloody cause!
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_100_022: So yes, I've got every right to tell you to leave my village!
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_023: ...No. You don't. Because it's my village too. My home!
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_024: What in the hells are you on about─
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_100_024: Wait... I know those eyes. You're one of Curtis's girls!
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_025: Lyse. Lyse Hext. And I'm here...I'm here to take back my homeland.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_026: By Rhalgr, the last time I saw you, you were... I didn't even know if you were still alive... And I never thought you would come─
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_027: I almost didn't. And my sister never will. Lots of others won't either...and that's why we've got to carry on the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_028: You even sound like him... <sigh> As you say, I've got no right to tell you to leave. Ala Gannha is as much your home as it is mine.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_100_028: But I say to you again: we can give no more.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_029: Yes, I heard you the first time.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_030: <sigh> We didn't come here to fight. I hope I haven't made a mess of things.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_040: That could've been handled better, but what's done is done. At least we've been granted permission to stay.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_RAGANFRID_000_050: Do what you will and say what you like─you'll find no recruits here.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_060: I was hoping Raganfrid might help us to recruit some of his people, but that clearly isn't going to happen. If we're to convince any of them to join, we'll first need to regain their trust.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_MEFFRID_000_061: It's risky, and it's hardly subtle, but I say we approach the villagers directly─see what problems they've got, and if we can do anything to help.
TEXT_STMBDA122_02456_LYSE_000_062: Makes sense to me. Let's split up and ask around.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_010: Ah, there you are, . I've been trying to help the villagers deal with this food shortage of theirs.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_011: Recently, the imperials have been swooping into villages unannounced and seizing supplies in order to prevent the people from stockpiling, in case they might be in league with the Resistance.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_012: It's not much, but I've taught them a few tricks to better hide what little they've got left. How's Lyse getting on, by the way? You'd think people would be more inclined to trust a local girl─assuming they remember her, that is...
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_030: Why don't you go and see how Lyse is getting on? I'll join you in a few.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_070: ...And where were you these past twenty years!? Where were you when we were being ground under the Black Wolf's boot!? On the other side of his bastard wall, living the high life, I'll wager!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_072: Ho, and who's this, another one of your freedom-loving friends, deigning to help us poor unfortunate souls?
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_100_072: Trying to whip us into a frenzy so we'll go and storm a castrum with our pickaxes and shovels!? Leave, all of you, before you bring a cohort down on us all!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_073: And you─don't you dare speak like you're one of us. You can't even begin to understand what we've been through. You weren't here, Lyse! You weren't here!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_074: This is my home, and I love it with all my heart. And if you truly have any love for it too, you'll keep us out of your doomed rebellion.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_075: ...He has a point. No matter what I say or do, it doesn't change the fact I left them behind.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_076: But this isn't about me, or anyone else. It's about Ala Mhigo. Let's go and find Meffrid.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_080: I knew it wouldn't be easy, but...
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_090: Looks like the elder wasn't the only one unwilling to hear us out. Can't blame them, given what happened at the Wall.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_091: I thought I might be able to appeal to them as a fellow...I don't know. But, if anything, it just made them angrier. I haven't lived through it like they have.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_092: I can't claim to know the struggle like they do either, Lyse. I ran too, aye, but if I hadn't, I'd've never met  or the rest of you, and we might not be here today, in a position to make a difference.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_093: So I don't regret my choices, nor will I apologize for them. There's more than one way to fight.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_095: I don't like the sound of that one bit. Come on.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_BEWILDEREDWOMEN_000: Wercrata, he...<pant> <pant>...the tributum and...and the bloody ratmen, they... <pant> <pant> Damn it all!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_097: You there─take a deep breath, and then tell us what happened.
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_BEWILDEREDWOMEN_000: It was all business as usual... The tributum's due soon, and we were taking it to the imperials when the Qiqirn attacked! They took my brother, and our money!
Ruins to the south of here. Was just an old temple before they came and... Listen, Wercrata's the only family I've got left! If I lose him, I─
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_101: The Ziggurat? If the ratmen took him there, he's as good as dead...
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_102: We've got to get after them! If there's even a chance her brother is still alive, we have to try!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_LYSE_000_105: We can save him if we hurry! Come on!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_WISCAR_000_110: (You shouldn't get her hopes up like that. Everyone knows the ratmen eat their prisoners.)
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_SHARPEYEDWOMEN_000_: If this sodding leg of mine was any good, I'd...
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_BEWILDEREDWOMEN_000: You've got to hurry! The gods only know what they could be doing to him!
TEXT_STMBDA123_02457_MEFFRID_000_130: You're right, Lyse. We've got to help them, if not for the missing man then for the tributum. The Garleans won't suffer excuses if they're late...
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_LYSE_000_001: We're wasting time! Let's go, go, go!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WISCAR_100_001: (You shouldn't get her hopes up like that. Everyone knows the ratmen eat their prisoners.)
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_SHARPEYEDWOMEN_100_: If this sodding leg of mine was any good, I'd...
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_BEWILDEREDWOMEN_100: You've got to hurry! The gods only know what they could be doing to him!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_010: So Wercrata's being held somewhere at the Ziggurat to the south, which has been taken over by a host of Qiqirn bandits. That about covers it, then.
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_011: Be prepared for a fight. They may not be the most challenging foes, but there's sure to be a lot of them.
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_070: (-???-)Please, let me go! I'm begging you! I don't want to die!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_071: Hear that? I think it came from the top of the Ziggurat!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_QIQIRNMEATGNASHER_0: Who dares come to loot our man-flesh! Ours to eat! Ours to eat!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_073: We knew it'd come to this. Kill them quick, before they alert the others!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_BALLOON_000_016:
Man-flesh is ours!
Man-flesh is ours!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_LYSE_000_030: <pant> <pant> I thought you said they'd be no challenge!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_035: <pant> <pant> I also said there'd be a bloody host of them!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_BALLOON_000_035: Go and loot your own loots!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_BALLOON_000_036:
Eat your flesh too
for this trespass!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_040: By Rhalgr, what did I ever do to deserve this? I've gone to bed hungry for months. I'm skin and bones! I'd hardly make a snack, much less a meal...
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_042: W-Wait...are you here to rescue me?
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_LYSE_000_043: Your sister sent us. It's going to be all right.
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_044: My sister? Oh, Rhalgr be praised, she's safe! And you...you lot fought your way in here just for me? To think there are still good, brave folk in this world...
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_045: We should go before the Qiqirn return in force. Do you still have the tributum?
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_046: Oh gods, the tributum! The imperials will be wondering where I am! I have to go!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_LYSE_000_047: What, right now? In your condition?
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_WERCRATA_000_048: You don't understand─we were given a warning last month for being short! If I don't make it in time, there's no telling what will happen to me and my sister!
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_MEFFRID_000_050: Aan like him are barely considered people under imperial rule. They're to work hard and pay their taxes, and if they don't, there'll be seven hells to pay. Beatings, imprisonment, enslavement─and as for your womenfolk, well...
TEXT_STMBDA124_02458_LYSE_000_060: I'm glad we saved him, but seeing him run off like that... I've got a bad feeling about this.
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_001: Aan like him are barely considered people under imperial rule. They're to work hard and pay their taxes, and if they don't, there'll be seven hells to pay. Beatings, imprisonment, enslavement─and as for your womenfolk, well...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_LYSE_000_010: Listen, , Meffrid... I think we need to go after Wercrata.
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_011: Wait─you had better not be thinking of stopping him! You heard what he said─if they don't pay one way, they'll pay another!
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_LYSE_000_012: I know that, I do, and I don't want to interfere! I just...I just want to see that he makes it there safely.
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_013: ...If that's the sum of it, then fine. Let's head down and see if we can't pick up his trail.
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_SYSTEM_000_020: Upon closer inspection, you find nothing of interest...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_SYSTEM_000_021: In the dirt, you spy a chocobo feather...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_023: A chocobo feather, is it? Aye, by my reckoning, it came from Wercrata's bird, in which case...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_024: There's a collapsed bridge just around the bend. Hug the rocks and stick to the shadows. We'll find him soon enough.
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_LYSE_000_025: Can they really see us all the way up there in the tower?
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_030: Any minute now, I expect he'll come thundering 'round the bend and─ Hear that? Get to cover, quickly now!
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_LYSE_000_040: We...we could've done something, instead of just...of just letting it happen...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_050: I'd heard their commander was keen-eyed but gods, that was a near thing...
TEXT_STMBDA125_02459_MEFFRID_000_051: It tears me up inside to see our own kinsmen doing the bidding of the viceroy. But they made their choice, and if it comes to it, I'll cut down every last one of them myself.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_001: We...we could've done something, instead of just...of just letting it happen...
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_010: Wercrata's alive, and the tributum's been paid. That's all that matters for now.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_011: I for one would rather not wait around to see if the Skulls decide to return. We'd best get back to Ala Gannha and tell Raganfrid his man got the job done.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_020: We owe you a debt of gratitude for what you did. Wercrata told me everything─how you fought with the Qiqirn and saved his life.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_021: For all the good it did. We saw what happened when he met with the Skulls. How they beat him half to death. We could've stopped them.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_022: Aye, I reckon you could. Meffrid's a warrior, as is your comrade. And you're strong, like your father. That much is plain.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_023: But I thank Rhalgr you did not, because it would not have ended with them. Wercrata and his sister would've been branded insurgents, if not the whole lot of us.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_024: Bones heal, scars fade, but the dead remain dead. We're alive, and that's more than can be said for only the gods know how many others.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_025: That's enough for you, is it? To put up with whatever they do to you, so long as you get to see another day?
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_026: That's right. You grit your teeth and you learn to live with the pain.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_027: I'll admit I was quick to judge you, Lyse, and for that I apologize. I know you and yours mean well, I do. But I'm telling you, gods in the heavens as my witness, that we've got nothing left to give. We can't help you.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_028: ...I understand. Thank you for your honesty.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_029: She may say it, but she doesn't mean it. Nor would I expect her to─her father was stubborn as an ox too. If she's set on walking the same path, I but pray she won't follow it to the same end...
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_RAGANFRID_000_040: I knew Curtis when he was younger. Golden locks and piercing blue eyes. When I finally looked into hers, I saw at once she was his.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_050: Well. She took it better than I anticipated. Which isn't saying much, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_051: We should go and see if she's all right.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_060: Ah, there's our stray. Hmm... Mayhap you should take the lead in this, .
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_071: Ala Mhigans terrorizing their own...? I just can't accept it, you know? No matter what he thinks, they shouldn't have to put up with it, day after day after day...
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_072: I'm not completely naive, you know. I didn't expect them to “storm a castrum with their pickaxes and shovels,” or whatever it was. But nor did I expect Wercrata to just lie there in the dirt while they kicked him.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_073: I can't claim to know their pain. I barely remember this place or...or even my father's face.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_074: But I remember Yda's. I remember how scared she was when we ran...and that look in her eyes when she talked about home.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_075: Her home...but not mine, is it?
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_076: There you are, Lyse. I've been looking all over for you...
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_077: Well...you've found me. Got something else to say?
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_078: Aye, that I do... I, um... I said some things to you before that I shouldn't've. 'Twasn't my place to do so, and I'm sorry.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_079: All that rubbish I spouted about how I loved my village...but when one of ours was in need, I was cowering here with all the others. I didn't even think to go after Wercrata...but you did.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_080: Made me feel like...like the bloody hypocrite I am!
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_100_080: If I truly cared for my people, I'd fight for them. So I will...if you'll have me.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_082: When you put it like that, I, uh...I suppose I am. But not just me─there are others I know who've been thinking about it for a while now. There's not many of us, and we're not hardened warriors like you lot, but─
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_083: If your heart bleeds for Ala Mhigo, then that's good enough for me. You and yours are more than welcome at Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_WISCAR_000_084: Thank you, sir! You won't regret this! I'll go and speak with the others and send word when we're ready!
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_086: N-No, I...I was just...thinking out loud...
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_087: And with that, my friends, our mission is concluded. Let us return to the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_090: First of all, allow me to commend you both on a job well done.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_091: Though nothing went according to plan, we nevertheless managed to attract some new recruits. And it was your passion and conviction that moved them to join. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_092: No, thank you─for giving me an opportunity to find out what our people have been through these past twenty years. It's been...humbling.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_093: And troubling, too. I'd heard about the Skulls, but that was the first time I'd seen them in the flesh.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_LYSE_000_094: I know you say they're the same as any other imperial soldiers─and maybe that's how I'll have to think of them myself if our paths ever cross on the battlefield, but─
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_095: When, not if. That day will come, Lyse. You can't afford to hesitate when it does.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_096: Young, old, conscript, citizen, Garlean, Ala Mhigan─none of that matters. They've all got their reasons. But they're no better than yours, especially when they're bearing down on you, blade in hand.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_097: ...Saying that, I don't want to kill them any more than you do. If I could convince them to lay down their arms, I would. Sadly, I've never been much of a talker myself, but who knows, maybe you could be one, Lyse. Your father certainly was.
TEXT_STMBDA126_02460_MEFFRID_000_098: Right, then. I'd best begin preparing for these new recruits. , Lyse, it's been a pleasure.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_YSHTOLA_000_020: I am told you have been busy. As have we, lest you wonder. None here shall perish for want of proper treatment.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_KRILE_000_025: Been to the Peaks and back, have you? Glad to see you're in good health.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_CONRAD_000_030: Owing to the efforts of you all, we have accomplished a great deal in a short time. The Resistance thanks you for your service, Scions.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALPHINAUD_000_031: I see operations here have been proceeding apace in my absence.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALISAIE_000_032: Welcome back, Brother dearest. I take it your efforts to gather new recruits were successful.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Indeed. There were several amongst the Scions' ranks that were quite eager to take part in our joint endeavor with the Resistance, whom I am come to present.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ARENVALD_000_034: Commander Kemp, if I may! My name...my name is Arenvald Lentinus. A...a half-breed, as you can doubtless tell.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ARENVALD_000_035: I'm here to fight for a free Ala Mhigo. For an Ala Mhigo where women like my mother are never made to suffer. I pray you grant me this honor.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_CONRAD_000_036: ...You are a trueborn son of Gyr Abania, same as me. This is not my honor to grant, but yours to freely take. Welcome, brother.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_CONRAD_000_037: With our swelling ranks, and the aid of the Eorzean Alliance and the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, I believe we will soon be in a position to seize the initiative.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_CONRAD_000_038: Once our new recruits have received sufficient training, I will propose to General Aldynn that we draw up plans for an assault on Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_MNAAGO_000_039: Then, in the meantime, we will make what preparations we can!
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_CONRAD_000_050: I feared it would take longer to rouse the people to action after the disaster at the Wall, but it seems our countrymen are not so easily discouraged. Change is on the horizon, my friends.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_MEFFRID_000_055: We won't have much time to train the new recruits, but we'll make the most of it. The Resistance will need every able-bodied man and woman in the field if we're going to take Velodyna.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_LYSE_000_060: It's all happening so fast... Isn't it exciting!?
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Arenvald is not much older than I am. We would often chat about this and that whenever I paid a visit to the Waking Sands. I knew he had strong feelings about Ala Mhigo and the occupation, but mayhap I underestimated his passion...
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALISAIE_000_070: M'naago did well to spread word of our victory in East End. Hardly a day goes by without some would-be recruit arriving, inspired by the tale.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ARENVALD_000_075: For a long time, I struggled to make sense of that day at the Waking Sands. Why I survived when A'aba and Aulie didn't. Not anymore.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_JMOLDVA_000_080: Long ago did I resolve never again to take up sword or spear─at first for sport, and then entirely. But a chance encounter with young Arenvald served to remind me that not all battles are as empty as those fought upon the bloodsands.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_VMAHTIA_000_085: Alphinaud asked for volunteers, so here I am. First Ishgard, now Ala Mhigo, eh? No rest for the righteous!
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_MNAAGO_000_090: Right, then. I've got duties to attend to.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Mayhap we could assist you with said duties? We are here to help, after all.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_ALPHINAUD_100_092: The three of you have been busy, so I will understand if you require time to rest. If not, however, it would seem sensible to assist our allies with their preparations.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_MNAAGO_000_096: We'd be grateful for any and all help you can offer. If you ask around, I guarantee you won't want for work.
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_SONGGARLEANEMPIRE_1: Meanwhile, in the Royal Palace of Ala Mhigo...
TEXT_STMBDA131_02461_SONGGARLEANEMPIRE_0: Beyond majestic mountains, across the emerald dale,
On march the ivory standard, united we prevail
From distant shores of Othard, to lakes of Aldenard,
The light of mighty Garlemald, fore'er our guiding star
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_010:
And with that, another task is complete...
Ah, . I hear you have been keeping busy.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_015: Aye, that  has, and we thank  for it.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_CONRAD_000_016: It pleases me to inform you that our new recruits have completed their initial training and stand ready to contribute.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_CONRAD_000_017: As discussed, M'naago, I would have you present my proposal for an assault on Castellum Velodyna to General Aldynn personally.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_019: Are you and yours planning to return to Castrum Oriens before the operation? If so, why don't we travel together?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_100_019: That seems a fine suggestion, but I must consult my comrades ere we depart.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_200_019: Very well. I will wait for you at the pass. But not too long!
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_300_019: I expect Krile and Y'shtola will wish to remain here to support the chirurgeons, but nevertheless, we should go and ask them.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_YSHTOLA_000_101: ...I see. That would explain the sudden flurry of activity outside.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_102: This joint operation marks a turning point in our conflict with the Garleans. For the first time, the Resistance and the Alliance shall go on the offensive and attempt to capture an imperial outpost in occupied territory.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Personally, I believe it is imperative that we offer them our full support. As was the case with Ishgard, however, this is not a choice to be made lightly, nor less on others' behalves. This is war, and every Scion must decide what part he or she would play.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_LYSE_000_104: I'll fight. For Ala Mhigo, for my father, for Yda. I'm in it to the end.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_105: The choice was made for us ere we were born, Brother, when the Empire marched on Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_106: They will stop at nothing to subjugate or slaughter us all. Van Baelsar and van Darnus were but the first to try.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_107: ...Though your fervor is surprising, I cannot dispute your logic.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_108: At the risk of repeating myself, I am of course of the same mind. The present situation is untenable, and further complicated by the existence of Ilberd's primal. I believe we have no recourse but to directly and openly intervene.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_YSHTOLA_000_109: ...I thought this a foregone conclusion given our actions thus far, but if you require renewed affirmation, then yes, I am still wholly committed to this cause. For it is ultimately the selfsame cause I have served since first I pledged to serve Master Louisoix and the Circle of Knowing: the salvation of Eorzea, by any means necessary.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_YSHTOLA_000_110: That said, I shall refrain from taking the field on this occasion. There are many here who require further treatment, and doubtless more to come after.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_KRILE_000_111: I came here for Minfilia, and that hasn't changed. However, I'd like to stay with Y'shtola for now and tend to the wounded.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_112: As for you, ...you are, to quote our dear friend Lord Edmont, the  who  and some half-dozen primals besides. Your presence may well prove the difference between victory and defeat.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_113: Many look to you as a hero, and heap great expectations upon your shoulders. But you, like every Scion, must decide for yourself.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_A1_100_001: I'll fight. The Empire poses too great a threat.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_A1_100_002: We can but carry on. For those we have lost. For those we can yet save.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_A1_100_003: As long as there's a battle to be fought, I'll be there!
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_A1_100_004: To be frank, Alphy, this isn't my fight. But I will do what I must.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_114: Indeed. As you have doubtless seen during your time in the outlying villages, their so-called “meritocracy” is but a pretext to torture and enslave their “lesser” subjects. Such is the fate that awaits us all should their expansion continue unchecked.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_116: Hah! Ever the adventurer! You live for these moments, do you not?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_117: ...I see. While it pains me to hear you speak thus, I am grateful for your candor. There was a time when you would have kept such thoughts to yourself.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_118: Take care, Y'shtola, Krile, and do not hesitate to contact us should you require assistance. Lyse─I would ask that you remain here, by Conrad's side.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_119: We should go, or M'naago will leave without us.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Might I persuade you to join us, ? Should you wish to give your decision further consideration, Castrum Oriens would seem an apt place to do it. You need not answer right away. I am sure I can convince M'naago to wait a little longer.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_YSHTOLA_000_121: Ah yes, asking everyone's opinion before making a critical decision. Truly, this is a far better arrangement than having centralized leadership.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_KRILE_000_125: We'll have our work cut out for us after the operation, I fear, but we'll do what we can. That's all any of us can do, is it not?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_135: Grandfather stood with the army that faced the Garleans at Carteneau. This is dangerously close to becoming a family tradition...
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_140: Best make sure you've got everything you need! We might not be coming back for a while.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_130: So you will be accompanying us? Full glad am I to hear it.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_131: All set? Excellent. Then let us be off!
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_STORMOFFICER_000_02: Greetings and well met, . I have been dispatched from Limsa Lominsa to command the Maelstrom forces here.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_STORMOFFICER_100_02: This campaign has taken us quite far from the shores of Vylbrand. Though the logistics of a prolonged deployment have been the source of much consternation, I prefer to view it as an opportunity to strengthen ties with our allies, and to study their methods.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: A pleasure to meet you, . I oversee Adder operations here in the Elder Seedseer's stead.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: Rest assured that our scouts were handpicked from the elite ranks of the Gods' Quiver and the Wood Wailers. If the imperials take so much as one step into East End, we will know.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_PIPIN_000_030: I hear that Rhalgr's Reach is overrun with new recruits. Did I not tell you that we needed only to inspire the people to rise up once more?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_041: Greetings, General. I am come at Commander Kemp's behest to brief you on the latest developments at the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_042: Our recruitment efforts have exceeded expectations. In addition to welcoming many motivated young Ala Mhigans, our ranks have been bolstered by the arrival of a number of experienced veterans, thanks in large part to the efforts of the Scions.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_043: As a consequence, we are now able to field half a dozen new units, with more being trained as we speak.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_044: Good. I gather Conrad is eager to strike while the iron's hot?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_MNAAGO_000_045: Just so, General. He proposes that we begin preparations for a joint operation to capture Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_PIPIN_000_046: Capture Velodyna? That will not be easy. It will, however, be necessary if we are ever to push east towards the capital...
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_047: There is no profit in delay. It is only a matter of time before the Garleans learn of our plans and summon reinforcements.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_048: The Alliance hereby accepts Commander Kemp's proposal. Tell him to take no chances─bring every able-bodied Ala Mhigan who can wield a weapon.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_049: Pipin─I want Velodyna watched. Assess its defenses. Every fortress has a weakness, and I would know this one's.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_050: If there is no objection, General, might the Scions join Marshal Tarupin?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_051:
By all means.
If that is all─let us be about it!
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_STORMOFFICER_000_05: For an operation of this import, we cannot afford to hold too many in reserve. Surely the Maelstrom must take part in this assault!
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: This will be our largest engagement yet. Our conjurers will do their utmost to provide support, but we must be prepared to suffer significant casualties.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_PIPIN_000_065: An accurate assessment of their strengths and weaknesses will be key to our success. Measure twice, cut once, as the Gridanian carpenters are so fond of saying.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_RAUBAHN_000_070: Taking Velodyna will be the first significant step toward wresting Ala Mhigo from the Empire's grasp─but make no mistake: there will be many more such steps, each one taken at a cost.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALPHINAUD_000_075: A castellum is less a military installation and more a supply depot─a storage and distribution facility for the surrounding area. That being the case, taking it will not only earn us a strategic foothold, but deprive our enemy of valuable resources.
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_080: Conrad and the General are of one mind, it seems... I only wish I could say the same. While this aggressive strategy may well profit us in the end, what losses will we suffer in the meantime...?
TEXT_STMBDA132_02462_ALISAIE_000_081: Anyway, we should speak with the vice marshal about this reconnaissance mission and see how he would like to proceed.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_STORMOFFICER_000_00: For an operation of this import, we cannot afford to hold too many in reserve. Surely the Maelstrom must take part in this assault!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: This will be our largest engagement yet. Our conjurers will do their utmost to provide support, but we must be prepared to suffer significant casualties.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALISAIE_000_010: So Marshal Tarupin means to lead the reconnaissance mission himself, does he?
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_RAUBAHN_000_015: Taking Velodyna will be the first significant step toward wresting Ala Mhigo from the Empire's grasp─but make no mistake: there will be many more such steps, each one taken at a cost.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALPHINAUD_000_020: A castellum is less a military installation and more a supply depot─a storage and distribution facility for the surrounding area. That being the case, taking it will not only earn us a strategic foothold, but deprive our enemy of valuable resources.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_000_030: Thank you for volunteering to join me. This should be a fairly straightforward reconnaissance mission, so long as we do not have the ill fortune to run afoul of an imperial patrol.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_000_031: Come─our destination is beyond East End, just north of Velodyna.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALISAIE_000_040: Naught appears out of the ordinary at a glance...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Even should they be unaware of our plans, I would be surprised if their western defenses were not heavily fortified, given the presence of Allied forces at the Wall.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_000_050: This ought to be close enough. Now we settle in for a long watch.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_000_051: That said...it would be prudent to keep your weapons at the ready, in the event a passing patrol stumbles upon us, or worse...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_SYSTEM_000_052: Upon reconnoitering Castellum Velodyna, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_SYSTEM_000_053: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALISAIE_000_070: I...I'm fine, really. Never been better...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Don't speak or try to move! Take slow, steady breaths, and remain calm...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_000_080: Ugh... That is going to leave a mark.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_KRILE_000_090: You're worried about Y'shtola, aren't you? <sigh> It's too early to make any kind of prognosis, but...she's alive. For now.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_LYSE_000_095:
If it wasn't for her, it'd be me lying there...
...I wish it was.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_CONRAD_000_100: <pant> <pant> What about...what about the others? Where's M'naago? Where's Meffrid?
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_RAUBAHN_000_110: You did well, . You saved lives. No matter what happens, remember that.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_RAUBAHN_000_111: Now then─let's do what we can for the wounded. Every minute counts!
