TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_WISCAR_000_113: Godsdammit, Meffrid... Weren't you the one telling me to use my head and stay alive...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_HOSTAGE_BATTLETALK_: Gods help us, they're killing everyone!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: We have to stop them while there's still someone left to save!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_HOSTAGE_BATTLETALK_: The imperials came from nowhere...started cutting people down left and right...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL:
Reinforcements are on the way. Spread the word.
We should keep moving...
Confound it! Nothing for it but to fight.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_KRILE_BATTLETALK_00:
Twelve forfend... It's a bloodbath...
Remember that we're here to save lives! Defend the hostages!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_BATTLETALK_00: It's not too late for the others. We must hurry!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL:
What the─ Are those beastmen fighting for the imperials?
I've never seen them before...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_KAIHOUGUN_BATTLETAL: They...they took Lyse and the others deeper inside... You've...you've got...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_KRILE_BATTLETALK_00: There they are! We're not too late!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_FORDOLA_BATTLETALK_: Well, well. A rescue party, is it? We'll see about that.
Gah! Who in the seven hells are you!?
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: If we kill him, here and now, we can end this!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ZENOS_BATTLETALK_10: I have no need for this rabble.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_PIPIN_BATTLETALK_00: Seven hells... Not even Father could do that...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ZENOS_BATTLETALK_10: Hm. You yet stand. Mayhap you have potential.
It would seem I misjudged you. This ends now.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_TEBBE_000_120: Medicines, is it? Come on, come on, take what you need! I'm not about to be a stickler when there's lives to be saved!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_CARMA_000_121: Valiantly did we fight, but ultimately for naught...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_AHELISSA_000_122: What's done is done. The dead are dead. All I can do is feed the living and pray it helps them to grow stronger.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_RANULF_000_123: Bastards paid no heed to whether or not the men they slaughtered were armed. Some of the sutlers... Damn it all!
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ORTWIN_000_124: The imperials came from the Peaks. Somehow they knew about the tunnel...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_MATHILD_000_125: We came together as best we could, but in the end, there were just too many of them.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ODILA_000_126: I don't know... If we'd noticed sooner we could've used the cannons, but by the time we did, it was too late...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_DHANNA_000_127: There will be a reckoning. Mark my words...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_ORELLA_000_128: No time to talk. I must prepare more medicines.
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_EMMET_000_129: I know there were spare bandages here somewhere...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_BERINHARD_000_130: Gah... In the heat of battle I barely felt the pain, but when the fighting died down, it was all I could do to stay standing...
TEXT_STMBDA133_02463_HUGHOC_000_131: Herbs for the poultices, herbs for the poultices...
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_RAUBAHN_000_040: See to the wounded, . If they live, help them. If not, move on.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_SYSTEM_000_060: Meffrid lies motionless, having breathed his last. Clenched in his fist is a small charm, which you take for safekeeping.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_WISCAR_000_061:
He was already cold when I got to him... There was naught I could do.
That charm must've been important. You'd best take it to Conrad.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_WISCAR_000_062: Godsdammit Meffrid... Weren't you the one telling me to use my head and stay alive...
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_SYSTEM_000_065: You spare another moment for Meffrid, before turning away. Fishing in your pockets, your hand closes around his charm. Conrad must be told.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_ALISAIE_000_075: Heh...heh heh... You seem ready to burst into tears. I'd...fetch you a handkerchief, but...
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Damn it, Alisaie! This is serious! You need rest!
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_PIPIN_000_085: It makes no sense. He brushed us aside as if we were nothing...
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_KRILE_000_090: You're worried about Y'shtola, aren't you? <sigh> It's too early to make any kind of prognosis, but...she's alive. For now.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_LYSE_000_095:
If it wasn't for her, it'd be me lying there...
...I wish it was.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_CONRAD_000_112: Meffrid was a worrier. Always thinking about others before himself. He once had an imperial patrol chase him nigh on twenty malms so that his wounded would have time to escape...
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_CONRAD_000_113: His comrades loved him for it, of course...though that only made him worry more. Did you know that he sent his men in Quarrymill away because he thought they were fighting for him, and not the cause? Aye, well, he did. The only life he was willing to risk was his own, you see.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_CONRAD_000_114: But that's exactly the kind of man who should be leader! The kind of man who deserves to survive. Not a...not an old fool who's all used up.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_ALPHINAUD_000_115: ...There's no logic to it, Master Kemp. There never is.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_ALPHINAUD_000_116: Who stands, who falls... In the heat of battle, we can but do our best─as he did. Meffrid will be sorely missed, aye...but because of his sacrifice, many now live who otherwise would not─and they need us, now more than ever.
TEXT_STMBDA134_02464_CONRAD_000_117: Aye...aye, that they do. Forgive me. I had...high hopes for him, is all...
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_CONRAD_000_010: I'll recover. My injuries aren't serious─though that was clearly by choice and not happenstance. They meant to take me alive.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_KRILE_000_015: You're worried about Y'shtola, aren't you? <sigh> It's too early to make any kind of prognosis, but...she's alive. For now.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_LYSE_000_020:
If it wasn't for her, it'd be me lying there...
...I wish it was.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_030: Our defeat was no near thing. It was total─a humiliation. We were powerless to withstand our enemy's assault.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_031: But we cannot afford to dwell on our failure. As Alphinaud said, it is those who survived whom we must think of now.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_032: Rhalgr's Reach is no longer safe. The imperials may have withdrawn, but they could return at any time to finish what they began. We dare not remain here.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_033: Those who are not fit to make the journey to Castrum Oriens will need to be taken by chocobo carriage. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_034: Good. I shall oversee preparations for the carriages. In the meantime, I would have you scour the infirmary for any supplies that might prove useful during the journey.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ORELLA_100_040: Forgive me, but it is imperative that I continue preparing medicines for the wounded. If you desire treatment, I must ask that you seek it elsewhere.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ORELLA_100_041: Oh, I see... In that case, you are free to search the Barber and take that which you require. I would not have our people dying en route.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ORELLA_100_042: I would assist you, but this process demands my undivided attention.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ORELLA_200_042: Take whatever you require for your needs. I will replenish the stock after.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ALISAIE_000_045: We're to move the wounded to Castrum Oriens? Understood. I'll go and see if anyone requires assistance.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I will accompany Commander Kemp in one of the carriages.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_CONRAD_000_055: No, no, I'd hate to be a burden...
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_KRILE_000_060: We'll need to carry Y'shtola to the carriage. Could you give me a hand, Lyse?
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_LYSE_000_065: As if you need to ask!
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_FLAMECOURIER_000_07: . Marshal Tarupin said you might have something for me?
Twelve be praised. This should put the drivers' hearts at ease. Tell the vice marshal we await his orders.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_KRILE_000_082: Y'shtola and the others are safely strapped in. Don't worry─I'll be by her side the entire time.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_LYSE_000_084: I'll walk alongside. They'll need protection in case the Garleans try anything.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_LYSE_000_085: Hang on. You're injured too, aren't you? Shouldn't you be in one of the carriages?
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_CONRAD_000_086: I'm not so frail that I can't make the trip on my own. Besides, there's still work to be done here. I'll see you at the Wall when it's finished.
TEXT_STMBDA135_02465_PIPIN_000_087: As you wish. Then let us set forth at once. We shall move as quickly as our comrades' health allows.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALISAIE_000_001: Let us pray they arrive safely...
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Master Kemp, your concern for your men's well-being is commendable, but I would urge you to consider your own.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_CONRAD_000_010: You saved a good many of my men, and I cannot thank you enough for that.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_CONRAD_000_011: ...But the fact remains: our forces were decimated. In this state, we'll not be mounting an assault on Castellum Velodyna or anywhere else.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_CONRAD_000_012: We need to be honest with ourselves about our prospects. But first, we need to put our affairs here in order. Afterwards, I'll join you all at Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Understood. We will go and speak with General Aldynn.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALISAIE_000_020: I can see the Reach means a lot to these people...but it would be suicide to stay.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_025: For more than a decade, the Resistance has resided here, hidden from the eyes of the Empire. And just when we set our sights on Velodyna, they strike. Do you not find that passing strange?
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_RAUBAHN_000_030: Pipin has already departed with the wounded, has he? Good. We have completed our search of the Reach and the surrounding area.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_RAUBAHN_000_031: As far as we can tell, Zenos and his men returned straightways to Specula Imperatoris after quitting this place. 'Twould seem he's lost interest in us.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Which brings us to the most troubling question of all─not how he found us, but why he chose to spare our lives having done so.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_RAUBAHN_000_033: In war, you kill or capture your enemy. You don't leave him to fight another day. Only a fool would turn his back and walk away...but Zenos is no fool.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_RAUBAHN_000_034: Whatever his motive, this is neither the time nor the place to think on it. I will leave a token force to watch over the Reach. The rest will fall back to Castrum Oriens. We can discuss our path forward there.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_STORMOFFICER_000_04: How in Llymlaen's name did they find the Reach? I thought their glamours were impenetrable.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I have called upon Stillglade Fane to send every available conjurer, no matter how inexperienced, to help with the wounded. I pray it will be enough.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_050: Krile is with Y'shtola. She still hasn't woken up, but...Krile says she's through the worst.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Given the severity of her wound, we could have hoped for no more. Let us pray she makes a full recovery.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_052: We lost a lot of good people, didn't we...
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_053: I saw it happen. When that Skulls commander cut down Meffrid. A single blow, and that was it.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_054: Everything he fought for, all his hopes and dreams for the future. Gone in an instant. And do you want to know the worst part? It wasn't a Garlean who did it─it was an Ala Mhigan.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_055:
Gods help me, if I ever─
No. Not now. Not while the General's waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALISAIE_000_060: So we fight on, come what may. Sentiment notwithstanding, what other choice did we have?
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_RAUBAHN_000_065: If the rumors are to be believed, this is not the first time Zenos has “spared” his foes. They say he abides by an unusual code, and takes pleasure in the fight. Whatever his reasons, we must use this time to our advantage.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_CONRAD_000_070: We've got a long road ahead of us...but it all begins with the first step.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_CONRAD_000_075: We'll stay in the Reach and rebuild. We'll reinforce our defenses. And if they come again, we'll be ready.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_PIPIN_000_080: I wish you well on your journey, my friend. Let us pray that when we meet again, our fortunes will be much changed.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_LYSE_000_085: I can't deny a part of me wants to stay and fight... But I know I'd be more use to you and the others.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_KRILE_000_090: You've said your piece, yes? Now would you please return to bed? You'll never recover if you carry on like this!
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_MNAAGO_000_095: <pant> <pant> Ye gods, the pain... It seemed like a good idea at the time...
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_100: It goes without saying, but the Scions alone have not the strength to topple a provincial government, here or anywhere else.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_101: And I am quite certain the same can be said of the Doman Liberation Front. Nevertheless, we can but go and assess the situation for ourselves, and see what can be done.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_102: Lest you doubt what good we few can accomplish, I would remind you that my grandfather and his twelve disciples once journeyed to these lands to save Eorzea and her people from certain doom.
TEXT_STMBDA136_02466_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Our present mission may not be as monumental in scope, but it is no less important to the multitudes whom we would free from imperial oppression─whom we will free.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_STORMOFFICER_100_00: How in Llymlaen's name did they find the Reach? I thought their glamours were impenetrable.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: I have called upon Stillglade Fane to send every available conjurer, no matter how inexperienced, to help with the wounded. I pray it will be enough.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_001: That which is beyond one alone may yet be within reach of the many.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_RAUBAHN_000_005: If there is truth in the rumors, this is not the first time Zenos has “spared” his foes. They say he abides by an unusual code, and takes pleasure in the fight. Whatever his reasons, we must use this time to our advantage.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CONRAD_000_010: We've got a long road ahead of us...but it all begins with the first step.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CONRAD_000_015: We'll stay in the Reach and rebuild. We'll reinforce our defenses. And if they come again, we'll be ready.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_PIPIN_000_020: I wish you well on your journey, my friend. Let us pray that when we meet again, our fortunes will be much changed.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_LYSE_000_025: I can't deny a part of me wants to stay and fight... But I know I'd be more use to you and the others.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_KRILE_000_030: You've said your piece, yes? Now would you please return to bed? You'll never recover if you carry on like this!
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_MNAAGO_000_035: <pant> <pant> Ye gods, the pain... It seemed like a good idea at the time...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_040: "Where men go as one, there is life. And where there is life, there is cause to hope.“ Our grandfather believed that, and so do I...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_041: But before we can forge ties with our friends in the Far East, we must first find a way to reach them. Othard is not exactly over the river and through the woods.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_042: I am one step ahead of you, dear sister─or rather, Tataru is. But before we discuss that, there is another issue I wish to address.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Much as I would like it if we could all make this journey together, someone will need to remain to serve as liaison to the Alliance and the Resistance during this critical period. Moreover, as Y'shtola cannot be left unattended...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_KRILE_000_044: ...Then I should obviously remain? Very well. Issue addressed.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_KRILE_000_045: You know, Alphinaud, it would have been quicker just to ask─and markedly less patronizing.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Y-Yes, I suppose, uh... Ahem. Would you be willing to look after Y'shtola and provide support to Arenvald and the others?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_KRILE_000_047:
Yes, Alphinaud. I would.
You see? That wasn't so hard, was it? Enjoy your trip, and don't you dare return with a gift!
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_048:
Oh, I would not dream of it...
Right, then. Sister, , Lyse─gather your things. We are for Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_LYSE_000_050: Vylbrand was always Y'shtola's domain. I haven't spent much time here, to be honest...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_055: I spoke with Urianger and Thancred along the way. To say they were surprised by our stratagem would be something of an understatement, but they did not dispute its logic.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Tataru should be here any moment with our ship's captain.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_LYSE_000_061: So we're going by sea after all. Is Merlwyb lending us our pick of the Crimson Fleet?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Not...exactly. You are right, in as much as we will be traveling by sea. Regrettably, it is simply not feasible for an airship to travel such a distance without impossibly large fuel reserves, to say nothing of the inevitability of running afoul of the Empire's aerial defenses.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_063: ...But then it is equally infeasible to sail an Eorzean Alliance vessel halfway around the world without the Empire taking notice.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Which leaves us with only one other option... Ah, speak of the devil.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_000_065: Sorry to keep you waiting! May I present to you Captain Carvallain of the Kraken's Arms!
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_066: The Kraken's Arms!? Don't tell me you made a deal with pirates!
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_000_067: Greetings and salutations, Scions. I take it from your comrade's tone that you no longer wish to proceed with our proposed arrangement?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_068: Not at all, Captain. Pray forgive my sister her outburst─she has ever been one to speak her mind. I, on the other hand, am the very soul of discretion, as many well-respected personages would attest, from the offices of the Admiral, to the High Houses of Ishgard.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_069: Ah, but where was I? Oh, yes! The Scions of the Seventh Dawn do indeed still wish to employ your services. However, it is important that you are aware of certain extenuating circumstances...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_000_070: ...And intent on securing passage to the Far East, you came to us, knowing us to be the proud purveyors of said region's finest spices.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_071: ...Which you steal from gods-fearing merchants out on the high seas.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_000_072: Whatever privateering the Kraken's Arms may or may not engage in is strictly within the limits of the law, as set forth by our indefatigable keeper of the peace. More to the point, we are pragmatists. I see considerable risk in aiding your cause, and negligible profit.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_000_073: Well, I for one think the captain has a point. The five seas can be extremely treacherous, and many a poor, unfortunate soul has to come to grief out there on the waves.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_000_074: Why, when we were in Ishgard, I heard the tragical tale of how the heir to House Durendaire vanished at sea!
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_100_074: Even now, nearly twenty years later, the poor count remains convinced that his son still lives, and would pay a sultan's ransom for news of his whereabouts...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_000_076: Truly a tragedy for the ages, and a testament to the misfortunes that may befall us should we act without...due consideration. But so long as you are prepared to abide the capricious whims of fate, I am willing to oblige you this once.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_100_076: That said, in light of the recent rebellion, I trust you understand that I cannot deliver you to Doma itself. I can take you only as far as Kugane, in Hingashi.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_CARVALLAIN_000_077: We will require time to procure sufficient provisions and make ready for departure. I humbly suggest you do the same.
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_LYSE_000_080: I'm not sure what just happened. I could have sworn he was about to turn us away, but then he...changed his mind?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALISAIE_000_085: (Blackmail, is it? This is a dangerous game the two of them are playing... What guarantee do we have that Carvallain won't just throw us overboard?)
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_000_090: The poor little boy had only seen fourteen summers when he left Ishgard. Can you imagine what it must have felt like─to finally be free to explore the world, unbeholden to all the stuffy traditions of the Holy See?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_TATARU_000_095: Such a shame that he never returned home. Without him, the Count de Durendaire must look elsewhere for a successor...and the good Lord Jannequinard is one step closer to being the next in line...
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Suddenly, all those hours Tataru passed cavorting and capering at the Forgotten Knight seem rather better spent, do they not?
TEXT_STMBDA137_02467_ALPHINAUD_000_101: (That said, I had intended to press the point more obliquely... And there was something disconcerting about the pleasure Tataru took in making Captain Carvallain squirm...)
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_001: I'm not sure what just happened. I could have sworn he was about to turn us away, but then he...changed his mind?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALISAIE_000_005: (Blackmail, is it? This is a dangerous game the two of them are playing... What guarantee do we have that Carvallain won't just throw us overboard?)
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_TATARU_000_010: The poor little boy had only seen fourteen summers when he left Ishgard. Can you imagine what it must have felt like─to finally be free to explore the world, unbeholden to all the stuffy traditions of the Holy See?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_TATARU_000_015: Such a shame that he never returned home. Without him, the Count de Durendaire must look elsewhere for a successor...and the good Lord Jannequinard is one step closer to being the next in line...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I say we should heed the captain's advice and attend to our own preparations while they ready the vessel for departure.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Tataru and I will procure the necessary supplies. Alisaie...I should be grateful if you would use the time to brief Urianger on recent developments. You may also wish to review the relevant safety procedures in the event of an emergency at sea.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALISAIE_000_022: How...how very prudent of you. Very well, I shall go and speak with him. What of  and Lyse?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALPHINAUD_000_023: I would like the two of you to return to Revenant's Toll and speak with our Doman allies. I fear we know too little of their homeland, and any information they can provide would be most welcome.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_ALPHINAUD_000_024: When we have completed our respective tasks, we will reconvene here at the ferry docks. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_025: Sounds like a plan! Let's go, !
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_030: Well, here we are. We'll need to talk to lots of people, so I think we should split up.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_031: I'll ask around at the House of Splendors. You take the Rising Stones. I'll meet you here after. Got it?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOMEI_000_040:
You are truly planning to travel to Doma? I...I do not know what to say...
Forgive me. I shall aid you to the best of my ability.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOMEI_000_041: Ours is a beautiful land, nestled on the eastern coast of Othard. Along the banks of the One River, our nation thrived, proud and free, until the Garleans came, twenty-five years ago...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOMEI_000_042: The river was our lifeblood, free to travel and to fish...but travel was soon restricted, and now the river belongs to none...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOMEI_000_045: I remember sitting on the banks of the One River as a child, watching the fishing boats drift by...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOMEI_000_050: But now the One River is closed to all. The Moon Gates open for none.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_100_060: Greetings, . What brings you to the Toll this ?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_000_060: What? You are for Doma? Heavens... You Scions have shown us naught but kindness, but never in my wildest dreams did I imagine you would fight for our homeland...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_000_061: For twenty-five years we suffered under their tyranny. And then we spied an opportunity─the Emperor, dead! Garlemald in chaos!
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_000_062: It seemed the time was ripe. Beneath our lord's banners we gathered, and fought to reclaim our nation. But when Zenos arrived with the XIIth Legion, it was over in an instant...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_000_065: Lord Kaien was a good man who cared only for his people. Though it pained him to kneel to Garlemald, he did so for our sake. And for our sake, he would willingly have endured that ignominy for another twenty-five years, had we not beseeched him to act.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HIGIRI_000_070: But we convinced him that we could win. That we could defeat Zenos and the Empire. And for our failure, he paid the ultimate price...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_100_080: Hm? What is it, my friend? You look as though you have something to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_000_080: That you go to join Yugiri and Gosetsu in the fight fills me with such joy! Ah, forgive my exuberance. You require information, yes?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_000_081: We of the Nagae clan have served Doma faithfully for generations. My ancestors held positions within Doma Castle, even. Now it is home to the imperial viceroy's witch, and her host of men and magitek.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_000_082: To think that what was once the shining symbol of our heritage─and the seat of dear Lord Kaien─has become a den for Garlean dogs...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_000_085: Doma was all but wiped from the face of Othard. Only Doma Castle, seat of our Lord and symbol of all that we were, was spared the wages of war.
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_HOZAN_000_090: Yet for the blessing that that is, the thought of that witch and her sycophants claiming it for their own fills me with unspeakable anger...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_100: Ah, there you are! Learn anything interesting? The older Domans I spoke with tried to teach me all about Far Eastern customs and the importance of formality and politeness...
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_101: I'd like to think Eorzeans can be just as stiff and stuffy as anyone─especially Ishgardians─but anyway... Did you know they eat with sticks? It wasn't all that hard, actually─or at least, that's what I thought until they told me I was holding them wrong. And then when I spoke with the younger Domans, they just rolled their eyes and told me it was all a load of stupid old─ Hm?
TEXT_STMBDA138_02468_LYSE_000_102: Wow... What you learned sounds a lot more useful. Unless someone invites us for dinner, of course. I hope they do.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_LYSE_000_001: Right. No point waiting around here, is there?
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_LYSE_000_002: We should head back to Limsa Lominsa. Alphinaud said to meet at the ferry docks, I think?
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_LYSE_000_010: It's times like this I'm glad we've got Tataru taking care of business.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_015: "An army marches on its stomach.“ Tataru took that lesson to heart.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_TATARU_000_020: A surfeit of sumptuous foods, wondrous sundries, plenty of clean undergarments... Yes, I do believe we have everything we need for a lengthy voyage!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: The Misery is the finest ship ever to sail the Rhotano, and I'll not hear any man say otherwise!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_030: You are returned, . I trust you learned much from our Doman friends in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_031: I am eager to hear all─though that can wait until we have left port. We will have time enough to talk on our journey to Kugane.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Our spice-trading friends have completed their preparations. Assuming you have completed yours, you may inform the deckhand that we are ready to depart.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_100_033: Something left undone, my friend? If not, let us be off.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: All set, ? I'll see you to the ship if so.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_100: How in the blue blazes did you─ Ugh, naught for it but to get our fastest ship to take you to the Misery.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: This ain't right. This ain't right at all.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Well? Do you have any idea what's going on?
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_042: ...No. As the man said, despite the absence of wind and current, the Misery is somehow being pulled off course.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_043: Well, why not fire up the ceruleum engines you have hidden below?
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_044: An excellent suggestion based on knowledge you should not have. Alas, our engines appear to be malfunctioning for reasons that escape my engineers at present...
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: I'm telling you, Captain, it's them...things the lads saw...
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_046: "Things“? I don't suppose I could convince you to attempt something more descriptive? An adjective, for example.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_047: Sea Wolf superstitions and faerie tales, naught more... But if you must know, the “things” which he is so reticent to name are the souls of deceased women said to lure sailors to their deaths.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_049: Yeees, indeed... If it is neither the sea nor the weather which is responsible, then it is probably a predatory entity of some sort─perhaps a siren or some such.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_050: For all we know, it could be a fellow “spice trader” employing magicks to seize and plunder passing vessels.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_051: Regardless, we have but one recourse: to let the current take us where it will, and deal with whatever we find there.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_052: What a thoroughly pragmatic suggestion. Oh, I am beginning to like you, girl.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_101_053: Once we arrive at our destination, my crew shall remain with the ship to defend it while we venture forth to deal with the cause of our troubles.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_054: Then it is settled! I know not what awaits us, but it will rue the day it reeled us in!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_LYSE_000_055: I'll make sure Tataru stays below deck until we know it's safe.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALISAIE_000_060: Alphinaud was terrified of ghost stories as a child. I'm glad to see that some things never change.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Wh-What? Why are you looking at me like that? I am calm and collected as ever! Carry on!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: I'm not saying that I believe beyond a shadow of a doubt that vengeful spirits are plotting our demise at this very moment! I'm just saying we cannot discount the possibility!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_075: (The fiery one─Alisaie, was it? 'Tis a pity she holds our profession in such disdain. She would make an excellent pirate.)
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: Glad that's over and done with. Sorry about the delay, eh? We'll be in Kugane before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_LYSE_000_080: I...I don't know what I was expecting, but it wasn't this.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_ALPHINAUD_000_090: By the Twelve, I have never been happier to be back on terra firma... Our voyage has instilled in me a new appreciation for surfaces which do not move of their own accord.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_TATARU_000_095: Strange... Is it just me, or is the ground swaying?
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: Thanks again for, uh, saving us from certain death at the hands of Lorelei and whatnot. We'll not soon forget it.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_110: Congratulations. You now stand in Kugane, the western port of Hingashi. Regrettably, the only port in this nation open to foreign trade.
TEXT_STMBDA139_02469_CARVALLAIN_000_111: Oh, and I do apologize for the unforeseen difficulties which befell us during our journey. Needless to say, your assistance in overcoming them was much appreciated.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_LYSE_000_001: I...I don't know what I was expecting, but it wasn't this.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_TATARU_000_010: Strange... Is it just me, or is the ground swaying?
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_015: Myriad delights await you, should you elect to explore and experience─assuming you are sufficiently open-minded, that is. I, alas, cannot afford to linger...
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_KRAKENSDECKHAND_000: Thanks again for, uh, saving us from certain death at the hands of Lorelei and whatnot. We'll not soon forget it.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Glad though I am to have arrived, I would remind you all that we are far from home, with limited resources at our disposal...
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALISAIE_000_026: Duly noted, Brother. I shall take care not to enjoy myself. In any event, Doma is our final destination, and our first order of business should be to secure passage there.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Captain Carvallain, I realize you pledged only to take us as far as Kugane, and I have no desire to change the terms of our agreement. I should, however, be interested to know how you would go about reaching Othard, were you in our position.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_028: At the risk of stating the obvious...you are in a port. Surely there is a kind and generous soul here who will aid you for the right price? You cannot be the first travelers seeking passage to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_029: ...The captain makes a good point. 'Tis like that Yugiri and Gosetsu were forced to come here for the selfsame reasons we were. They must have found a way to Othard─assuming they are not still in the city.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Hmm... Ere we seek passage, mayhap we should first seek our friends.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_TATARU_000_031: Leave it to me, Alphinaud! Making friendly inquiries is my specialty. Lest you forget, I got plenty of practice in Ishgard!
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_TATARU_000_032: Captain Carvallain, could you direct us to the nearest tavern?
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_033: Desperate for a drink, are we? You may find one in that large building just beyond the pier.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_034: Whether your journeys have come to an end or are about to begin, the Shiokaze Hostelry is an ideal place to rest, relax, and reflect. Or so they say.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_035: And with that, my dear Scions, I bid you farewell. As soon as we have replenished our supplies, we must away. Ours was ever a fast-moving business.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_CARVALLAIN_000_037: But of course. Surely you did not think I traveled halfway around the world and delivered you to your destination solely out of the kindness of my heart?
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_038: Perish the thought. Thank you, Captain, and may the Navigator watch over and keep you.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_LYSE_000_045: So there are imperial spies everywhere? Great. Just great...
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALISAIE_000_050: (I daresay Alphinaud has met his match.)
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_TATARU_000_055: (I don't trust him one bit...and neither should you!)
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Forgive me. The mere mention of the East Aldenard Trading Company is enough to... <mumble> <mumble> I am fine. Truly. You need not worry.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_070: And you must be ! Slayer of Gods... Rider of Dragons... Savior of Ishgard... Stealer of Pants─if some of the more puzzling rumors are to be believed.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_071: I knew it! May I say what an honor and a pleasure it is to make your acquaintance, . I just know you and I are going to get along famously!
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_072: Now then, without further ado, allow me to escort you to the company offices.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_073: This being your first visit to our fair city, I shall make an effort to point out various landmarks along the way. If you would be so good as to follow me!
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_LYSE_000_080: Even the aetherytes look different here...
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALISAIE_000_081: I note that our would-be host has elected to dress in the local fashion.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_TATARU_000_082: <sniff> <sniff> I say, what is that I smell wafting from yonder teahouse? Could it be─ Yes, could it just possibly be the scent of whispered secrets waiting to be overheard?
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_ALPHINAUD_000_083: I do not like the cut of that man's jib. Not one bit.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_090: Everyone! If I could have your attention, please. You are now standing in Tenkonto.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_091: Loosely translated, the name means “spire of drifting souls,” which─as some of you may have deduced─makes reference to the aetheryte which stands over yonder.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_092: Hmm... The design is markedly different from those of Sharlayan, yet I trust its function is identical?
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_093: A diplomat and a scholar! Will wonders never cease.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_094: Far Eastern aetheryte technologies have a long and storied tradition, I assure you. This particular example was constructed by the Onishishu, a collective of skilled craftsmen, who guard their ancestral techniques with the utmost secrecy.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_HANCOCK_000_095: In short, you will find it no less reliable than its western counterparts. Attune, if you like.
TEXT_STMBDA201_02470_EATCASSISTANT_000_1: Greetings, , and welcome to the Kugane branch offices of the East Aldenard Trading Company. Do you have an appointment?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_LYSE_000_001: Even the aetherytes look different here...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALISAIE_000_005: I note that our would-be host has elected to dress in the local fashion.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_TATARU_000_010: <sniff> <sniff> I say, what is that I smell wafting from yonder teahouse? Could it be─ Yes, could it just possibly be the scent of whispered secrets waiting to be overheard?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I do not like the cut of that man's jib. Not one bit.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_020: Beautiful though it may be, we cannot spend all day staring at the aetheryte.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_021: Come, come, let us move along. The markets are next!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_LYSE_100_030: No sign of Gosetsu or Yugiri here. Not that I expected to stumble across them just like that. Though it would have been nice...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALISAIE_100_031:
Just look at all these garish designs... Not fond of subtlety, are they.
Hm, is that a theater over there?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALPHINAUD_100_033: Well, well. I would expect no less of a bustling port...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_040: We have arrived at the largest shopping district in Kugane: Kogane Dori!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_041: "Kugane,“ as you are doubtless unaware, is an ancient Hingan word for gold. So, in this prosperous port where golden fortunes are made, lesser fortunes, or ”kogane,“ are earned by the local merchants. It's all quite logical once you learn the language.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_TATARU_000_042: Heh heh heh... Now you're beginning to speak my language...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_043: Oho! A kindred spirit! What a pleasure it is to meet a young lady who appreciates the value of hard-won coin!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_KEITEN_000_044: (-???-)Hancock of the East Aldenard Trading Company. You are with clients today?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_045: Why, if it isn't Master Keiten! Pray allow me to introduce to you my esteemed guests, but recently come from distant Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_046: This kind and generous soul supervises all transactions here in Kogane Dori.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_KEITEN_000_047: Your sincerity is ever appreciated. As he says, I am Keiten of the Hakuuchi clan, and it is my honor to serve as overseer of these markets.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_KEITEN_000_048: As we receive many foreign visitors in Kugane, we accept all manner of currencies. Rest assured, your Eorzean gil are welcome here. I invite you to peruse our wares at your leisure.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_049: Arms, armor, foodstuffs, potables─here you will find all of them and more.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALISAIE_200_031: Hmm... We're actually quite far from the docks now, aren't we. This place is bigger than I thought.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_TATARU_200_032: Don't think I haven't memorized every detail of that street! There's at least half a dozen shops that will soon be enjoying my custom!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALPHINAUD_200_033: Hmm...the district up ahead has a different air about it.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_060: If we may pause here for a moment...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_061: This road leads to the Ijin-gai: the district in which “ijin”─or foreigners─are permitted to reside.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Would this also be where the foreign embassies are found─including that of a certain empire?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_063: Precisely. So you see, it would not be at all unusual to cross paths with one of our Garlean cousins here. With this in mind, I would encourage you to choose your words carefully. We would not want any physical altercations, after all, such spats being strictly forbidden!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_064: The Sekiseigumi punish breaches of the peace quite severely. I have seen foreigners permanently exiled for a single violation─though, to be fair, this is not common. More often than not, they are executed on the spot.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_LYSE_000_065: What, cut down then and there!? You're joking, right?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_066: Would that I were, but alas, these samurai are a humorless lot.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_067: Why, I recall one instance when a foreign merchant in his cups dared lay hands upon a Hingan aristocrat in front of a Sekiseigumi. The samurai cut him in half with a single stroke.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_LYSE_000_068: Ugh, I don't even want to think about that...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_069: So, as you see, it would behoove you to behave. Failing that, we may be forced to “part ways” with one another─or you with yourselves, in the manner of the late Teledji Adeledji!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_070: ...Oh, how I amuse myself. But we must carry on! I have yet to show you the Garlean Consulate!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_LYSE_000_080: So that building's full of Garleans...
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALISAIE_000_081: Some might call it unwise to loiter outside the gates of a hostile empire's consulate.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_ALPHINAUD_000_083: Compared to the Hingan architecture, this seems drab and uninspired. Or mayhap I have simply had my fill of Garlean aesthetics, such as they are.
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_090: This, as you may have surmised, is the consulate of you-know-who. Mark the guards at the gate─are their uniforms not different from those you have seen in the West?
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_HANCOCK_000_091: Were you to travel far and wide, you would find that many such variations exist, often inspired by local designs. All of which goes to show that even a massive empire seeking to rule all of creation is not without its artisans!
TEXT_STMBDA202_02471_EATCASSISTANT_000_1: Greetings, , and welcome to the Kugane branch offices of the East Aldenard Trading Company. Do you have an appointment?
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_LYSE_000_001: So that building's filled with Garleans...
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALISAIE_000_005: Some might deem it unwise to loiter outside the gates of the consulate of a hostile empire.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Compared to the Hingan architecture, this is drab and uninspired. Or perhaps I've had my fill of Garlean aesthetics, such as they are.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_HANCOCK_000_020: There is oh so much more I could speak of─the soothing waters of the onsen, the ephemeral delights of the pleasure district─but you are doubtless still weary from your long sea voyage.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_HANCOCK_000_021: Let us retire to the company offices.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_LYSE_000_025: Even though this feels just as out of place as the Garlean Consulate, it's a lot more...comforting.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALISAIE_000_026: ...There is no denying that this place was built for an Ul'dahn.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_TATARU_000_027: Ahhh, the unmistakable scent of wealth and power...
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALPHINAUD_000_028: (I daresay we could travel to Meracydia or the New World and find a man like Hancock waiting for us.)
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_EATCASSISTANT_000_0: Greetings, sirs and ladies, and welcome to the Kugane branch offices of the East Aldenard Trading Company.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_HANCOCK_000_040: At long last, we arrive at our destination. May I present to you our humble offices.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_HANCOCK_000_041: We have much to discuss, so I will refrain from further prattle. Come, come, right this way!
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_LYSE_000_045: I'm not sure how I imagined our time in the Far East unfolding, but it definitely didn't involve Ul'dahns. And especially not these Ul'dahns. Still...whatever works, right?
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALISAIE_000_050: He was not exaggerating when he spoke of their wards' efficacy. Whoever wove them did so with consummate skill...
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_TATARU_000_055: Oh, this place takes me back! It reminds me of the workshop of an Ul'dahn lapidary I once served!
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_HANCOCK_000_056: I must confess, I am an avid collector of all things Far Eastern. See for yourself. I insist!
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Though I am reluctant to take any action whatsoever that could be construed as placing ourselves in Lord Lolorito's debt...we must avail ourselves of what means are available.
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Our Ala Mhigan allies placed their faith in us, and I do not intend to disappoint them...
TEXT_STMBDA203_02472_EATCASSISTANT_000_0: The Scions are always welcome here. Shall I show you inside?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_001: I'm not sure how I imagined our time in the Far East unfolding, but it definitely didn't involve Ul'dahns. And especially not these Ul'dahns. Still...whatever works, right?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALISAIE_000_005: He was not exaggerating when he spoke of their wards' efficacy. Whoever wove them did so with consummate skill...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_TATARU_000_010: Oh, this place takes me back! It reminds me of the workshop of an Ul'dahn lapidary I once served!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_HANCOCK_000_011: I must confess, I am an avid collector of all things Far Eastern. See for yourself. I insist!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALPHINAUD_000_020: It would seem inefficient for us all to venture out together in search of information on Yugiri and Gosetsu's whereabouts. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALISAIE_000_021: Agreed. We need to cast our net wider─split up and pursue all available avenues of inquiry. But if we're to coordinate our efforts effectively, we'll need to establish a working base of operations here.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Indeed. Tataru would seem best suited to the task of organizing our supplies and procuring new ones.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALPHINAUD_000_023: While she attends to that, we four can begin our search by questioning the individuals Hancock identified. Alisaie and I will take those in the southern districts of the city, and the two of you can take those in the north.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_ALPHINAUD_000_024: In, uh...anticipation of just such an eventuality, I took the liberty of preparing some few sketches of Yugiri and Gosetsu during our voyage.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_025: Wow... Y'shtola warned me that you were a bit of an artist, but these are great! They'll definitely come in handy.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_026: Looks like it's you and me, . Let's step outside and talk about where to start!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_TATARU_000_030: Leave everything here to me! If I can keep the Waking Sands, the Rising Stones, and the Falling Snows afloat, then this should be easy! I just need to think of a new name. The Blooming Cherry Blossoms? No, no, that's no good...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_027: Wow, Alphinaud's sketches are so... I don't know how to put it, but they're very...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_SYSTEM_000_028: You may view Alphinaud's sketch at any time during this quest by using the relevant item in the Key Items menu.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_100_028: Go on, take a look! You'll see what I mean.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_SYSTEM_200_028: You may view Alphinaud's sketch at any time during this quest by using the relevant item in the Key Items menu.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_029: It looks more like them than they do! Honestly, he could make a living doing this...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_031: Ah, sorry, sorry! No time for distractions! Why don't we start by visiting...Karaku at the...on-something? Onsun? Onsan? Onsen! That was it!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_040: Come one, come all! Burns, cuts, embarrassing rashes─there is naught that the mystical waters of the Bokaisen Hot Springs cannot heal!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_041: Ho, what is that in your hand?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_042: Hmm...you seek this Au Ra and this Roegadyn, do you?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_043: A thousand apologies, but I cannot help you. It is against our policy to divulge information regarding patrons past or present.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_044: Please! We came all the way from Eorzea to find our friends!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_045: We have our reputation to consider, miss. Men and women from all walks of life come here in search of rejuvenation─body and soul.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_046: They seek privacy and discretion, and we have ever honored their wishes. Only the Sekiseigumi may demand otherwise. I am sorry, but there is naught I can do.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_047: I suppose we'll just have to ask someone else, then. What about that woman who runs the hostelry? Kotokaze, was it?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KARAKU_000_050: You seem a kind soul, and it pains me that I cannot help you. If the strain of your troubles weighs too heavily on your heart, I could recommend a number of treatments...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_060: Welcome, traveler. Can I interest you in some rice wine? Exceptional quality, delivered but the other day...
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_061: ...Ah. An Auri shinobi and a Roegadyn samurai. If I may, I would answer your question with some few of mine own.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_062: If I speak of that which you know, ijin, be not offended. You are familiar with the situation in the lands across the Ruby Sea? The doomed rebellion, after two and a half decades of quiet?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_063: I see. And you are familiar with the ways of Hingashi? How we elect to stand apart and support no cause but our own? Indifferent and callous, some may call us, but pragmatism is essential if a humble island nation such as ours is to survive.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_064: But we are not fools. Complete isolation is impractical. And so Kugane is open to ijin, and we are equally hospitable to all. Or, if I must speak more plainly: Yes, I can help you. But if I do, I must also oblige the ones who ask after you.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_065: Are you willing to accept this fair and equitable treatment?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_066: If anyone comes looking for us, tell them whatever you like.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_067: As you wish. The two individuals of whom you speak did indeed come here. They sought passage across the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_068: Few ships are willing to make the trip at the moment. Nevertheless, I made several introductions on their behalf. That was the extent of our interaction.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_069: I will provide you with the names of the captains, if you like.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_070: You've been a great help, Mistress Kotokaze. I'll be sure to come back for that wine sometime.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_071: We would welcome your custom, miss.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_072: We should question these captains as soon as we can. You take the first three, I'll take the rest, and we'll meet here when we've finished. All right? Good luck!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KOTOKAZE_000_075: All ijin are subject to the same rules, and must receive the same treatment. To be equal is to be fair, and to be fair is to be free.
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KUGANEFERRYMAN_000_: ...Yes, a Roegadyn gentleman did approach me. He wanted to charter a ship to take him across the Ruby Sea, the mad devil.
I sent him away, like all the others before him. The woman? Nay, I know her not.
I told you, I refused the man's request, and I know nothing of the woman. Now leave me be!
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_KUGANECAPTAIN_000_0: Passengers? No. We no longer offer that service. Too much trouble. Now, we only transport goods. I told this to the samurai and sent him on his way.
The woman? Pah. If it is women you seek, the pleasure houses have plenty.
I told you, the man was alone, and I sent him away. What more do you want?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_RADZATHANMERCHANT_0: You ask me if I have seen this Auri woman and this Roegadyn samurai? Hmm... The woman is unknown to me, but the man is not.
He was for Doma, but I could not help him. We travel solely between here and Radz-at-Han. It would be an unreasonable detour.
As I said, I spoke only with the man. He wished to go to Doma, and went away when I said I could not help him. Will that be all?
TEXT_STMBDA204_02473_LYSE_000_110: How did it─ Oh. Never mind. Judging from the look on your face, you didn't have much better luck than I did...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_001: Well, I suppose we might as well head back to─ Wait! I've just remembered!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_002: There was someone on my list I forgot to visit: Gyodo.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_003: He's a “Namazu” fisherman─whatever that means─and a regular here. Maybe we'll find him if we look around?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_005: (When I asked Kotokaze what “Namazu” meant, she said it was Hingan for catfish. And there I was thinking she'd said “fisherman”!)
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_010: ...What, what? Why do you stare? You have business with me?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_011: By the Twelve, a talking fish!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_012: Yes, yes, a talking fish. How very observant of you, ijin. <sigh> You find me in good spirits, so your rudeness I will ignore this once─but only if you address me again in the proper manner.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_013: Sorry, I've never met a─ Let's start again. You're Gyodo, right? My name is Lyse, and this is . We're looking for some friends of ours...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_014: I see, I see... Both these ones I know well. I helped them secure passage across the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_015: Really? That's wonderful! Could you do the same for us?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_016: Yes, yes, this would not be a problem. For you, I could charter a ship this very day.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_017: But the journey is fraught with much peril! The fare will not be cheap. Are you sure you can afford to pay?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_018: I didn't think to bring any money...but surely Tataru will let us take whatever we need from the Scions' coffers, right?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_019: We wouldn't be the only passengers, though... Could we take a moment to talk it over with our friends?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_GYODO_000_020: Yes, yes, but hurry! Your ship must depart under cover of darkness. We shall meet again at sunset on the Tasogare Bridge. Do not forget your fare! Bring many gil, yes!?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_021: It's about time our luck changed! Alphinaud and the others will be thrilled!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_030: Welcome back. We ourselves returned but a moment ago.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_035: I hope my information was of value?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_TATARU_000_040: You wouldn't believe some of the things you can find down at the markets! We're spoiled for choice here!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_050: We spoke with a number of merchants and captains at the southern piers.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Several recognized Gosetsu and confirmed that he had been searching for a vessel to deliver him to Othard. None, however, made any mention of Lady Yugiri...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_052: Yes, it was the same story for us─and then you'll never believe what happened...!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_053: ...So this Gyodo claims to have aided both Gosetsu and Yugiri? How fortuitous.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_054: Not the word I would have chosen, Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_TATARU_000_055: Stupid's what I'd call it! How can you agree to his price without making any attempt to haggle? Or even confirming what it was in the first place!?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_056: Yes...that too was a misstep on their part, but it is not what troubles me most. Gyodo and his brethren are not renowned for their generosity of spirit. Rather, they are disdained as scheming moneylenders, ever eager to turn a profit from others' misfortune.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_057: Everyone else we questioned stated that Gosetsu was alone. Only Gyodo claims to have met both him and Yugiri...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_058: I suppose it's just possible that Gosetsu made inquiries by himself, and only called upon Yugiri once he had found a willing captain...?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_059: ...But it is equally possible─if not more likely─that you are being deceived. Do not forget that there are parties present in Kugane with agendas which may run contrary to your own.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_060: The viceroy was once a spy herself, as I recall. I should be surprised if she did not have countless agents here in her employ─all eager to prove themselves to their new master. And what better way to do so than by delivering her the heads of foreign insurgents?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_061: Fine. You may be right about him. But if Gyodo's working for the Empire, who's to say he didn't try the same trick on Yugiri and Gosetsu? I mean, if he did, he might know where they are. And if he succeeded, they might be in trouble!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_062: Anyway, if he holds up his end of the bargain, we'll have nothing to worry about, will we? But if he tries to betray us, I vote we take him prisoner and punch him till he tells us the truth.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_063: So, if it's a trap, we'll spring it and deal with the consequences. Hmm...I like the way you think.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_064: <sigh> Very well... We should prepare for the worst. Tataru will remain here, and I shall follow the three of you at a discreet distance.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_065: Once more, I must caution you to avoid physical altercations at all costs─even should imperial agents attempt to engage you. The Sekiseigumi will not hesitate to clap you in irons...or cut you down.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_066: If anything untoward should happen, you are to return here at once. Is that clear?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Rest assured, I will not be far behind, . While I am no shinobi, I can keep to the shadows when necessary.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_075: The Sekiseigumi are not to be trifled with. Rare is the week that I do not hear at least one tale of an ijin being arrested under dubious pretext. Fortunately, a wealthy and well-connected ally can help resolve such matters with the minimum of fuss.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_080: And there I was thinking Gyodo was just being nice. I tell you now, if Hancock's right about all of this, that fish is getting filleted.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_TATARU_000_085: I had a feeling we might find ourselves in a situation like this, so I made sure to stock up on some “special supplies” that I thought might prove useful. Alisaie has them, in case you're wondering.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_090: To review: Lyse, , and I will meet with Gyodo as planned.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_091: Alphinaud will keep watch from a distance, ready to provide support in the likely event that Gyodo attempts to betray us to the imperials or whomever else.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_092: Should that happen, you and Lyse will subdue him, and together we will make our escape.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_093: As our actions will surely draw the attention of the Sekiseigumi, we will evade them with Alphinaud's assistance and return here with our prisoner. Does that meet with everyone's approval?
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_094: Of course, these precautions will be for naught if Gyodo does not play us for fools...but we shall see. To the bridge!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_095: ...It's a trap, isn't it. We may as well stop kidding ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_100: Our would-be ally is nowhere to be seen... Make ready, . Something smells...fishy...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALPHINAUD_000_110: All things considered, that went rather well. Thanks to Soroban, that is.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_SOROBAN_000_115: Though we Kojin are of the sea, we often come ashore to sell our wares and peruse your markets. It is my hope that an arrangement with the East Aldenard Trading Company will help us to more quickly obtain the treasures that we seek.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_HANCOCK_000_120: You are doubtless wondering why our objectively green-hued friend here refers to himself as a Kojin of the Blue. The answer is quite fascinating, really. The Kojin language has many similarities with ancient Hingan, you see, and in ancient Hingan, the word for green, “ao,” can mean green and or blue─though I do the word a disservice by even attempting to translate it, so steeped in meaning as it is. Why they elected to keep on calling themselves the “blue” in modern times is anyone's guess─I for one would have much preferred “Kojin of the Ao”─but one theory posits that they prefer the sound of the word “blue” when spoken. Another is that they are physically incapable of distinguishing between the two, which would have interesting implications in their everyday lives...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_000_125: There's no denying that they were imperials. They were wearing the same uniforms as the ones outside the consulate.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_130: I'm still annoyed he tried to deceive us, but at least we were prepared for it.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_LYSE_000_131: Even so, next time we should probably try to avoid running around Kugane in the middle of the night with half the city guard snapping at our heels...
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_900_010: As expected, the Sekiseigumi have caught our scent. Since fighting them is out of the question, we'll have to wind our way back to the Ruby Bazaar, evading their patrols as we go.
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_ALISAIE_900_011: If they find you, use these smoke bombs to make your escape!
TEXT_STMBDA205_02474_SYSTEM_900_015: Use the smoke bombs to evade the patrols. Be warned that attacking the Sekiseigumi will result in failure.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALPHINAUD_000_001: All things considered, that went rather well. Thanks to Soroban, that is.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_SOROBAN_000_005: Though we Kojin are of the sea, we often come ashore to sell our wares and peruse your markets. It is my hope that an arrangement with the East Aldenard Trading Company will help us to more quickly obtain the treasures that we seek.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_010: You are doubtless wondering why our objectively green-hued friend here refers to himself as a Kojin of the Blue. The answer is quite fascinating, really. The Kojin language has many similarities with ancient Hingan, you see, and in ancient Hingan, the word for green, “ao,” can mean green and or blue─though I do the word a disservice by even attempting to translate it, so steeped in meaning as it is. Why they elected to keep on calling themselves the “blue” in modern times is anyone's guess─I for one would have much preferred “Kojin of the Ao”─but one theory posits that they prefer the sound of the word “blue” when spoken. Another is that they are physically incapable of distinguishing between the two, which would have interesting implications in their everyday lives...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_015: There's no denying that they were imperials. They were wearing the same uniforms as the ones outside the consulate.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_020: Right, then. Gyodo should be coming round soon.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_021: I think it's time we had a little chat, don't you?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_030: Rise and shine, little fishy. I know you can hear me, so stop pretending to be asleep or I'll give you another ride on my boot.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_031: ...No! No, no, no more boots! All my secrets are yours for the asking!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_032: Tell us what you know about Yugiri and Gosetsu. Every last detail.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_033: And if I find out later that you lied to me─
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_034: No, no, no more lies! The clear, unvarnished truth! You have my word!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_035: Only the samurai did I meet. Yes, yes, only him! He asked after a ship, so I provided an introduction to...to the Garleans...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_036: You mean you led him into a trap, as you did us. Because you are an imperial spy.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_037: No, no, I am no spy! It was just business! Fewer ships pass through Kugane these days, and we have struggled to make ends meet...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_038: So when the Garleans offered a bounty for any Domans found in Kugane─
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_039: Oh, my mistake! You're not a spy, but a common cutthroat! Not that I'm surprised─you need half a brain to be a spy. So what happened to the samurai?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_040:
Such a cruel, vicious tongue you have...
He would not go quietly, no, no. Blades were drawn, men were cut down, and the Sekiseigumi came. They took the samurai away.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_041: Hold on a moment! You mean to tell me the ijin they arrested the other day was Gosetsu?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_042: Oh, had I but known! If he is in the custody of the Sekiseigumi, I need only see to it that the requisite funds find their way into the right official's hands, and your friend will walk free.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALPHINAUD_000_043: As it is in Ul'dah, so it is in Kugane...but given the circumstances, it seems we have no choice but to resort to morally questionable means.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_044: We'll make a pragmatist of you yet, Master Alphinaud!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALPHINAUD_000_045: (One of these days, I may just punch that man in the face...)
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_046: I have given you everything that you have asked for, yes, yes? Then there is no need for me to remain your prisoner?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_047: I hope I never have to carry a Namazu again. He's not heavy, but gods, the smell...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_048: I'm glad we finally learned what happened to him, but did we really need to stir up all that trouble to do so?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_SOROBAN_000_049: I have never laid eyes upon the sacred treasures of Eorzea. My heart fair trembles with excitement at the thought!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_TATARU_100_049: Hmm...I didn't think to include “bribes” when I was calculating our budget for this trip.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_050: You are free to wait here while I speak with the relevant official, but if you would rather wait for Gosetsu outside the barracks, we can go together.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_051: I wouldn't put it past the imperials to try something again, so mayhap it would be best if Lyse, , and I joined you.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_052: All right, but what about Gyodo?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALPHINAUD_000_053: I will keep an eye on him for the time being. We can release him after you return with Gosetsu. He will doubtless have some choice words to say to the little fellow. Soroban─mayhap it would be prudent to prepare your ship for our immediate departure.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_055: Everything is in order? Then let us be off. The Sekiseigumi Barracks are to the north.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALPHINAUD_000_060: You need not worry. I swear I will not let him out of my sight. In fact, I may have some more questions of my own...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_GYODO_000_065: No more lies, no more betrayals! Yes, yes, I swear by all the kami in creation!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_TATARU_000_066: Talking tortoises, talking catfish... I tell you, though─it's when the bears start talking that you need to worry. That, my friend, spells the end of civilization as we know it!
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_070: This looks a bit fancy for a barracks, don't you think?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_075: I hope Hancock is as good as his word...
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_HANCOCK_000_080: I must ask that you wait here. You may be assured that this will not take long.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_090: ...Is it really going to be as simple as he says, do you think?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_091: ...He said it wouldn't take long, right? Because this feels a bit long to me.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_092: Calm down, Lyse. Everything is going to be all right. Much as I hate to admit it, I share Hancock's dim view of government officials and their supposed incorruptibility.
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_ALISAIE_000_093: From what I've gleaned of the Far East, they're probably exchanging lengthy pleasantries. There seems to be a correct way to do everything here, bribery being no exception. I say we leave them to it. Right, ?
TEXT_STMBDA206_02475_LYSE_000_100: Right, right. Everything's fine. Probably. I mean, it couldn't be as bad as the last time we stood around waiting for something to happen...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Leave Gyodo with me. I have a mind to ask him a few more questions. If nothing else, it will be interesting to see how cooperative he feels in the absence of Lyse's boot.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GYODO_000_005: No more lies, no more betrayals! Yes, yes, I swear by all the kami in creation!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_LYSE_000_010: To be honest, I wish I had seen that fight.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_015: Just when I think I've heard everything...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_HANCOCK_000_020: 'Twas not for naught, at least. Our friend in the Sekiseigumi is willing to consider this an investment of sorts─a payment against future misunderstandings.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER_: 'Tis rare indeed to have the opportunity to study the swordsmanship of a master, much less spar with him!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_030: I must apologize. That you endured such trials and tribulations in search of me─
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_031: There's no need for that. You had no way of knowing we would come looking for you.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_032: You were after a ship to take you to Doma, yes? It just so happens we have found a willing captain.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_034: We will tell you all about it back at the company offices. Alphinaud and Tataru are waiting for us there.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Gosetsu! Thank the Twelve you are unharmed!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_041: As you can see, Master Alphinaud, I am the very picture of health!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_042: You! Vile fiend! Malevolent trickster! How kind the kami are to grant me vengeance so soon. But first, I demand you return the coin you so villainously embezzled from me!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GYODO_000_043: Y-You have every right to be angry, good sir! Gladly would I return to you your coin...had I not been forced to repay certain gambling debts beforehand...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Setting that matter aside for the moment─where is Lady Yugiri? Was she not traveling with you?
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_045: For a time, aye, but we parted ways some while ago, the better to improve our chances of finding Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_047: Forgive me, I have yet to explain. Lord Hien is the heir to Doma's throne, and our master.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_048: His was a passionate voice for the cause of Doman liberation, and when we learned of the Emperor's death, it only grew louder...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_049: So you seized upon the opportunity and rose up to reclaim your freedom...only for your hopes to be dashed when Zenos led his army unto your lands.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_050: The crown prince was a merciless foe. Against him and the might of the XIIth, we had no chance.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_051: Once Lord Hien understood this, he bade Yugiri take to the sea with as many of our people as possible. He, however, would stand and fight, that they might have more time to escape...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_052: I remained by his side as well, and together we carried on our doomed war. And then, one day, in a fierce battle, we were separated. I knew not what became of him─only that he was beyond the Empire's reach, and that to find him, I would need Yugiri's aid.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_053: The situation grows more perilous by the day, for the new viceroy, Yotsuyu, is a black-hearted villainess who delights in the torment of our people. There is naught she would not do to further her pursuit of Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Thank you. I believe that makes matters a good deal clearer.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_055: It should please you to learn that we are come to aid the Doman Liberation Front in resuming their efforts to overthrow their imperial oppressors.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_056: Then allow me to join you! My inquiries here bore no fruit, hence my desire to return to Othard.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_057: Once there, I can lead you to our headquarters in Yanxia, where we shall all be reunited with Yugiri!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_058: Mayhap not all. Alphinaud's talents would seem better applied here in Kugane, working closely with Tataru and Hancock to feed us intelligence. There is a Garlean embassy just down the road, after all─
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_059: While I appreciate the vote of confidence, I should be glad to accompany you all─
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_060: As a soldier in the field, so to speak? Come now, Brother, a competent commander assigns his soldiers the tasks best suited to them─as you of all people should know. And you are so very good at espionage and intrigue.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_061: "...For we all must serve, each in our own way.“ Very well. It would seem my place is here.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_TATARU_000_062: Soroban is waiting at the pier. Have fun, you lot!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Just because an individual excels at a particular task does not mean he should be obliged to do it over and over and over again...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GYODO_000_075: Um... How much longer do you intend to keep me here? I have given my full cooperation, yes, yes?
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_HANCOCK_000_080: Like the compensation given to the Sekiseigumi, the company considers our aid to you and yours an investment. We look forward to establishing ties with any fledgling governments that may be formed in the aftermath of a successful revolution.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_TATARU_000_085: What are you waiting around here for, ? Don't you have places to be? Off you trot!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_LYSE_000_090: This one's smaller than the Misery. A lot smaller.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_095: I know Alphinaud can hold his own in a fight, but he is plainly better suited to more cerebral tasks. Surely I'm not alone in thinking that?
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_100: Ah, a Kojin captain! A fine choice. Only Confederate sailors rival their knowledge and skill.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_SOROBAN_000_110: I have been waiting for you, my friends. All preparations have been completed, and my ship awaits its passengers.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_SOROBAN_000_111: Shall we depart without further delay?
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_SOROBAN_000_113: If you insist! With me, everyone! The Ruby Sea awaits!
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_LYSE_000_120: Somewhere out there, across the water, is Yugiri and Gosetsu's homeland...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_ALISAIE_000_125:
Woe betide any enemy foolish enough to attack by sea.
Now, if the Garleans were to bring their airships, on the other hand...
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_GOSETSU_000_130: The Hingans built this island as a bulwark against invasion, and filled it with enough cannons to sink an armada.
TEXT_STMBDA207_02476_SOROBAN_000_140: How wide and beautiful she is, the Ruby Sea! Filled with promise and adventure and treasures─many wonderful treasures!
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_000: Somewhere out there, across the water, is Yugiri and Gosetsu's homeland...
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_ALISAIE_000_005:
Woe betide any enemy foolish enough to attack by sea.
Now, if the Garleans were to bring their airships, on the other hand...
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_GOSETSU_000_010: The Hingans built this island as a bulwark against invasion, and filled it with enough cannons to sink an armada.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_020: Now, in order to reach the shores of Othard, you will need to cross the resplendent waters you see before you. However, this is easier said than done.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_021: To set forth without making the necessary preparations is to invite the Confederacy to claim your vessel─and your life should you resist.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_022: But this fate can be avoided by paying the Ruby Tithe, thereby earning you the blessing of the pirate lords.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_023: So─let us go and greet them. Our destination is the isle to the west.
