TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_024: That doesn't look very far to me. , why don't we jump in and swim for it? I've had my fill of boats.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_025: Hmm, an excellent idea! I think you shall find the water to your liking.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_026: I will use my ship to deliver those less inclined to the isle.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_ALISAIE_000_030: Not that I've anything against the occasional dip in the ocean, but to dive in on a whim is a bit...hm.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_GOSETSU_000_035: Ho, what spirit you two have to delight in this simple joy so readily!
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_040: Hm? Is Lyse not with you?
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_050: Right, this should be easy! And a good way to loosen up before the next fight, whenever it comes.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_051: Twenty gil says I beat you there!
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_060: <pant> <pant> ...Not bad. We'll call it a draw!
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_070: Ah, there you are. I trust you enjoyed yourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_071: Follow me, my friends. The one with whom we must speak is a man named Tansui.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_LYSE_000_080: Ugh... My clothes have mostly dried, but they're a bit clingy. Still, no regrets!
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_ALISAIE_000_085: I wonder─Lominsan pirates have been known to say things like, “Arrr,” but surely pirates on the opposite side of the world would use different expressions? “Errr,” or “Urrr,” or “Arururu,” perhaps?
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_GOSETSU_000_090: Doma's position on the Confederacy could be best described as one of “guarded acceptance.” They are pirates, aye, but they adhere to a code and are a stabilizing force in the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_SOROBAN_000_095: This one is Tansui. Come, come, introduce yourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_TANSUI_000_100: ...I fear you have the advantage of me.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_TANSUI_000_101: Most honorable and esteemed . I am Tansui, a humble mate who serves at the pleasure of the Confederacy's captain.
TEXT_STMBDA301_02477_TANSUI_000_102: As you are in the company of the shellback, I presume we have business to discuss...
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_LYSE_000_000: Ugh... My clothes have mostly dried, but they're a bit clingy. Still, no regrets!
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_ALISAIE_000_005: I wonder─Lominsan pirates have been known to say things like, “Arrr,” but surely pirates on the opposite side of the world would use different expressions? “Errr,” or “Urrr,” or “Arururu,” perhaps?
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_010: Doma's position on the Confederacy could be best described as one of “guarded acceptance.” They are pirates, aye, but they adhere to a code and are a stabilizing force in the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_015: As he says, there is business to be discussed.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_020: You wish to pay the Ruby Tithe, yes? With your...gil, perhaps? It is just as well. Foreign currencies are in demand these days.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_021: I would pay for their passage to Othard.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_022: Does this sum meet with your satisfaction?
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_023: ...The sea has been quite tempestuous of late. I cannot say with confidence that you would reach your destination safely─unless you tripled it.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_024: D-Do you take me for a fool? I know the price, as do all!
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_025: Alas, we live in interesting times. As you came from Kugane, I should think I need not tell you that.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_026: The shadow of war looms. The wise and the cautious shirk our waters and our custom, and the foolhardy sharpen their knives in anticipation.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TESHITAPIRATE_000_0: Sir! Sir! You've got to come quickly. The bastards're at it again!
I tried to convince them to stop, but they weren't having it.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_030: <sigh> Very well. I will be there shortly.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_TANSUI_000_031: ...Hm. A proposition. Your comrades strike me as a worthwhile investment. I would not hear men name me a cat before koban, so I shall consider their tithe paid─not for what they have done, but for what I expect they will do.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_ALISAIE_000_032: I'm not sure what to make of that man, but at least the matter of our tithe is settled. For now.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_LYSE_000_033: What was that he and the other pirate were talking about? Maybe we ought to go and have a look.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_LYSE_000_040: That's Tansui over there, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_ALISAIE_000_045: Do you know what this is all about?
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_050: Hmm...I have been away for some time, so...
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_055: I...I am not certain this is a wise idea...
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_LYSE_000_060: So they really don't care what happens to Doma? I can't...I refuse to believe that.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_ALISAIE_000_065: Doma is but one of many provinces under imperial control, filled with people who have had to find ways to cope with a bitter reality...
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_070: What are we waiting for? Come, come! Soroban cannot have gone far!
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_071: ...Though now that I think on it, it is passing strange that he left without warning. Mayhap he did not wish to be seen by his Kojin brethren?
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_072: I doubt he thought to leave us behind, but nevertheless, it may be prudent to return to his ship. Or at least to the Confederate encampment.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_ALISAIE_000_085: I am sure he has his reasons for his odd behavior...and I should like very much to hear them. Trust requires honesty.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_GOSETSU_000_090: Hah! I told you he would not abandon us!
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_100: Oh, my friends! A thousand pardons! ...As you may have guessed, I was reluctant to be seen in your company by my Red brothers. Ours is a...complex relationship.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_101: I pray you do not misinterpret their actions as a reflection of our allegiances as a whole.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_102: You...you understand? Kami be praised! Too often are shell-less quick to judge all Kojin for the deeds of one.
TEXT_STMBDA302_02478_SOROBAN_000_103: Right, then. Now that our business with Tansui is concluded, we can traverse the Ruby Sea without fear!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_001: So we can leave for Othard, right?
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_002: ...Hm. I suppose that shall have to suffice for now.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_003: Hah! I told you he would not abandon us!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_005: I shall return to the ship and prepare for our departure. If you have any remaining business to conduct with the pirates here, I pray you do so now.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_006: Ah, that reminds me. , would you be so kind as to inform the Confederates of our plans? The more they know of our movements, the less like we are to be mistaken for another vessel by their comrades.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_007: Next stop, Othard...and Doma. We're coming, Yugiri...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_008: Even if we need not fear the Confederacy, there is no telling what manner of imperial presence we will find waiting for us. We must be careful.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_009: What are we standing around for? Did you not hear what Tansui said? The viceroy must be stopped!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_010: Regardless of Tansui's assurances, I would take no chances and inform the pirates of our plans, lest the more unscrupulous among them decide to board us regardless. Stranger things have been known to happen...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_TESHITAPIRATE_000_0: Oh, you're one of the ijin from the beach. Leaving us already?
No need to pay the tithe, like Tansui said. On the other hand, if you were to peruse our wares and find anything to your liking, we should be glad to sell it to you for a fair price.
Tansui seems to believe you're not the type to let a favor go unanswered. Assuming he's not mistaken, I've no doubt you could find a few odd jobs here.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_020: You have spoken with the Confederates up above, then? Excellent! If you are ready to depart, we may do so at any time.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_024: Of course. Take as much time as you require.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_025: Then let us be off! I shall deliver you to the fishing village of Isari.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_026: Wait─Tansui said that the viceroy was “holding court” in one of the fishing villages, did he not?
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_027: Should Isari chance to be the village in question, we could instantly find ourselves surrounded by imperial soldiers. I think it safer to come ashore some distance away.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_028: Very well! I know just the place.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_030: Hmm... It would have been silly to try to swim all the way here. At least this time.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_035: Still have your bearings? I know it can be difficult when you're on the water.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_040: At long last, I am returned to my homeland...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_050: Here we are! I am reasonably certain none bore witness to our approach.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_051: And with this, I believe I have fulfilled the terms of our agreement?
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_052: Aye, that you have. You have my deepest thanks, Soroban. Truly, we are blessed to have befriended such a clever and industrious merchant!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_053: Oh, you are much too kind, good sir!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_SOROBAN_000_054: I know not where your path may lead, but I wish you the very best, and hope that we shall meet again.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_055: So we've finally arrived in Othard. All we need to do now is, uh...liberate Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_056:
Ah, yes...that.
Look...daunting though it is, we do have one thing in our favor: the element of surprise. Unlike in Gyr Abania, the imperials don't know we're here.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_057: Admittedly, that may be our only advantage, considering how few of us there are...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_058: Well, I expect the Doman Liberation Front will even up the odds a bit. But before all that, we need to see if this is the fishing village Tansui was talking about.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_GOSETSU_000_059: It may well be. I smell ceruleum on the breeze...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_070: I hate it as much as you. Maybe even more. Every fiber of my being was crying out to intervene, but...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_071: But what's done is done. Gosetsu's gamble has gifted us the time we need to find a solution.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_072: He bade us seek aid at the distant tower, yes? For want of a better idea, I say we do just that─while taking care to avoid the imperials.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_080: She's right. This is not like the Reach. This is worse. They were defenseless...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_090: We seem to have evaded their patrols so far...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_091: What is that tower, anyway? I've never seen anything like it.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_092: According to my map, we are on Onokoro, and the tower is known as Heaven-on-High. A mysterious structure built long ago by persons unknown...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_093: Oh gods, listen to me. I'm starting to sound like Alphinaud. Next thing you know, I'll be saying things like, “As you are doubtless already aware...”
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_094: Hm? Over there! Do you see it?
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_095: Hmm... Doesn't look like it's been dead long.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_096: Whoever did this, they're a good shot. I can't see a single stray arrow.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_097: Well, someone's hungry! Wait...that wasn't either of you two, was it.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_098:
Calm down! We had nothing to do wi─
Wait, what am I doing? They can't possibly understand us.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_100: Time to run, Lyse! We save our strength for any that give chase! You too, !
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_POP_MESSAGE: The beasts howl in rage and charge!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_110: Whew... That went better than expected.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_120: Just imagine if they'd taken us by surprise. What a fine ending that would have been to our story...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_121: Anyway, I think it's safe to assume that the people at the tower know how to defend themselves. You'd have to, sharing an island with these things. Now all we need to do is convince them to help us!
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_ALISAIE_000_130: So that's the way of it...
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_140: Ohh...there's a settlement here! And they've even got their own aetheryte.
TEXT_STMBDA303_02479_LYSE_000_141: Wait a minute... I've seen that standard before. It was when we met with Tansui. Which means this place belongs to... Oh.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_000: ...There's no mistaking that design. It has to be them.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_010: It would seem we have found a Confederate settlement─mayhap even their headquarters, judging by the size of the place.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_011: So Gosetsu bade us seek out the Confederacy for aid and succor. The selfsame Confederacy that refuses to openly oppose the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_012: ...Well, nothing ventured, nothing gained, I suppose... At the very least, they're unlikely to ask us for the tithe.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_030: What wind brings you hither, of all places? Were you not bound for Othard's shores?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_031: ...I see. I trust you have not forgotten our previous conversation on the subject? No? Then what do you want, a second opinion? Very well.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_032: Come with me. I will take you to the captain─Rasho.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_033: ...Just like that? An audience with their leader? How very accommodating. We must needs choose our words carefully.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_034: You leave it to me! I've always been good with people. And this will also give me a chance to use the eastern greeting they showed me in Revenant's Toll!
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_040: Um... On second thought, maybe I shouldn't be the one to do this...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_045: It's never this simple. Not with pirates. And if they're anything like Carvallain, then may the gods have mercy on us all.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_050: There he is, then. Our illustrious leader. Speak. No need to be shy.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_060: Greetings! Y-You must be Rasho, leader of the Confederacy and...so on... I realize this is all a bit sudden, but...the thing is...we have a little favor to ask...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_061: ...Oh gods, I've probably broken half a dozen rules of Far Eastern etiquette already... Well, I'm sorry about that, but you have to understand that we're in a hurry, so...I'm going to stop talking now.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_062: ...Men who revere manners and tradition can be found the world over. But not here.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_063: Your candor is appreciated. Speak your heart.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_064: ...Gosetsu. A former leader of the rebellion. Aye, I know of him.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_065: Why he bade you petition us for aid and succor, however, I know not.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_066: At the risk of repeating myself, to join the Confederacy is to renounce all other ties. We are beholden to none─allied with none.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_067: When Doma was invaded by the Empire twenty-five years ago, we did not rush to her defense. Knowing this, do you honestly expect us to help you drive the imperial forces out of Isari?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_068: The Garleans have long maintained a presence in this region, and we would be fools to break the peace, fragile as it is. Besides, you are capable warriors, yes? With guile and preparation, you can surely resolve this matter yourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_069: It is imperative that our presence here remain secret for as long as possible. For us to openly engage the imperials at this time would endanger everything we have come here to achieve!
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_070: You have told us why you cannot fight. Not why we should fight in your stead.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_071: If you would speak to me of lives saved, I would speak to you of slaughter. How many will die when all pretense is lost and the Garleans declare war on the Confederacy?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_072:
...Hate is a luxury we cannot afford.
You are free to come and go as you please, but you will receive no further aid.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_073: Thank you for your hospitality. If you would excuse us.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_080: I wish I could say I'm surprised, but I'm not...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_TANSUI_000_085: The captain's word is final. Can't say I didn't warn you.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_090: All ties that bind a man must be renounced, without exception, if he is to find a place here. Former lovers and bitter enemies alike must learn to bury their past and work side by side, or else be cast out.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_RASHO_000_091: ...No matter how deep a man's hatreds may run, he cannot let them dictate his actions. The good of the Confederacy takes precedence over all.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_100: Hey, ... I know that didn't go well, but I'm not prepared to give up on them yet.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_101: Gosetsu told us to come here for a reason. He must have believed we could convince them to help us... We just have to work out how.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_102: My thoughts exactly. I'm glad to hear we're of the same mind.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_103: 'Tis little wonder they refused─we have done naught to persuade them. The real work begins now.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_104: We need to learn more about the Confederacy─what their needs and weaknesses are. Once we know that, we will know how to earn their trust.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_110: Such unusual designs. Unlike the standards of most nations and organizations, they have chosen to incorporate a variety of symbols. A testament to their diverse heritage?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_115: They've got plenty to eat, by the look of it, though it's mostly the same stuff. I wonder if they trade much with outsiders...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_SYSTEM_000_120: The arms and armor have been piled up haphazardly. They display no signs of recent use or maintenance...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_SYSTEM_000_125: A number of crates and barrels have been stored here. On closer inspection, however, most are empty...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_NAWASHIRO_000_130: Hm? Taken an interest in the ship? Heh, good eye! She's not much to look at now, but once upon a time, she was a beauty!
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_NAWASHIRO_000_131: The Confederacy favors flotillas of smaller ships to capture and board errant vessels. The larger ones, like this sekibune, only take part in major engagements.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_NAWASHIRO_000_132: ...Not that we've had any of those recently, what with those imperial bastards throwing their weight around. If it wasn't for them... Well, no use moaning about what you can't change, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_NAWASHIRO_000_135: She's less a ship and more a storehouse these days. What a waste...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_140: Had a good look around? Then we just need to wait for Lyse.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_141: Sorry to keep you waiting, but I wanted to talk to as many people as I could...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_142: It's just as Tansui said. They have no intention of standing up to Yotsuyu.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_143: I don't know if you two got a different impression...
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_A1_000_145: Under the right circumstances, they might help us.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_A1_000_146: I think the situation is coming to a head.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_147: I agree. It's obvious that they are struggling to survive, and that they blame the imperials for their recent troubles.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_148: Even if we do nothing, it is inevitable that they will come into conflict with the Empire sooner or later─and deep down, they all know it.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_149: The only thing holding them back at the moment is the belief that they lack the strength to survive the coming war.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_150: So we need to prove to them that we're not all talk─that we can be valuable allies in the fight!
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_ALISAIE_000_151: And what better way to demonstrate our worth than by...seeking out people with mundane problems and offering them our expert assistance?
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_152: Wouldn't be the first time we've had to earn someone's trust by helping them out with this and that. And you know it won't be the last.
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_LYSE_000_153: I'll look around the western end of Onokoro. You two take the east. Good luck!
TEXT_STMBDA304_02480_SYSTEM_000_154: You have learned the emote Eastern Bow!
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_HIRASE_000_030: You've been busy, haven't you? And now you're here to ask if I need help with anything? Heh, now that you mention it...
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_HIRASE_000_031: Lately we've had trouble with ravenous sharks that've been leaping out of the water and making off with our fish. Damndest thing, I know, but you wouldn't doubt it if you saw it.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_HIRASE_000_032: We've got to cull the thieving bastards regularly─so happens I sent three of my mates out there before you came along. Still, the more the merrier. If you can kill two or so, that ought to be enough.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_HIRASE_000_033: Take a few of those rotting fish as bait. I'll not be needing them. Oh, and maybe see if you can't find the other group. They've been away longer than I like.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_HIRASE_000_035: To be honest, I'm more worried about my mates than the sharks at this point. They should've come back by now...
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_PIRATE02481_000_050: Oh, kami be praised! I don't know what I would've done if you hadn't come along.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_PIRATE02481_000_051: My partners and I got separated when we fled. You haven't seen them, have you?
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_PIRATE02481_000_052: Damn... Before the Kojin started chasing us, their leader asked us if we were Doman...
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_PIRATE02481_000_053: They're Yotsuyu's catchers, I know it! First Isari, and now this! I've got to tell Rasho and the others!
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_LYSE_000_060:
We've been keeping busy. How about─
Oh no, you've got that look. What happened now?
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_070: Ah, there you are, . I heard you went shark hunting?
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_071: We too did our fair share of beast culling─though I think Lyse made a stronger impression when she bested a drunken pirate in a sparring match. Fastest knockout to date, I am told.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_072:
I should like to think we have proven ourselves to be rather─
Hm. Why do I get the feeling you have something important to tell me?
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_073: Kojin mercenaries rounding up Doman Confederates? Surely Yotsuyu has crossed the line now...
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_074: We must go and speak with Rasho immediately. Even he cannot deny that this changes everything.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_075: At least, I should like to think that he cannot...
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_LYSE_000_080: What is Yotsuyu thinking, kidnapping Confederates? She has to know they won't take this lying down.
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_ALISAIE_000_085: We need to speak with Rasho immediately!
TEXT_STMBDA305_02481_TANSUI_000_090: ...Let's get this over with, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_000: Thank you for placing your faith in me. All that remains is to carry out our promise...ambitious as it is.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_TANSUI_000_005: Bold claims and even bolder promises. I should be interested to see if you can live up to them.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_RASHO_000_010: So. Alone you will deal with the Kojin.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_RASHO_100_010: If you are set upon this course, I shall give to you a word of advice.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_RASHO_000_011: Two factions have the Kojin. The mercenaries who serve the Empire belong to the Red.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_RASHO_000_012: Those who belong to the Blue are the traders. They have made no pact with the imperials, and so may be willing to aid your cause.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_RASHO_000_013: Seek the Blue on the Isle of Bekko. There you will find a cave. The rest is up to you.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_014: Thank you, Captain. We shall endeavor not to keep you waiting overlong for your sign.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_015: Right, then. Let us head for─ Wait, where is Lyse? We cannot leave without her.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_031: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to wander off. I...I just wanted to have a think.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_032: You're worried we won't be able to live up to our promises?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_033: No, it's not that at all! If anything, I'm frustrated that I didn't think of it first...
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_034: Yda and my father had a way with words. They knew how to inspire people─how to bring them together. I always hoped I might have something of that in me too, but I'm starting to think I don't.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_035: What am I even doing here...?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_037: Gods, listen to me! I don't know where that came from. Forget I said anything!
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_038: We have places to go, imperials to fight, and friends to save! And we're not going to get any of it done by standing around here moaning, right?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_040: ...Before we first traveled to Gyr Abania, I was in Limsa Lominsa, visiting...visiting a friend. A young child who had been through a great deal.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_041: ...That's neither here nor there, I suppose. Anyway, on the way back, I passed a patisserie which sold some of the most exquisite-looking tarts I had ever seen. I've always preferred cookies, to be honest, but nevertheless I decided to stop and try one...
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_042: ...I'll treat you to one, when all this is over.  too─and I won't take no for an answer.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_043: What about Y'shtola? We'd never hear the end of it!
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_044: All right, all right─Y'shtola too, once she's better. Deal? Good. Then let's hurry, shall we? We have a million things to do before then!
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_050: Red, Blue... Wait─didn't Soroban say something about this before?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_060: I think this is the Isle of Bekko─though, to be honest, it looks the same to me as however many other islands around here...
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_061: Rasho said there was a cave that would lead us to their village. We should search further inland.
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_070: How much further do you think it is?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_LYSE_000_080: Of course! Soroban said he was a Kojin of the Blue, didn't he?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_SOROBAN_000_085: Pleased though I am to see you again, I am confused. Were you not bound for Othard?
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_090: How fortunate that we should find a familiar face in this place...
TEXT_STMBDA306_02482_ALISAIE_000_091: We should tell Soroban about our situation. If anyone here can help us, it's him!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_000: Of course! Soroban said he was a Kojin of the Blue, didn't he?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_005: Perhaps Soroban can help us convince his brethren to aid us somehow. We may as well ask him, don't you think?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_010: So tell me, my friends─what strange tides bear you to our home?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_011: That is indeed a most dire predicament...but perhaps an opportunity for us to craft yet another profitable arrangement!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_012: Very well. I shall introduce you to our leader, Bunchin. It will be up to you, however, to present your case.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_020: Um, should we bow when we meet the elder? I know that's the sort of thing they usually do in the Far East, but does that extend to turtle people living under the sea? Oh, why must diplomacy be so complicated...
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_025: The center of the village lies further below. I still have so many questions, but they will have to wait. The elder awaits.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_030:
I present to you the honored elder Bunchin.
(...You should probably refrain from addressing him by name. He does not much care for it.)
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_040: Whatever it is we've got to do, we'll do it, right? I mean, what other choice do we have?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_045: A thousand thousand gods, found within the great and the small... Rather different from Eorzea and her Twelve, but I have heard of stranger things. In some lands, for instance, men refuse to acknowledge the existence of all but a single god!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_BUNCHIN_000_050: May this bargain be the first of many between our peoples.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_060: Listen well, my friends. We require your assistance with the search for a priceless treasure: the Yasakani-no-Magatama.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_061: This jewel, this most sacred of Kojin relics, was in the possession of Hingashi─until they decided to present it to the Garleans in a gesture of conciliation.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_062: The Red would not abide this, and so they plotted to seize the vessel bearing it to their imperial masters. Alas, though they succeeded, in the ensuing chaos the Magatama was lost to the sea.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_063: We wish to recover the sacred jewel before our brothers. However, were we to come into conflict with them, it would be...problematic. Therefore, we turn to you.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_064: So you want us to search the ocean floor for this treasure of yours? I'm not sure how we're supposed to do that without, you know...
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_065: Drowning? Fear not. There is a ritual I can perform to imbue your bodies with a powerful blessing. But first, you must prepare offerings for the sea.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_066: I require twisted ruby coral, several fist-sized sea snail shells, and a freshly harvested unkiu carapace.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_067: That's quite the shopping list. I will see to the shells, and Lyse can look for the coral. , would you go and find an unkiu and relieve it of its carapace?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_070: I think I see some ruby coral over there. It's a bit far, but I can swim for it.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_075: How quick my dearest brother was to boast of his firewood gathering techniques. If only he were here to gather these shells in my stead...
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_080: Do take care when killing the unkiu not to damage its carapace too much!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_090: Well? Have you the unkiu carapace?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_091: How splendid they are! The kami shall be most pleased, I am sure.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_092: I got it! I got the ruby coral you wanted!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_093: And I the sea snail shells. They're about the size of my fist, though I realize now you may have meant yours...
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_094: These shall more than suffice for our purpose. Next, we must make ready to present them to the sea and perform the ritual.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_095: Once it has been completed, you will be able to move freely through the depths and find the Yasakani-no-Magatama!
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_ALISAIE_000_096: ...Out of curiosity, how large is this sacred jewel of yours? Unless it's far too large to be carried by the three of us, how are we supposed to even find it? The Ruby Sea is not exactly small.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_097: Hah hah hah! Surely you realize we have been searching this whole time? The area we wish you to explore is but a small fraction of the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_098: Already have we scoured most of the seabed near and within our territory, to no avail. All that remains is a region to the west.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_099: The shell-less of Sui-no-Sato can provide you with better guidance than we. You would do well to visit them first.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_LYSE_000_100: Shell-less? You mean the Kojin aren't the only ones living under the sea?
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_101: Of course not! The Raen have been here as long as I can remember. Shiosai, the...overseer, I believe, can tell you more when you arrive.
TEXT_STMBDA307_02483_SOROBAN_000_102: But we are getting ahead of ourselves. We have yet to carry out the ritual!
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_ALISAIE_000_005: Quite how this blessing is supposed to keep us from drowning remains to be seen...
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SOROBAN_000_010: Are you ready, my friends, to explore a world unlike any you have ever known?
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SOROBAN_000_011: Then let us go to western part of the village, where the water twists and turns, and there complete our preparations for the ritual.
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_LYSE_000_020: This is the place, right? Hmm... I'm not sure I like the look of that whirlpool...
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_ALISAIE_000_030: He dove into the water a moment ago and said to wait here until he returned...
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SYSTEM_000_040: Owing to Soroban's blessing, you may now dive into deep water and stay submerged indefinitely.
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SYSTEM_000_041: Underwater settlements like Tamamizu and Sui-no-Sato can be accessed via circular portals.
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SYSTEM_000_042: To leave deep water, you need only swim towards the surface. Conversely, to dive into deep water while swimming on the surface, press .
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SYSTEM_000_043: Should you become separated from your steed, speak with Soroban in Tamamizu to mount a striped ray.
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SOROBAN_000_050: Were you thrown from your ray? No matter! I shall summon another─assuming that is your wish?
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_ALISAIE_000_055: I'll admit I had my doubts, but this is a “blessing” worthy of the name. One cannot help wondering what other magicks the Kojin possess...
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_LYSE_000_060: This must be Sui-no-Sato, the Raen village Soroban told us about.
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_LYSE_000_061: Right, then! Let's see if they can't help us find the Kojin's missing jewel!
TEXT_STMBDA308_02484_SYSTEM_000_062: You may now perform underwater emotes!
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_000: I'll admit I had my doubts, but this is a “blessing” worthy of the name. One cannot help wondering what other magicks the Kojin possess...
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_010: If this is Sui-no-Sato, then Shiosai, the overseer, should be around here somewhere...
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_011: I daresay one of the locals will be able to point us in his direction.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_012: Though...now that I look around, I get the distinct impression we are not welcome here...
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_020: In a place like this, it's hard to tell where the important people live. I mean, everywhere has a sea view...
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_025: Soroban called him the overseer. One can only assume he is some sort of leader in the community...
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_030: ...Leave this place and never return. We have no need of wide-eyed wanderers.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_031: Sorry, I didn't mean to stare. My name is Lyse, and these are my friends,  and Alisaie.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_032: We're looking for the overseer of Sui-no-Sato, Shiosai. That's you, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_033: ...The Kojin of the Blue sent you hither, did they?
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_034: I am no overseer, nor ever would I claim to be one. I am high priest of Shisui of the Violet Tides. Shiosai.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_035: So you are the man we're looking for! Great! We need your help. We're looking for this jewel called the Yasakani-no─
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_036: Stop. I will hear no more.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_037: We will suffer no outside troubles in our sanctuary. Especially those of would-be treasure hunters.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_039: Quiet, Isobe, or there will be no dango for dinner.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_040: Ahem. I can do naught to aid you. I say to you again, leave this place and never return.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_041: ...At the very least, sir, you might condescend to tell us of your village, and of why you are so loath to show us even the most basic courtesy.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_042: ...Sui-no-Sato is our sanctuary. Under the benevolent leadership of the Ruby Princess, sovereign of Shisui, we Raen enjoy humble yet fulfilling lives. But it was not always so.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_043: Long ago, our forebears were driven from their ancestral lands. Beneath the waters, they sought refuge from the ravages of war, and here they flourished. All that we are─our culture, our traditions─was born of the sea. As was I.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_044: Though we have engaged others in diplomacy, it has ever been with the utmost caution. Isolation and independence are essential to preserving our way of life.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_045: So it was when Doma fell twenty-five years past. The Ruby Princess, in her wisdom, decreed that we would take no part. As it was, so ever shall it be.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_046:
Forever and ever apart...
Forgive me. I understand now how highly you value your way of life, and how you will suffer none to endanger it.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_047: You may be assured that we have no desire to do so. And I would hope that we have given you no cause to assume otherwise.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_048: ...You have not. But this changes nothing.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_049: Regardless of your intentions, it is not my place to break with tradition.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_050: I must consider the wishes of all who call Sui-no-Sato home. For me to defy their will and permit outsiders to remain would be a gross betrayal of my responsibilities. Please do not ask this of me.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_LYSE_000_060: Everywhere we go it's the same. “Go away, we don't want any.” You'd think I'd be used to it by now, but some stupid part of me just can't help hoping for the best.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_SHIOSAI_000_065: It is not for me to make exceptions. I am bound by our rules, as are you. Please, leave us be.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_070: And so it continues. Another village, another deaf ear.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_071: Clearly, Gyr Abania is not the only place with walls.
TEXT_STMBDA309_02485_ALISAIE_000_072: I'm starting to wonder if this was all a huge mistake. Gosetsu couldn't have known we would take this long. I only hope he's still alive...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_LYSE_000_000: Everywhere we go it's the same. “Go away, we don't want any.” You'd think I'd be used to it by now, but some stupid part of me just can't help hoping for the best.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_010: We seem to have reached an impasse. And to make matters worse, every solution I can think of will only take more time...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_011: I don't suppose you have any ideas, do you, ?
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_A1_000_014: We could ask the villagers if they know anything.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_A1_000_015: Soroban sent us here. Mayhap we should ask him.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_A1_000_016: We find some Red Kojin, and encourage them to talk.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_018: Heh! The thought of administering a little encouragement does have its appeal...but I would need to be convinced that the Red Kojin knew anything before resorting to violence.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_019: (-???-)You are the ones who came from above, yes? If we could have a moment of your time?
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_020: Mine apologies. I did not mean to startle you. My name is Ihanami, and this is my wife Yunagi.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_021: We were wondering... Have you any news from Doma? If so, we should like very much to hear it.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_023: ...If you must. Our daughter fought in the rebellion. We have heard naught from her since.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_024: 'Twould be too much to hope that you know of her, but...her name is Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_025: Kami be praised! She lives! She lives...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_LYSE_000_026: We're looking for her too, actually, but I'm sure she's all right.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_027: We had no idea she hailed from Sui-no-Sato. How did she come to serve Doma as a shinobi?
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_028: It all began when she was a little girl. She and another child crept out of the village, having grown curious about the outside world. To Doma they went, where they met a young boy─a proud son of Yanxia.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_029: His tales of imperial oppression left a lasting impression on her. When she returned, she spoke passionately of the Domans' plight and urged us to take the boy in. But my wife and I would not hear of it.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_030: We thought the matter closed, but she never forgot his words. She became convinced that the Garleans would one day come for us. And it was in search of the strength to defend us that she left, years later, to learn the ways of the shinobi...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_031: When the then Ruby Princess learned of this, she forbade Yugiri's return, lest she bring misfortune to us all.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_032: We protested the judgment, but there was naught we could do. And so our daughter, who wanted only to keep her people safe...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_033: Surely there is something we can do for these people? They who gave her aid and succor when no other would?
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_034: ...I am but a humble stonemason. But if it is the Yasakani-no-Magatama you seek, I may yet be of some assistance to you.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_035: The jewel is known to possess an unusual property. To the naked eye it is as jade, but when bathed in a particular light, it shimmers with a divine resplendence.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_036: I have mined similar materials before. To find them, one must use these lamps.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_037: They cast an invisible light, under which the stones sparkle. In the deepest depths, they are invaluable.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_038: There is a sunken ship to the east. Though the currents may have spirited away her cargo, you should begin your search there.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_039: Thank you so much. We will do just that!
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_040: I hope you find that which you seek. I only wish there were something more we could do to assist you... Know that you will be in my prayers.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_041: And...when next you see our daughter, pray tell her not a day goes by that her parents and her brothers do not think of her.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_IHANAMI_000_050: I would so dearly like to hear more of your adventures with my daughter─but I understand time is of the essence. Go now, and use the lamps as I told you. ...Ah! But be aware that their light only shines for short periods.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_YUNAGI_000_055: May the kami speed you on your journey!
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_070: If this wreck is the selfsame vessel of which Soroban spoke, then if the gods are good, the Magatama is nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_071: Ready your lamp and keep your eyes open, . We're going to need to take this slowly. Move too fast and we risk overlooking something.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_073: To find the Yasakani-no-Magatama, you will need to search the area marked on your map.
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_074: Use your lamp to pinpoint the precise location of the treasure and claim it!
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_080: I wish I knew how far the light from these lamps travels...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_090: You raise your lamp high, but notice naught out of the ordinary...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_091: Though you cannot say for certain, you think you glimpse a flickering light in the distance...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_092: For an instant, you spy a flash of light. You are getting closer...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_093: The flash is unmistakable in the dark, but you are still unable to pinpoint its exact location. Just a little closer...
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_SYSTEM_000_094: There! Peeping out from beneath a fine layer of sand, you spy something shimmering!
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_100: I swear, looking for a needle in a haystack would be quicker. Gosetsu will have died of old age by the time we finish. You haven't found anything, have you, ?
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_101: This...this is it! The Yasakani-no-Magatama, exactly as Soroban described!
TEXT_STMBDA310_02486_ALISAIE_000_102: Heh, it would seem that our fortunes have finally changed for the better!
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_000: It's a good thing we found the Magatama before the Red!
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_010: Much as I would like to return and thank Yugiri's parents for their assistance, time is of the essence. I say we make for Tamamizu at once.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_011: Hold on to it for now, . Once we arrive, present it to the elder, and then we can finally learn how to deal with the Red Kojin.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_020: We fulfilled our end of the bargain. Now it is their turn.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_025: What do you think it will be? Some sort of secret weapon or elaborate plan? I can't wait to find out!
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_SOROBAN_000_030: It is good to see you again, my friends! Have you brought the Magatama?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_040: You are returned, and with the Yasakani-no-Magatama, I trust?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_041: Yes, there is no mistake. Well done, well done.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_042: So...about the Red Kojin. You said there was a way to make them retreat into their shells? Are you ready to tell us now?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_043: I did indeed, and yes...I am.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_044: For you see, divinity resides not only in material vessels, but in individuals. In laying claim to this most sacred of treasures, you have demonstrated an affinity with the divine.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_045: To treat with men and women such as you is to invite fortune into our homes. Gladly will we aid your cause.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_046: All is ready, Soroban? Then give them what they require.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_047: This is...a ceremonial knife of some sort?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_048: Before this blade, that which is sealed shall open. The treasure vault of the Kojin, on the Isle of Zekki.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_049: It is there that our most prized relics, be they of the Red or the Blue, are kept safe. Fiercely do the Red guard it, for its contents are more precious than their lives.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_050: Were the vault to be attacked, their response would by necessity be immediate. Kojin would be summoned from malms around to defend their treasures.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_051: ...And were we to sow enough chaos, the Reds in service to the imperials would have no choice but to answer the call as well.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_052: Giving the Confederacy the sign they've been waiting for! Without the Kojin, the imperials don't have nearly enough troops in Isari to hold off the pirates.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_053: However...you must understand that the vault is holy ground: home to a thousand thousand kami. To intrude upon it without paying the proper respects is a sacrilege we cannot condone.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_054: So...if we were to pay the proper respects, it would be all right? Great! How do we do that, again?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_055: The Yasakani-no-Magatama is one of three most coveted treasures of the Kojin. The other two lie within the vault.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_056: Were you to deliver the jewel unto the others, and thereby make them whole, the kami may forgive your trespass and instead delight in your...mischief-making.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_057: So...if I understand you correctly, you want us to take the sacred jewel coveted by your Red brothers and deliver it to their treasure vault?
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_SOROBAN_000_058: More or less. The Yasakani-no-Magatama belongs on the Isle of Zekki. So long as it finds its way there, we are satisfied.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_SOROBAN_000_059: The Magatama has chosen you to bear it to its brothers. Had it not, you would never have found it. And we would not be having this conversation.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_SOROBAN_000_060: I shall inform the Confederacy of your plans, and bid them make ready to act when the time is right.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_061: The Isle of Zekki lies to the west of Sui-no-Sato. Look for a cave beneath the waters.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_062: May fortune favor you in this and all other endeavors.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_LYSE_000_070: This is going to work! I'm sure of it! I just hope Gosetsu and the others are all right...
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_BUNCHIN_000_075: Beneath the waters to the west of Sui-no-Sato lies a cave that will lead you to the Isle of Zekki. May the kami watch over and keep you.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_080: Right, then. I am not normally in the habit of sneaking into heavily guarded treasure vaults, but if this is the only way to convince the Confederacy to act, then so be it.
TEXT_STMBDA311_02487_ALISAIE_000_081: We should be prepared for a fight. The bigger the better. The kind where you'll wish you had seven of your most battle-hardened friends at your side...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_000: This has to work. I know it! I just hope Gosetsu and the others are all right...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_BUNCHIN_000_005: Beneath the waters to the west of Sui-no-Sato lies a cave that will lead you to the Isle of Zekki. May the kami watch over and keep you.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_010: I don't know about you two, but I'm as ready as I'll ever be.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_012: Right. Right. Naught left to say, then...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_016: R-Right! Let's go and find that cave!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_017: Me? Nervous? Come now. I mean, it's not as though I haven't risked my life in ridiculous ways before.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_018: Well, maybe I am a little bit... Hm. Strangest thing, that. Completely out of character, even. Anyway, let's go!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_020: I hope you didn't waste too much energy swimming here. Once the fighting starts, I doubt we'll have a moment to rest.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_030: Assuming this is the right cave, it should lead us straight into the heart of the Isle of Zekki...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_031: Have you got a plan for once we get to the isle?
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_032: Hmm... How about two of us get the guards' attention while the third heads straight for the vault?
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_033: Afterwards, the other two join them there, and together we make a stand. With our numbers, it's not feasible to do anything more complicated, I think.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_034: Fine by me. I like simple plans. I'll be one of the decoys, then.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_035: You read my mind. I also had a mind to ask  to be one, given  peerless martial prowess.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_036: Then it's settled. You two will make your way through the stronghold, creating as much chaos as possible. You know, have some fun.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_037: Meanwhile, I will attempt to locate the vault and gain entry with the ceremonial knife. When I am inside, I will contact you via linkpearl.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_038: Right! Come on, ! We've got work to do!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_044: You're a sight for sore eyes! I hope Alisaie's all right too...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_045: (-Alisaie-), Lyse, can you hear me? I've found the vault!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_046: (-Alisaie-)Head northwest. There's a passage leading deeper within. Hurry!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_050: Come on, you Red bastards! Is that the best you can do!?
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_060: There you are! The entrance is straight ahead.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_061: Good timing, I might add. It sounds like the whole garrison is headed straight for us...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_LYSE_000_070: We should, um...we should definitely talk strategy before we do anything else!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_080: <pant> <pant> That...that was not part of the plan! A Kojin primal was most definitely not part of the plan!
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_081: ...Though I am sure there is a perfectly logical explanation involving the aether stored in the treasures and the religious fervor with which the Kojin guard them. Or something. <sigh> A pity Alphinaud isn't here to provide it.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_082: And just when I thought our fortunes had changed. I swear, if Soroban and his people knew this might happen...
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_083: ...No, somehow I doubt that. Even the Red seemed surprised by what happened.
TEXT_STMBDA312_02488_ALISAIE_000_084: All rises and falls at the whim of capricious fortune, does it? Then the same goes for him. We have to defeat that primal!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_000: We'll get through this, somehow! After all, we always do!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_010: As before, our numbers limit our options. I wish I could claim to have a brilliant plan, but I don't─all I have is a desperate one.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_011: Lyse, you and I will do our best to draw the Kojin away from the primal. We'll lead them on a wild-dodo chase all over this isle.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_012: The rest of the plan, I'm afraid you can guess. I'm sorry, , I truly am, but neither of us can even approach Susano, much less hope to defeat him. Which means you're on your own.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_013: Well, who knows?  does have an awful lot of adventurer friends. Maybe some of them decided to take a fishing trip to the Far East, and are surprisingly close by...?
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_014: Yes, and I speak fluent Hingan. Come on, there's no point putting this off!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_VILLAGERB02489_000_: Don't hurt me, please! I swear, I didn't do anything!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_PIRATE02481_000_030: Heh heh. Saw the smoke, did you?
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_040: I think we're safe. I didn't see any Kojin following us...
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_041: Wait here. I'm going back for Alisaie.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_A1_000_044: She stayed behind so we could escape...
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_046: She stayed behind so that you could escape. Even I know that.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_047: So that you could escape, not me. And that was a mistake─I should've been the one to stay behind, not her.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_048: So I've got to go back. If we lose her...I'll never forgive myself.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_049: ...I was the one who dragged you all into this. It was my fight, not yours. I knew that from the start, but I also knew I couldn't do it alone.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_050: But I've asked too much and let too much happen to you all. I have to make this right─and I have to do it on my own.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_051: So let me go, please. I'm asking you as a friend. I have to help her!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_052: You can start by finding me a towel and some bandages. Brrr...
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_054: What? Why are you looking at me like that? I said I was going to distract them, not make a heroic and ultimately futile last stand. Who does that, anyway?
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_055: For the love of─ This is stupid! You're embarrassing yourself! And me!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_056: Shut up and let me have this.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_057: Right. That wasn't so bad, was it? Now then, we need to hurry back to Isari!
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_060: They didn't follow you, did they? I gave you enough time to escape?
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_ALISAIE_000_061: Good to hear my selfless act of heroism achieved the desired effect. You needn't worry, by the way─I'm not intending to make a habit of this.
TEXT_STMBDA313_02489_LYSE_000_070: I don't see any soldiers... Do you think the Confederacy drove them off?
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_VILLAGERB02489_000_: Don't hurt me, please! I swear, I didn't do anything!
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02481_000_010: Heh heh. Saw the smoke, did you?
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_015: They didn't follow you, did they? I gave you enough time to escape?
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_016: Good, good... And don't worry─I'll try not to make a habit out of it.
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_LYSE_000_020: Something definitely happened here. I see several people who look like they might be injured. Let's give them a hand and find out what we missed.
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_021: Hm? Do I need help? Oh, I'll be fine. It's nothing that won't heal. You should go after Lyse.
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_030: Ugh... What was it Thancred once said about battle scars and maidens? Naught worth repeating in polite company, I'm sure...
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_LYSE_000_035: I see. I'm glad Soroban reached you in time...
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02490_000_040: The captain scoffed at first, but Tansui convinced him to at least muster our forces...
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_VILLAGERA02489_000_: Thank you, my child. When the fighting started, I tried to run and hide, but fell and could not regain my feet...
I thought for sure that we would all be slaughtered, but the pirates drove them off! I never thought I would see the day when the Confederacy came to our aid!
Thank you for your concern, but I shall be fine. There is no more need for running, after all!
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_VILLAGERB02489_000_:
Uwaaaaaah!
Oh, you're not an imperial. Is...is it over?
Kami be praised! I was certain she would have us all killed and burn Isari to the ground─or kill us after making us watch, or barricade us in our homes before putting them to the torch...
We had heard stories about the viceroy, but that was the first time any of us had seen her in the flesh...and I should be glad if I never see her again.
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02481_000_060: I remember you! You're the one who saved me from the Doman catchers!
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02481_000_061: Thanks to you, we managed to rescue the fishermen and my kidnapped comrades─one of whom joined the Confederacy with me long ago. It would've broken my heart to have had to bury him...
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02481_000_062: Oh, and if you're looking for the captain, you'll find him in the tavern.
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_PIRATE02481_000_063: You should've seen it! The captain was a bleedin' whirlwind of death!
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_070: Back already? What have you learned?
TEXT_STMBDA314_02490_ALISAIE_000_071: At the tavern, you say? In that case, we should find Lyse and speak with him together.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_LYSE_000_000: This is it. We're finally headed into the heart of Doma. I can't help but be a little nervous...
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_ALISAIE_000_005: According to my map, the plains of Yanxia lie to the west. Of note is the One River, upon the shores of which Doma was built...
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_010: You did well, . Were it not for the tremendous strength and bravery of you and yours, many innocent souls would have suffered terrible fates.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_011: Though I knew the Confederacy would be loath to meet the imperials in battle, I also knew that if any could win them over, it would be you.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_012: Truly, yours is a heroic spirit that inspires men to rise above their circumstances─to strive for something greater! It will be an honor to travel with you again.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_013: Now then, let us not squander the Confederacy's gift. Yanxia and my countrymen await!
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_014: There is a tunnel to the southwest. We need but follow it to reach our destination. With me!
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_LYSE_000_020: This place, I...I don't know what I expected.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_ALISAIE_000_025: There's a weariness. A desolation. An emptiness...
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_030: Hmm... Yes, this is far enough.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_031: Ere we proceed further, I should speak of Yanxia and what became of her. Of what lies beyond that great wall at the heart of Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_ALISAIE_000_032: And we should be glad to hear it, but is it wise for us to have this conversation here, on the road, out in the open?
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_033: Once, your caution would be warranted...but no longer.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_034: Zenos did not linger after he crushed the rebellion. He appointed Yotsuyu to act in his stead and quit these lands for “fresh sport.”
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_035: The acting viceroy was no less merciless than her master. Without warning, her men would march into villages and search for “radical elements,” killing and torturing any who dared resist. And then, as quickly as they had come, they left.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_036: Satisfied that the memory of the purges would keep the people in line, she relaxed her grip on Yanxia. What need for the leash when the dog is broken...
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_037: The village of Namai lies to the west. Though I doubt the imperials are present, let us proceed with caution.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_LYSE_000_040: It seems peaceful enough to me...
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_ALISAIE_000_045: Even if there aren't any soldiers in the village, it would be foolish to simply stride in and announce ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_050: There she is─the humble village of Namai! How delicious her rice; how sweet her persimmons!
TEXT_STMBDA315_02491_GOSETSU_000_051: Too long has it been since I saw her with my own eyes. And, for a mercy, the imperials appear to be absent...
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_LYSE_000_000: It seems peaceful enough to me...
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ALISAIE_000_005: Even if there aren't any soldiers in the village, it would be foolish to simply stride in and announce ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_010: Let no man claim that I am reckless. Prudence has ever been my watchword! ─venture closer, if you would, and confirm that there are no soldiers lurking about.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_020: Forgive me, my friend, but unlike Yugiri, I am not made for the shadows.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_LYSE_000_030: Who is this boy, and where is he taking us?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ALISAIE_000_035: Judging from the reactions of the villagers, it's probably for the best that we left.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_040: I do not understand it! Was it not clear that we wished to remain awhile?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_050: I don't know who you people think you are, but do you have any idea what would happen to us if you were found in our village!?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_051: Again you address us with unwarranted spite! I have let your impropriety pass until now, but no longer!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_052: Who are you, boy, to speak to me thus? Know you not who I am?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_053: (-Isse-)I am Isse of Namai─a farmer, like my father before me, and his father before him. I wouldn't expect a man like you to know who I am─but I know you. We all do!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_054: (-Isse-)Lord Kaien's retainer and leader of the rebellion─Gosetsu! Notorious fugitive, wanted dead or alive by the Empire!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_055: Hah hah hah hah hah! Is that what this is all about?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_056: I am hardly the first man to earn the ire of the Empire. Nor will I be the last.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_057: Was not Namai home to brave and true warriors, who fought beneath our banners for king and country?
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_058: (-Isse-)They fought, and they died. Every last one. And then the imperials came looking for more. Because of them.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_059: (-Isse-)They were this close to killing us all─to burning our village to the ground. We've only just begun to enjoy some semblance of peace...
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ISSE_000_060: (-Isse-)Never again─never again, do you understand!? We've had enough of you and yours! Whatever it is you're plotting, leave us out of it!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_061: ...Hmm. Impassioned as his pleas may be, surely he must know that I cannot leave things as they are.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_062: But for now, I shall respect his wishes. We must continue on towards our final destination─the House of the Fierce. Proud headquarters of the Doman Liberation Front.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_063: There is a secret entrance to the north of Namai, by way of a small spring. Come─I will show you!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_ALISAIE_000_075: And there I was thinking our swimming days were behind us.
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_080: This way, this way! We must dive into the water!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_081: Have no fear, ! It is but a short distance. You need not hold your breath for long!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_RESSIANGATEKEEPER_0: Kami be praised! I know you!
TEXT_STMBDA316_02492_GOSETSU_000_091: Congratulations, my friends! You are come to the House of the Fierce!
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_LYSE_000_000: If it's strength we need, then it's strength we'll get. We can't lose to him again...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_RESISTANCE02492_000: To think that warriors such as you journeyed across the seas to aid our cause... We cannot thank you enough!
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_010: Now then, I should be glad to discuss our next course of action─
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_011: Though now that I think on it, I myself have been away from Doma for some time, and even after my return, the search for Lord Hien commanded my full attention...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_012: Mayhap it would be to both our benefit if we were to see the reality of Doma for ourselves. For did my lord not bid me learn the truth of her heart?
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_013: Let us do this together, . Let us go among the people and with our own eyes bear witness to their hardship.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_014: As a foreigner in these lands, your reputation does not precede you. Moreover, unlike Gosetsu, I can accompany you without attracting unwanted attention.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_LYSE_000_015: I'd like to join you, if that's all right.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_016: By all means. We should be glad of your company, and your perspective.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_017: Namai is not far. I say we begin there.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_LYSE_000_020: Yugiri told me to wear this outfit. My legs haven't felt this light and airy in ages!
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_030: Ah, . I am glad to see that you too put thought into your garments given the covert nature of our activities.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_031: Hm? I should think my reasons obvious. To enter the village while wearing the garb of the shinobi would be beyond reckless
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_032: We shall pose as traveling merchants─ as our leader, and we as  assistants. Are there any objections?
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_LYSE_000_033: I'm not really the merchant type, but if you think this is the best way to go about it, I'll trust you.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_034: Then without further ado, let us begin.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_040: You? A merchant? Forgive me my skepticism, but you strike me less a  of commerce and more a common sellsword.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_A1_101_040: Give your best impression of Hancock.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_041: That does little to assuage my doubts, and if anything makes me clutch my coinpurse tighter...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_042: I stand corrected! Such a warm and cordial nature you possess. I pray you forgive me my earlier rudeness.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_043: It has been some time since the viceroy came to our village to purge it of insurgents. Those who resisted suffered terribly, and those who did not fared little better.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_044: We who remain know better than to risk her ire. If the imperials demand laborers, we comply. If they demand conscripts to send as soldiers to other provinces, we obey.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_045: Ours is a difficult life, with little in the way of luxuries. I know not what you sell, merchant, but I doubt that I─nor anyone else here─can afford it.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_CHIGUSA_000_046: My apologies, merchant, but you will find no custom here.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MIYAMA_000_050: Foreign peddlers? In Namai? Whatever it is you sell, I have no money to buy. Perhaps you should go elsewhere.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MIYAMA_000_051: Saying that, I know of no village in Yanxia that has fared any better. Once, I would have directed you to the samurai lords of Monzen─had they not all died in battle or in the purges.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MIYAMA_000_052: There is the Doman Enclave, of course, but that lies beyond the Dairyu Moon Gates. Needless to say, the imperials are disinclined to let any but their own pass.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MIYAMA_000_053: You cannot pass through the Moon Gates without the blessing of the imperials. In other words, you will not pass through the Moon Gates.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_HONAMI_000_060: Weren't you the one who came with the general? No? Hmm. I see... My mistake.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_HONAMI_000_061: It warms my heart to see traveling merchants in Namai again. Though the imperials never sealed our borders, folks like you have taken to avoiding Yanxia ever since the rebellion.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_HONAMI_000_062: Unfortunately, that has only made it harder for us to survive. You may have noticed, but we lack for a great many things. It was not much better before, true, but it has only gotten worse...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_HONAMI_000_063:
What are you selling? I have a few koban stashed away, if you will accept them.
...What is wrong? Why do you hesitate? You are a merchant, are you not?
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MASATSUCHI_000_064: A traveling merchant? With meat, perchance? Bah, better not to know when I have so little coin.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MASATSUCHI_000_065: ...I feel your eyes upon me. You know not the Lupin? Surely you have not been long in Yanxia, else you would.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MASATSUCHI_000_066: For generations we served the lords of Doma, compassionate and wise as they were...but the memories of such times fade with every passing day. As others will tell you.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_MASATSUCHI_000_067: If I may, would you be so kind as to spare... No, never mind.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_LYSE_000_070: I've seen these looks before. That same weary hopelessness. It's just like Ala Gannha...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_081: Lyse and I encountered much of the same. They have been pushed beyond the brink.
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_082: I expected frustration and disillusionment, but not so much that they would come to question the wisdom of opposing imperial rule in the first place...
TEXT_STMBDA317_02493_YUGIRI_000_083: Unless we can convince them otherwise, I fear I cannot convince Lord Hien to return, and without him...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_LYSE_000_000: I've seen these faces before. That same weary hopelessness. It's like I'm back in Ala Gannha...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_010: Let us not yet lose hope. Though the situation in Namai is bleak, mayhap it is not so elsewhere.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_011: I wish to speak with others outside the village. Lyse and I will look for farmers in the paddies to the east. , I ask that you look to the south.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_012: Surely they cannot all have given in to despair...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_030: Thank you, thank you, thank you! If you hadn't come along, I don't know what I would've done!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_031: What am I doing out here? Oh...looking for flowers. I need some for my parents' graves.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_032: The ones my brother and I usually bring are yellow, because it was my mother's favorite color. You haven't seen any, have you?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_040: If you find any yellow flowers, could you bring them to me? But be careful─my brother says that you have to look out for the vilekin!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_050: Only yellow ones will do. Mother wouldn't have wanted anything else...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_051: Ah! You found some! Thank you so much, . That's twice you've saved me now!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_052: Um, if you have some time to spare, maybe you could come with me? I'm sure Mother and Father would want to meet the  who showed me such kindness.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_053: We buried them on a cliff to the west of the village. There's a path through the terraces. I'll show you!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_060: We're here! Just give me a moment to put down the flowers, and I'll introduce you...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_061: They loved to meet travelers and hear tales of faraway places. Maybe you could tell them one about your homeland?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_063: What in the─ You should not be here! Get away from my sister!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_AZAMI_000_064: Don't be so rude!  saved me from monsters, Brother─ even helped me pick flowers for Mother and Father!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_065: Go back to the village. Now.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_067: I said go! Stay inside and lock the door until I return!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_068: ...Don't think me ungrateful. My sister is the only family I have. If you saved her, then...thank you. But it changes nothing. I asked you to leave, and now I'm asking you again.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_069: I'm not going to report you to the imperials, or anything stupid like that. But it's too dangerous for you to stay here. So please, I'm begging you─just leave us alone!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_A1_000_071: Is that really what you want?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_A1_000_072: She said your parents were buried here...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_073: How many times do I have to tell you!? If they find you here, we're the ones they'll punish! And it'll be a thousand times worse than before!
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_074: ...So she told, did she? Yes. That's right.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_075: ...My mother and father believed in the rebellion. They left to fight for Lord Kaien. They came home on a cart driven by imperial soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_076: The soldiers demanded that the families of the insurgents present themselves, or else they'd burn the whole village to the ground.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_077: So we did. What choice did we have?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_078: They beat us in the village square─with their hands, with sticks, with anything. They kicked us while we lay on the ground, begging for mercy. They made us denounce my mother and father─call them fools, call them traitors. Say they deserved to die.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_079: I heard them laugh, but I dared not look up. One leaned close and whispered in my ear what he'd do to my sister if they had to come back.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_080: They're gone, but they're never far. All it takes is the wrong word in the wrong ear, and they'll return. And then I'll have to dig another grave. If I'm lucky.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_081: Whatever you came here to do, leave us out of it. If you want to fight the imperials, go and fight them on your own.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_ISSE_000_082: You can't help us. No one can. And this is all we've got. So please─don't take it from us.
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_100: You are come at a good time, . We but recently completed our inquiries. What of yours?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_101: I...I was not aware of these events... The boy, Isse, he told you all of this?
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_102: Such disgraceful, despicable crimes... If I knew the men responsible, I would not hesitate to hunt them down and─
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_103: Forgive me, that outburst was unbecoming. The more I learn of the imperials' actions in my absence, the more difficult I find it to marshal my emotions...
TEXT_STMBDA318_02494_YUGIRI_000_104: Could Lord Hien have foreseen this? That our people's spirits would be broken so? Though at first I scoffed at his pronouncement, it feels all too possible now that he might resolve to surrender himself...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_LYSE_000_000: There's got to be something we can do, right? We can't just give up and go home. Not after everything we've been through.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_010: ...Despite everything we have seen and learned, I refuse to renounce this cause.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_011: We should return to the House of the Fierce and consult with our comrades. Perhaps together, we might─
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_012: Did you hear that? Quickly, we must find a place to hide!
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_LYSE_000_020: Is someone coming? I didn't hear anything.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_025: Behind me, ! They come from the south!
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_030: Regardless of what the officer claimed, I fear they have crueler designs for these people.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_040: Given the circumstances, we must make every effort to refrain from needless violence.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_041: Here. It is a shinobi's tool, for when a more discreet approach is required. Use it with these darts. They are coated with an alchemical reagent that induces a deep sleep.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_042: There are soldiers patrolling ahead. Were circumstances different we could engage them directly, but for the villagers' sake we dare not risk it.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_043: We will use our blowguns to incapacitate them. For a shinobi such as you, this should prove no challenge. Nevertheless, practice is in order...
