TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_044: We will use our blowguns to incapacitate them. Regardless of your familiarity with such weapons, you are a veteran warrior, and I am sure it will come naturally to you. Nevertheless, practice is in order...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_050: There─the soldier on the hill below. Take aim and fire─if the dart finds its mark, he should fall within moments.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SYSTEM_000_051: Search your surroundings for the imperial soldier. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the soldier and use the blowgun with .
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_052: Well done, my friend! Now, give me your map─there is a vantage point from which you may observe and fire upon the other soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_053: Worry not─I shall be with you every step of the way, keeping watch for other patrols. We shall speak again on the other side of the river.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SYSTEM_000_060: The last imperial soldier crumples to the ground, asleep. You put away your blowgun and prepare to rejoin Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SOLDIERA02495_000_0: Huh. Who are you? Some wandering merchant? Whatever it is, I don't want any. Piss off.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SOLDIERB02495_000_0: This is no place for the likes of you. Begone!
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_080: Excellent work, . They appear to be none the wiser...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_081: The villagers are being held in the castrum to the south─Fluminis.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_082: Once, it was the base of operations for the Garlean occupation...until ten or so years ago, when they relocated to Doma Castle. Now, the castrum serves as little more than a storage facility...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_083: I spy two sentries near the gate. As you have proven yourself to have impeccable aim, I would ask you to incapacitate them. This very hill should afford you a clear shot.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_085: I will stand watch while you see to the guards. Climb the hill and use your blowgun to put them to sleep!
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SYSTEM_000_090: The two sentries slumber side by side. No others appear to be forthcoming...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_100: Fine work, . Oboro would be proud.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_101: Fine work, . You have a gift for the ways of the shinobi...
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_102: The way is clear─let us move closer and see what has become of the villagers.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_SOLDIERC02495_000_1: (-Imperial Decurion-)Sir! The Aan from the other villages are assembled for inspection.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_GARLEANLEADERDOMA_0: Very good. I will address them personally.
Attention! Shortly you all will be transported to the facility on the distant shore.

Your duties, as you have been previously informed, will be rudimentary in nature. More specifically, you will be tasked with the repair and maintenance of various arms and armaments, as well as magitek devices.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_VILLAGER02495_000_1: Magitek!? But we're farmers! We don't know the first thing about magitek!
It'd take us months, if not years, to learn how to do that kind of work!
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_GARLEANLEADERDOMA_0: The materiel in question was damaged when your kith and kin rose up in rebellion! Therefore, you bear responsibility for its repair!

If you cannot perform your duties, you will learn how. And if you cannot learn how, then your villages may find themselves at the mercy of the Confederacy and other radical elements. Is that what you want?
Deal with this rabble. I am needed at the castle.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_112: This is no temporary measure. Those men and women will die in servitude.
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_113: Once they are taken to the other facility, it will be too late. If we are to intervene, we must do so now. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA319_02495_YUGIRI_000_114: Then let us be about it.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_000: Despite the urgency of the situation, we must still proceed with the utmost caution to ensure the safety of the villagers.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_001: To wit, we must infiltrate the castrum without raising the alarum.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_002: I will deal with any soldiers near the entrance. Stand watch for others approaching from the north until you hear my signal.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_010: For a mercy, you spy no imperial patrols bound for the castrum. A hawk's cry pierces the silence─Yugiri is waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_BIGSOLDIER02496_000: Mmm... Mmm... No, you sign off first... <snore>
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_040: Speak softly, lest the others hear us. What of the outside?
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_041: ...That is good. We may proceed as planned.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_042: These ones shall not soon wake. However, the others are too close to the villagers. Incapacitating them as I did these ones is far too risky.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_043: Fortunately, a solution presents itself. I would have you disguise yourself as an imperial soldier and convince them that a changing of the guard is in order.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_044: You have your pick of uniforms. They shall not protest.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_050: I would not presume to choose for you. You know your own proportions best.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_060: This uniform appears to be more or less your size...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_061: Although this unform is quite large in several places, with a few minor adjustments, it appears as though it could suffice...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_062: Although this uniform is a little large for your tastes, with a few minor adjustments, it appears as though it could suffice...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_063: If there were three of you standing on each other's shoulders, you could perhaps fit into this uniform. Walking, however, would present a challenge.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_064: This uniform is far too large for you to wear comfortably.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_065: This uniform appears to be more or less your size...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_066: ...It would probably be considered obscene to wear this uniform in polite company.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_067: Attempting to wear this uniform might force you to confront certain uncomfortable realities better left unexplored...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_068: Perhaps, in another life, this uniform would have suited you perfectly. But not this one.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_069: ...Upon further consideration, you realize that such ambition would better serve you on the battlefield.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_070: ...Though it is often said that one should aspire to bigger and better things, it would not be prudent at this juncture.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_071: Although this uniform is a little small for your tastes, with a few minor adjustments, it appears as though it could suffice...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_072: This uniform appears to be more or less your size...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_073: With all due care and consideration, you relieve the sleeping soldier of their uniform.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_074: You have chosen one to your liking, then? Excellent.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_075: I shall hide these ones where none will find them.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_076: Our sleeping beauties have been laid to rest in their bunks. Oh, and while I was in the barracks, I happened upon these spare uniforms, in case the items in your possession are not to your liking.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_080: The sack appears to be filled with a nigh-infinite supply of imperial equipment...though it would be best if you did not attempt to put that cursory assessment to the proof.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_081: The sack appears to be filled with a nigh-infinite supply of imperial equipment...though it would be best if you did not attempt to put that cursory assessment to the proof.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_090: This kabuto and tekko should match the uwagi, hakama, and choka in your possession...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_091: And with that, you have a full set. I am sure that once you change, it will seem as though it was bespoke.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_092: You will need to give the soldiers guarding the villagers a proper imperial salute to complete the deception and convince them to come here, where I will be waiting to deal with them.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_100: The imperial soldiers assigned to Doma are hardly the Empire's best and brightest. Nevertheless, you will need to approach them in uniform if you wish to convince them you are one of their own.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_101: Do not forget to give them an imperial salute. They may not be the most clever soldiers in the imperial army, but they know protocol.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_102: ...In the strange and inexplicable event that you somehow dispose of all or part of your uniform, you may search these sacks for replacements. Not that there should be any need for that. Certainly not.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_105: The sack appears to be filled with a nigh-infinite supply of uwagi, hakama, and choka...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_106: Being the prudent and responsible individual that you are, you resolve only to take items to replace those which you may have misplaced under circumstances better left unsaid.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_000_107: The sack appears to be filled with a nigh-infinite supply of kabuto and tekko...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SOLDIERC02495_000_1: Huh!? How did you get in here! Leave, now!
Oh, hello there. Are you new?
...I don't know what you're about, but don't think that the provinces are any less strict than the capital. The viceroy does not tolerate insubordination.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_100_112: The decurian stares at you intently. You will need to perform a proper imperial salute to avoid suspicion.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SOLDIERC02495_000_1: Is it time already? Not that I'm complaining, mind, but I thought the others would be gone longer...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SOLDIERD02496_000_1: Hah hah, very amusing, you. Is this a drill? Am I supposed to bellow, “Rebel insurgents! To arms, to arms!” or some such rot?
Let me guess: hangover, eh? I've been there─woke up once after a late night drinking and didn't find my kabuto until days later. You don't want to know what it was filled with, let me tell you...
...This is that game where you try to make me guess a word or phrase by gesticulating wildly, isn't it? Hmm...can you do it again?
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SYSTEM_100_116: The decurian stares at you intently. You will need to perform a proper imperial salute to avoid suspicion.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_SOLDIERD02496_000_1: Changing of the guard, is it? About bloody time. Just looking at these Aan is making me depressed. Reminds me of when I was in their shoes, pissing myself in fear...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_130: These ones shall sleep soundly along with the others...
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_131: And, with that, there are no more soldiers to trouble us. You can dispose of that accursed uniform too.
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_132: It is time to guide the villagers to freedom!
TEXT_STMBDA320_02496_YUGIRI_000_140: Quickly, we must go to the villagers before more soldiers come!
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_012: Mayhap they have the right of it. Mayhap we are fools for urging them to rise once more. Yet I believe─I have to believe─that in their heart of hearts, they...they still...
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_013: ...Now is not the time. We must finish what we started.
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_014: I have in my possession a powerful medicine that befuddles the mind and memories. We must administer it to the soldiers ere they wake.
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_015: The medicine will leave the soldiers confused and unable to clearly recall recent events. They will suspect that they fell asleep at their posts and be reluctant to discuss it with others.
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_016: It is naught more than a temporary measure, but we dare not kill them for the sake of the villagers. Tend to the last two I put to sleep─I shall see to the others.
TEXT_STMBDA321_02497_YUGIRI_000_040: Come, come! We must tell the others of this airship, or hear what they know of it!
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_GOSETSU_100_000: Zenos will fall, but not to a desperate knife in the dark. We will need to plan and prepare, and she has done neither.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_001: He will depart Doma Castle by ship and approach the Moon Gates. The magitek field will be deactivated briefly, allowing his vessel to pass. It will then continue on to these very docks, where he and his entourage will disembark.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_002: As you can see, this area is not ideal for an ambush. Wide open, multiple avenues of escape. The manor is better suited to our needs.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_003: Let us split up and search for suitable hiding places.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_SYSTEM_000_010: Surrounded by walls and deserted, this location appears to be ideal for concealment...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_012: Hmm... From the roof, we would have a clear view of the docks...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_013: It is settled. We shall lie in wait here until Zenos arrives.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_014: As discussed, if all goes to plan, he shall fall with my first blow. If not, then the two of us will have to engage him in open combat.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_015: His escort is of no consequence, which means that we will have a two-to-one advantage. Nevertheless, he is not to be underestimated...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_000_020: All that remains is to wait. I trust that you are ready?
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ISSE_000_035: It's all right. Here, have some water...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_GOSETSU_000_040: 'Tis naught that will not heal with time.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ALISAIE_000_050:
I don't think we were followed...
Gods... I have no idea what was going through that man's head, but I am heartily glad he decided to leave.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ALISAIE_000_051: Oh, and don't thank us. Thank Alphinaud. He's at the House of the Fierce, patiently awaiting your gratitude.
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ALISAIE_000_052: You should've seen the way he turned pale when he heard about Yugiri's plan─and how you of all people had decided to help her. He was in such a panic, barking orders, calling for a squadron to be assembled─
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ALISAIE_000_054: I was rather composed, as I recall. Though that is neither here nor there...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: Zenos yae Galvus! You will die by my hand!
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ZENOS_BATTLETALK_00: First you must kill my men. You can do that, can you not?
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YOTSUYU_BATTLETALK_: What are you doing, you fools!? There are only two of them!
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ZENOS_BATTLETALK_00: Hm. How much longer must you make me wait?
Very well. I suppose you have earned this...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: This is not a game, you twisted, arrogant bastard!
No! I can still fight, I can still...still...
TEXT_STMBDA322_02498_ZENOS_BATTLETALK_00: Well done, beast. You have earned the right to look on the Ame-no-Habakiri.
You're better than most, I'll grant you that. But not good enough. This ends now.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_005: I...I can manage on my own.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_GOSETSU_000_010: 'Tis naught that will not heal with time.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_020: Can you believe it? We faced the crown prince himself and lived to tell the tale!
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_021: You've no idea what this means for us. Everyone's talking about getting more weapons and armor and...and...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_022: And we're not going to stop until we've taken back our homeland!
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_023: Ah, right. Getting a bit ahead of ourselves, aren't we? We've got wounded to tend to first. We should get back to the village!
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_030: How are you feeling? After fighting that demon, I can only imagine...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_031: ...I suppose I ought to apologize to you. For...you know...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_032: Anyway, uh... Thank you. For not giving up on us. The shinobi too.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALPHINAUD_000_040: In the meantime, how shall I occupy myself...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_050: I will be traveling to the Azim Steppe, .
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_051: I found Lord Hien once before, and I am confident I can do so again. Moreover, it was to me whom he put the question of Doma's resolve. I feel it my duty to deliver to him our people's reply.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_052: My injuries are of no moment. You need not fear for me.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_GOSETSU_000_055: Our countrymen's deeds speak for themselves. Lord Hien cannot deny the truth of their hearts.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_GOSETSU_000_056: Too long has it been since I looked on his face. It would be of great comfort to see him again─and no small comfort if you were to join us in the search, I should add!
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_GOSETSU_000_057: I will wait no longer to greet my young lord and master! Nay, I should be glad to accompany Yugiri and bring him back home!
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_LYSE_000_060: I wonder what kind of man Hien is. From what I heard, he's about the same age as me. And then there's Fordola, who isn't a whole lot younger than us both...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_LYSE_000_061: Like her, he was born and raised in an imperial province. This is all he's ever known. But unlike her, he chose to do something about it...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_LYSE_000_062: I want to meet him. I want to know why. Maybe, if I understand that, it'll help me to understand a lot of other things...
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_LYSE_000_063: I don't think I could stand waiting around for them to get back. I want to go too.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_065: The beloved king returning to urge his countrymen to rise up in rebellion. Not a story you'd ever hear in Sharlayan or Ul'dah, is it?
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALPHINAUD_000_066: Not in those words, perhaps, but no land's people is so cynical to be wholly immune to inspiration. Singular individuals have the power to move hearts and minds no matter where they go.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_067: Mmmhm. Doubtless you speak from personal experience.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_068: As much as this Lord Hien intrigues us, , there are vital tasks to be attended to here─preparations for the inevitable assault on Doma Castle, for one.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_069: There is also the matter of coordinating our efforts with the Confederacy and our comrades in Kugane, dealing with this troublesome aetheryte─I could go on, but you understand.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_070: As I said before, we've a million things to do here. Much as Alphinaud and I would love to join the search, we cannot. Right, Brother?
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALPHINAUD_000_080: ...Aye, so it goes. We all have our responsibilities.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_081: We shall depart for the Azim Steppe at once.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_083: For our part, we shall do what we can to aid the Doman Liberation Front in your absence.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ALISAIE_000_084: We will refrain from conducting any large-scale operations in your absence, and instead devote our energies to bolstering our ranks and training our new recruits. When you return, we will be ready for war.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_LYSE_000_085: If anything happens, if you need us to come back sooner, you'd better contact us. “Noble sacrifices” are a last resort, remember?
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_YUGIRI_000_086: Follow me, my friends. We have many malms to travel before we reach Reunion.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_088: Here, take these for the road. It's simple fare, but it's the least we can do for you, after what you did for us.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_089: ...It may be stupid and naive of me to say this, but I will.
TEXT_STMBDA323_02499_ISSE_000_090: When you come back, we'll finish what we started. We'll beat the imperials and we'll win our freedom! So...don't keep us waiting too long!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_LYSE_000_000: Is it just me, or is everyone here Xaela?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GOSETSU_000_005: I must confess that this is my first time on the Steppe...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_010: When last I spoke with Lord Hien, he said he spent much time in these markets. I had hoped we might find him here today, but alas...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_LYSE_000_011: Hey, Yugiri, I've been meaning to ask─there are an awful lot of Xaela here, aren't there?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_012: Oh, I assumed you knew. The Azim Steppe has been home to the nomadic tribes of the Xaela since antiquity.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_013: More than fifty roam these lands, and though they do not constitute a nation, there is a hierarchy of sorts, determined through ritual combat.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_LYSE_000_014: Funny... If they're so busy fighting each other, you'd think the Empire would be able to march in and take the Steppe with ease. I wonder why they haven't...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GOSETSU_000_016: Perhaps they see little value in it, especially given the fierce reputation of the Xaela warriors who would fight tooth and nail to oppose them.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_017: These lands were not made for men. The soil is thin, and the weather unforgiving.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_018: The Xaela found ways to survive, it is true. But they are made of sterner stuff than most imperials─conscript or citizen.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_LYSE_000_019: Thanks for taking the time to explain. It sounds like I've got a lot to learn. Later, I mean. We're meant to be looking for Hien!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_020: People from many tribes gather in Reunion to trade goods and information. I should be surprised if we cannot learn something of value here.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YUGIRI_000_021: Let us make our inquiries separately. , why don't you speak with some of the merchants here?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CHAMBUI_000_030: Buuz! Fresh buuz! Your choice of lamb or dzo! Guaranteed to satisfy! How many will you have, ?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CHAMBUI_000_031: Eh? A Doman? Unless another Dazkar is keeping him in her yurt, he is not here. <snort> More fool her if she took a Doman for a husband.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CHAMBUI_000_032: But enough about Domans─let us speak of buuz instead! You cannot come to the Azim Steppe and not sample this most traditional of delicacies!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CHAMBUI_000_033: But enough about Domans─let us speak of buuz instead! Surely your mother or father made you some when you were little? A Xaela who never eats buuz is never a whole Xaela!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CHAMBUI_000_034: You there! Why don't you have a buuz in your hand right now?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YESUI_000_040: What fortune you have to come hither at this time! Freshly slaughtered, every cut available on request. Organs too─hearts, livers, brains. Or a brace of blood sausages, if you desire only a snack!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YESUI_000_041: A Doman? Poor meat they make, Domans─ I jest, I jest. Hmm...I did see a young Mol in the company of one some few days ago...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_YESUI_000_042: Are you sure you do not wish to purchase anything? Organs as fresh as these will be gone before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_BAIDUR_000_050: Roasted fish with pumpkin! An exotic foreign delicacy, cooked to perfection, beloved without the Steppe! Come, come!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_BAIDUR_000_051: You seek Domans? Then you are come to the wrong place, my friend. Delicious as my foodstuffs are, they find little favor with those from the south.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_BAIDUR_000_052: Now, if it were Goro you were looking for, on the other hand, then I might be able to help you. They flock to my stall!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_BAIDUR_000_053: Doubtless you know well the wonders of Western cuisine. Then I need not persuade you to partake, yes? Come, come─eat your fill!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_060: I did not think it would be so expensive...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_NARENGAWA_000_065: There, there. You did well to travel so far.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GORO02500_000_080: I have brought you a new brush, my beloved. So smooth and silky your mane shall be─the envy of every other man...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GORO02500_000_081: Hm? Say again? You are seeking who?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GORO02500_000_082: Ah, the Doman. I know of whom you speak. He comes and goes with a Mol girl.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GORO02500_000_083: Though I could not describe her. I only know that she is Mol because I heard them talking as they passed.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_SYSTEM_000_084: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase that contains “Mol” to ask the Xaela in Reunion if they are of the Mol tribe.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_GORO02500_000_090: Oh, my dearest, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_NARENGAWA_000_100: I am Ura, if you must know. Come down from the mountains in the north. If there is nothing else...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_UCUGEN_000_101: You take me for a Mol!? I am Oronir! Compare me not with ones so weak and lowly!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_102: ...Yes? I am Mol. My name is Cirina. May I help you?
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_110: Oh... Oh, I see. You are looking for Hien. In that case─
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_MASGUD_000_111: How urgent this business must be to leave our conversation unfinished!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_MASGUD_000_112: The kinsai. Will you buy it? There is but one bundle left. If not, then─
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_113: I will, I will! Though I had not thought to pay so high a price...
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_MASGUD_000_114: It is a bargain for which you should be grateful. If you lack the coin, then the fault is your own, and you will leave with nothing.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_115: Please, I must have the kinsai! The gods themselves requested it! We are bound to their will!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_MASGUD_000_116: ...Pay me the difference in whisperroot. I will sell it to the next apothecary to pass through Reunion, and we will each feel fairly treated.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_MASGUD_000_117: But do not tarry. Should another come before you, coin in hand, I will not refuse him.
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_118: I understand. Thank you for this kindness!
TEXT_STMBDA401_02500_CIRINA_000_119: I am sorry, but we must speak of Hien later. I cannot leave Reunion without that kinsai...
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_010: You...you want to help me, is that it?
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_011: I do not know what to say... Thank you, , thank you!
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_012: The lumbering ones we must fell wander the plains to the west of Reunion. If we each harvest two, then we should have enough whisperroot.
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_013: Return here when you have finished. Good luck!
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_020: Welcome back, . Have you brought the whisperroot?
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_021: Blessed is he who shows kindness to strangers, for with fortune does he ever ride.
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_MASGUD_000_023: It shall. The kinsai is yours.
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_MASGUD_000_024: The gods favor you more than you know, child. Udgan rarely have need of such herbs, and so my stock is limited. Had you come a day earlier or later, I would have none for you.
TEXT_STMBDA402_02501_CIRINA_000_025: Perhaps the gods guided me here, as they guided Grandmother. As they guided this  from the West...
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_LYSE_000_000: I like a good fight as much as anyone, but we should probably find Hien and head back to Doma as soon as we can.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_YUGIRI_000_005: The people have spoken, and Lord Hien will heed their words. He must.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_GOSETSU_000_010: If she knows where Lord Hien is, then what are you waiting for? Ask her!
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_CIRINA_000_020: Long ago, my grandmother, having received a vision from the gods, bade me go forth into the southern mountains. It was there that I found Hien, near death from many wounds.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_CIRINA_000_021: I brought him to our village, and there we nursed him back to health. Afterwards, he chose to remain, that he might repay us for our kindness.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_CIRINA_000_022: Domans set much store by honor and shame, so at first I did not question it...
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_CIRINA_000_023: Excuse me. If I could see your map for a moment... Here─he has grown fond of this place. It affords him a view of the markets and the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_CIRINA_000_024: I would accompany you, but I must return to our village to prepare my grandmother's meal. Thank you again for your assistance!
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_YUGIRI_000_025: Our long-awaited reunion is at hand! Come, my friends─let us go and greet our lord and master!
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_LYSE_000_030: He's a lot more...straightforward than I expected? And he's certainly not short on confidence.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_LYSE_000_031: But maybe that's the kind of leader Doma needs if they're going to beat these odds. And hey─we've come this far, haven't we? Who's to say we can't go even further?
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_GOSETSU_000_040: Has he truly recovered from his wounds, I wonder? I believe a match may be in order...
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_HIEN_000_050: , was it? Once again, allow me to thank you for your many deeds in service to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_HIEN_000_051: For twenty-five years did my father rule in name only. My rule─if one would deign to call it that─has been naught in comparison.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_HIEN_000_052: That changes now. We have a purpose and a plan, and after we take to the battlefield together, we will have victory as well.
TEXT_STMBDA403_02502_HIEN_000_053: But you are a practical . I can tell. Disinclined to trust in words when actions speak truer. I can relate...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_000: He's a lot more...straightforward than I expected? And he's certainly not short on confidence.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_001: But maybe that's the kind of leader Doma needs if they're going to beat these odds. And hey─we've come this far, haven't we? Who's to say we can't go even further?
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_GOSETSU_000_005: Has he truly recovered from his wounds, I wonder? I believe a match may be in order...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_010: So─you too have heard of the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_011: "The great battle for supremacy of the Steppe.“ I learned of it during my stay with the Mol.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_012: To my knowledge no foreigners have ever participated, much less triumphed in a Naadam. But, lack of precedent notwithstanding, I should think we would have good standing to bid them march with us to Doma─should we win.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_GOSETSU_000_013: Will they even permit us to fight, my lord? We belong to no tribe of the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_014: We are not without options, given what Cirina has told me.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_015: You see, in accordance with the gods' wishes, her people shall participate in the coming Naadam...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_016: ...And when they take the field, I mean for us to fight alongside them as fellow warriors of the Mol.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_017: But we need not discuss this at length here. Come, let us head north to Mol Iloh, where Cirina and her people have made camp for this season.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_020: Cirina came all this way by herself? She's braver than she looks.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_GOSETSU_000_025: The beasts are never far. I saw more than a few stalking us as we walked. Truly, these lands are fraught with peril.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_030: My friends, I give you Mol Iloh!
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_031: The khatun of the tribe, Temulun, resides in the largest yurt. We should go and make our introductions.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_040: It's smaller and more cozy than Reunion. And is that music I hear? It's strange...but somehow comforting...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_GOSETSU_000_045: For all the grand promises my lord Hien has made, it would not do for us to falter now. We must earn the Mol's blessing.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_050: I am told you have a knack for making excellent first impressions, . Why don't you lead the way?
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_CIRINA_000_055: Oh, it's you. Where are your comrades? Did you find Hien?
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_070: I guess we'll have to beat some strong opponents to win this Naadam...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_LYSE_000_071: But that's good, isn't it? I mean, if they were easy to beat, they wouldn't be worth taking back to Doma, would they?
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_GOSETSU_000_075: How confident and bold in speech he has grown. More and more he reminds me of his father in his youth...
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_080: Although I have spent much time with the Mol, I have yet to fully grasp the nature of the udgan and their insights.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_HIEN_000_081: That they value the chance encounter, and the potential fortune it brings, however, is plain. Let us try not to disappoint them!
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_TEMULUN_000_085: Wheresoever you go, remember that you are not alone. Remember that you carry the fire for them, and they for you.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_CIRINA_000_090: ...Thank you all for coming, and for offering to fight with us in the Naadam. Though I still fear our chances grim, I am grateful for your assistance.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_CIRINA_000_091: To be recognized as warriors of the Mol, there is a trial you must overcome.
TEXT_STMBDA404_02503_CIRINA_000_092: But before we speak of such things, there is another, more pressing matter!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_LYSE_000_000: I guess we'll have to beat some strong opponents to win this Naadam...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_LYSE_000_001: But that's good, isn't it? I mean, if they were easy to beat, they wouldn't be worth taking back to Doma, would they?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_005: How confident and bold in speech he has grown. More and more he reminds me of his father in his youth...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_010: Although I have spent much time with the Mol, I have yet to fully grasp the nature of the udgan and their insights.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_011: That they value the chance encounter, and the potential fortune it brings, however, is plain. Let us try not to disappoint them!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_020: My friends. I must warn you. The path upon which you embark is fraught with peril.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_021: You will journey unto the far reaches of the Steppe to confront a terrible foe, as did the warrior Bardam in days of yore. Three days he battled with the demon ere he returned to his people. So it is written, so must it be.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_022: Many who follow in his footsteps perish, lacking in strength of body and mind. Therefore...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_023: We must treat you to a great feast!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_024: Have...have I said something strange? The hungry fox starves staring at the bull's testicles, therefore warriors should be well fed on the eve of battle!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_025: She does have a point. You have been keeping busy in my absence. A brief repast may be in order, lest we collapse of fatigue and malnourishment in the midst of our trial.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_026: Yes, just so! However, it will take time to prepare.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_LYSE_000_027: Is there anything we can do to help? It might also give us a chance to learn more about your people and their ways.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_028: Well, if you insist, I am sure that the others would be glad of your assistance.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_029: Hmm... Would you go and speak with Dorbei, Lyse?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_030: As for you three─you can help me with another task.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_031: For today's feast the gods decreed that we lure gulo gulo to slaughter with entrails. Perhaps you could be the ones to do this?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_032: That your people look to the gods for guidance I understand, but in your daily meals! I say, your grandmother must be quite busy.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_033: Some days more than others. But every night we come together around the cookfire.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_034: Even babes must earn their keep on the Steppe. Give over the entrails, Cirina. We will bring you a bounty of meat!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_040: Hien has the entrails. Good hunting, !
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_045: Shall the gulo gulo be so easily lured to the slaughter, I wonder...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_050: A word of advice. Our quarry is wont to avoid the Xaela and their settlements, but is fond of flowing waters...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_051: Hmm. A thought occurs to me. How about we make a game of it, ?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_052: I have six bags of entrails with which we may lure our gulo gulo. Three for you, and three for me.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_053: Whoever returns with the greater portion shall be declared the winner. What say you?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_054: Then it is settled! Gosetsu will stand as witness. Let the game begin!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_060: The rules are simple. Whoever returns with the greater portion shall be declared the winner.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_061: You have but a limited quantity of bait. Use it wisely, . Seek places far from men and near water.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_070: Use the entrails to erect a lure here?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_071: This area appears to be isolated and far from any Xaela settlement. There may be many gulo gulo lurking nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_072: The river winds its way south, the waters churning with the gentle current. There may be many gulo gulo lurking nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_073: This area appears to be isolated and far from any Xaela settlement. There may be many gulo gulo lurking nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_074: Hoofprints and wagon tracks are unmistakable in the earth. Perhaps there are gulo gulo lurking nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_SYSTEM_000_075: The watchtowers of Mol Iloh are still visible in the distance. It seems unlikely that gulo gulo would venture this close...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_080: Oh, have you used all your bait? In that case, let us see the fruits of your labor!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_081: Ho! It would seem that, at the very least, you are the faster hunter.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_082: But speed is not everything. For my part, I slew six gulo gulo!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_083: Aye, that you have, my lord. As for ...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_084: The meat of eight gulo gulo did  bring! A fine day's work, and undeniably the greater portion.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_085: The meat of seven gulo gulo did  bring! By a slim margin did  best you, but victory is  all the same.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_086: Six gulo gulo did  slay too! 'Twould seem you have met your match, my lord.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_087: The meat of five was all  could muster. The day is yours, my lord─but only by a touch.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_088: With the meat of four did  return. Congratulations, my lord─you are the victor!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_089: This day you are twice the hunter as , for our friend delivered unto me but three portions─half your sum, my lord.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_100_089: ...My lord, I do not wish to alarm you, but the bounty of meat  has brought far outstrips yours! Impossibly so...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_090: Bah! A loss, is it? And how confident I was in my chances.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_091: Nevertheless, it is a testament to your skills as a hunter and a warrior. How fortunate I am to count one so talented among my allies!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_092: Hah hah hah! Of all the possible outcomes, this is perhaps the most amusing.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_093: And perhaps the most auspicious. Though I would have preferred to win the day, I shall settle for the whimsy of the kami.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_094: Oho! And there you have it. I shall try not to let it go to my head.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_095: I know better than to expect the hawk to show  talons on a whim. Nay, when the time comes, I expect you will prove yourself more than my match.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_096: And with that, our game is concluded. Let us return to Mol Iloh forthwith─and let us have  present our meat to Cirina.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_097: Mayhap you are unfamiliar with traditional Xaela cuisine? Let not its appearance deceive you─it is quite hearty and nourishing.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_098: Were it not so, I doubt they could have nursed me back to health. Heh heh, you should have seen the state I was in...
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_HIEN_000_100: She should be impressed when she sees the quantity we have brought.
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_GOSETSU_000_105: Such kindness and generosity they have shown not only my lord, but us all. Victory in the Naadam will be a fitting repayment!
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_110: You are returned, . How was your hunt?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_111: My word, this is impressive! Or were you so hungry that you felt the need to kill so many?
TEXT_STMBDA405_02504_CIRINA_000_112: Well! I shall endeavor not to disappoint you all with my cooking!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_HIEN_000_000: Mayhap now would be a good time to speak with Gosetsu at greater length, and learn more of our countrymen's plight.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_GOSETSU_000_010: Such kindness and generosity they have shown not only my lord, but us all. Victory in the Naadam will be a fitting repayment!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_020: It will be a little while before the meal is ready. If you and Lyse wish to fill the time, perhaps you could assist Dorbei?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_021: He has many responsibilities, and would welcome your help. Nor would you regret making his acquaintance, for he is liked and respected by all.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_022: You may find him by the other yurt, taking stock of our supplies.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_030: Leave the cooking to me! I promise I will not disappoint you.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_DORBEI_000_040: Ah. One of the newcomers. Welcome. I spoke with Lyse.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_DORBEI_000_041: I bade her help the children gather fuel for the cookfires. I trust it will be a good experience for all.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_DORBEI_000_042: For you too, perhaps. Seek them in the south, across the bridge.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_DORBEI_000_050: Please use the bridge. One should not sully flowing waters without cause.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_060: Oh, ! Are you here to help too?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_061: Great! So...I suppose Dorbei told you that the children and I are gathering “fuel” for the fires, did he?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_062: It'll need to be dried before they can burn it, of course. You, um...you do understand what we're here for, right? Only, some people can be a bit squeamish about this sort of stuff.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_063: Then again, you've never minded getting your hands dirty, have you? Anyway, we're trying to get four piles each. Good luck! And keep an eye on the children while you're at it, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_070: The children are around here somewhere. You should talk to them. They're great!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_01GIRL02505_000_075: Oh, you are Lyse's friend! Are you here to help us too?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_03BOY02505_000_085: Traveler! I will not lose to you! I shall find three times as much dung as you─at least!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_04GIRL02505_000_090: I cannot seem to find any dung here. Maybe somewhere else...?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_100: Well? Have you found your share yet?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_101: Good work. I hope you took the time to talk to the children while you were at it.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_03BOY02505_000_102: Lyse! Lyse! Look how much dung we have!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_103: Wow, I'm impressed! I thought we'd gathered a lot, but it looks like we'll have to admit defeat!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_04GIRL02505_000_104: Dorbei will be happy we found enough...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_01GIRL02505_000_105: Not just Dorbei! Now we can continue making cheese! Not that I was worried─it was easier when we were living near that forest, but dung works just as well as wood.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_106: I heard the Mol move from place to place─that the gods tell you where to go. That must be hard on you all...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_03BOY02505_000_107: Hard? I do not understand. Why is it hard?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_03BOY02505_000_108: It is better for the animals to move─to have more food to eat and land to roam. To stay in one place is harder, no?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_02BOY02505_000_109: ...From the heavens comes the rain which nourishes the soil. From the soil comes the grass which nourishes the beast. From the beast comes the flesh which nourishes the Xaela. Ours is the soil of one and all.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_01GIRL02505_000_110: But you Westerners are like the Domans─you live in the same place. In villages. And all the villages in one place are part of a “nation,” yes?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_01GIRL02505_000_111: Hien talks about nations sometimes. When he was injured, he spoke of Doma in his sleep, but I did not understand his words.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_04GIRL02505_000_112: Whenever I ask him about Doma, he just smiles and looks to the south...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_04GIRL02505_000_113: It reminds me of my mother when she waits for my father to return from a long journey... But Hien will not wait any longer, will he? Because you came for him. To take him back...because his nation is more important...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_114: Um...I'm not sure how to answer this...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_115: A nation...is a place, I suppose. A place...and the people in it...and maybe the things, too...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_116: But more than that, it's the history, the traditions, the words. The stories we tell ourselves and our children. Everything that came before and everything that comes after.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_117: The place we were born is part of who we are. We carry it with us, no matter where we go. Whoever...whatever we become, that part remains─that link to our fathers and their fathers before them...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_118: It's...it's not important to everyone, I suppose, and that's fine. But it's important to Hien. And to me.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_02BOY02505_000_119: ...Some call the Mol fools for listening to the elder gods, but it is our way. Our pride. Our...nation?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_120: Something like that. It's something precious that you and others share─and that no one can ever take from you.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_121: But we can talk more about it later! It's time to go home. Dorbei is waiting!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_122: I'll stay with the children. Why not go and let Cirina know how we got on?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_DORBEI_000_125: You aided the children? That is well. I trust you enjoyed their company.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_130: Welcome back, . Did you speak with Dorbei?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_131: Well, well! Then you will forgive me if I ask you to wash your hands. I shall pour you a cup of milk tea in the meantime.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_132: The meal is almost ready, so we should summon Hien and Gosetsu...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_LYSE_000_140: <yawn> That was just what I needed!
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_GOSETSU_000_145: A new beginning lies beyond the horizon. We have but to seize it with our own two hands.
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_CIRINA_000_150: Was the food to your liking? Good, good...
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_HIEN_000_160: Well, my friends! I for one am full of vim and vigor! I trust you feel the same?
TEXT_STMBDA406_02505_HIEN_000_161: Then what better time than now to undertake our trial, and become full-fledged warriors of the Mol!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_000: <yawn> That was just what I needed!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_GOSETSU_000_005: A new beginning lies beyond the horizon. We have but to seize it with our own two hands.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_010: Was the food to your liking? Good, good...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_020: Now then, Cirina, if you would tell us of the trial we must undertake that we might participate in the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_021: Ah, yes! As I mentioned before, to be recognized as warriors of the Steppe, one must follow in the footsteps of the legendary warrior Bardam.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_022: He embarked on a great pilgrimage, eschewing cart and horse, and walked for many malms until he came to a holy place, thereafter named Bardam's Mettle. There, at the altar, as he did, you must pray.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_023: The altar lies deep within the breeding grounds of the yol. To complete your trial, you must tame one. Only then will your trial be complete.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_024: Fair enough. And where is the entrance to Bardam's Mettle?
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_025: You must journey far, far to the west─beyond Chakha Zoh, where lie the bones of a great and wise woman.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_026: Beyond the ruins of Ceol Aen, hidden within the mountains is a narrow pass. Follow it, and you will come to Bardam's Mettle.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_027: Sounds to me like it'll be a trial just getting to the trial...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_028: More than you may know. On the eve of the Naadam, many strive to improve their fortunes─some by abducting and enslaving the warriors of other tribes.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_029: Be ever mindful of your surroundings, lest you be taken as well.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_030: Hah! What grim expressions you wear while nodding so powerfully! Warriors such as you are not like to fall en route to a mere rite of passage.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_031: We shall proceed with all due caution, yes, but let us not worry overmuch.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_032: We will overcome this trial, and the next, and the next, until we stand triumphant. That is all there is to it, no?
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_033: With me, my friends! To the west! To Bardam's Mettle!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_034: W-Wait, Hien! Oh dear. I knew I would forget.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_035: Here─take these whistles. Once tamed, your yol will hearken to their call.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_036: Thanks. We'll try them out once we've finished the trial.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_037: Let's catch up to Hien and Gosetsu!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_CIRINA_000_040: It is indeed a perilous journey, but I know you will succeed─as I once did.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_050: We still have a long way to go, but I think I can see that monument Cirina talked about.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_051: I don't see Hien or Gosetsu, though. We should hurry!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_060: Hey...I don't know about you, but I can't shake the feeling someone's watching us.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_061: Cirina did warn us about tribes that kidnap warriors and make them fight for them. Something tells me we're about to meet them...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_BALLOON_000_063: Your blood shall water the soil.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_070: They're wearing yellow. I've seen their clothes somewhere before...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_GOSETSU_000_075: Is that the best you can do!? Come, villains! Come at me!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_080: Ah, there you are. As you can see, they left us little choice.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_081: I gather you were forced to dispatch a few yourself? So it goes. A few less warriors to face in the Naadam, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_082: Ceol Aen is not much further. That said, I should be surprised if our would-be masters do not try to subdue us one final time...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_LYSE_000_090: <huff> <puff> This is it! The real trial!
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_GOSETSU_000_095: Tread softly. We are for hallowed ground, and the kami are restless...
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_100: Right. This must be the pass that leads to Bardam's Mettle.
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_101: They say no foreigners have overcome this trial, but, well, there is a first time for everything, no?
TEXT_STMBDA407_02506_HIEN_000_102: Perhaps you do not hail from these lands, but your forefathers did. You do them honor to carry on their legacy this day.
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_000: <huff> <puff> This is it! The real trial!
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_GOSETSU_000_005: Tread softly. We are for hallowed ground, and the kami are restless...
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_HIEN_000_010: Nothing left but to begin, then.
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_HIEN_000_011: To complete the trial, we must pass through Bardam's Mettle and each tame a yol. How precisely we are to do this, I am not sure, but since countless warriors before us have succeeded, I imagine we'll muddle through somehow...
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_HIEN_000_012: But enough talk! We have a Naadam to win!
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_020: First the trial, then the Naadam, then Doma, then Ala Mhigo! We'll be back home before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_HIEN_000_025: Quite frankly, if I cannot convince a large bird to follow me, then what hope do I have with the Xaela? Or my own countrymen, for that matter.
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_GOSETSU_000_030: I have stood upon more battlefields than I can count and lived to tell the tale. No bird will be my downfall!
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_100_050: Well fought back there, . Things got hairy at times, but I knew we'd manage!
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_050: Oh, right. I've still got those whistles Cirina gave me.
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_051: Here's yours. I suppose we ought to give them a try like she said.
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_053: I think that means we've won them over. That one there is yours, right? The other one is mine. Awww...
TEXT_STMBDA408_02507_LYSE_000_054: So that's that, then! We're officially warriors of the Steppe!
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_LYSE_000_000: Well, we've done what we came to do. Let's head back to Mol Iloh.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_LYSE_000_010: I know, I know, I probably should've left the talking to everyone else...
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_HIEN_000_015: Pretentious and preening he may be, but doubt not that he is a warrior. You saw the axe by his throne...and the rage in his eyes.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_GOSETSU_000_020: Favor, tribute...how easily the language of tyrants tumbles from this khan's lips.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_BAATU_000_025: You will conduct yourself with utmost propriety in Magnai's presence. Or face consequences.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_DAIDUKUL_000_030: Hmm... Yes...yes... This one is special.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_040: So you are the first to step forward. Hmm. Bold...or reckless. I see why Daidukul favors you.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_041: ...Were I Buduga, I might take offense.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_042: But I know better than to dismiss a woman outright. You demonstrate boldness...or recklessness. Time will tell.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_043: The Naadam approaches, and the Oronir will reign supreme once more. Such is the will of Father Azim.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_044: Yet only fools think to triumph by the grace of the gods alone─and we are not fools.
TEXT_STMBDA409_02508_MAGNAI_000_045: Your task will be to aid us in our preparations. Baatu will tell you the rest.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_LYSE_000_000: I know, I know, I probably should've left the talking to everyone else...
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_005: Pretentious and preening he may be, but doubt not that he is a warrior. You saw the axe by his throne...and the rage in his eyes.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_GOSETSU_000_010: Favor, tribute...how easily the language of tyrants tumbles from this khan's lips.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_020: Warriors of the Steppe! By the grace of our most radiant brother, you will not die this day, but instead be granted an opportunity to contribute to our cause.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_021: Rejoice, for this is a great honor indeed. Serve well, and you will be rewarded.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_LYSE_000_022: Question! You keep calling Magnai your “most radiant brother.” You're not related or something, are you?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_023: ...All Oronir are descendants of Father Azim. But if you mean to ask if our mothers are one and the same, then no. The most radiant is the elder brother to we younger─the strongest and most deserving of respect.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_024: No more interruptions! Your duties are as follows.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_025: You, the red woman. You will milk our beasts. To grow strong, one must be well fed, and we have great need of kumis and cheese.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_LYSE_000_026: ...Is that it? I mean, I'm not happy about all this, but I suppose I can go along for now.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_027: You, the one who lumbers as a mountain... Hm. An old warrior, I see. We have arms and armor in need of repair. Go and speak with our menders.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_GOSETSU_000_028: I have no talent for delicate work, but if that is your wish, then so be it.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_029: You, the insolent fool. As for you─
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_DAIDUKUL_000_030: This one carries the fire. The Buduga would take his measure.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_DAIDUKUL_000_031: Seek my comrade outside tending to the stores. He will give you your task. You will know him by his cloth─unlike they of the yellow, we are of the green.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_032: I, for one, would welcome the opportunity to learn more of the Buduga and their ways. It would be an honor!
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_033: ...We shall speak of your task outside. With me.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_041: ..., then. You are to dive into Azim Khaat, below the Dawn Throne, and gather swordgrass from the lakebed.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_042: It is an invaluable ingredient in many medicines. Eight bundles will you bring.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_043: You will need to dive deep to obtain that which you seek...but that shall pose no trouble for a true warrior, no?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_044: Some say that the dominion of the Dawn Father and the Dusk Mother does not extend beneath the water. But ours does. Indeed, the Oronir fear naught above nor below.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_045: Speak with the guard to descend. We shall speak again when you have finished.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_THEDAWNTHRONEUPPERK: Yes, yes, I know who you are. You wish to go below?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_060: returns, and with swordgrass in hand?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_061: ...That you would immerse yourself in the depths is a testament to your bravery. Well done.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_062: Lest you wonder, we will use it to prepare potions to induce paralysis. In the Naadam, we must use every means at our disposal to delay our foes.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_063: He who inscribes his deeds upon the sacred ground shall be declared the victor. However, none may know this place until the Gharl have scattered the soil.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_064: It matters not. We shall be swift as stallions and fierce as baras. The Steppe will be ours once more!
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_065: Your tribute is accepted. We will return to the most radiant, and you may beg a boon.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_070: Ah, there you are. The others have yet to return.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_BAATU_000_075: To approach the most radiant still sullied by the depths is an insult. Dry yourself.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_080: ...Am I to understand you have completed your tasks?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_081: I know not what yours was, but mine was surprisingly simple.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_082: They bade me carry various goods and sundries from storehouse to storehouse. Alas, it was difficult to learn much with all the Buduga swarming around me...
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_083: You dove deep into the waters to harvest swordgrass? I see. That is well.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_084: Most radiant brother Magnai, we have given you tribute, as demanded. Were we to beg leave to depart with our comrades, would you consent?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_085: We never intended to press you into our service, and tribute offered in good faith cannot be denied. To grant you naught in return would be an affront to Father Azim.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_086: However, the boon must be proportional to the supplications. What you ask far exceeds what you have earned.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_087: ...Then if we must remain here, would you at least permit us to learn more of your people and your ways?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_088: Temulun Khatun taught me but a fraction, you see...
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_089: How this world born of the gods was to be their battlefield, their creations to fight in their stead.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_090: How Azim, Father of the Dawn, he who birthed the sun, and Nhaama, Mother of the Dusk, she who birthed the moon, made the Au Ra...
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_091: Yet though these children warred for a time, eventually they laid down their arms and came to love one another. And so the gods bequeathed this world to their children, and ascended to the heavens whence they came.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_092: Those born of the Dawn Father were called the Raen, and those born of the Dusk Mother were called the Xaela. So it was and ever after.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_HIEN_000_093: But I say to you, Brother Magnai─how can this be? How can Oronir be the children of Azim, if they are Xaela born of Nhaama?
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_094: ...You amuse me, Doman. How you wield your ignorance as a weapon.
TEXT_STMBDA410_02509_MAGNAI_000_095: Very well. I bid you speak with our elders and learn the truth of this world.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_000: ...I know what you're thinking. And yes, I could probably have convinced him to let us go had I handled that differently. But then we would have learned naught for our troubles.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_001: If there is one thing I know, it is that men of faith yearn to share it with others. And in learning more of their beliefs, we may learn more of other things─things which may prove useful in the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_002: When I was carrying out my tasks, I met an elder─a storyteller─named Udutai. Mayhap he can be our teacher.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_010: This is the man of whom I spoke, Udutai.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_020: Hm? I can spare no time for you. Other troubles demand my attention.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_021: What troubles? What ill fortune has befallen you?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_022: Not me, but my lambs. Some few wandered far and have yet to return.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_023: Mayhap they will return to their mothers in time. Mayhap they will not. Mayhap you can help?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_024: If we must, then we must. Let us be about it, .
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_030: Where are you, little ones? Your mother is waiting! It is time to come home!
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_035: They cannot have gone below. They must be here somewhere...
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_040: Greetings. I trust all of our little explorers are safely accounted for?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_041: That they are. My thanks to you, Doman. Now─you had questions for me?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_042: Aye. I would know more of the Oronir─of their creation, and of Father Azim.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_043: As you wish. Come, let us sit.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_044: Before we begin, tell me: what do you know of the Au Ra, and how they came to be?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_A1_000_046: In the days before men, Azim and Nhaama waged a bitter war...
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_A1_000_047: The Raen were born of the Dawn Father and the Xaela of the Dusk Mother...
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_048: Yes, yes. A common tale, and one believed by many tribes.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_049: But what it does not mention is this: Azim and Nhaama were lovers.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_050: Oh, they fought in the beginning, as did their creations. That much is true. But when they saw how the Xaela and the Raen rose above their hatreds and joined hands in harmony, their hearts stirred, and the love their children shared became theirs as well.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_051: Alas, he was of the sun and she of the moon. Apart they must remain, lest day and night cease to be, and with them all creation.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_052: With sadness in their hearts they returned to the heavens─he to the day, she to the night, destined to walk before and after, never to meet.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_053: As time passed, Azim's yearning for his beloved grew deeper still. Was there truly naught that could be done, he wondered. At last, he knew.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_054: "If the Father cannot be with the Mother, then he shall go amongst her children. Now and ever after.“
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_055: So it was that Azim took a fragment of his being and with it fashioned an avatar. Clad in scale of midnight, he descended, and sought out the Xaela.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_056: Yea, he was the first Oronir. We are of his flesh and his blood. We are the children of Azim, and it is our duty to watch over and keep the Xaela safe.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_057: ...I confess, I did not expect the tale of your people's beginnings to be quite so romantic.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_058: Yet I must ask: if it is your duty to defend the Xaela, how can you go to war with them in the Naadam? Is that not a contradiction?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_059: If a father disciplines his son, does that mean there is no love in his heart? Xaela are not wont to kneel. They must be made to─only then will they heed reason.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_060: I see... Such is the way of the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_061: Thank you, elder, for sharing with us your wisdom.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_062: Eager to depart? Ere you go, you would do well to hear the end of my tale.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_063: When Nhaama looked down and saw the avatar of Azim, she knew him at once, and shed tears of love and longing.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_064: When they struck the earth, they rose anew, as a counterpart to the Oronir. Their fates entwined.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_065: So you see, for every son of Azim is a daughter of Nhaama for whom he must search. Even now.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_UDUTAI_000_070: Come again, traveler. There are tales to be told, songs to be sung.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_080: Mayhap I am being overly optimistic, but I sense that these Oronir may prove loyal allies to Doma under the right circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_081: Their arrogance is rooted in the belief that they must act as caretakers of all Xaela. Therefore, if we can prove to them that we come as kindred spirits, seeking to defeat a common foe...
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_082: But mayhap this is a discussion for after we win the Naadam. Come, let us return to Magnai.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_LYSE_000_090: You're back. They had me milking sheep, by the way. It was, um, interesting...
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_HIEN_000_095: Another “task” completed, eh? I wonder what the most radiant brother has in store for us next.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_GOSETSU_000_100: At a glance, their arms and armor may seem crude compared to those of Doma, but they are well crafted, and no less effective.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_MAGNAI_000_110: Hmm...you shine with the light of newfound wisdom. Could it be that you have at last accepted the supremacy of the Sun?
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_MAGNAI_000_111: No matter. You have each completed your tasks, and proven yourselves deserving of mercy.
TEXT_STMBDA411_02510_MAGNAI_000_112: However, if it is freedom you desire, then there is one more thing you must do...
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_LYSE_000_000: You're back. They had me milking sheep, by the way. It was, um, interesting...
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_HIEN_000_005: Another “task” completed, eh? I wonder what the most radiant brother has in store for us next.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_010: At a glance, their arms and armor may seem crude compared to those of Doma, but they are well crafted, and no less effective.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_020: ...A pity you will not pledge yourselves to the Sun. You might have proved useful in the coming Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_021: Nevertheless, I will permit you to return and fight for the Mol. Their cause is futile, with or without your assistance. However, you must first complete a final task, as was my decree.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_022: You will reconnoiter the encampment of the Dotharl.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_023: For this task, two will go, and two will remain.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_024: Should the two who embark upon this expedition choose to flee, or be captured or killed by the Dotharl, then the others will be taken as slaves and serve the Sun unto death.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_LYSE_000_025: We'd better not fail then, eh? The question is, who should we send?
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_026: That is not for you to decide.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_027: All of you have conquered Bardam's Mettle and proven yourselves warriors of the Steppe. You should all be equally capable of carrying out this task, and therefore, you should have no objections.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_028: The first choice of hostage shall be mine─though it is hardly a choice, given the circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_029: The red woman will remain. Doubtless you are not the moon I seek, but stranger tales have been told─and the men are of no use to me.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_030: You may have your pick of the men.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DAIDUKUL_000_034: The firewalker! Yes, this Doman is my choice.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_HIEN_000_035: Hah hah! I don't know whether to be flattered or insulted. Mayhap both.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_HIEN_000_036: I had hoped to see these undying ones for myself, but it seems it was not meant to be.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_HIEN_000_037: I know you will be fine, but permit me to wish you luck all the same.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_038: We will return soon, my lord. But, if the kami are unkind, and we fail in our mission, then do what you must to survive. For Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DAIDUKUL_000_040: The Buduga require that a hostage be male, for if these ones fail, we cannot accept a woman as a slave.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DAIDUKUL_000_041: Therefore, we choose the firewalker. The one they call Hien.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_042: ...So be it. I shall choose second.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_043: I doubt either of you are the moon I seek, but stranger tales have been told─and men are of no use to me...
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_LYSE_000_044: I don't know what this “moon” stuff is that he's going on about, but I don't like the sound of it. At all.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_045: ...No, of course not. The woman I seek is of the dusk─a gentle, ethereal maiden. A dancer in the morning mist.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_046: You are warriors of the Steppe─fierce and brutal, conquerors of magicked stone and steel. Ethereal you are not.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_A2_000_049: You try ethereally chasing after lambs, when your boots are full of lake water.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_050: ...A Western expression, I presume. Betokening...I care not what.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_051: Ah...how well your tasks befitted you both.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_052: But since I must choose, I choose you. You did well milking the sheep─they took a liking to you, I am told.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_HIEN_000_053: Gosetsu and , then. I had hoped to see these undying ones for myself, but it seems it was not meant to be.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_054: Dotharl Khaa lies far to the south, where the grass turns to sand.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_055: Return with valuable knowledge, and all will be free to rejoin the Mol. Now go.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_056: Have no fear, my friend. We shall see them freed soon enough. Let us quit this place and speak of our plans outside.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_060: Journey south to Dotharl Khaa and return with knowledge. Do this, and your comrades shall walk free.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_061: ...You wonder why I chose her instead of you?
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_MAGNAI_000_062: There is a violence in you both. Hers is untamed. Yours is honed. She cannot be trusted.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DAIDUKUL_000_065: I will not mourn your death. Rather, I will celebrate it.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_BAATU_000_070: Perhaps you think they were chosen because they are more valuable to us as slaves? You would not be wrong. Regardless, you are free. Be glad of it.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_080: 'Tis plain they hope we will never return. I shall enjoy disappointing them.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_081: According to my map, there is a colossal wreck to the south which should provide a vantage point from which to survey Dotharl Khaa from afar. Let us go and do just that.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_090: I spy tents to the west─theirs, I presume. What do you see?
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_100: Over there, look! Those men are in danger!
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_101: Gah! Too late for the one, perhaps, but there is yet time to save the other.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_102: Come! We cannot abandon him to his fate!
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_110: These ones are mine! Go! Help the man!
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_121: Nay, friend, think nothing of it. I but wish we had come sooner...
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_122: I knew at once he was dead. It will come as scant comfort, I fear, but I slew the beasts responsible.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DOTHARL02511_000_12: Nay... That is no way for a Dotharl to die.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_124: (-???-)What is this? Who are these outsiders?
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DOTHARL02511_000_12: Sadu Khatun! Forgive me. We were returning from our hunt when we were caught unawares by manzasiri.
These ones saved me, but Geser is...
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_127: Who are you? Why have you come? Not to cross the sands, that much is certain.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_128: I have heard tales of travelers in league with another tribe. Are you they? Who do you serve? Answer me.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_129: If I may begin to answer your questions before you ask more...we are friends of the Mol, and we are come to see the strength of the Dotharl for ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_130: The Mol? The little lambs who wander to and fro at the behest of their gods?
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_131: Bwahahaha! What fools you are to share the soil of such weaklings! Next you will tell me you wish to fight in the Naadam!
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_132: Ah...so you do. Hah! That is unexpected...yet not unwelcome.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_133:
I am Sadu. Khatun of the Dotharl.
For your deeds, I grant you leave to walk among us. Come. Look on our glory and despair.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_134: We fear no tribe─least of all the Mol. Though, if you were of the Oronir, I would burn the flesh from your bones here and now.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_SADU_000_135: You can stand, yes? See to the corpse.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_DOTHARL02511_000_14: Thank you again, but I shall manage on my own.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_150: So that is the leader of the Dotharl. Clearly not a woman to be crossed.
TEXT_STMBDA412_02511_GOSETSU_000_151: But how callously she spoke of her dead! “See to the corpse”? Surely this warrior deserves better than that...
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_DOTHARL02511_000_00: Thank you again, but I shall manage on my own.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_010: Forgive me, , but I cannot in good conscience ignore the callous disregard that woman showed for her kinsman!
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_011: We must seek her out at once! With me!
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_020: Such contempt as was in their eyes I have never known... But for the soul to live on as they say is not something I can so easily accept.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_021: Do they truly believe this? All of them? That in death there can be rebirth? ...Retribution?
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_022: ...In any event, we came here in search of information. We cannot leave without speaking with her people.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_030: Err...that is to say, then, that death is essentially meaningless?
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_040: I know you! Reunion! The travelers with the Mol girl!
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_041: I marked you after I left the Oronir. Ones from Doma, others I could not place.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_042: My name is Koko. Welcome to Dotharl Khaa.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_043: Hm? Koko sounds to your ear the name of a woman? Well, of course. That would be because it is.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_044: I died a woman and was reborn a man. It is of no moment─the soul is the soul, and the flesh the flesh.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_045: Perhaps you scoff? Many would. Many look only to the name and the flesh, and let these things dictate their perceptions.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_046: Consider Sadu Khatun. Three times before she died a man, yet she returns as a woman the fourth. Yet she is no less fierce, and any outsider foolish enough to think so will learn the truth to their peril.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_KOKO_000_047: Is the khatun woman or man? A stupid question. She is Sadu.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_QOYAR_000_050: The cycle of death and rebirth? It is simply that. Take me─I died in battle with the Hotgo. Fiercely did I fight, and so I returned.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_QOYAR_000_051: Alas, we know naught of our past lives. I must learn what it means to be Qoyar again and again. It is difficult to remember everything, but important.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_QOYAR_000_052: It filled me with such excitement when they first told me of my deeds, as did my friends!
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_MERGEN_000_060: Impressive, is it not? 'Twas slain by my boy.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_MERGEN_000_061: We were childhood friends, he and I, before he fell and returned. A master of the bow. It is good to see that he retains his skill.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_MERGEN_000_062: We competed against one another in the hunts. Though I knew he would return, I never expected it to be as my son!
