TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_070: Ah, . You have completed your inquiries?
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_071: Aye, it is as she said. They believe with every fiber of their being that their bravest warriors will be reborn.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_072: As for me, I observed some of their warriors at practice. They are as formidable as the Oronir, perhaps more, and their weapons are their equal as well.
TEXT_STMBDA413_02512_GOSETSU_000_073: Yet while they do not lack in skill and resources, 'tis plain to see that their numbers are inferior...
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_000: This has been an educational experience, to say the least...
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_001: Yet everything we have learned is common knowledge to the people of the Steppe. 'Twill not be enough to earn our comrades their freedom.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_002: Naught less than the Dotharl's plans for the Naadam will suffice, I fear.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_003: Well, I have never been one for skulking about. I will go to Sadu and see what secrets I can prise from her lips!
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_010: The spies return. And they have learned naught.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_011: Mayhap so, but no longer! Though you hide it well, I know you have devised some manner of cunning stratagem for the Naadam! Out with it, I say!
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_012: We are what you see, Doman. We are Dotharl.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_013: Others rely on tricks and traps. Subterfuge. Lies. We have need of naught but our own strength. We meet the enemy in battle and kill him.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_014: That is why I cared not what you did from the first. There is naught for you to learn. Tell your masters to meet us on the field, and make ready to ride with their ancestors.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_015: ...Your confidence is plain, as is your strength.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_016: Yet you are not the most prosperous of tribes. The Mol you mock are few, but so too are you. Why?
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_017: ...Though a glorious death is to be celebrated, it is yet death.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_018: While we kill many, many are killed in turn. In the wake of our battles, the soil drinks deep of the blood of the fallen, their bodies piled high.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_019: Not all are born again. Only the bravest. Yet one cannot return unless there is a vessel to inherit the soul, and if warriors die ere they birth children, then that is that.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_020: Even the brave warrior who finds a vessel will for many years remain a shadow of his former self. It falls to his elders to endure until he is ready to accept his responsibilities.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_021: Ever will we meet our enemies in battle without fear. Such is our way, even when our numbers dwindle. If we die, so be it─but know that we fight to live, not to die.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_022: Dotharl train and make ready for the day─but they do not rush to meet it. Not until we have done our duty.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_DOTHARL02511_000_02: Sadu Khatun. Geser's body has been given to the sands.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_024: Then our part is done. Rest, warrior. The Naadam draws near, and you will need your strength.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_025: If you intend to fight in the Naadam, you should return to the Mol and make ready. But know that when next we meet, you and yours will die. ...Or you could fight for us and live. Think on it, travelers.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_026: ...We shall. But if you would permit me a final question ere we part...where is this place that Geser has been lain to rest?
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_027: Though I knew him not, I was there at his end. I wish to say a few words.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_028: Rites for the flesh? I have heard of this. Madness, I say, for his body is of the earth now. He will not hear you.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_029: But you may speak to the sands, if that is your will. They lie to the west. Make haste, for the gedan may already have caught his scent.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_030: My apologies, . This will take but a moment.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_SADU_000_040: Return to your Mol, and die with them if that be your wish. But ware the ones in yellow as you go. They are fond of secrets and stratagems, and will not hesitate to involve you.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_050: Well, then. We must all be on our way─even Geser.
TEXT_STMBDA414_02513_GOSETSU_000_051: Let us return to the Dawn Throne, and pray that our tale is enough to satisfy our “most radiant” taskmaster.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_000: You are ready to depart, I trust? Good. Then let us away.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_010: We can but tell Magnai the truth. And if our most radiant brother is unsatisfied, it will be my pleasure to put an end to this charade.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_DAIDUKUL_000_015: You are alive...and returned. No matter. All hinges on what you have to say.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_020: Welcome, travelers. The most radiant brother will hear your tale.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_030: All that you have seen and heard. Your knowledge. I would have it.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_031: ...No secret stratagems, you say. That is well. I expected as much.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_032: The Dotharl are not schemers. They live only for war─for the contest of strength and will. They are fierce, aye, and to face one is to court death.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_033: "Meet us on the field, and make ready to ride with your ancestors.“ Such were the words of their khatun, Sadu.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_034: Speak not that devil's name in the presence of the most radiant!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_035: You bade us tell you of the Dotharl, yet you will not hear the name of their leader?
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_036: After the last Naadam, she gave great offense.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_037: The most radiant brother called to him the women of the Steppe, that he might look into their eyes and see if Nhaama looked back.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_038: But that gedan, that feral udgan! She spat curses and called forth flames! She scorched the soil and refused to present herself!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_039: Three days and nights had we fought to claim the Dawn Throne, and still she shows Brother Magnai such disrespect! Such defiance! By rights should she pay with her life!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_040: Speak not another word, Baatu, or you will pay with yours.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_041: Her words are air, as the Domans say. However, they are proof of your service to the Sun.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_042: Go and fetch the others from their cells.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_043: My lord, Lyse, you are unharmed?
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_HIEN_000_044: Thanks to you and . We are free to return to Mol Iloh, I take it?
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_045: By your deeds have you proven yourselves to be warriors brave and true.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_046: You may return to the Mol and make ready for the Naadam...on one condition.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_047: To fight in the Naadam is to be bound by it. Swear, here and now, to abide by the law of the Steppe. To accept the supreme authority of the khagan, whomsoever it may be.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_LYSE_000_050: In a way, being forced to stay behind may actually have been a good thing. I had a lot of time to think, and usually I don't...
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_055: Let us not be too quick to count our blessings. We must still win the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MAGNAI_000_060: When next we meet, it will be on the field of battle. You will kneel, or you will die.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_DAIDUKUL_000_065: The Buduga will stand with the Oronir, and victory will be ours, as before.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_BAATU_000_070: I like you, traveler. That is why I will kill you last.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_HIEN_000_080: Well done, my friends. I knew you would not fail.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_HIEN_000_081: I should be glad to hear of your experiences with the Dotharl, but as time is of the essence, let us converse en route.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_HIEN_000_082: Come, come─Cirina and the others are waiting!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_LYSE_000_090: It's almost time for the Naadam! I'm so excited!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_HIEN_000_095: Though our journey home was rather more roundabout than I had anticipated, it was also more educational. I think it safe to say we are better prepared for the experience.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_GOSETSU_000_100: There is a tension in the air─an awareness of the coming storm. A nervousness, aye, but a confidence as well. Faith, perchance...
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_TEMULUN_000_105: Today's enemies are tomorrow's allies. Remember this.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MOLA02514_000_110: How my heart throbs with excitement! I can wait no longer for the Naadam!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MOLC02514_000_120: A-All shall be well. I must have faith in myself and my yol...
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MOLD02514_000_125: Though we must ware the Oronir, it is the Dotharl who frighten me most of all. I have seen them in battle before. They are not men─they are monsters.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_MOLE02514_000_130: It has been many years since the gods bade the Mol fight in the Naadam. For us, it is the first time. The khatun says we will win, but...will we?
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_CIRINA_000_140: Thank the gods you are all right! When you failed to return, I feared the worst.
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_CIRINA_000_141: But here you are, hale and whole! And you survived Bardam's Mettle!
TEXT_STMBDA415_02514_CIRINA_000_142: Blessed are we to have you as allies. With your strength, we may have a chance...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_LYSE_000_000: It's almost time for the Naadam! I'm so excited!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_005: Though our journey home was rather more roundabout than I had anticipated, it was also more educational. I think it safe to say we are better prepared for the experience.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_GOSETSU_000_010: There is a tension in the air─an awareness of the coming storm. A nervousness, aye, but a confidence as well. Faith, perchance...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_020: How my heart throbs with excitement! I can wait no longer for the Naadam!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLC02514_000_030: A-All shall be well. I must have faith in myself and my yol...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLD02514_000_035: Though we must ware the Oronir, it is the Dotharl who frighten me most of all. I have seen them in battle before. They are not men─they are monsters.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLE02514_000_040: It has been many years since the gods bade the Mol fight in the Naadam. For us, it is the first time. The khatun says we will win, but...will we?
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_050: My friends. We are come to the final day of the Tsagaan Sar. To the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_051: The battle will commence with the rising of the sun. The Gharl will scatter the soil, and the Steppe will be unbound.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_052: A great ovoo will erupt from the earth and call for a new khagan. All will converge upon the light, and the warrior who claims it will win the day.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_053: Precious little time remains. Pray use it to prepare for the battle.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_054: Many of the young ones have never taken part in a Naadam. They are nervous. Perhaps you might favor them with some few words? It would do much to ease their fears...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_060: If you had come any later, we would have had to fight by ourselves...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_065: All know you for a warrior. They will heed your counsel, and take heart from your encouragement.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_070: How strange this feeling... The thrill before battle... A battle in which I may die.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_A1_110_070: People die all the time. Many of them in their sleep.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_A1_120_070: We will fight, we will win, and we will return to Mol Iloh together.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_071: ...W-Wise words, I am sure. I suppose I should rightly thank you for your honesty...but I have so little time left...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_072: Yes...yes of course we will! I must have faith! I must have courage!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_073: I have not always understood the motives of the gods, but I have accepted their guidance ever since I was a child. If they would have us fight, I must believe they have their reasons.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_074: So I shall fight with all my might! And if it is the gods' will, then we shall win!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_075: Thank you again for your help. I will not let you down, my friend. I may be Mol, but I am nevertheless a warrior!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_080: Ah, it is you. The one who helped the children with their chores. For that I must thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_081: Though mayhap I will repay the favor in battle. Yes, I too will fight in the Naadam, though you may not see me. While you and yours contest the ovoo, my comrades and I will devote our efforts to preventing other tribes from interfering.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_082: We are few, and we are weak, but we shall do what we can to aid you. Go well, traveler, and if it be the gods' will, let us speak again when the day is done.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_083: The children are of course too young to fight, but not too young to observe. Their time will come.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_BUJEG_000_090: At the behest of the khatun you speak with us, yes? You are kind to do so, and I am grateful.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_BUJEG_000_091: Do not underestimate the power of words. A warrior conquers one with his hands, but a thousand with his head. Even you cannot fight forever.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_BUJEG_000_092: War is not our way. We have no grand rites for those we send forth into battle. Only solemn prayers.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_100: When we were young, my friends and I could scarcely wait to challenge Bardam's Mettle. We longed to become warriors...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_101: The day came and went, but we rarely fought men. Mostly beasts. And now we must stand against the Oronir and the Dotharl. You have seen them─taken the measure of them. Do you believe we can win?
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_A1_000_103: You can and will. Have faith!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_105: Yes...yes! 'Twas the gods' will that we fight. Surely it is their will that we win! Of course!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_106: No, it will not...but it is well that you acknowledge it. A warrior must be brave, but not foolhardy. I will not forget.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_107: We must trust in the gods. Whether I live or die, it shall be in service to their grand design.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_110: Already, I sense a change in the people. Their hearts soothed, their resolve strengthened. This we owe to you.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_111: We are of the soil. The wind and the water. We are not conquerors.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_112: But we are yet the children of Nhaama─we are yet Xaela. We were made for battle─to kill and be killed. We delight not in such things, but let no man doubt that they are in our nature.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_113: Flesh, blood, bone─that which was given, we offer unto the gods as tribute. This day we embrace death. Ours and our enemies'.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_114: So too must you embrace this truth, for this is who we are. Who you are become, as warriors of the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_115: May the gods guide you to victory.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_116: All that remains is to wait for daybreak!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_LYSE_000_120: We're not dying here. Not when we've got a score to settle with Zenos.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_125: Though I know how much this battle means for the future of Doma, a part of me is glad simply for the opportunity to repay my debt to the Mol.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_GOSETSU_000_130: Mayhap their souls will shine bright in battle, but my steel will sing!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_135: We are but one link in the divine chain. The Naadam will end, and a khagan will reign, until the next.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MAGNAI_000_200: You came, as I knew you would. For you too are a warrior of the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MAGNAI_000_201: I salute you, traveler, and should be honored to face you alone...but the Dotharl thirst for blood and will suffer no duels.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MAGNAI_000_202: Bear witness, Father Azim! The soil shall drink deep of blood this day!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_LYSE_000_210: Go on! They're waiting for you!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_GOSETSU_000_215: The others have returned as well, it would seem.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_CIRINA_000_220: We won...we actually won! I mean, you did. If it were not for you...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_TEMULUN_000_225: The gods saw fit to return you to us. But what of your comrades? Where are they?
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_230: I...I have acquired a wound for my trouble. But it will heal with time and care. The children are gathering herbs for a poultice.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_DORBEI_000_235: Had the Naadam not ended when it did, I would likely have perished. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_BUJEG_000_240: From traveler to warrior, and now to khagan. What will you become next, I wonder?
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_COTAN_000_245: 'Twould seem this was not the day for either one of us to die! Nevertheless, I should be glad if the gods never bid me take up arms again. I am a trader at heart.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLA02514_000_250: I saw you fight, ! You were incredible!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLB02514_000_255: My arms, my legs...every part of me is tired and sore. I feel as though I could sleep for a fortnight...
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLC02514_000_260: Wherever did you learn to perform such feats? Is everyone in the West as strong as you? Can you teach me!?
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLD02514_000_265: Be still and let me set the bone! You are only making it worse for yourself!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_MOLE02514_000_270: <pant> <pant> I know, I know! A-A moment! Just...a moment, if you please!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_290: Your imperial friend has truly impeccable timing. Had he come even a few moments earlier, he might actually have stood a chance.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_291: In any event, that is two battles won in a single day. Which, by my reckoning, gives us twice the cause to celebrate!
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_292: But first, I pray you grant me a moment to express my gratitude. Thanks to you, we are one step closer to freeing my homeland from the tyranny of the Empire. I am in your debt.
TEXT_STMBDA416_02515_HIEN_000_293: Of course...if all goes to plan, this is like to be but the first of many such debts. Yet I promise to endure my insolvency with a smile, out of gratitude to the kami for seeing fit to send you hither.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_LYSE_000_000: Go on! They're waiting for you, I'm sure!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_GOSETSU_000_005: The others have returned as well, it would seem.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_010: We won...we actually won! I mean, you did. If it were not for you...
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_DORBEI_000_020: I...I took a wound. But it will heal with time and care. The children are gathering herbs for a poultice.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_DORBEI_000_025: Had the Naadam lasted much longer, I may not have survived. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_040: I saw you fight, ! You were incredible!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLB02514_000_045: My arms, my legs, everything is tired and sore. I feel as though I could sleep for a day...
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLC02514_000_050: Where did you learn such feats? Is everyone in the West as strong as you? Can you teach me!?
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLD02514_000_055: Stop fidgeting and let me set the bone! You're only making it worse for yourself!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLE02514_000_060: <pant> <pant> I know, I know! Just...just give me a moment!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_HIEN_000_070: Ah, but it would be rude of me to monopolize your attention. Doubtless there are others who would speak with you.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_HIEN_000_071: Let us go and greet Temulun Khatun.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_LYSE_000_080: I hope everyone is all right...or alive, at least.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_HIEN_000_085: Temulun Khatun! We are returned, and victorious!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_GOSETSU_000_090: Ah...mayhap you should speak with the khatun instead of me. That is why we are here, is it not?
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_TEMULUN_000_100: Welcome, warriors of the Steppe. It is an honor to receive you once more.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_TEMULUN_000_101: We observed the battle from a distance, and marked the moment of your triumph. In that instant, I wept tears of joy.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_TEMULUN_000_102: Not only did you bring us victory in the Naadam, but you ensured that every one of my kinsmen returned with their lives.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_103: Some were more gravely wounded than others, but none were lost to us. We could not have asked for anything more.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_104: If it is not too much of an imposition, would you be willing to go and speak with them? A simple gesture for those with whom you shared the battlefield.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_LYSE_000_110: You really shouldn't... I mean, I'm glad you're all right, but we had our own reasons for fighting, and it feels wrong to be thanked for that...
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_HIEN_000_115: Hahaha! The pleasure and the pain that can only come in the wake of a battle. I know it well.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_GOSETSU_000_120: How long it has been since last I saw young men and women celebrating a hard-fought victory... Let us pray we enjoy a similar sign in Yanxia soon.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_125: Please, it would mean a great deal to the others if you were to go and speak with them again.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_TEMULUN_000_130: For the Mol to triumph in the Naadam with the aid of outsiders. The Steppe will not soon forget this day.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_140: Some part of me still struggles to believe it, but we won! We defeated the Oronir and the Dotharl and won!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_141: When they appeared before us I was filled with such fear as I had never known. But then I saw you charge with Cirina and the others, and before I knew it, I was running and shouting...
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_142: I will carry the memory of that moment with me always. As well as the moment when you became one with the ovoo and were declared khagan!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_143: The victorypose you struck was a sight to behold! I say, would you be willing to show us again?
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_150: It is a silly thing to ask, I know, but I must! Please, will you not show us again your grand victorypose?
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLC02514_000_160: Aye, that's the stuff of legends! That's the khagan in all  splendor!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_161: Praise be to the khagan, and to the gods for guiding  to us!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLD02514_000_162: Glory to the khagan and  comrades! Forever and forever! A hundred years! The khagan!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_LYSE_000_170: I think they love you, ! They really, really love you!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_HIEN_000_175: It is good that they can delight in such simple things as the dramatic posings of a comrade.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_GOSETSU_000_180: Like the child and the father, the student and the master, all men need an ideal for which to strive.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLA02514_000_185: How impressive! I shall have to practice with my own weapons until I can do the same!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLB02514_000_190: I could hear the others cheering. What did I miss? Is there to be a feast or some other celebration?
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLC02514_000_195: How I envy you, khagan! You could court the  of your choice!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLD02514_000_200: Have a care that it heals properly. There is much work to be done, and you will be needed.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_MOLE02514_000_205: Yes, yes, I know...even in victory we must look to the future.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_210: Ah, ! I am told you gave the young warriors a fine show!
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_211: Grandmother and I have been discussing how we might best express our gratitude to you. Mere words did not seem sufficient.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_212: This is a morin khuur─a traditional instrument of our people.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_213: The feats of our greatest heroes, like Bardam and Chakha, are preserved in song. Yours too will live on for years to come.
TEXT_STMBDA417_02516_CIRINA_000_214: Perhaps one day you might learn how to play it! But, even if not, you may look on the morin khuur and remember this time, this place. As we will when we hearken to the music.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_000: I think they love you, ! They really, really love you!
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_005: Like the child and the father, the student and the master, all men need an ideal for which to strive.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_DORBEI_000_020: I...I have acquired a wound for my trouble. But it will heal with time and care. The children are gathering herbs for a poultice.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_DORBEI_000_021: Had the Naadam not ended when it did, I would likely have perished. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_030: At the risk of sounding impatient, we have certain pressing obligations. It is time that we saw to them.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_TEMULUN_000_031: ...You are right. To whom much is given, much is expected.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_032: Nay, do not think yourselves so indebted to us. Was it not you who gave us your blessing to participate in the Naadam─and you who saved my lord Hien from certain death?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_033: Doma is in your debt, and will ever be a friend to the Mol.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_035: A thought occurs to me. If you wish to return to Yanxia with all haste, the passage to the south of the Dusk Throne would offer the most direct route.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_036: The Dotharl sealed it with their magicks during the Doman rebellion, when more men in iron came from afar.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_037: If ever there were a time to open the pass, it is now. We should journey to Dotharl Khaa.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_038: But before that, might we visit the Dawn Throne? I wish to speak with our most radiant brother.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_039: Are you sure that's a good idea? I know he agreed to fight for Doma, but I doubt he'll be very happy to see us so soon after we beat him.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_040: Nhaama made us for war, Lyse. Ever since we came into this world, we have fought.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_041: In the Naadam, blood was shed, and lives were lost. Brown earth was stained crimson, and Xaela wept.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_042: But crimson is the dusk and the dawn. Death and rebirth. An ending to mark a new beginning.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_043:
"We who are born are destined to die.
As the seasons turn, we are born again.“
Thus spoke the first.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_044: So you see, we harbor no hatreds. The Naadam is the Naadam, and what comes after is what comes after!
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_045: If you say so... The Dawn Throne first, then?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_046: Yes. And I shall accompany you!
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_050: Just like that, eh? Not that I expected them to put up a fight...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_055: Let us hope we do not find our most radiant friend in a foul mood.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_060: Hmm. There are fewer here than I remember...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_065: I found him quite intimidating before, but perhaps it will be easier this time.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_TEMULUN_000_070: Look always to the light of the stars to guide you in the dark. For none need walk alone.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_DORBEI_000_075: You are for Doma, then. Go safely, khagan. I pray we meet again.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_080: The Sun is disinclined to entertain you at length. Speak your purpose in coming.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_082: Should I be humble in the presence of inferiors? I am a child of Azim, and you are not. Your triumph in the Naadam does not raise you to such heights.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_083: Baatu will not be joining us. He was wounded in the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_084: ...His hurts are grave, and he requires rest. But he will walk again in time.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_085: Though it is no business of yours. Such pity does not become a khagan. We are not allies, traveler─far from it. The Naadam will come again, and with it our rule.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_086: I say again, why have you come? To bid us surrender the Dawn Throne to the Mol?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_087: N-Nay. The Mol are beholden to the will of the gods, and they would not have us reside here. The Oronir and the Buduga may remain.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_088: We are for Yanxia, and wished to speak of your part in the coming war.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_089: Ah, the Domans and the ironmen. I remember our pact. Sound the call and the Oronir will answer.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_090: Full glad am I to hear it. We have preparations to attend to, but will send for you soon.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_091: The gods are kind! I am sure the Oronir will prove a great boon in the days to come.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_092: Of the dusk...a maiden gentle and ethereal. A dancer in the morning mist. And a warrior besides...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_093: Look into my eyes, child! See you Azim? Are you my Nhaama!?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_094: I...I know not of what you speak, Brother Magnai, but I am certain you are mistaken. Quite.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_095: We should get going. Right now.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_100: The dry wind from the desert reminds me of home...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_105: Ahh, Dotharl Khaa. Better late than never.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_110: How long has it been since they gave Geser to the sands? Is there aught left of him now, I wonder...?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_115: As daunting as I found it to speak with Brother Magnai, it is nothing compared to the fear I feel at the thought of approaching Sadu Khatun...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_MAGNAI_000_120: Am I fated to live my life as a sun without a moon? Is there no Nhaama for me...?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_131: Greetings, my lady. We come to you on our journey south, bound for Yanxia where our comrades await us. How fare you and yours in the wake of the Naadam?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_132: Many were wounded. Some few to the death.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_133: ...Resplendent were their souls in the chaos. It was a good battle─a good day to die. Soon we will greet them again.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_134: ...And mayhap one who went before them also. Geser's seed has quickened in his lover. When the child is born, we shall see who waits behind its eyes.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_135: Already we must look to the next Naadam. We must grow strong of body and mind, and your war will help us do so. Say the word and we will fly to the field.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_136: Of that I have no doubt. For you are Dotharl.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_137: There is one more thing we would ask of you... The magicks you used to seal the passage to the south. Will you unmake them?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_139: When next we come together, it will be on a great battlefield against a common foe. I trust you will fight with the same fervor you demonstrated during the Naadam.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_140: Hah! And you, ancient one, will be the demon I know you to be. Aught less would be a disappointment.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_150: So this path leads back to Yanxia...back to Doma, and the others... <sigh> It's so easy to forget why we're doing all this...
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_155: I will miss this place. Though my heart belongs to Doma, the Steppe and her people will always be dear to me.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_GOSETSU_000_160: I daresay that woman has never known a single regret. I envy her.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SADU_000_165: Do not fail to call on us, khagan. The preening prince and his little yellow band will not kill half as many ironmen as we Dotharl.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_SHAR_000_170: I have never been a mother. It is a strange feeling to carry another in one's own flesh. I cannot wait to welcome the child into this world, and meet the warrior within.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_180: Sadu Khatun has done her part. This passage will deliver you to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_181: It is here we must part ways, until the day you call us to battle.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_182: It won't be long, I know, but...take care of yourself, Cirina. And tell your grandmother and the others again how much we appreciate everything they did for us.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_183: I will. Oh, I nearly forgot! I have another gift for you.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_LYSE_000_184: Oh, it's...a red, um...? Wait, is this a banner of the Mol tribe?
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_185: It is not the most practical of gifts, but we nevertheless wished to present it to you.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_186: I do not fully understand what has befallen Doma, or your homeland, Lyse. But I do understand that you and yours have suffered terribly.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_187: The Mol place their faith in the gods, and in turn they shepherd us. They watch over and keep us. We pray they show you the same favor.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_188: As it was in the Naadam, blood will be shed, your lands engulfed in a storm of fire and steel. Yet as it did here, it shall mark a new beginning there.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_CIRINA_000_189: May you ever walk in crimson. For in crimson there is life. There is liberation.
TEXT_STMBDA418_02517_HIEN_000_190: Thank you for your prayers, Cirina. We shall remember them.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_LYSE_000_000: Let's go. Everyone is waiting for us back at the House of the Fierce!
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_GOSETSU_000_005: Heh heh...I wonder what Yugiri will have to say when we tell her of our adventures?
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HIEN_000_010: Right, then. To the House of the Fierce. With me, my friends!
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_LYSE_000_015: Err, remind me─what part of Yanxia is this again?
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HIEN_000_020: Ahh...this air that fills my breast, these sounds which resound in my ears. I am home.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_GOSETSU_000_030: I have not used this road before, but... Ah. I recognize this place.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_GOSETSU_000_031: The House of the Fierce should lie somewhere to the south. I will go on ahead and inform the sentries of our master's return.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_LYSE_000_040: Huh, I didn't realize there was another entrance.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HIEN_000_050: Here we are! I wonder if they all are gathered inside, waiting...perhaps expecting a speech or some such...
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HIEN_000_051: Well! No matter! I shall have to do what I shall have to do!
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_LYSE_000_060: So...have we got a plan? Tell me someone's got a plan.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_ALISAIE_000_065: Alphinaud has been hard at work devising our strategy to seize Doma Castle. I'm sure he will be happy to share the details with you all shortly.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HIEN_000_070: No time to soak it in. We have work to do.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_YUGIRI_000_075: Not that I doubted you for a moment, but I am relieved to see him returned.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_GOSETSU_000_080: All is in place. We need but commit to action and see it through to the end.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_YAGORO_000_085: Lord Hien has returned! Lord Hien has returned! And together we will drive the imperials out of Doma once and for all!
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_HANAME_000_086: I knew Lord Hien only by name and reputation until today. There is no denying that he has a presence...
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Once more, welcome back. It is good to see you again, .
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Ah, yes. There is another recent development we neglected to share with you.
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Alisaie and I have been hard at work attempting to restore the aetheryte here to its former glory...and I am pleased to inform you that we succeeded!
TEXT_STMBDA419_02518_ALPHINAUD_000_093: Suffice it to say, it should prove a boon for travel─well, for those replete with anima like you, at least...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_LYSE_000_000: So...have we got a plan? Tell me someone's got a plan.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALISAIE_000_005: Alphinaud has been hard at work devising our strategy to seize Doma Castle. I'm sure he will be happy to share the details with you all shortly.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HIEN_000_010: No time to soak it in. We have work to do.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_YUGIRI_000_015: Not that I doubted you for a moment, but I am relieved to see him returned.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_GOSETSU_000_020: All is in place. We need but commit to action and see it through to the end.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I imagine you are eager to hear the particulars of our plan. Allow me a moment to gather everyone's attention...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_LYSE_000_040: Looks like I'll be heading to Namai. Wish me luck!
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_045: As for how best to infiltrate the Moon Gates...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALISAIE_000_050: I suppose I ought to go and take stock of our supplies. We'll be needing a lot of weapons...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_YUGIRI_000_055: I am told Cirina fought with you in the Naadam? I would not have taken her for a warrior. Appearances can indeed be deceiving.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_GOSETSU_000_058: This may be our final chance to win Doma her freedom. We dare not take any chances, for if we fail...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HIEN_000_060: There is no shortage of tasks which must needs be completed before we can launch our attack. If you have a moment, perhaps you could lend a hand?
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HIEN_000_061: That said, I have only just returned. 'Twould be better for you to speak with Alphinaud to find out how you might be of service.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HIEN_000_065: Much has changed in my absence. The state of the enclave, in particular, concerns me...
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HIEN_000_066: But it would seem Alphinaud understands the importance of ensuring their safety. You Scions are no ordinary mercenaries, that much is plain.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Trying to keep busy? Full glad am I to hear it. There is one task which comes to mind.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_071: As I explained during my briefing, Alisaie and I will need to infiltrate the Moon Gates to disable the magitek field generators.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Though I pride myself on my knowledge of various subjects, I must confess I lack confidence in my knowledge of this particular one. Which is why I turned to an expert.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_073: I have been conversing with Cid via Tataru, attempting to ascertain the design of the generators based on our limited intelligence. Most recently he sent a parcel with some documents which he believes may be of use.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_074: I would like for you to go to Kugane and bring them back here.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_ALPHINAUD_000_075: In the meantime, I will continue to work with our shinobi allies to plot a path into the gates. Safe travels, , and thank you again.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_HANCOCK_000_080: Well, well, well! What a pleasant surprise this is!
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_TATARU_000_090: !? What are you doing here? I thought you were off fighting nomads on the Azim Steppe!
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_TATARU_000_091: ...Oh, you beat them! Good show! A shame I didn't get to see it.
TEXT_STMBDA501_02519_TATARU_000_092: Alphinaud has been keeping me apprised of the situation in Doma. I may not be any good in a physical fight, but in an, err...paperwork...fight, I'm the true khagan! Yeah!
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_000: So much to do, and so little time to do it...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YUGIRI_000_005: During the rebellion, the imperials turned to their agents among the shinobi, and through their treachery were many of my comrades slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YUGIRI_000_06: We few who survived have not forgotten that day. The memory of it has spurred us never to neglect our training, that we might be ready to administer revenge.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Should you wish for further employment, mayhap you could speak with Alisaie?
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALPHINAUD_000_011: I believe she was planning to search the surrounding area for imperial patrols. If you go now, you may be able to catch her before she departs.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The Dairyu Moon Gates have guarded the approach to Doma Castle since long before the imperial occupation.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALPHINAUD_000_021: We do not anticipate any great difficulty in gaining entry to the gatehouse as our Doman friends know its every nook and cranny. The challenge will come in preserving the element of surprise. But I am confident the shinobi will rise to the occasion.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_030: Alphinaud told you about my plans? And you wish to come with me? Well, far be it from me to refuse you.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_031: If truth be told, I'm not entirely sure what I expect to find. In the wake of your failed assassination attempt, the imperials demonstrated uncharacteristic restraint. There were no public executions, and not a single village was put to the torch.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_032: But, as I mentioned earlier, our latest intelligence does suggest a purge is imminent. For all we know, they could be out in the field even as we speak, surveilling their targets and making plans.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_033: If so, we need to put a stop to it. Let us begin our search in the north.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_040: This is the place. Do you see anything or anyone of note?
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_050: All quiet...for now. Follow me to the next location.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_060: This was the second point I marked on my map...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_070: No imperial patrols near our headquarters, then. Good. The last thing we need is a repeat of Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_071: Even so, 'twould be prudent to search a little longer.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_080: Not exactly the enemy I was worried about. <sigh> ...Damn it all. I can't just leave the carcass lying in the middle of the road.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_084: ...Next to you, I feel like a child playing at swords and sorcery. Though mayhap it suits me better than books.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_085: I owe much to a Miqo'te I met on my travels. He was a master of these techniques, and kindly agreed to teach me the fundamentals.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_086: But I never could warm to common rapiers. I vastly preferred using a blade of my own creation, despite the toll it took on me. Urianger's gift was a godssend, to be honest.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_087: ...I didn't mean to imply that you should help me. This isn't the first wild beast we've had to slay to keep the people safe in your absence.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_088: But we'll need all the help we can get when the real fighting starts...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_089: Anyway, we're falling behind. We should split up, and try to recoup some lost time.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_090: We've heard rumors of imperial soldiers skulking about disguised as villagers. One was supposedly spotted near the Ribbons, to the south of here. Go and see if there's anything out of the ordinary.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_100: I'll come and find you when I've dealt with this carcass. If you run afoul of imperials, call out and I'll be there that much sooner.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_110: Oh... Hello there, young . My associates and I are in search of fertile soil for farming, and this land caught our eye.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_111: ...You doubt my words? You suspect we have some other purpose in coming here? <sigh> How vexing it is to be questioned in this manner.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_112: Very well.  desires the truth, and  shall have it. Deal with !
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_POP_MESSAGE: The two men draw their swords and charge!
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_300: I saw them attack you, while this one fled. Since you seemed to have everything in hand, I decided to capture him. An imperial, I presume?
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_301: I knew it would come to this... But at the hands of a Westerner? A Doman would at least know the rites...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_302: You think you understand, but you do not. She will burn it all before she surrenders. She will never kneel again. Nor should she...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_304: ...Rest assured, the Naeuri will receive due compensation. Young Asahi has great potential─that much is plain.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_305: If he applies himself, he may one day be granted the opportunity to go to Garlemald and learn from some of the leading authorities in the field of magitek. Few citizens are afforded such treatment, however─much less people of the provinces. You will need to do more─
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YOTSUYUSMOM_000_306: Oh, oh, of course! Have no doubt that we shall! My husband and I want only the best imperial education for our boy!
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YOTSUYU_000_307: (-Starveling Girl-)I've finished planting the rice, Mother...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YOTSUYUSMOM_000_308: Not while the officer is here, Yotsuyu! Inside! Now!
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_310: You did not mention that you had a daughter.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YOTSUYUSMOM_000_311: My sister's, not mine─kami rest her soul. <sigh> She is utterly hopeless, but one cannot choose one's family.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_HENSO02520_000_312: Indeed... She is of age to receive an education as well, is she not? Yet we have no records. I trust I need not remind you of your legal obligations─
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_YOTSUYUSMOM_000_313: No, no! Of course not! But she is weak and sickly. Some days, she has not the strength to leave her bed! Though...a thought occurs to me. Mayhap we can come to an understanding...
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_315: What happened? We were talking, and then all of a sudden you were somewhere else. Did one of those soldiers hit you on the head or something?
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_316: Well, if you say so... We should go and tell the others what happened here.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_330: Thank you. You didn't have to come with me, but you did, and for that I am grateful.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_331: I told the others of our encounter with the disguised soldiers. Though we disposed of the bodies, it is only a matter of time before their comrades note their absence.
TEXT_STMBDA502_02520_ALISAIE_000_332:
As if we needed any more reason to act quickly...
Are you sure you're all right, by the way? You've been awfully quiet since we returned...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ALPHINAUD_000_005: The Dairyu Moon Gates have guarded the approach to Doma Castle since long before the imperial occupation.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ALPHINAUD_000_006: We do not anticipate any great difficulty in gaining entry to the gatehouse as our Doman friends know its every nook and cranny. The challenge will come in preserving the element of surprise. But I am confident the shinobi will rise to the occasion.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_YUGIRI_000_010: During the rebellion, the imperials turned to their agents among the shinobi, and through their treachery were many of my comrades slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_YUGIRI_000_011: We few who survived have not forgotten that day. The memory of it has spurred us never to neglect our training, that we might be ready to administer revenge.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ALISAIE_000_020: I'd tell you to rest and leave the rest to the others, but seeing as that isn't in your nature...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ALISAIE_000_021: Lyse returned but a moment ago, looking a bit worried. It would seem that trouble is afoot in Namai.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ALISAIE_000_022: You may as well go and ask her about it. As for me, I will not impose upon you any further.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_030: We've barely got enough armor as it is, huh...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_031: Oh, you're here to help? That's a relief. I've been trying to help the villagers in Namai get ready for the operation, but we've run into a few problems...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_032: You remember how we're supposed to stir up trouble as a diversion, right? Well, the thing is, we don't have enough armor to go around.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_033: I thought the Doman Liberation Front would be able to furnish us with some, but it seems that's not the case. I was about to go and tell Isse─why don't you come too?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_040: We'll have to come up with a solution somehow.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_050: Oh, you're here too. I heard about those soldiers you and Alisaie encountered. I'm glad you're all right... Ahem. Right, then...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_CHIGUSA_000_051: Isse─we have gathered up all the rope we could find in the village.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_MIYAMA_000_052: And every tool with an edge, but it is still not enough. Even a hoe would suffice, but there are no more to spare.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_053: Thank you, Chigusa. Ryosen could use a hand, if there is nothing else.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_054: As for more tools...I may have some in my home. Go and search it─take whatever meets your needs.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_AZAMI_000_055: I made enough rice balls for everyone─including some special ones for Lady Yugiri. Can I go and give them to her?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_056: Y-You silly little girl, of course you can! Hurry! You never know when she'll have to leave on a secret mission!
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_057: Sorry about that. Everyone's been trying to contribute since Lord Hien returned. There's so much to worry about.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_058: You're doing well, Isse...though I have to ask: have you had any luck finding more armor?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_059: Unfortunately, no. Unlike weapons, there are no substitutes for proper protection...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_060: It's not as though we need full suits of imperial plate, but we're not soldiers. If we attack without any equipment, we'll be slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_061: The Doman Liberation Front doesn't have any armor to spare. I suppose we could ask Hancock, but there's no telling how long it would take for him to send us supplies...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_062: Do you have an armorer in the village, or anyone with some skill to fashion armor?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_063: There is one man. A craftsman who fled the enclave. He is experienced, and may be able to help.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_064: I don't know if I can persuade him to, though. But maybe you two could come with me?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_ISSE_000_065: His name is Tsuranuki, and he lives in Kusakari, in the south. Come with me.
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_LYSE_000_070: There's something odd about this man...
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_TSURANUKI_000_080: Bwahahaha! Who are these starry-eyed youths who stand before me?
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_TSURANUKI_000_081: Ones who sing of rebellion? Of liberation? Hah hah hah! Surely they would not think to trouble me with such foolish dreams!
TEXT_STMBDA503_02521_TSURANUKI_000_082: Oh, go and say what you will. But do not take offense if I die from laughter! Bwahahaha!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Dairyu Moon Gates have guarded the approach to Doma Castle since long before the imperial occupation.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_ALPHINAUD_000_001: We do not anticipate any great difficulty in gaining entry to the gatehouse as our Doman friends know its every nook and cranny. The challenge will come in preserving the element of surprise. But I am confident the shinobi will rise to the occasion.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_YUGIRI_000_005: During the rebellion, the imperials turned to their agents among the shinobi, and through their treachery were many of my comrades slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_YUGIRI_000_006: We few who survived have not forgotten that day. The memory of it has spurred us never to neglect our training, that we might be ready to administer revenge.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_ISSE_000_010: I didn't think we'd have another chance so soon, but here we are. We're going to beat them this time. We have to!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_TSURANUKI_000_015: All the armor I can provide, you will have. I will labor until I can no longer lift my hammer!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_LYSE_000_020: Even after twenty-five years of oppression, they still have it in them to stand up and fight. We just have to show them the way forward...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_LYSE_000_021: Isse and I will stay and help Tsuranuki finish the armor, so you've no need to wait around.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_LYSE_000_022: Why not go back to the House of the Fierce? I'm sure there's plenty of work left to be done. Ask about and see what you can find!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_LYSE_000_030: Right! Where are the hammers? Just show me what needs hammering!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_KAIDATE_000_031: Everything is in order, ! Under Lord Gosetsu's sage tutelage, we grow stronger by the day!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_KAIDATE_000_032: We will acquit ourselves with honor on the battlefield! This I swear!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_MOTOJIRO_000_035: Hm? Help? Oh, no, no, no─I will not impose upon you without cause! Rest assured that everything is in its place, and every place is in...everything is fine!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_MOTOJIRO_000_036: Beneath the armor, an imperial is a man like any other. But magitek armor is different. Without the right tactics and equipment, we will be hard-pressed...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HANAME_000_040: I require no assistance, comrade. Lord Hien's instructions to me were quite clear─I need only transcribe them for the benefit of our Xaela allies.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HANAME_000_041: Speaking of Lord Hien, if you are eager to be of service, mayhap you could seek him out? Keep an eye on him, perchance, should he decide to venture outside?
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HANAME_000_042: Like you, Lord Hien is not given to idleness. He may go whither he will, of course, but I do fear for his safety...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_050: Hmm, let me guess: someone asked you to act as my protector? Hah! To hear them mutter, one would think I intended to stride up to the castle gates on my own!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_051: The truth, of course, is rather less dramatic. I had hoped to look on the castle one last time before the battle. Would you care to join me? You would be setting a lot of fretful minds at rest...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_052: Very good! Then let us depart for Monzen at once.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_060: Monzen was home to many great and powerful families. Men of honor─samurai. Once...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_061: Great swaths were razed, and people put to the sword. What little remains stands as a testament to what was...and what will never be again.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_062: ...Come. I would take a closer look.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_070: No sentries, at least of the living sort. Those shambling suits of armor have the run of the place. To think this was once a bustling street, so full of life...a river of people, with a current all its own...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_071: ...But even then, the imperials walked among us. Sometimes openly, sometimes discreetly, but we were always aware of their presence. And we...we were complicit.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_072: He did what he had to do to preserve the peace. To keep our people safe. But at what cost...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_073: F-Forgive me, this is neither the time nor the place for such dark musings! Though they did serve to remind me of the barracks which once stood to the west of here...where there may yet be weapons our comrades could use.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_074: If you head down that street, past those makeshift barricades, you will come to the ruins. I will search elsewhere. Meet me at the water's edge when you have finished.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_080: Alas, I found naught of value. Did you?
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_081: Still sheathed in its scabbard...though even shielded from the elements, it will need to be cleaned and oiled─
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_082: ...I recognize the crest. It belonged to the son of a samurai I trained with when I was young.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_083: He never even had the chance to draw it...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_084: There she is. Doma Castle. My home.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_085: They let us keep her for a time, before gradually moving their forces across from Fluminis. Now her every court and corridor belongs to Yotsuyu.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_086: Though Father spent much of his time there, I did not. I may only have visited him there on half a dozen occasions, if that. I cannot remember.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_087: But I remember the view from the keep. Doma seemed much smaller from there. Like you could hold it in your hands.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_088: Well, Monzen at least. Doma is so much more than that. There, beyond the Moon Gates, unto the shores of the Ruby Sea, and here, in the places that no man can see or touch or take from you...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_089: We carry her with us, wheresoever we go.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_090: Not the land or the soil...but the story.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_091: And what is life if not a story? The story of our journey from dawn to dusk, day after day after day. The story of our mothers and our fathers, our families and our friends, our peoples and our nations.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_092:
I think a part of me understood that, when I looked out from the keep.
Hien, son of Kaien. Another caretaker of the story of Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_093: It's a fine castle, truly, with an even finer view. But in the end...
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_095: Kami strike me down, how could I be so blind! We must return to the House of the Fierce at once!
TEXT_STMBDA504_02522_HIEN_000_096: I have had what can only be described as a revelation. Ours is an excellent plan, but not so excellent that it cannot be improved─and I know how.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Dairyu Moon Gates have guarded the approach to Doma Castle since long before the imperial occupation.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_001: We do not anticipate any great difficulty in gaining entry to the gatehouse as our Doman friends know its every nook and cranny. The challenge will come in preserving the element of surprise. But I am confident the shinobi will rise to the occasion.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALISAIE_000_005: Oh, there you are. I saw you leave with Lord Hien earlier. Where is he?
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YUGIRI_000_010: During the rebellion, the imperials turned to their agents among the shinobi, and through their treachery were many of my comrades slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YUGIRI_000_011: We few who survived have not forgotten that day. The memory of it has spurred us never to neglect our training, that we might be ready to administer revenge.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_HIEN_000_020: On second thought, , I ask that you return to the House of the Fierce without me, and tell Alphinaud to call the others together for a meeting.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_HIEN_000_021: It is imperative that the Kojin emissary be in attendance as well. I shall join you anon.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_HIEN_000_030: Do not worry, my friend. I will not be far behind.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Lord Hien wishes to discuss the details of our plan? Very well, if he insists. I shall summon the others at once.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_041: As for the Kojin, I believe one of their emissaries was already en route. Nevertheless, I shall contact them to make certain.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_050: It is...unorthodox, but I am in no position to speak against it.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALISAIE_000_055: We are fast approaching that moment when all is in order and we have naught to do but wait...frustrating as it is. <sigh> Well, when the time comes, I wish you the best of luck. Oh, and remember: no noble sacrifices or anything similarly stupid.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_HIEN_000_060: Thank you for accompanying me earlier. 'Twas in that moment of clarity that I understood what we needed to do.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_HANAME_000_065: We are to flood the castle, then... So be it. I will inform the Xaela.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_KAIDATE_000_070: Lord Hien may be young, but none among us question his leadership! We will defend him and his people to the last!
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_MOTOJIRO_000_075: Mayhap it is for the best. According to our spies in the castle, they do strange and terrible things in the lowest levels. Experiments involving men and magitek. If we can destroy their work before our forces enter the castle...
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YAGORO_000_080: My lord and his comrades are an inspiration. To spur our countrymen to rise up once more within a year of our defeat is a feat no others could accomplish.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_LYSE_000_090: If there's nothing else, I'll head back to Namai. Tsuranuki's working hard, and Isse's doing what he can to help, but maybe there's more that I can do too.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_LYSE_000_091: He was like a different person when he began hammering those plates. Younger, brighter, full of life and hope...
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YUGIRI_000_100: No plan is perfect, and there is ever room for improvement. I expect my comrades will be refining their approach until the moment they begin.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YUGIRI_000_101: In case you are unaware, the other jonin will lead the assault on the Moon Gates, not I. My place is at Lord Hien's side.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_YUGIRI_000_102: That my lord saw fit to let me accompany him came as a relief. There is nowhere I would rather be than by his side when the fighting begins.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_GOSETSU_000_110: The plan is set, and all that can be done has been done. Rest and relaxation are now paramount, for tomorrow we may die.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_GOSETSU_000_111: Have you too not done enough? Will you not pause a moment to gather yourself on the eve of our grand design? Go not unto battle with weary eyes or lingering regrets, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_GOSETSU_000_112: Ere you go to war, savor peace, for you may never know it again.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Soroban informs me that his sappers will be ready within the day, which means that we can proceed as planned and attack Doma Castle tomorrow.
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Considering the key role you will play, I think it only prudent that you refrain from further labors and rest until tomorrow. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_A1_000_123: Far be it from me to refuse...
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_125: We shall speak again in the morning. Take care, my friend...
TEXT_STMBDA505_02523_ALPHINAUD_000_126: True enough, true enough. When you have seen to your sundry tasks and are ready to retire, I pray you let me know.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Good...<yawn>...morning. I trust you slept well─or at least better than I did. 'Twould seem I dozed off in the middle of something, but your carousing with Lord Hien and Gosetsu woke me from my fitful slumber, and I retired to my bunk.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Alisaie is faring rather less well than either of us, but she will be fine, I am sure─so long as you do not remind her of what you saw.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_020: There  is. I trust you are none the worse for wear after last night.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_021: We received confirmation from the Kojin not long ago. Their sappers stand at the ready and await our signal.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_022: Let us not keep them and the others waiting. Gather your things─we depart at once.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_023: Alphinaud─instruct Lyse and the others to move into position and launch their attack.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_024: Our scouts report no change in the imperials' disposition, but I would leave nothing to chance. We must act quickly, lest we lose the element of surprise.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Understood. I will relay your orders to her and rejoin my unit.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Gosetsu and Yugiri await the two of you at Monzen. Good luck, my friends. I will see you both again soon.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_YUGIRI_000_035: Lyse will contact us once the attack has begun, after which the others will carry out their allotted tasks. Our part comes last.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_GOSETSU_000_040: I have dreamed of this day... A chance for freedom. For liberation. For redemption. After twenty-five years of regret.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_YUGIRI_000_050: The Confederacy report that they have secured the enclave. We need not fear for the civilians' safety!
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_GOSETSU_000_055: It is done. The water surges through the broken masonry and floods the castle even as we speak. Though my heart breaks at the sight of it, I must be strong. All is for the sake of Doma!
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_060: Aye, there can be no doubt. The viceroy is trapped. And so comes our part.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_061: Our Kojin allies will deliver us to our destination. To the western dock! And do not forget to bring your fellow adventurers, !
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_070: I can only imagine the chaos inside the castle. To be trapped by the rising waters and know the enemy is at their gates.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_071: They will fight us with every onze of their strength. As will we them, for the eyes of history are upon us.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_YUGIRI_000_075: When I led the Doman refugees to Eorzea, I did so only with the intention of seeking sanctuary. The thought of enlisting you and yours to aid us in another rebellion did not once cross my mind.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_YUGIRI_000_076: Yet here we stand, shoulder to shoulder, ready to strike at the heart of the occupation. It has been and ever will be an honor, .
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_GOSETSU_000_080: To see the castle thus defaced─and by our own hands... It is enough to make me smile─to laugh at the sheer absurdity of it.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_GOSETSU_000_081: This is not the end, but it is an ending. Soon...soon I will be free.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_AOKORA02524_000_090: Greetings and well met, my friends. Climb aboard, climb aboard! There is room enough for you all!
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_091: . That we might improve our odds of success, we will divide into two parties upon arrival─one composed of myself, the other you, Gosetsu, and Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_100_091: Given our inferior numbers, we must needs finish the battle quickly. And so, while you and yours draw the enemy's attention, I shall steal over to the keep.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_101_091: Lest you worry, though I've been to the castle only a handful of times, my father saw fit to drill its layout into me. I could find my way blindfolded.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_092: Even should one meet with misfortune, the other will reach Yotsuyu. Agreed?
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_HIEN_000_093: Then let us be about it. For Doma!
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_AOKORA02524_000_100: What are you waiting for? Come, come! Before the river swallows all!
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_LYSE_000_110: What happened in there? Where is Gosetsu?
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_ALISAIE_000_115: ...Tell me it was not for nothing.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_YUGIRI_000_125: ...He was right. The day is won. The people must know.
TEXT_STMBDA506_02524_SOROBAN_000_130: Victory is ours, is it not? Then why are you all so quiet?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_000: What happened in there? Where is Gosetsu?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_005: ...Tell me it was not for nothing.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_YUGIRI_000_015: ...He was right. The day is won. The people must know.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_020: Victory is ours, is it not? Then why are you all so quiet?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_030:
...Thank you.
The occupation is ended, then. And the people must be informed of our victory.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_031: But I will not simply give up Gosetsu for lost. Before aught else, we must needs search the ruins.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_032: Allow me, my friends. The castle is still collapsing into the river, and could easily drag you to your deaths. I can navigate the waters easily, without fear of drowning.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_100_032: Be reasonable, Brother. You know he is right.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_YUGIRI_000_034: My lord withdraws into himself, unable to turn his thoughts from the keep. He needs us now, more than ever...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_035: My friends, I am returned. I swam as far into the ruins as I could...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_037: ...Nay, lady. Naught remained of the keep for me to search.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_038: Undermined from below and shaken from above, the manner of its collapse was most unusual. If the floor beneath him gave way before the rest...it is not impossible that he could have been sent tumbling into the river.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_039: But the water is thick with silt and debris. Despite my best efforts, I could not find him. I am sorry.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_040: ...There is naught for which you should apologize. Thank you, Soroban, for taking it upon yourself to search.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_041: The castle is in ruins, and the people are eager to learn the fate of their nation. We leave at once.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_043: The day is won, and the morrow beckons...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_044: It falls to us to greet it.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_045: ...I'm going down to the docks to see if I can't get one of the Confederate ships to take us to the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_046: Mayhap we should tell the others at the House of the Fierce to gather there?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_047: Magnai and Sadu know naught of what happened in the castle. I will go and tell them.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_048: They fought valiantly and with honor, Cirina. I pray you tell them that as well.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_049: You too, my friend, were instrumental in this triumph. I must insist that you be present when we bring these tidings to my people.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_050: It seems Tansui was on his way as soon as he saw you flee the keep.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Our Confederate allies have already set about ferrying the others to the Doman Enclave. By the time we arrive, all should be present and waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_060:
I wish I knew what to say, but I've never had my brother's way with words.
It's...what he would have wanted? ...I-I'm sorry. This is not helping.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_065: You've never actually been to the enclave, have you? It was a lively place...before Zenos sent his troops.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_YUGIRI_000_070: You have witnessed the destruction wrought by the Empire, but nowhere is it more apparent than the enclave. Would that you could have seen it as it was...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_075: My brothers of the Blue have called for me, but we shall speak again soon.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_080: I cannot accompany you to the enclave. Magnai and Sadu will expect me to deliver the news of our victory to them in person.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_091: The captain thought you might need a ride to the enclave. Ready to come aboard?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_095: On you go, then. Sit wherever you like.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_096: I don't know what happened in there, but it's over. You won. That's cause enough for celebration─and those people you're about to see need something to celebrate...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_097: As you wish. They've waited twenty-five years. A few more minutes won't make a difference.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_098: Hm? What's wrong? You do want me to take you to the enclave, don't you?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_HIEN_000_100: Twenty-five years... If only you were here to see it.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_YUGIRI_000_105: It was not for naught. It was not for naught...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ISSE_000_110: <sniffle> Mother, Father... I understand now. I do...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_AZAMI_000_115: Why are you crying, Brother? Isn't today a good day?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TSURANUKI_000_0130: 'Twas a year ago my lord Kaien died, and with him, the dream of Doma. Never again would we be free, I thought...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TSURANUKI_000_0131: ...Miserable old fool that I am. But Doma lives! Doma rises! Doma will stand tall again! Till the end of my days will I labor to make it so!
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RESISTANCE02492_000: I want to shout and scream until my throat is hoarse. I want my fallen brothers and sisters to know that it was not in vain!
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_140: I'm glad we could be a part of it. That we could see with our own eyes that things can change if people have the courage to stand up and fight.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_145: We journeyed here from the opposite side of the world, but until now, it didn't seem half as far. I think that means our work here is done.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_150: Oh, you will not be staying in the enclave?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_155: Oh. Hien is not with you? N-No matter. The sun and moon were not fated to share the same sky.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_DOMABOATMAN_000_156: Honored hero! You seek passage across the One River?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_160: Are you quite certain you would not prefer to stay awhile longer? There are sure to be festivities─at which you would be the guest of honor, like as not.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_161: Very well. There are other ways in which we might celebrate─by rejoining the fight for freedom in Gyr Abania, for one.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_162: Short though our time here has been, we have all come to regard this land and her people as our own, I think. But we have done that which we came here to do.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_163: Word of Doma's liberation will soon spread throughout the Empire, and we must seize this opportunity to rekindle the fires of liberation in the West.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_164: We dare not allow the imperials a moment's respite, lest they march on Doma again. For the sake of all concerned, we should leave immediately.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_165: Did I hear you right? You are leaving?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_166: I'm afraid so. We've got our own battle to fight. What about you? Will you be heading back to the Steppe?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_167: Yes. The war here is ended, and there is no cause to remain. The Oronir and Dotharl have already withdrawn.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_168: I will follow them anon, but I wished to bid you farewell first.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_169: The Blue, too, must return to their homes, but we will be back. Doma has need of merchants and builders, and we are eager to offer our services!
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_170: And just like that, our grand fellowship is broken? Without ceremony or pomp, you steal off into the dark?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_171: No matter. We have plenty to be getting on with. Places to be, people to rob, and so on. And the captain never was one for mingling.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RASHO_000_172: I am a pirate. Give me a song at the tavern, and I will be happy. Hobnobbing with Lord Hien? Nay.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_173: <sigh> No taste for the finer things...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_174: In any event, we need not part ways here. If you are for Kugane, we would be happy to take you. Her waters have always been...fruitful.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_CIRINA_000_175: I wish you well on your journey, my friends. May you ever walk in crimson.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_SOROBAN_000_177: May the kami speed you on your way! Until we meet again!
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_180: We have said our good-byes. Though it be with heavy hearts, let us board the boat and begin our long journey home.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_185: Didn't even think to tell Lord Hien you were leaving? Well...I'm sure you had your reasons.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RASHO_000_190: Naught remains undone? You are ready to depart?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RASHO_000_195: Oh? I thought matters in your homeland pressing. Mayhap I was mistaken.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_LYSE_000_200: It's just as colorful as I remember...
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALPHINAUD_000_205: In a way, this too feels like a homecoming. How long has it been since Carvallain brought us here...?
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_ALISAIE_000_210: I can still hear his voice... My ears haven't stopped ringing since he first barged his way into the Rising Stones, a veritable force of nature.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_TANSUI_000_215: It's a rare thing for us to sail into Kugane like common traders. I don't rightly recall the last time, but it will have been years.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RASHO_000_220: Have everything? Good. We will need to weigh anchor before the Sekiseigumi arrive.
TEXT_STMBDA507_02525_RASHO_000_221: ...From the bottom of my heart, I thank you for what you did. Give my regards to the Ul'dahn.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_LYSE_000_000: It's just as colorful as I remember...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALISAIE_000_005: I can still hear his voice... My ears haven't stopped ringing since he first barged his way into the Rising Stones, a veritable force of nature.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_RASHO_000_010: Do not worry. We will be safely away before the Sekiseigumi arrive.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TANSUI_000_015: It's a rare thing for us to sail into Kugane like common traders. I don't rightly recall the last time, but it will have been years.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I informed Tataru of our coming. She and Hancock should be waiting for us in the Ruby Bazaar.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALISAIE_000_021: Then it is here we part ways. Best of luck to you and yours in your...piratical endeavors, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TANSUI_000_030: Do come and visit us again. 'Twould be a shame if we never got to see you and the little miss again.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_040: Welcome back, everyone, and congratulations on a job well done!
