TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_041: It is a pleasure as ever to see your smiling face, Tataru. Less so yours, Hancock, though Rasho and I are sincerely grateful for your assistance.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_042: The pleasure was all mine, Master Alphinaud. I assure you.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_043: Anyway, you will be glad to hear that I have already chartered passage for you back to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_044: The ship is to leave port this very day, but the captain has agreed to wait until the four of you have boarded.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_045: The four of us? You mean to stay here in Kugane?
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_046: Yes. I gave it some thought, and I realized that even with Doma free, there's still a need for a woman in the middle. Maybe even more than before, considering all the friends and alliances you made.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_047: As I told her many times before, I would be more than willing to assist you─
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_048: And as I told you many times before, I am not about to let you worm your way into our affairs and exploit our connections for your personal gain!
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_049: <sigh> Must you always presume the worst?
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_050: So there you have it. I will remain here for now. You needn't worry─I'm a regular at the hostelry and a half-dozen other local institutions. Everyone loves me!
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_051: So go, go! Don't let me keep you. Buy your supplies and souvenirs while you still can!
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_052: When you've finished, make haste to the docks. Pier number two, to be precise. I'll be waiting for you there!
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I cannot deny that the thought of leaving her here alone worries me, but she has proven time and time again that she is far more clever than she appears. Besides, I do not think I could persuade her to change her mind.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Mayhap I should take her advice and purchase a souvenir or two before leaving...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_065: Personally I would have preferred to host you for a few days, but Tataru was adamant that you return on the first available ship. One could almost suspect she is eager to be rid of you...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_066: Idle musings, naught more. Purely hypothetical and most assuredly incorrect. She wants only the best for her dear friends, and is surely not motivated by hidden desires to go gallivanting about with her Hingan paramours...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_TATARU_000_070: First to arrive, as always. Hopefully the others will not be far behind...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Compared to Kugane's vivid colors, Limsa Lominsa seems a bit...lacking. Still beautiful in its own way, but not as much as before...
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_ALISAIE_000_085: It feels like a lifetime ago that we left for Kugane, doesn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_YUGIRI_000_090: We should inform the Admiral of our arrival, and brief her on that which took place in Doma before leaving the city.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_095: Setting your sights on Ala Mhigo next, I presume? Excellent. The chairman is most interested in seeing how that whole affair plays out.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_HANCOCK_000_096: Hm? Is the company willing to openly aid the Gyr Abanian campaign? Oh, heavens no. Far too close to home. 'Twould be an unconscionable risk.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_LYSE_000_100: Back in Eorzea at last. Ready to pick up where we left off and finish the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_LYSE_000_101: We're not who we were when we left. We're stronger and wiser.
TEXT_STMBDA508_02526_LYSE_000_102: So let's do it! Let's get back to Ala Mhigo and defeat Zenos once and for all!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_001: We've been away for far too long, but finally─finally, we're going to make things right!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_005: It feels like a lifetime ago that we left for Kugane, doesn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_YUGIRI_000_010: We should inform the Admiral of our arrival, and brief her on that which took place in Doma before leaving the city.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Here we are, home at last. I must say, the journey passed more quickly than I had expected.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_021: That would be due to the absence of otherworldly interference, I expect.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_022: I-I should be glad if we did not speak of that unpleasantness again!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Ahem. But in spite of all that and more, we return better for the experience─and, more importantly, triumphant.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_YUGIRI_000_024: Indeed. And with Doma freed of imperial oppression, it is only right that we turn our thoughts to the plight of Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_025: Well, I'm all for that, obviously, but I think you should go and see the refugees at Revenant's Toll before doing anything else. They'll be thrilled to hear what we've accomplished, and it'd sound best coming from you.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_YUGIRI_000_026: ...Thank you. I shall do as you suggest.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_027: I see I am not too late.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Admiral! What are you doing here?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_029: The East Aldenard Trading Company informed me of your impending arrival. I have tidings I thought best to share with you in person.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_031: Aye. The Alliance still holds the Wall, despite several imperial counterattacks. But we have been unable to press further into occupied territory.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_032: Commander Kemp and his men, meanwhile, have made great strides toward rebuilding their depleted ranks. They have even taken it upon themselves to attempt some few operations...with mixed results, I am sorry to say. 'Twas a complication arising from one such venture which moved me to seek you out.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_033: During a mission to transport wounded Resistance fighters to the Rising Stones, Krile Baldesion was taken prisoner.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Krile!? Do they know where she is being held?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MERLWYB_000_035: They do not. But your comrades were informed at once, and I am told Thancred is in Gyr Abania looking for her as we speak.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_036: How could this have happened...? We must seek out Thancred without delay!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_100_036: ...Nay. Krile taught me better than that. It would be unwise to act without first acquiring a full understanding of the situation...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Thank you for informing us. Tired though we may be, we must make haste to Castrum Oriens. Pray excuse us, Admiral, Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_PIPIN_000_050: Ah, you are returned! You should speak with Thancred. He is waiting for you with Arenvald.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_RAUBAHN_000_055: Glad to have you with us again. Hmm...you seem stronger than I remember─hard though I find that to believe. One would almost think you'd spent the whole time fighting. Well done, by the way.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I swear to you, the imperials will not cross this wall again, on my honor as a man of the Twin Adder.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_STORMOFFICER_000_07: Imperial scum! We will make them pay for this!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_100_080: I'm sorry, . It's all my fault...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MNAAGO_300_090: It's good to see you again...though I wish it were under better circumstances...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_080: There you are! You have heard the news?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_081: In broad strokes from Admiral Bloefhiswyn. What happened?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_082: Krile and a squadron of Resistance fighters were escorting Y'shtola and several other wounded to the Rising Stones for further treatment when they were ambushed by imperial forces.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_083: Arenvald and his men fought valiantly, but in the chaos─
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_084: I will make no excuses! We failed to protect her.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_085: Do not be so hard on yourself. You protected Y'shtola and the others, did you not? Tell us about the attack.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_086: It was the Skulls. They knew a path across the Wall we hadn't found. We thought we were safe once we reached the Black Shroud. <sigh> We weren't expecting an ambush...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_087: During the fighting, I caught a glimpse of their leader's memories. It was all planned.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_088: The advantage of having a Walker in the field.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_089: I'm not as strong in the Echo as  is, of course. Half the time, it's enough to knock me on my arse, like I've taken a dose of concentrated aether...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_090: So you walked in Fordola's memories. What did you see?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_091: A woman promised the world─education, training, citizenship─all that and more if she but sold her soul. A traitor to her people, a pretender to her masters...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_092: ...It was Zenos himself that gave the order. Told her to return with Krile Baldesion─alive.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_093: Our agents have been carefully monitoring imperial communications since the attack, but have yet to intercept any transmissions making reference to Krile or her current whereabouts.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_094: If their orders were to bring Krile back alive, we can save her if we move quickly enough.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_095: As you say, time is of the essence, which is why I intend to slip past enemy lines and see what information I can uncover on my own.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_000_096: In the meantime, it is up to you and our allies to command the imperials' undivided attention. Lots of shouting and explosions and so forth. Keep them distracted, and I will find her.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_097: ...Very well. I wish I could do more to aid you, but I understand.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_THANCRED_100_098: Commander Kemp is on his way to the castrum as we speak for a meeting with General Aldynn. If you hurry, you could find him on the road, and discuss the situation beforehand.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_200_098: I think  and I are going to go and see Conrad like he suggested. You all wait here.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_100: What can I say? Patience isn't one of my virtues.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_105: ...I wish I could go with him. It would be utterly self-defeating, but I would do it nevertheless.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_110: There's nothing wrong with wanting something stupid, so long as you don't act on it. Remember that there are other ways you can help her.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_115: Alphinaud called it an advantage, but in truth, it was a liability. The vision left me reeling, and Fordola seized the opening to push past and snatch up Krile. I'm sorry...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_PIPIN_100_115: Once Commander Kemp and his men arrive, we can begin.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_130: Well, well! Isn't this a pleasant surprise! It fills my heart with joy to see you two hale and healthy.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MNAAGO_000_131: Welcome home, Lyse, . I'm sure you've heard about Krile by now...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_132: That's why we're here. I'm still not sure what to think about it...but we'll save her. We'll definitely save her somehow.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_133: Aye, I've no doubt that you will. You look stronger for your time in the Far East, lass, and that's good news for Krile.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_134:
I'd like to think so...
But enough about me─how is everything with you and the Resistance?
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_135: Better than when you last saw us, and no mistake. Arenvald's been a godssend. Him and M'naago and all the other youngbloods have achieved so much in such a short time.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_136: We've been blessed to receive the support of the Flames' Ala Mhigan Brigade, who've been instrumental in freeing our countrymen from labor camps throughout Gyr Abania, as well as some political prisoners from the city proper, believe it or not.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_137: Together with the refugees returning from Ul'dah and elsewhere, we've had no shortage of able-bodied men and women eager to join the cause.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_138: I knew you wouldn't stop fighting, even after what happened at the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_139: Force of habit, I suppose. Though we've come a long way, we still have far to go. But we'll fight for every ilm, and sooner or later, we'll get to Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_140: But listen to me prattling on when we should be making haste to Castrum Oriens. There's no point you telling me everything now when you'll only have to say it all again for the Flame General's benefit.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_141: You're right. I'll go on ahead and tell the others that you're not far off.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_LYSE_000_150: You can go ahead and tell Marshal Tarupin that Conrad's party will be arriving any moment.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALPHINAUD_000_151: I know, I know. There's naught to be gained from giving in to my emotions. I need to stay calm and composed. Krile herself would say as much.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_000_152: Ephemie and the others at the Rising Stones are looking after Y'shtola now. We need not fear for her safety.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ALISAIE_100_152: As for Krile, everything that can be done is being done. It falls to the rest of us to carry on the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_ARENVALD_000_153: Y'shtola is safe, but it's still anyone's guess when she'll be strong enough to take to the field...
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_CONRAD_000_154: Go on ahead, . We'll not be far behind.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_MNAAGO_000_155: Losing Krile hit us hard. So many of us owe her our lives...which is why we owe it to her not to give up hope. We'll find her, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_PIPIN_000_120: You have spoken with Thancred, then? Good. Take heart─if anyone can track her down, it's him.
TEXT_STMBDA601_02527_PIPIN_000_121: I believe I hear Commander Kemp's party approaching. If you are ready to address Father and the others, let us be about it.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_001: You can go ahead and tell Marshal Tarupin that Conrad's party will be arriving any moment.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALISAIE_000_005: Ephemie and the others at the Rising Stones are looking after Y'shtola now. We need not fear for her safety. As for Krile, everything that can be done is being done. It falls to the rest of us to carry on the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_000_010: Y'shtola may be safe, but it's still anyone's guess when she'll be strong enough to return to the field.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I know, I know. There's naught to be gained from giving in to my emotions. I need to stay calm and composed. Krile herself would say as much.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I swear to you, the imperials will not cross this wall again, on my honor as a man of the Twin Adder.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_STORMOFFICER_000_04: Imperial scum! We will make them pay for this!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_PIPIN_100_050: ...You are ready, yes? Then I pray you inform Father.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_100_050: There you are─and there is Commander Kemp, I see. I know you are eager to speak of our next move, but we would first hear more of your last. Tell us of your deeds in Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_050: The success of this operation is paramount. So long as the Empire holds Castellum Velodyna, the main host cannot advance.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_051: Zenos knows this, which is why he has ordered Fordola and her men to see to the bridge's defense.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_052: So we'll get to fight the Skulls again...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_053: The Butcher is not to be underestimated. She is decisive, ruthless, and feared by foes and friends alike. But we have a plan to defeat her.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_054: First, we send an Alliance force down the main road, signaling our intention to mount an all-out assault. The garrison will muster their forces and prepare for a protracted battle...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_055: However, they will soon find that we are ill prepared for their counterattack. Our men will begin to break ranks and flee.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_056: I see... Show them your backs and give them a target too tempting not to pursue.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_057: Aye, Fordola is too aggressive not to press the advantage. She will order her men to give chase.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_058: We lure them as far as East End, where the commanders will rally their forces and attempt to hold their ground. If all goes to plan, we should be able to keep the greater part of their garrison occupied.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_059: ...Leaving us to tackle the bridge's remaining defenders. Very clever, I'm sure. But what are we to do if the imperials smell a rat and return before we've taken the place?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_060: I don't need you to take Velodyna, Commander Kemp. All I need is for you to fly your flag from its tower.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALPHINAUD_000_061: You mean to trick them into believing that the bridge has fallen!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_062: Aye. We convince them Velodyna is lost, hit them hard with our reinforcements, and watch them go running for the hills.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_RAUBAHN_000_063: Then, when the dust has settled, we regroup at the castellum. What say you?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_064: It's a bold plan...but a good one. We'll do it.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALPHINAUD_000_065: In that case, we shall support both the Resistance and the Alliance forces.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALPHINAUD_000_066: , Lyse, Arenvald─I ask that you accompany Commander Kemp. Alisaie and I will remain with the Flame General.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_067: We will return to Rhalgr's Reach and make our preparations. As soon as they are complete, we will join you in the field. Godsspeed!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_210: Conrad wasn't kidding when he said they'd made a lot of progress while we were away...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_MNAAGO_000_211: I can't tell you how long I've been waiting for this! It's going to be grand!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_000_212: If it takes a hundred battles like this to rescue Krile, then I'll fight in every one!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_220: In case you haven't noticed, the flag flying above Velodyna is bloody massive. It'd take a dozen men to change it, and far too long besides. But there's no need for all that─right, M'naago?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_MNAAGO_000_221: Not so long as I have my griffin and a satchel of glamour prisms, no!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_224:
Arenvald, you're in charge of the runners between us and the Alliance. No linkpearls.
Lyse, I want you to look in on the squadrons─make sure they've got everything they need. Everybody clear?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_226:
All forces are to depart for Castellum Corvi when ready. That will be all.
, stay with me a moment, if you would.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_227: There's a few men I'd like you to look in on personally. Each of them has lost people, and I can tell that it weighs on their hearts...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_228: There have been a lot of new faces since last you were here, so it's best if I just tell you where to look. One's an officer you'll find in the Barber, another's an older fellow who likes to pass the time on the shore of Starfall. The last is a fiery young lad from Little Ala Mhigo, who I'm told trains by himself by the river to the Fringes. You'll know them when you see them. Come and find me when you've finished.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_229: I have a few things to see to here, so I should still be around when you've had a word with those three men I mentioned.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ALAMHIGAN02528_000_: Wait, I know you!  ! It is an honor to meet you!

I was living hand-to-mouth in Ul'dah, but decided to enlist in the Flames after I heard tales of your derring-do. And now, as fate would have it, I've been sent here to join in the fight for my homeland's liberation.
Ah, but this is no time to talk. I've got to prepare for the operation! Take care, ! We'll give those imperial whoresons what for!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_BURLYPRIVATE02638_0: I say, if it isn't the  who helped me find the Ward I misplaced!

Ah, but there I go again treating you as an equal! It wasn't till after you'd gone that one of my comrades pulled me aside and told me it was only the bleedin' hero of Eorzea who'd taken time out of  busy day to help me!
Well, what is done is done. But know that I will fight with every onze of my strength in this coming battle, and the next and the next! Mayhap that will serve to repay the favor. Fare you well!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_STRAPPINGLAD02528_0: ..., am I right? I doubt you remember me, but I'll never forget you─saved my life in Little Ala Mhigo, you did.
Wilred and the rest of us had got it into our heads that if we had enough crystals, we could summon Rhalgr like the Amalj'aa summoned their god. Thankfully, you put a stop to it.
Ever hear about what happened to Wilred? Joined the Braves when they came calling, only to turn up dead one day. Never found out how or why, but I reckon it doesn't matter. Dead's dead, after all.
But at least he died doing what he thought was right. And maybe that's the best folks like us can hope for, eh? Not that I'm in any hurry, mind!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_260: You've had a word with the men I mentioned, then?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_261: As I'm sure you noticed, they've another thing in common aside from tragedy: you've touched each of their lives in one way or another. But that's not the reason I wanted you to speak with them.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_262: A man who's lived in Gyr Abania his entire life, who bore witness to the realities of the occupation for twenty unbroken years...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_263: A man who fled Ala Mhigo in search of a new life, who swore to serve another nation, only for fate to conspire to send him back here...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_264: A youth born on foreign soil, who never knew his parents' homeland, yet nevertheless felt kinship with our cause...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_265: Three men, three stories, three reasons. Yet all belong to the Resistance. In growing larger, we've grown more diverse, and while there is good in that, there's also the potential for strife and discord.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_266: It'd take a special sort to lead such men to Ala Mhigo, don't you think?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_A1_000_003: ...Leader of the Resistance, eh? Don't I have enough titles already?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_267: For now, aye, but not forever. And, to be frank, I don't always know what to say to the ones who left, not to mention the youths.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_100_267: Nay, the Resistance needs a leader with a wider view. Someone who's not lived their whole life in Gyr Abania; who's known death and hardship but not been ground down by them.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_200_267: Aye. As you may have guessed, I've been thinking of asking Lyse. But it'll be her decision in the end.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_268: I see we're of one mind. She'll have to make the decision for herself, of course.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_100_268: You've traveled with her. Been by her side when she's had to make hard choices. You've seen her at her worst and her best. If you think she's got it in her, then she does.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_200_268: Look after her, . She's our future, and my hope.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_269: Hah, now wouldn't that be a sight! The Slayer of Gods and Savior of Ishgard leading the Resistance into battle. You're not short of relevant combat experience, I'll give you that!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_100_269: Being serious, though...I've been thinking about asking Lyse to be my successor. She's young and worldly, strong and kind. A bit daft at times, but not so much that it worries me─especially given what I've seen of her since she returned.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_200_269: Look after her, . She's our future, and my hope.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_275: I trust I needn't say that this conversation is just between you and me?
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_276: Good . Right, then─we'd best head to Castellum Corvi. Or what remains of it, rather.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_070: I said it then, and I'll say it again: I won't let it all be for nothing...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_000_080:
I'll prove to them that it wasn't a mistake...
...That I wasn't a mistake.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_MNAAGO_000_100: Her name is Obda. We've known each other since we were small. We'll be going on this mission together...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ANANTASOLDIER_000_1: You are the warrior, yesss? It is an honor.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_170: We'll lead the way while the other units launch their own separate attacks. Remember that we need to hold out until M'naago sees to the flag.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_171: Got your gear in order? Any moment now...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_FORDRA_000_175:
Think you're clever with all your little tricks? Think again!
None of you are leaving here alive!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_000_180: Did you see that, A'aba, Aulie? We did it!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_MNAAGO_000_185: <pant> <pant> For a moment there, I didn't think I could do it...but then I did!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_000_190: Well fought, brothers and sisters! Today is a day that will be remembered for generations to come!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ANANTASOLDIER_000_1: Ssso, you are indeed everything they sssay. The ssstuff of legends...
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_200: It's a shame Fordola got away, but we did what we came here to do.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_000_201: I have to remind myself it's just the first step...but it's a big one. We're going to take it back...all of it─one ilm at a time if we have to!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_BATTLETALK_0: Quickly now! We've got to reach Velodyna before General Aldynn and his men are overwhelmed!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_BATTLETALK_101: Scouts, dead ahead! If they see us, they'll warn the others!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_BATTLETALK: Not if we kill them first!
That's the last of 'em! Let's keep moving!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_BATTLETALK_101: What are you doing, !? Stay close!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_CONRAD_BATTLETALK_0: No sign of sentries. General Aldynn must have his hands full.
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_ARENVALD_BATTLETALK: Then let's seize the bridge and be done with it!
They left a token force behind. Nothing we can't handle!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LYSE_BATTLETALK_102: Cannons! They could use those to fire on Naago!
That's the last of the cannons! It should be safe for Naago now!

This bridge belongs to the Empire! I am not about to give it up!
Hero or not, you'll die just like all the rest!
This is MY BRIDGE! You are NOT taking this from me!
TEXT_STMBDA602_02528_LISE_BATTLETALK_007: Naago made it! We've only got to hold on a little longer...
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ARENVALD_000_001: Did you see that, A'aba, Aulie? We did it!
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_MNAAGO_000_005: <pant> <pant> For a moment there, I didn't think I could do it...but then I did!
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_LYSE_000_010: One step at a time, one step at a time. Until we're on Zenos's doorstep!
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ANANTASOLDIER_000_0: Ssso, you are indeed everything they sssay. The ssstuff of legends...
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_020: There's still a chance that some imperials are holed up inside the castellum. We'll need to search it top to bottom to be sure it's safe.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_021: In the meantime, I want you to rendezvous with the main host. Keep your weapons at the ready─there's a chance you might come face-to-face with soldiers on the run en route.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_022: On second thought, it might be prudent for you to do a preemptive sweep of the region for soldiers that have gone to ground. We shouldn't afford them any time to regroup and launch a counterattack.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_023: When you've judged your work to be done, report to General Aldynn in Bittermill.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_025: Just because we've won doesn't mean it's over yet. There're still enemies about, and a panicked soldier can kill you just as quick as a cool-headed one.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_BALLOON_000_035: Sod this! I'm not dying today!
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALPHINAUD_000_040: The Bull of Ala Mhigo has done it again. His assessment of Fordola's response was without error.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALISAIE_000_045: It's a good thing M'naago got the flag flying when she did. Any longer and those imperials might have had us at their mercy...
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_RAUBAHN_000_051: Good, good. The fighting has died down here too, as you can see.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_RAUBAHN_000_052: Pipin left but a moment ago with a contingent of troops to occupy Velodyna. If and when the imperials return, they'll find us dug in behind their own walls.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALPHINAUD_000_053: I could not have hoped for a better outcome, General. Splendidly done.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_RAUBAHN_000_054: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. It'll take more than one castellum to turn the tide.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_RAUBAHN_000_055: My men and I will deal with the remaining enemy forces. Scions, I bid you return to Commander Kemp and his men.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALPHINAUD_000_056: Delight not overmuch in victory─not when there are battles left to fight...
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALPHINAUD_000_057: Our work here is finished. Our Resistance allies are waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALPHINAUD_000_060: From a stone bridge to a massive fortress... Garlean engineering never ceases to impress.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_ALISAIE_000_065: Now that we have taken control of Velodyna, there's nothing stopping us from marching east towards the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_LYSE_000_070: If you're looking for Arenvald, I think he's with Pipin, searching the castellum for any remaining soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Velodyna belongs to the Alliance and the Resistance now. You may be assured that the imperials will never hold it again!
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_080: Back so soon? I suppose the General and his men had matters well in hand.
TEXT_STMBDA603_02529_CONRAD_000_081: The vice marshal and his men showed up not long after you left. If the gods are good, there'll be no one left to fight...
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALPHINAUD_000_001: From a stone bridge to a massive fortress... Garlean engineering never ceases to impress.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALISAIE_000_005: Now that we have taken control of Velodyna, there's nothing stopping us from marching east towards the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_LYSE_000_010: If you're looking for Arenvald, I think he's with Pipin, searching the castellum for any remaining soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Velodyna belongs to the Alliance and the Resistance now. You may be assured that the imperials will never hold it again!
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_020: I know you're not one for waiting, but if you'll bear with us─
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Commander Kemp! Marshal Tarupin reports that their sweep of the castellum's interior has been completed!
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_022: So it's finally over, eh? Pray extend to him my deepest thanks.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALISAIE_000_023: It's official, then. Castellum Velodyna is well and truly ours. Mayhap this calls for─ Wait, where is M'naago?
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_024: She took her bird and flew off towards the Peering Stones─the village of the M tribe, where she was born.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_025: I doubt that the imperials who fled Velodyna had a mind to give them trouble on their way back east, but she was nevertheless worried, so I gave her leave to go and see that her people were safe.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Though I pray you are right, 'twould be best if M'naago were not alone if she should encounter the enemy.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_LYSE_000_027: Agreed! Let's all go to the Peering Stones and make sure that everything is all right.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_028: If that is your wish, then I've no objection. Just let the guard know when you wish to cross.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_CONRAD_000_030: For now we need to take stock of our supplies, tend to our wounded, and so forth. We'll resume our march east soon enough, but not yet.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Greetings, Scion. Do you wish to pass?
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ARENVALD_000_045: Did you say you were for the Peering Stones? In that case, mayhap Marshal Tarupin and I should join you.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ARENVALD_000_050: We spied a suspicious pair earlier─a Hyur and a Lalafell, by the looks of them─but they fled when they realized they'd been spotted. If they're imperials, then we can't have them stirring up trouble.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_JMOLDVA_100_055: <sniff> <sniff> On your guard, Arenvald. They're still about...
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_VMAHTIA_100_060: Since when did you become a bloodhound? A Miqo'te ought to trust their ears, not their nose.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_PIPIN_000_055: We will soon start sending scouts east to survey the land in preparation for our advance. We do not anticipate much resistance at this time, but should we encounter any imperial forces, we shall deal with them quickly and severely.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_LYSE_000_060: The path to the village is through a tunnel just east of here. Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALPHINAUD_000_065: ...But of course. Tiring though it may be to come and go from the clifftop, it is easily defended and affords an excellent view of the surrounding area.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALISAIE_000_070: This area is home to dangerous beasts. Naught that we cannot handle, mind, but do not be surprised if something ravenous and slavering comes charging at you out of nowhere.
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_LYSE_000_075: Well, what do you think? Hard to tell from down below that a whole village is up here, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Not just Seekers of the Sun, but Ananta? Mayhap there is a settlement nearby...
TEXT_STMBDA604_02530_ALISAIE_000_085: We may not have seen any imperial forces thus far, but we mustn't forget that this was occupied territory until very recently. They could still be nearby.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_001: And now we have a primal to contend with as well. <sigh> As if the Empire needed an excuse to start rounding up beastmen again...
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_MNAAGO_000_005: I still can't believe that a primal's been summoned so close to the village. The idea that our people could be taken to serve as thralls is... It just doesn't bear thinking about.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_VIRASOLDIER_000_015: You have ssslain many eikons before, yesss? Then please─put an end to thisss madnesss...
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ahem. At the risk of sounding hopelessly naive...there may yet be a way to avoid a violent confrontation.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_021: In the past, I fear I have been rather too willing to accept that we have no other recourse than to risk our lives─or rather your life─to address these threats.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Yet the primals we have faced thus far have demonstrated a variety of temperaments and objectives. Ravana may delight in battle, but Ramuh would sooner keep to the forests with his children.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Ere we decide to challenge Sri Lakshmi, it would seem wise to learn more of her nature from those who summoned her unto this world.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_VIRASOLDIER_000_024: If that is your will, then ssso be it. To the north will you find our village. Sssarisha shall unfold all.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_025: We shall leave at once. M'naago, can you inform our comrades at the bridge of what happened?
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_MNAAGO_000_026: Of course. Be safe, my friends.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_MNAAGO_000_030: I will send word to Conrad and the others. Take care, and do not hesitate to send for help if you need it.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_040: ...We do not often receive guestsss. What is the purpossse of your visit?
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Greetings and well met. We are the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, and we come seeking Sarisha of the Vira. You are she, are you not?
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_042: You have petitioned us for aid and succor, and we intend to provide them, but we would first learn more of Sri Lakshmi, that we might better understand the nature of the threat she poses to you.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_043: A sssimple requessst, and one which I shall gladly oblige.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_044: In the beginning was Sri Lakshmi. We were created in Her image─daughters blesssed with Her beauty. Her breath became ours; Her ssserenity our sssolace. There is naught She would not give.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Hm. 'Twas the Qalyana broodmother's desire to bring about her daughter's resurrection which first called forth Sri Lakshmi from the aether. That being the case, I rather doubt the goddess will be spoiling for a fight.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_046:
That would depend. The primal's motives will have been colored by the summoner's state of mind─namely, that of a grieving mother who had just borne witness to her daughter's murder. Though she apparently craved a miracle, she may also have harbored thoughts of vengeance.
Moreover, the Qalyana's conception of Sri Lakshmi may differ from that of the Vira.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_047: Thisss is true. The Vira and the Qalyana do indeed regard the Lady of Blisss in different ways.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_048: To the Vira, Sri Lakshmi embodies freedom. She would not sssuffer Her daughters to be bound to another's will. And ssso we ssstand with the Resissstance againssst the Empire, and give our lives for the cause.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_049: To the Qalyana, however, She embodies transsscendental beauty, which they ssstrive to create through their craft. To shape cryssstal is lesss art and more ritual─a sssacred duty wherein each tribute is imbued with a fragment of the sssoul.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_050: The imperials do not interfere with thisss holy work, and ssso the Qalyana were content to turn inward and ignore our plight.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_051: ...Until reality asserted itself, and they summoned a primal. A fever dream to soothe their aching hearts.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_LYSE_000_052: But surely they can see that it won't do any good! The imperials will still rule these lands. Nothing will change!
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_053: The Ananta will. The Qalyana bade the Vira make pilgrimage to “pay proper respects,” remember? Those who do not wish to partake of their primal's bliss will be made to do so.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_LYSE_100_054: Not while we're around they won't!
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_200_054: Though our beliefsss are not the sssame, we are ssstill kin to the Qalyana. Will you help them to sssee reason?
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_A1_000_002: Know that I'll kill your god if I have to. Maybe even if I don't.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_100_056: Then we shall, for without you we may be powerlesss to ssstop them.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_100_057: ...Do what you will, warrior. That sssimulacrum is not Sri Lakshmi.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_200_057: If we do not act quickly, more lives will be lost, more families torn apart...more children made to suffer.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_LYSE_000_060: Then it's settled─we're going to find that primal and put an end to this!
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_000_061: My sssister Vajra will guide you to Djanan Qhat...and I shall pray for your successs.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALISAIE_000_065: We need to go. I won't be late again. Not like in Limsa.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_ALPHINAUD_000_070: I am reminded of the tragedy we bore witness to beneath O'Ghomoro, when poor Ga Bu cried out in despair and rage, and Titan came forth in answer...
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_LYSE_000_075: I'm not sure why Alisaie's so eager to face this primal all of a sudden, but you won't hear me complaining!
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_SARISHA_100_080: My sssister Vajra will guide you to the Qalyana village. Do what you mussst, eikon-ssslayer.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_VAJRA_000_080: Well met, Ssscions. I am Vajra. She who shines bright and unbroken.
TEXT_STMBDA605_02531_VAJRA_000_081: I ssstand ready. We leave upon your command.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_001: We were too late for him in Limsa, but this time...this time...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I am reminded of the tragedy we bore witness to beneath O'Ghomoro, when poor Ga Bu cried out in despair and rage, and Titan came forth in answer...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_LYSE_000_010: I'm not sure why Alisaie's so eager to face this primal all of a sudden, but you won't hear me complaining!
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_020: You are ready? Hm. You look ready.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_021: Djanan Qhat. There you find the Qalyana's cryssstals, and Sri Lakshmi. Follow me.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_025: I expected more resistance. Let us pray our luck holds...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALPHINAUD_000_030: It would be in our best interest to avoid any confrontation unless absolutely necessary. The primal and the crystals are our primary objectives.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_LYSE_000_035: We should follow their lead and let them do any fighting for now. You'll need your strength when the time comes.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_040: Djanan Qhat. The path leads to an entrance above.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_041: Within is an aetheryte. You must use it to enter.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_050: The aetheryte is within. I will go no further. Good luck, eikon-slayer.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALPHINAUD_000_070: (I knew things were not going to end well the moment she stepped out of hiding...)
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_LYSE_000_075: Ugh... Is there really no way we can fight alongside you without being turned into one of her dreamers?
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_080: I know, I know, it was stupid and foolish but...but I had to try, . I had to.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_082: I had to try...and I failed. So you have to fight. There is no other way.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_A1_000_151: I'll wake them from the dream.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_A1_000_153: Primals cannot be suffered to live. You know this.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_084: Thank you, . I know you will.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_100_084: It means a lot to hear you say that. It does. But it doesn't make it any easier to have to ask you to face that...that thing.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_200_084: Maybe so, but every time we must turn to you and others like you to do what we cannot. I just wish there was another way...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_300_084: We can but do that which is within our power. Lyse, Alphinaud, and I will go and seize their crystal stores. This will not happen again.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_400_084: And you... When it is finished...we will be waiting for you.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_085: We came too late for Ga Bu, but perhaps, this time, when the primal is no more...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALPHINAUD_000_110: We had to use force to secure the crystals. Alisaie...was not gentle.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_ALISAIE_000_115: You've finished, then. Good. I'm glad it's over.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_VAJRA_000_120: Hm. You yet live... I had my doubtsss. Welcome back.
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_LYSE_000_130: I wish we could have left on better terms, but that was never going to happen. It could be a problem if they get their hands on any more crystals, though...
TEXT_STMBDA606_02532_LYSE_000_131: Never mind. We'll deal with that when the time comes.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_001: We had to use force to secure the crystals. Alisaie...was not gentle.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_005: You've finished, then. Good. I'm glad it's over.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_010: I hate leaving it all to you. It makes me wish there were some way of borrowing the Echo.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_VAJRA_000_020: You have done us a great ssservice this day. Long shall my sssisters sssing the praises of the eikon-ssslayer.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_VAJRA_000_021: Let usss bear word to them of Sri Lakshmi's passsing. Come, friends─to Vira Nilya!
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Had the Qalyana's beliefs been closer to those of the Vira, this crisis could surely have been avoided...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_030: If only I had your power. The things I would do...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_035: I just hope we won't have to deal with any more primals before we march on Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_VAJRA_000_040: 'Twas your victory. 'Tis only meet that you be the one to tell my sssister.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_SARISHA_000_050: Ahh... The winds whissspered of your successs...and your eyes confirm their tessstimony. The Lady of Blisss no longer holds our Qalyana sssisters in Her thrall. For thisss we thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_051: did the deed. We were but witnesses to  heroism.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_052: However, I fear this is only the beginning, for there is no cure for that which drives the desperate to beseech the gods for salvation. Should they wish to use their crystals to summon Sri Lakshmi again, naught can be done to stop them.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_SARISHA_000_053: We ignore our sssisters' plight at our peril. Thisss we know. We shall endeavor to show them another path ssso that the day you ssspeak of never comes.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_054: We're all in this together─Ala Mhigans and Ananta. We understand that. Hopefully, in time, they will too.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_SARISHA_000_055: You and yours will ever be friends of the Vira. On that you have my word.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_056: We should be getting back to the Peering Stones. Thank you again, Sarisha. For everything.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_SARISHA_000_060: All Vira will know of your deeds. Long shall they be celebrated.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_VAJRA_000_065: It was an honor to ssserve you, eikon-ssslayer.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_070: We heard about the primal. Excellent work. If you are looking for Arenvald and his unit, they are currently investigating reports of suspicious activity in the area.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_CONRAD_000_075: The hero returns, together with  stalwart comrades-in-arms. Glad to hear you managed to deal with the Ananta's primal before it could cause us any more grief. Gods know we have enough to worry about.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_080: Welcome back! Conrad and Marshal Tarupin came to render aid─but I hear that won't be necessary...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_081: It won't. Sri Lakshmi's gone. Ah, but I should probably start at the beginning...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_082: Incredible. I don't know what to say... If you hadn't been there to stop her, who knows where it would've ended.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_CONRAD_000_083: You've saved a lot of lives, . Take pride in that.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_084: It must be said that this is something of an unprecedented situation. Previous summonings were, to my knowledge, planned well in advance by a tribe as a whole.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_085: Indeed. There are several aspects of this incident which bear further investigation. In any event, the Qalyana's supply of crystals must remain limited for the foreseeable future, and ambient aether levels closely observed.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_086: Understood. The Alliance will consult with the Resistance and the Vira on how best to enforce said restrictions.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_087:
Thank you, Vice Marshal.
To other matters, then. What news of the imperials?
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_088: None─which itself is troubling. It seems as though the Skulls and the remainder of the garrison have fully withdrawn into the Peaks. We've seen neither hide nor hair of them since Velodyna.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_089: Regardless of their reasons, our path is clear. Father has decided that it is time to advance east.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_091: ...He was also most emphatic that you be spared further duties for the present. You are to rest. It would not do for the Warrior of Light to collapse from exhaustion during the march.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_PIPIN_000_092: We may not be as strong or as quick as , but we are soldiers nonetheless. We can deal with the imperials.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_CONRAD_000_093: Aye. You've earned this respite, so enjoy it. And the same goes for you, M'naago. You've been away from your family too long─don't deny it.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_094: ...As you say, sir. Thank you. We'll make the most of our time here.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_095: Much will hinge on whether we can capture or destroy Specula Imperatoris. Though the facility was unassailable from the north, it is very much vulnerable to attack from the south.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_100: I know how you feel. I've never taken kindly to people telling me to rest.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_105: Naago used to tell me stories about her home, but somehow it didn't really register that we'd be up this high...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_110: Heh heh, looks like it's up to me and mine to give you lot a proper welcome.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_111: My mother prepared a special meal for this occasion, and I have it on good authority that hers is the finest cooking this side of the Velodyna!
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MRAHZNUN_000_112: Honored guests, I pray you partake of our humble offerings as we give thanks for your many valiant deeds.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_113: Thank you, sir, for this warm welcome. We are honored to break bread with you and your family.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MHAHTOA_000_114: Come, come, eat your fill of our food, and drink deep of our spirits. There is more than enough for all.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_115: Well, when you put it that way─don't mind if I do!
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_116: She wasn't kidding when she said her mother could cook.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_117: You know, seeing her with her family...I can't help thinking of my own.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_118: How my father would come home from a hunt with dinner on his shoulder, and Yda would prepare it with herbs and spices... Our mother died when I was little, so she did most of the cooking...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_119: We didn't have much, but we had each other. And that was enough for me.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_120: But they wouldn't let us have even that. Theodoric, Gaius... Of course Father and Yda had to fight. I would have too, if I'd been older. But they didn't have to die...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_121: It never ends, does it? They call us beasts...and they treat us like them. They push and they push and they...until someone pushes back. Until someone takes up arms or...or summons a god. A false god.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_122: If the Twelve are watching us, what are they thinking?
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_123: What are they thinking when they see the strong hurt the weak? When people fight and die, and nothing gets better, and it just goes on and on and on...
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_A1_000_001: There is no justice. Just us.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_125: ...I know. That's why we're here, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_126: ...I don't think the gods listen to people like me.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_127: Thanks for listening. I know I was just rambling...but I feel better somehow.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_128: Who knows what the answers are─or if there even are any. Either way, life goes on, and we've got to...go with it. Sorry, that sounded better in my head. I must be getting tired. Time to turn in, I think.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_129: Tomorrow's another day, eh? Let's see what it brings. Sleep well, .
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MNAAGO_000_130: Because I've got other skills! In case you've forgotten, I'm one of the finest hunters this tribe has ever seen! And anyway, I don't remember you being a master culinarian!
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALISAIE_000_135: ...How long has it been since I last saw my father? Maybe Alphinaud and I should plan a trip to Sharlayan. When all of this is over, I mean.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_LYSE_000_140: So if your mother's food is so good, why are you such a terrible cook? Honestly, you've got to get her to teach you the basics while we're here.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MRAHZNUN_000_145: Leaving so soon? Then may you walk with the Warden ever at your side.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_MHAHTOA_000_150: Keep an eye on my daughter, would you? And yourself while you're at it.
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_160: There is something to be said for a home-cooked meal, is there not?
TEXT_STMBDA607_02533_ALPHINAUD_000_161: We must cherish these moments, fleeting as they are. The fight will always be there, waiting for us to return...
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_MNAAGO_000_001: Because I've got other skills! Need I remind you I'm one of the finest hunters this tribe has ever seen? And speak for yourself! I don't remember you being a master culinarian!
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALISAIE_000_005: ...How long has it been since we saw Father? Maybe Alphinaud and I ought to visit Sharlayan.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_LYSE_000_010: So if your mother's food is so good, why are you such a terrible cook? Honestly, you've got to get her to teach you the basics while we're here.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I trust you are well rested and refreshed, yes? Then let us return to the front.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_021: The greater part of the Alliance forces should have advanced into the Peaks by now, but I expect we will pass many of our comrades on the road east.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_022: There is a checkpoint along the way, as I recall, but we will need only to identify ourselves to the soldiers in order to pass.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALLIEDRECRUIT_000_0: Scions! A pleasure to have you with us again.
You'll be happy to hear we've taken Ala Ghiri, and have already begun fortifying it as our new base of operations in the Peaks. Give a shout to the lads as you pass, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALISAIE_000_040: The imperials sure do like their towers, don't they?
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_LYSE_000_045: My village─the one we visited with Meffrid─is far to the north. There's no easy way to get to it from here, though...
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Through the pass and onward to the southeast, was it?
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_RAUBAHN_000_055: Well met, Sci─ Wait, where are the rest of you?
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_PIPIN_000_060: Everything appears to be in order. Very good, very good...
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_CONRAD_000_065: Enjoy your time with M'naago and her kin? Aye, that's what I want to hear. Too many soldiers forget the importance of time away from all this.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: On behalf of the Elder Seedseer, I thank you for your swift and decisive action against the primal menace. We are not unaware of the danger it posed to our fair nation.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_STORMOFFICER_000_07: The imperials underestimated us once, and they paid dearly for it. They may not be so easily deceived next time─but if we cannot fool them, we will simply have to break them!
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_MNAAGO_000_080: As you can see, this part of the Peaks is much higher than the northern reaches, hence why the imperials built Specula Imperatoris where they did.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_MNAAGO_000_081: See those three towers to the east? That's her. Sits right on the edge of a cliff, so attacking from the north is a fool's errand. From the south, on the other hand, she's no different from any other imperial installation.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_MNAAGO_000_082: You see now why Velodyna was so important, eh? Right, then. Come along─they're waiting for us in Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALISAIE_000_090: The settlement is remarkably intact. I see little evidence of fighting...
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_LYSE_000_095: Ala Ghiri's famous for that giant crystal. Some say Rhalgr Himself put it there.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Ala Ghiri was once a hub of trade and commerce, as I recall, hence the need for a large central square.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_MNAAGO_000_110: Here we are. The new base of operations for the Alliance and the Resistance!
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_112: Greetings, General. I see you have been quite busy in our absence.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_RAUBAHN_000_113: Less than you may imagine. The imperials fled at our coming, and we took the village without a fight.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_RAUBAHN_000_114: Your timing is impeccable. We were about to discuss our strategy to seize Specula Imperatoris.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Though we are fresh from the road, we should be glad to attend.
TEXT_STMBDA608_02534_RAUBAHN_000_116: Good. Take a moment to gather yourselves, and join us when you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_001: Hm? Where are the others? I thought all of you were going to attend?
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_PIPIN_000_005: Everything appears to be in order. Very good, very good...
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_CONRAD_000_010: Enjoy your time with M'naago and her kin? Aye, that's what I want to hear. Too many soldiers forget the importance of time away from all this.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: On behalf of the Elder Seedseer, I thank you for your swift and decisive action against the primal menace. We are not unaware of the danger it posed to our fair nation.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_STORMOFFICER_000_02: The imperials underestimated us once, and they paid dearly for it. They may not be so easily deceived next time─but if we cannot fool them, we will simply have to break them!
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALISAIE_000_025: So that's why the village was unharmed...
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_LYSE_000_030: I don't know why the imperials would abandon Ala Ghiri without a fight, but I'm glad they did.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Rather cowardly of them. Uncharacteristically so...
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_MNAAGO_000_040: Well, you heard the Flame General. Looks like we've got a meeting to attend!
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_050: That everyone? Then let us begin.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_051: Ala Ghiri is ours, and for a mercy we took it without losing a single man. But we dare not grow complacent─Specula Imperatoris will not be so easily won.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALPHINAUD_000_052: If I may, General─should we not pause to consider the imperials' motivations? For Zenos to surrender a fortified settlement of strategic importance without so much as firing a shot is...inexplicable.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_053: We searched the village and found no traps or other signs of sabotage. Suspicious though it may be, I will not refuse this gift from our enemy.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_054: The path to Ala Mhigo is through the east─through Specula Imperatoris, and Castrum Abania. It bears repeating, however, that the latter is home to a massive cannon with unparalleled range and destructive power.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_PIPIN_000_055: Which means that we will need to strike Specula Imperatoris quickly, both to limit their ability to locate our forces in the field, and to utilize the installation as a shield against attack, as they would doubtless not risk damaging the towers.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALPHINAUD_000_056: I see... Then we have no choice but to accept what we have been given.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_CONRAD_000_057: Aye, that's the way of it. I've no doubt that Zenos has got something planned, but we'll just have to deal with it when the time comes.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_RAUBAHN_000_058: To the assault, then. The main host will commence a direct assault on Specula Imperatoris. During this time, I would hold the Scions in reserve at Ala Ghiri to deal with any imperial forces that may be dispatched in response.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_LYSE_000_060: Wait a minute! We should be fighting with you and the Resistance!
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_LYSE_000_061: I understand you don't want to rely too much on  after what 's been through, but at least let the rest of us do our part!
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_A1_000_001: If she wants to fight, I say let her fight!
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_A1_000_002: ...Don't do anything too reckless, all right?
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_LYSE_000_063: Thanks. I knew you would understand.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_LYSE_000_064: I won't. I promise I'll do what Conrad says.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALPHINAUD_000_065: ...Mayhap it would be best if I accompanied you. Alisaie can stay with .
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALISAIE_000_066: Oh, go if you must. The two of us can take care of ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALISAIE_000_070: So full of fire and eager, weren't they? Well, I wouldn't worry too much. They're strong and they have each other.
TEXT_STMBDA609_02535_ALISAIE_000_071: At least he spared me the trouble of having to speak up. I wasn't about to let Lyse go alone...
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_001: We have a fair bit of ground to cover, so we should split up. If you come across any imperial soldiers, you know what to do.
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_002: Oh, and so you know─I sent word to Arenvald's squadron. They are already searching other nearby areas, so we have allies in the event we encounter anything beyond our means.
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_200_020:
Say that again, if you would.
...Hmm. No, maintain your distance for now.
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_100_020: ...Understood. Keep me apprised of any developments.
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_021: That was Arenvald. The pair that was spying on us in the Fringes has followed us here...
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_023: ...And there I was thinking we might be due for some peace and quiet. Glad to hear you dealt with them.
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_024: I hope the assault on Specula Imperatoris is going well...
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_025: By the Twelve, did you see that!? The main tower just collapsed!
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_026: You heard it too, didn't you? It must have been the cannon at Castrum Abania. But that was an imperial installation, and their troops were still─
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_027: Dammit, no one's responding! I don't know if the shell is being jammed or...
TEXT_STMBDA610_02536_ALISAIE_000_028: We have to go right now! They need our help!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_001: This way! There's no time to lose!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_SYSTEM_100_020: The locks on the massive gate appear to have been disabled. You need only prise them open to pass through...
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_020:
It's worse than it looks─ H-He probably wasn't even─ Pull yourself together.
The gate. This is our way inside.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_021: We need to find my brother. Right...now.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_025: Damn it! I-I don't see them. My brother or Lyse. Maybe the General knows something.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_RAUBAHN_000_030: I'm glad you're here, . In case it isn't obvious, the imperials fired on us. On Specula Imperatoris.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_RAUBAHN_000_031: I didn't think they had it in them. To kill their own men just to kill us! Gods damn them all!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_032: Where is my brother? Tell me where he is! I want to see him!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_PIPIN_000_033: He was in the tower when it was struck. But that need not mean anything. Our forces are still evacuating, and many remain unaccounted for.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_RAUBAHN_000_034: Alisaie? Alisaie, listen: there are soldiers wounded and dying all around us─soldiers with families, just like you and me. They need our help. Do you understand?
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALISAIE_000_035:
...He's right.
I'll take the north, you take the east.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_RAUBAHN_000_040: Tell the Adders we need their conjurers ready to receive our wounded! And get me every carriage you can find! They could fire on us again at any moment!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_WOUNDEDSERPENTSOLDI: Thank you. I think...I think I can manage on my own...
I'll be fine, really. Just...just give me a moment...
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_WOUNDEDFLAMESOLDIER: For a moment there, I thought I was bound for Thal's great hall. Ye gods, what were the imperials thinking...
I'll go to the carriages once I catch my breath. You needn't worry.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_WOUNDEDSTORMSOLDIER: Just...give me a moment to let the world stop spinning, would you? ...There. Ala Ghiri's not far. I'll make it. I'll make it...
I swore I'd die at sea, and I'm not about to break that promise.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_WOUNDEDISHGARDIANSO: Ugh... Everything hurts. I think I was struck by debris from the tower...
Wait, I know you! ! Ward of House Fortemps!
We fought together on the Steps of Faith. You saved my life back then...and now...
I can walk. Thank you. A thousand times, thank you...
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_LYSE_000_084:
Conrad! Conrad, can you hear me!?
Naago, put him down over there!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALPHINAUD_000_085: ! Full glad am I to see you! Wait─where is my sister?
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_MNAAGO_000_090: O mighty Rhalgr, O noble Azeyma, I beg of You─do not take him from us!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_MNAAGO_000_105: No, no, no! You can't! Not now... <sniffle> <sob>
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALPHINAUD_000_110: We could have killed them. We could have walked away...
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALPHINAUD_000_111: But instead we tried to convince them to lay down their arms. We tried to seek a peaceful resolution.
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALPHINAUD_100_111: We showed them mercy, and this was their response. Fire and blood! This was their answer!
TEXT_STMBDA611_02537_ALPHINAUD_000_112: Such crimes cannot go unpunished. They must not! Gods as my witness, there will be a reckoning!
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_MNAAGO_000_005: No, no, no! You can't! Not now... <sniffle> <sob>
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_020: ...Forgive me. Now is not the time for vows of vengeance. We must remain calm and rational and in control.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_021: The imperials have demonstrated a willingness to fire on their own. So long as we remain here, we are in danger.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_022: We three will see to Commander Kemp's body. Find my sister and return to Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_LYSE_000_025: We'll look after him. You should go.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_035: We will meet you in Ala Ghiri. I pray you find my sister and leave at once.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALISAIE_000_040: There, that should suffice for now. Go on and join the others.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALISAIE_000_041: ...Tell me you've found Alphinaud. Tell me he is all right.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALISAIE_000_042: Oh, thank the Twelve! I don't know what I would have done... Though, saying that, what will the Resistance do without Commander Kemp?
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALISAIE_000_043: Sorry─not here, not now. We should return to Ala Ghiri. Keep an eye out for any wounded who need our help on the way.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_WOUNDEDRESISTANCESO: Oh, oh, bless you, kind─ Wait, is that you, ?
I didn't recognize you at first. Been feeling a bit dizzy. Must've lost a lot of blood. I...I can keep going. I can keep going...
Go on without me, . I'll not be long.
...Thanks, friend. Bloody tourniquet came loose and I was having trouble getting it back on. I should be fine the rest of the way.
I can manage on my own. Reckon you've got more important things to do than watch over a poor sod like me.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_WOUNDEDIMPERIALSOLD: <pant> <pant> ...It wasn't long ago I was trying to kill you and yours. I half expected you were about to slit my throat.
To hells with this. I should be back home in Ilsabard, instead of taking fire from my so-called comrades.
Put me in a gaol or wherever─I'm through with it. Do you hear me? I surrender!
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_WOUNDEDRESISTANCESO: What should we do? We've got plenty of our own wounded to deal with. Say the word and I'll finish him quick!
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_LYSE_000_055: It's up to all of us to carry on in his stead. It's up to me...
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_MNAAGO_000_060: I knew we'd lose people doing this, but him...? I was sure the old bear would outlast us all.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALISAIE_000_065: I did what I could for those I found along the way...but some were beyond help.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_RAUBAHN_000_070: ...No need to say it. I heard.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_PIPIN_000_075: We lost a lot of men inside the tower. Casualties are still mounting among those who survived.
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: The Elder Seedseer has been informed. By the grace of the Matron, mayhap we can yet save more lives...
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_STORMOFFICER_000_08: Whatever “rules of war” can be said to exist, that whoreson has broken them all. This will not stand!
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_090: . We have given over Commander Kemp's remains for safekeeping. Later─I have no idea when─rites must needs be performed...
TEXT_STMBDA612_02538_ALPHINAUD_000_091: For now, however, we must carry on. We must press forward. We must not give in to despair...
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_001: It's up to all of us to carry on in his stead. It's up to me...

TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_STORMOFFICER_000_03: Whatever “rules of war” can be said to exist, that whoreson has broken them all. This will not stand!
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALPHINAUD_000_040: All Alliance and Resistance units have now withdrawn from Specula Imperatoris. It is time we spoke with General Aldynn.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_050: ...These deaths weigh heavy on my soul. Commander Kemp's most of all.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_051: He was a wise leader. He was a patriot. But above all else, he was a good man who will be sorely missed. One of many lost this day. I ask for a moment's silence to pray for the souls of the departed.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_052: We have suffered a grievous defeat. But we can not and will not renounce this cause. The die has been cast.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_053: Hold tight to this grief, this anger, and let it drive you forward. Let it be your strength and your shield when next you face the enemy.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALPHINAUD_000_054: It will carry us far, General. Of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Ere we take another step towards Ala Mhigo, however, we must first address the question of how to deal with Castrum Abania's cannon. If the imperials are willing to employ the weapon without thought for their own soldiers' safety, we may struggle to approach them.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALISAIE_000_056: A frontal assault is out of the question. We'd lose countless men before we even reached the walls.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_PIPIN_000_057: Would we? Recall that the imperials could have obliterated our forces had they kept firing, but neglected to do so.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_PIPIN_100_057: They had no strategic reason to cease fire, which begs the question: why did they?
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALPHINAUD_000_058: ...You suspect they were unable to fire the cannon again. Mayhap due to a malfunction?
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_PIPIN_000_059: Or one of their officers found his conscience after the first barrage. Or a heretofore unknown Resistance faction chose that moment to disable it.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_PIPIN_100_059: There are many possibilities, but the fact remains that they stopped when logic dictated they continue.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_060: Then I'll just have to go and see for myself if the cannon is still operational.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_MNAAGO_000_061: Are you mad? Conrad put you in charge of the Resistance! We can't risk losing another commander so soon!
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_062: I know how you feel, Naago, I do. But I need you to understand...
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_100_062: It wasn't long after Papalymo and I arrived at Rhalgr's Reach that Conrad first asked me to join the Resistance. And then he kept on asking.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_200_062: Every time I said no, I told myself it was because of the Scions. But even then, I knew deep down that it was an excuse. That I was still afraid of following my heart, because I couldn't be sure if it was for me or for Yda.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_063: But then I met someone, on the other side of the world, who had struggled with the same worries. And as we traveled and fought together I saw him grow and become the leader his people needed him to be.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_064: And now it's my turn to do the same.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_100_064: There's not a lot of us left, and of the ones that are, many are still wounded. We have to make do with what we've got, and I'm the best qualified. It's as simple as that. But don't worry, Naago. I'll come back. I promise.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_066: While I acknowledge Commander Hext's right to carry out this mission, I see no reason why she should do so alone. , would you go with her?
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_A1_000_121: Would've done it even if you hadn't asked, sir.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_A1_000_122: I suppose someone's got to keep her out of harm's way...
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_067: Then it is settled. We will await your return.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_MNAAGO_000_070: Conrad confided in me that he was considering naming her as his successor, so it didn't come as a complete shock. I mean, I was still surprised, but I've never once doubted his judgment. None of us have. If he thought Lyse was the best choice, then she is.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALISAIE_000_075: (When did Lyse become leader of the Resistance? That...that is... Hm. I suppose we have Hien to thank for this too.)
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_ALPHINAUD_000_080: I understand M'naago's concern. If they were to lose another leader so soon after losing Conrad, the Resistance might never recover.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_RAUBAHN_000_085: (More than a keeper, she needs a friend now. Stay close to her.)
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_PIPIN_000_090: One can but wonder how the rank and file of the XIIth Legion will view their leadership upon hearing about the fate of Specula Imperatoris.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Grim though it is, the conjurers have had no choice but to impose a rigid triage system when treating the wounded. Under the circumstances, we have to be realistic.
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_STORMOFFICER_000_10: Mark my words: when this is over, I will take the heads of every officer in Castrum Abania. I'll swing the bloody axe myself if I have to!
TEXT_STMBDA613_02539_LYSE_000_111: It may not be the decision Conrad would've made...but I'm not Conrad. I never will be. I don't know what kind of leader he was hoping for, but right now, all I can do is be myself...
