TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_RAUBAHN_000_015: (More than a keeper, she needs a friend now. Stay close to her.)
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_PIPIN_000_020: One can but wonder how the rank and file of the XIIth Legion will view their leadership upon hearing about the fate of Specula Imperatoris.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Grim though it is, the conjurers have had no choice but to impose a rigid triage system when treating the wounded. Under the circumstances, we have to be realistic.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_STORMOFFICER_000_03: Mark my words: when this is over, I will take the heads of every officer in Castrum Abania. I'll swing the bloody axe myself if I have to!
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_ARENVALD_100_030: I still can't believe it. Conrad, and so many others, dead. It's not right, what those bastards did... It's not right.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_VMAHTIA_100_035: You wouldn't believe the two fools we caught skulking about in imperial uniforms. It felt good handing them over to the Alliance...though it all feels pointless now.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_JMOLDVA_100_040: Conrad always treated us with kindness and respect. His death will not go unavenged.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_040: If you don't mind, I'd rather not wait around and have people try to talk me out of it. Let's get moving. I know a good vantage point overlooking the castrum.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_041: Nyunkrepf's Hope─the ship stranded on the rocks to the east of here. It shouldn't take us long to get there. Oh, but there might be some ancient golems guarding it. Or that might just be an old wives' tale. Either way, it's worth the risk.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_MNAAGO_000_043: Lyse...Commander...I pray you proceed with all due caution. Do not hesitate to call upon us if needed.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_044: To reach the ship, we'll have to scale the cliff face. I'll get some climbing gear and meet you there, all right?
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_MNAAGO_100_044: The ship dates back to days of the great flood. The legend goes that it was teleported onto the rocks by magick. No idea if it's true, but I'll be damned if I know how else it could've got up there.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_050: Sorry to keep you waiting! I see you've met the golems. Looks like the old stories were true, eh? In a way, I'm glad...
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_052: <pant> <pant> Whew! That took a bit more out of me than I expected...
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_053: And here she is. Nyunkrepf's Hope. The ark that one man made to save countless others from the flood during the Sixth Umbral Era.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_054: It's comforting to think that there have always been people who cared this much about their fellow man─who accomplished such great feats that people couldn't help thinking they must be made up. But the proof's right here, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_055: I don't just mean the ship, you know. I mean you. Long before anyone started calling you a hero, you were there for those in need. You did things for people when you didn't have to─sometimes even when they didn't want you to.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_056: It can't have been easy, staying true to yourself. But we're all better for it. Me included.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_057: I'll never be a leader like Conrad. Or Hien. Or my father...
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_058: But I can be a friend to you all, and I can fight by your side.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_059: I can be me...and that'll just have to be enough, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_070: Strange to think back on it. If we'd been standing in different places, or if the shell had struck the tower differently, it would've been me instead of Conrad. Or maybe both of us.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_071: What kind of monster murders their own...
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_072: Uh... Is that smoke from Castrum Abania? Wait─it's coming from the cannon!
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_073: I can't tell what happened from here, but I can tell that it won't be giving us any trouble in the immediate future.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_074: This is our chance, ─to avenge Conrad and all the others who died in the tower, friend and foe.
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_075: To take Castrum Abania and bring the bastards who gave the order to fire to justice!
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_076: It won't be easy after the losses we took, but I know everyone's champing at the bit to strike back. With the right plan, I'm certain we can do it!
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_077: We have to tell the others! Come on!
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_060: Easier down than up, eh? Though not necessarily safer...
TEXT_STMBDA614_02540_LYSE_000_061: Anyway, no time to rest! We need to convince the others to strike now, before the imperials have time to fix their cannon.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_MNAAGO_000_001: Conrad confided in me that he was considering naming her as his successor, so it didn't come as a complete shock. I mean, I was still surprised, but I've never once doubted his judgment. None of us have. If he thought Lyse was the best choice, then she is.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALISAIE_000_005: (When did Lyse become leader of the Resistance? That...that is... Hm. I suppose we have Hien to thank for this too.)
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I understand M'naago's concern. If they were to lose another leader so soon after losing Conrad, it would be devastating.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_015: (More than a keeper, she needs a friend now. Stay close to her.)
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_020: One can but wonder how the rank and file of the XIIth Legion will view their leadership upon hearing about the fate of Specula Imperatoris.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Grim though it is, the conjurers have had no choice but to impose a rigid triage system when treating the wounded. Under the circumstances, we have to be realistic.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_STORMOFFICER_000_03: Mark my words: when this is over, I will take the heads of every officer in Castrum Abania. I'll swing the bloody axe myself if I have to!
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ARENVALD_100_030: I still can't believe it. Conrad, and so many others, dead. It's not right, what those bastards did... It's not right.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_VMAHTIA_100_035: You wouldn't believe the two fools we caught skulking about in imperial uniforms. It felt good handing them over to the Alliance...though it all feels pointless now.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_JMOLDVA_100_040: Conrad always treated us with kindness and respect. His death will not go unavenged.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_LYSE_000_040: There's no time to lose, ! General Aldynn needs to know what we saw!
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_MNAAGO_000_045: I'm relieved the two of you made it back in one piece. I mean, I always am, but it's a little different now, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALISAIE_000_050: You look like you've got something important to say...
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Well? Did you learn anything of value?
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_055: So long as the imperials hold Castrum Abania, we will not be able to march on Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_STORMOFFICER_000_06: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_070: You are returned. I only hope you bring good news.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_LYSE_000_071: We scaled the cliffs of Nyunkrepf's Hope and spied smoke rising from Castrum Abania's main cannon.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_LYSE_000_072: I think Marshal Tarupin's right─they didn't fire again because they couldn't. The cannon seems to have been disabled somehow.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Then we must attack Castrum Abania at once!
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_074: Hm. It could still be a trick. But if it isn't, we may not get a better opportunity.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_100_074: Bluntly, General, if it is a trick, it is an utterly baffling stratagem. Had the imperials wished to wipe us out, they could simply have kept firing.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_075: Be that as it may, we need not risk everything to seize it. I say we dispatch a small contingent to infiltrate the castrum and secure control of the weapon.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_076: If the enemy is preoccupied with repairs, we may be able to take them unawares. If, on the other hand, it is indeed a trick, our token force will prove an elusive target─and we will at least know the cannon is operational.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_077: Either way, it seems well worth the risk. But how are we to infiltrate the castrum?
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_078: ...In anticipation of a day such as this, men and women under my command have labored long to cultivate a network of informants throughout Gyr Abania─including Radiata.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_079: Radiata is home to many who hold menial positions at Castrum Abania and other nearby installations. With the aid of our allies there, I believe we can secure a route into the fortress.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_LYSE_000_080: The Resistance will handle this. You may have recruited these informants, but they'll be just as happy working with fellow Ala Mhigans. And at the end of the day, it's our land─our responsibility. Let us do right by Conrad.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_082: I should be glad to accompany her, General─as would Alisaie and , I am sure.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_083: Well then. If you are all in agreement, I see no reason to refuse you.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_084: We will make ready to march on Castrum Abania. Go, and may Rhalgr watch over and keep you.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_RAUBAHN_000_085: Had Alphinaud not volunteered you, I would have asked. If anyone can see this mission through, it's you.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_LYSE_100_085: Thanks for standing by me, . Together, we'll make Conrad proud!
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALISAIE_000_086: ...I suspect a handpicked contingent of the Ala Mhigan Brigade's finest would have been equally, if not more, qualified...but what do I know.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_PIPIN_000_087: Perhaps you recall the night we first met outside the Sil'dihn ruins, under such unfortunate circumstances? I had just returned from a meeting with my Ala Mhigan agents. As I said before, we have been preparing for this day.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_STORMOFFICER_000_08: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_MNAAGO_100_089: Hm! I knew the Alliance had spies in Gyr Abania, but in Radiata? Impressive...
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_090: My apologies for speaking on your behalf. It would seem my sister's forthright manner is rubbing off on me... I confess, my decision to volunteer was not wholly motived by concern for Lyse, nor less Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_091: ...Castrum Abania is the largest imperial facility in the Peaks, you see, and so the likelihood that Krile is being held captive there is quite high...
TEXT_STMBDA615_02541_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Dealing with that cannon remains our main objective, of course, but if there is even a chance that Krile might be rescued in the process, I would never forgive myself if I did not take it.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_MNAAGO_000_001: Hm! I knew the Alliance had spies in Gyr Abania, but in Radiata? Impressive...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALISAIE_000_005: ...I suspect a handpicked contingent of the Ala Mhigan Brigade's finest would have been equally, if not more, qualified...but what do I know.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_PIPIN_000_010: Perhaps you recall the night we first met outside the Sil'dihn ruins, under such unfortunate circumstances? I had just returned from a meeting with my Ala Mhigan agents. As I said before, we have been preparing for this day.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_STORMOFFICER_000_02: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_RAUBAHN_000_025: Had Alphinaud not volunteered you, I would have asked. If anyone can see this mission through, it's you.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ARENVALD_100_030: We'll be fighting with the main host when the time comes to attack Castrum Abania. I swear by everything that is holy─we won't lose!
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_VMAHTIA_100_035: There you go again, getting all worked up...though it could be worse. So long as you don't start saying bollocks like, “I'll never forgive them!” Makes for a terrible battle cry, you know?
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_JMOLDVA_100_040: Many of the J tribe call this place home. I shudder to think what would become of them if we fail.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_LYSE_100_040: Thanks for standing by me, . Together, we'll make Conrad proud!
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_030: So, to review: we are to travel to Radiata, where we will meet with a contact recruited by Marshal Tarupin's agents.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_031: I took the liberty of reviewing intelligence reports while  and Lyse were away, so the settlement is not wholly unfamiliar to me...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_032: As the vice marshal indicated, the vast majority of the populace is employed as menial labor in either Specula Imperatoris or Castrum Abania. Perhaps as a result of this, the Resistance has long struggled to make inroads there.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_MNAAGO_000_033: Aye, you have the right of it. They got a better deal than most Ala Mhigans─feeding off what scraps the imperials gave 'em. Damned if I know how Marshal Tarupin's agents got one of them to turn his coat.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_034: I understand your disdain, I do. But I also understand their desire to look after their families by any means necessary...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Our contact is a Roegadyn woman. She will ask us a question. After we answer with “courage,” she will know us as friends.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_LYSE_000_036:
"Courage.“ Right.
Put together a squadron, Naago. We'll need them soon.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_037: With me, my friends─and be ready for anything.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALISAIE_000_038: Keep an eye out, would you? Something doesn't feel right...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_100_039: If there were magitek armor nearby, surely we would have heard them by now?
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_200_039: See? What did I tell you? Let us continue on to Specula Imperatoris!
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALISAIE_000_040: Whew. That would have been an unceremonious ending to our tale.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Of course there were still soldiers lurking about... Fortunately, they were no match for Lyse. Come─Radiata is not much further.
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Of course, in light of our recent encounter, it would be prudent to proceed with caution and remain vigilant for imperial forces...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALISAIE_000_060: I thought they said this was a village? It looks more like a work camp...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Nary a soldier in sight. Mayhap they were recalled to Castrum Abania...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_LYSE_000_070: Looks like it's safe to enter. I don't see any imperials...
TEXT_STMBDA616_02542_LYSE_000_071: Hmm... I don't see smoke above Castrum Abania anymore. Do you think they fixed the cannon already...?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALISAIE_000_001: I thought they said this was a village? It looks more like a work camp...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Nary a soldier in sight. Mayhap they were recalled to Castrum Abania...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_PIPIN_100_010: Perhaps you recall the night we first met outside the Sil'dihn ruins, under such unfortunate circumstances? I had just returned from a meeting with my Ala Mhigan agents. As I said before, we have been preparing for this day.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STORMOFFICER_100_02: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_RAUBAHN_100_025: Had Alphinaud not volunteered you, I would have asked. If anyone can see this mission through, it's you.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_LYSE_000_010: Alphinaud said we were looking for a Roegadyn woman, right? And that we should answer her question with “courage”?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_LYSE_000_011: I suppose we'll just have to strike up a conversation with every one of them until we find our contact. Let me know if you find her, and I'll do the same.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALISAIE_000_015: Hmm...she has to be around here somewhere...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_020: So as I was saying, about this woman...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_030: ...Ain't seen you around before. Takes a certain kind of  to walk into a place like this uninvited.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_A1_000_001: I will go whither the wild rose blooms.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_A1_000_003: Times are tough, but so am I.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_032: See any roses 'round here? 'Cause I don't. Piss off.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_033: Oh aye? I'll bet you are. Best of luck to you, soldier.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_034: ...Courage, you say? Well, that's in short supply these days. Better to keep your head down and go along to survive.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_035: Call me a coward too, if you like, 'cause I'll not speak on it more─at least not here.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_036: Outside Radiata, behind those barricades over yonder, on the other hand...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_LYSE_000_037: Hey. Was that who I think it was?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_LYSE_000_038: Well, that's a relief─or a trap. Either way, I'll find Alphinaud and Alisaie. We'll meet you there.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_042: That all of you, is it? Let's get to it, then. Name yourselves.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_043: We are the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. Friends of Marshal Tarupin.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_044: (-Stark Woad-)Name's Stark. Stark Woad. The rest you know, or we wouldn't be here.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_045: (-Stark Woad-)This is about Specula Imperatoris and the cannon, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Just so. Can you tell us what happened?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_047: (-Stark Woad-)Aye. I overheard soldiers talking while working in the mess. The ceruleum pipeline fueling the cannon was destroyed by an unidentified male insurgent, they said.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_048: One man single-handedly disabled the cannon? That beggars belief!
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_049: (-Stark Woad-)Nevertheless, that's what they said. It took a while, but they've finally put the fires out, and the engineers have been working day and night to repair it.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_050: (-Stark Woad-)Wish I could tell you more, but the incident had everyone jumping at shadows and afraid to say much more. To make matters worse, the Ala Mhigan help have been sent home indefinitely.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALISAIE_000_051: So the cannon could already be fully operational...
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_LYSE_000_052: We need to sneak inside Castrum Abania to ensure the cannon is no longer a threat to our troops. Can you help us?
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_STARKWOAD_000_053: (-Stark Woad-)Aye, that much I can do. I've pieced together a map of the interior over the years, and I know for a fact that there are multiple points of entry.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_054:
Impressive...
If we split into several groups, that may improve our odds of reaching the fire control center.
TEXT_STMBDA617_02543_ALPHINAUD_000_055: We may be few in number, but I have faith that we can see this through!
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALISAIE_000_001: It's good to see that even this deep within occupied territory, there are still those who would defy their oppressors.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_005: It's thanks to brave men and women like her that we still have a chance to win this war.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_PIPIN_100_010: So long as the imperials hold Castrum Abania, we will not be able to march on Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: We have lost so many men already... If we suffer another defeat like that, this campaign is over.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STORMOFFICER_100_02: We will have our retribution. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_RAUBAHN_100_025: Had Alphinaud not volunteered you, I would have asked. If anyone can see this mission through, it's you.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_100_030: I tell you, some of these Resistance folk can't see the forest for the trees. Ambushing the occasional imperial patrol won't change a damn thing. Infiltrating their castrums and learning their secrets, on the other hand...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_010: We have that for which we came. All that remains is to make our preparations.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Lyse and her unit will make for our primary objective, the fire control center.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_012: At the same time, we will enter the castrum by way of the ventilation ducts, whereupon we will proceed into weapons research and create a diversion.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_013: If all goes to plan, our parties will subsequently converge, and together we will secure the cannon before finally notifying the Alliance that they are clear to attack.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_014: Sounds simple enough. I'll go and brief Naago on the details.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_015: The rest of you come with me. We'll need to deal with the magitek patrols before you can infiltrate the castrum.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_100_020: They should be here any moment...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALISAIE_100_025: Here's hoping there aren't too many for us to handle.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_100_030: Quickly and quietly, so as not to raise the alarum...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALISAIE_000_020: It won't be long before someone realizes their armor is missing. We have to hurry!
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_025: The Alliance is counting on us to deal with that cannon. Failure is not an option.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_026: Almost there, friends. Your point of entry is just around the bend up ahead. The last patrol should be here any moment.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_027: Once you've dealt with them, we'll be clear to advance...assuming they keep to their usual schedule. Might be prudent to stand watch for a moment after, just in case.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_028: Lead the way and deal with the last patrol, if you would. We'll hold here and watch for soldiers coming from the west.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_030: By Rhalgr, I knew you lot were good, but I never expected you to defeat them so swiftly...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_031: is the finest warrior I know, and I should like to think we have learned something from our time in  company... Now─where is the entrance to the ducts?
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_032: Right behind you. I've mapped the branches, so you should have no trouble reaching the hangars or any number of other places.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Understood. Thank you again for your invaluable assistance.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_100_033: As discussed, , we shall infiltrate the castrum and cause as much chaos as possible.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_034: This will draw the imperials away from Lyse and her men, thereby allowing them to safely reach the fire control center.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_STARKWOAD_000_035: If there's nothing else, I'll return to the Resistance forces and show them to their entrance. May Rhalgr guide you to victory!
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_ALPHINAUD_000_036: This is your last chance to make your preparations, . When you and yours are ready, we shall begin.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_060: Well, we did it. Castrum Abania belongs to us now...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_061: Naago and her people took Alisaie to Radiata to receive treatment. Alphinaud tells me she'll make a full recovery...
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_062: I know I should be happy. We won, and with minimal casualties. But somehow...it feels empty.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_LYSE_000_063: We should report to General Aldynn. Krile wasn't here, but who knows, maybe one of Raubahn's men found something which could lead us to her. Can't hurt to ask, anyway.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_RAUBAHN_000_065: Well done! That thrice-damned cannon won't be troubling us again.
TEXT_STMBDA618_02544_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I am told one of your comrades was injured during the operation. If there is aught we can do to help, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I am told one of your comrades was injured during the operation. If there is aught we can do to help, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_LYSE_000_005: ...Maybe we should speak with General Aldynn. Just in case his men learned something about Krile.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_010: , Commander Hext. Fine work you did today.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_011: After Specula Imperatoris, we needed a resounding victory like this. Thanks to you, Rhalgr's star yet burns bright.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_LYSE_000_012: I'm glad, I really am. But you should know that Alisaie was injured in the fighting...
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_013: ...Regrettable, but I am pleased to hear that she will make a full recovery. Fordola's parting words, on the other hand, ring less favorably in my ears.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_014: But if Zenos wishes to invite us to his so-called “royal hunt,” then this bull would fain accept!
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_LYSE_000_016: O-Oh, it's nothing really, just that...we're almost to the end, but we've still got to save Krile and do so much more...
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_017: We'll find her soon enough. Pipin has his best men scouring the castrum's archives as we speak.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_018: ...Listen, Lyse. It will take time for us to fully occupy the castrum and prepare to advance into the Lochs. While we wait, there is something I would like to show you. Both of you.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_019: After all, this may be the last chance we have to catch our breath before the final push.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_021: Then come with me to Radiata. From there we'll need to follow another road south.
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_LYSE_000_035: I don't think I know this village. It's so small...
TEXT_STMBDA619_02545_RAUBAHN_000_040: Even after all these years, it's still the same... Ah, but I'm getting ahead of myself. You deserve a proper welcome.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_100_001: , Lyse─I brought you both here for a reason...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_100_005: I don't think I know this village. It's so small...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: I am told one of your comrades was injured during the operation. If there is aught we can do to help, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_001: "Liberty or death.“ Has it really been twenty years since he wrote those words...?
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_010: Even a blind man could see that Lyse wasn't herself. Not that I don't understand.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_011: To be thrust into a position of authority under such circumstances─to be made responsible for the lives of so many... It isn't easy. And when you see your friend get cut down before your eyes, it only gets harder. I'll wager she thought Alisaie was dead for a moment back there.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_012: 'Tis one thing to risk your life for a cause. But to risk that of another is a burden no soldier is ever truly ready to shoulder.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_013: The fear, the guilt─it weighs on her. And that's good. It will make her a better commander.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_014: But first she needs to learn to carry it. To not let it break her. To remember that some causes are worth fighting for.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_015: "Liberty or death.“ Her father's words gave me strength once. Mayhap they'll do the same for her now.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_016: Right, then. I think I've said enough. The two of you can head back. I mean to stay a bit longer...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_RAUBAHN_000_020: ...Twenty godsforsaken years. <sigh> It didn't have to be like this. We could have walked this road together...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_030: ...I understand. He's been away for a long time, and he probably wants to be alone for a while.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_040: Wait... Am I the only one who feels like I'm being watched?
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_041: I don't know if it's imperials or bandits, but I know there's more than one of them.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_042: Let's split up. You head northwest, and I'll head northeast. Maybe I'm wrong, but I don't think so...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_HIGHLANDER_000_050: Seven hells,  seen us! Sod it─dead's as good as alive to the imperials!
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_060: They attacked you too, didn't they? I...I had no choice...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_061: They're Ala Mhigan─not even conscripts, by the look of them. Barely adults. In fact, some of their faces look familiar...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_062: Wait, I remember. They're from Radiata! They must have seen us when we were looking for Stark!
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_063: They probably thought the imperials would reward them if they captured or killed─
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_064: Oh gods... Alisaie and Alphinaud could be in danger too! We have to get back to Radiata and find Naago!
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_MNAAGO_000_070: What's all this about? You two look ready for a fight.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_071: We were ambushed by villagers outside of Radiata, and thought they might try to attack you too. Are you all right?
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_MNAAGO_000_072: Aye, we're fine. The twins are at Stark's. Alisaie was asleep, last I checked.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_MNAAGO_000_073: I'm sorry, did you say you were ambushed by villagers? Not soldiers? Did they not see what we just did to Castrum Abania? Godsdamned fools!
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_075: The ones that attacked you. They were young? Less than twenty summers?
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_076: Aye, I thought so. It's always the young ones─the ones who have only ever known the occupation. They're the ones you've got to look out for.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_077: See, the only decent work to be found in Radiata is for the imperials, and everyone knows it. Children grow up knowing it. They have it pounded into their skulls that the best they can hope for is to serve an imperial officer.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_MNAAGO_100_077: Bloody fools! After everything they've seen us accomplish! They ought to be begging to fight for the Resistance, not against us!
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_078: They've been living in the shadow of a castrum their whole lives. A few victories won't change that. Aye, you get some who can't wait to spit in a soldier's eye, but they get beaten for their trouble, or worse...
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_079: ...And the ones that don't fight back but refuse to beg, well, they just starve. Beat the dog that bites his master's hand, and ignore the dog that refuses to do his bidding, see?
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_080: In the end, the ones that learn to abide are the ones that survive.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_000_081: Now, you may say that's all about to change, and I believe you. Many here do.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_STARKWOAD_100_081: But a young man or woman who grew up only knowing what he knows has got every reason to doubt. Remember that. Do what you have to, if it comes to it, but remember that.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_ALPHINAUD_000_082: The sooner we liberate Ala Mhigo and bring an end to the occupation, the better. Only then can we show these youths that things do not have to be this way.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_083: ...Only then will they know what it means to live free.
TEXT_STMBDA620_02546_LYSE_000_084: We're going to build a new home for ourselves. Together. A better home than they've ever known.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Alisaie will make a full recovery, but I doubt she will be well enough to take to the field again before this is over.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_STARKWOAD_000_005: I can imagine how you must feel, but I want you to know that many of us here are grateful for what you did at Castrum Abania.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_MNAAGO_000_010: I'll never get used to it, killing my own countrymen. In the heat of battle, it's either you or them, but after...when you've had time to think about what you've done...
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_SERPENTOFFICER_100_: I am told one of your comrades was injured during the operation. If there is aught we can do to help, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_020: I've been thinking. If Alisaie needs more time to heal, maybe we should move her to Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_021: She can receive much better care there, after all. Our infirmary is probably the best place for her, short of sending her to Gridania.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Indeed. And given what Mistress Woad has told us, I would rather she did not remain here.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_023: Then it's settled. Naago, go and see about getting us a carriage and an escort. Alphinaud, you should get your sister ready for the journey.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_024: , would you mind going on ahead and telling Orella that we're on our way? I want a bed waiting for Alisaie when she arrives. Thanks.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_STARKWOAD_000_025: They'll learn what it means to live free. We'll teach them. Together.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_030: Must seem strange seeing me doling out orders. But not half as strange as it feels to do it, let me tell you.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ORELLA_000_041: Very well, we will make ready to receive the patient at once. Give me a hand, would you?
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ORELLA_000_042: There. All crisp and freshly laundered.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_043: We're here. Is everything in order?
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALISAIE_000_045: Honestly, Alphinaud, you needn't have gone to all this trouble...
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_046: What can I say? It seemed a good way to discourage you from limping off to battle when my back was turned. Listen to Orella, please. You need your rest.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALISAIE_000_047:
I know, I know...
Any news of Krile? She'll be cross if you make her wait too long. As will I.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_048: Hah. A chilling prospect indeed... I'll find her, Sister. And I'll fight twice as hard─for the both of us.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_049: They're good together...when they're not at each other's throats. I miss that feeling...
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_050: ─I have a favor to ask. Would you mind waiting outside for me? I won't be a moment.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALPHINAUD_000_055: We'll find Krile and bring her home. After all, I need her to tell you to stay in bed.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_ALISAIE_000_060: I should have been there with you to the end. If only I hadn't been so reckless...
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_080: <pant> <pant> Maybe we got a little carried away... But you have to admit that was fun.
TEXT_STMBDA621_02547_LYSE_000_081: Thank you, . You're the best kind of friend─the kind that's not afraid to knock some sense into you.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALISAIE_000_005: I should have been there with you to the end. If only I hadn't been so reckless...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_000_010: Now that Alisaie's settled in, it's time we rejoined the fight.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_000_011: Though, actually...maybe you and Alphinaud should go on ahead without me. I need to talk strategy with the officers, and that might take a while...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_000_015: This is the first time I've visited Rhalgr's Reach since taking over from Conrad, so we have a few things to discuss. Don't worry─I won't be far behind.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ah, there you are. What was it that Lyse wanted of you?
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Ahahaha! A sparring match on the Destroyer's very palm? I would have liked to have seen that.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_022: But she is right─we have lingered here long enough. I am ready to depart when you are.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALISAIE_000_023: Take care, you two. Don't do anything I wouldn't.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_024: And you had better not rise from that bed until you are given express permission to do so. Urianger will be paying you a visit soon, and he is already worried enough as it is.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_025: We have a long road ahead of us. Lead the way, .
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_040: You are returned! How fares your sister, Alphinaud?
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Her rapier wit remains undulled─for better or for worse. Have there been any developments in our absence?
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_042: I am proud to say that Castrum Abania is now wholly under our control. At present, we are taking stock of the enemy's supplies and redistributing them amongst our men.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_043: Also, while sifting through the officers' documents, we learned that a unit of Skulls under Fordola's command passed through the castrum en route to the capital...with a single prisoner in their custody.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Krile! It has to be her!
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_045: In all likelihood, yes. You will be glad to hear that the tunnel leading to the Lochs has been secured by our soldiers and is now safe for travel.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_046: And one final piece of good news: reinforcements from all four Alliance nations have arrived and joined the main host, which has established a new base of operations within the Lochs.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_PIPIN_000_047: Commander Hext should be arriving soon, yes? When she does, we will call a meeting to discuss the final stage of Rhalgr's Beacon.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_100_047: Sorry for keeping you all waiting!
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_048: An Ala Mhigan folk dress? How very fitting. And well-fitting, I might add.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_000_049: I wanted to do something for Yda. And myself.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_100_049: This is it. The last push. We're coming, Krile...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_LYSE_000_060: Cotter built those walls to give shelter to his brothers and sisters. And now our people's freedom rests on us tearing them down...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_MNAAGO_000_065: Most of the Ala Mhigans in the residential district are Aan, so I doubt we'll have to deal with many imperial sympathizers.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ARENVALD_000_070: The battle for Castrum Abania was brutal, but the one for Ala Mhigo will be unlike any we have ever known...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_VMAHTIA_100_110: The end is in sight. It has been a long time coming...
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_JMOLDVA_100_115: "A storm of blood approaches fast... Hells open, Heavens weep...“
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The stage is set, and the players are assembled. Eorzea has come at last to drive the invaders from her lands.
TEXT_STMBDA701_02548_ALPHINAUD_000_121: What would Grandfather say if he were with us here today...?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_001: Cotter built those walls to give shelter to his brothers and sisters. And now our people's freedom rests on us tearing them down...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_MNAAGO_000_005: Most of the Ala Mhigans in the residential district are Aan, so I doubt we'll have to deal with many imperial sympathizers.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ARENVALD_000_010: The battle for Castrum Abania was brutal, but the one for Ala Mhigo will be unlike any we have ever known...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_VMAHTIA_100_110: The end is in sight. It has been a long time coming...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_JMOLDVA_100_115: "A storm of blood approaches fast... Hells open, Heavens weep...“
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_000_060: For all our other accomplishments, Krile remains in the hands of our enemy, and I find myself wondering if we─if I could have done more. Though we know now that she was taken to the city, we have found nothing which might tell us where she is being held.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_061: You know, you could just ask me.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_063: I shall spare you the particulars of my infiltration and simply state that I have seen her with my own eyes. She is being held within the residential district south of the city proper.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_064: I tracked her to the ruins of an old temple of the Fist of Rhalgr, within which the imperials have constructed a research facility...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_100_064: A research facility? What manner of research?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_065: Why...methods to imbue Garleans with the power to manipulate aether. In pursuit of which goal, their scientists have, I am sorry to report, performed many questionable experiments─on living subjects.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_067: Calm down, Alphinaud. We've already been tasked with securing the Ala Mhigan Quarter. This just gives us a reason to do it faster.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_068: I entered and exited the facility by stowing aboard imperial transports, but that method is not suitable for a larger force.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_100_068: And it goes without saying that a direct assault on the rather substantial main gates would be ill-advised.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_MNAAGO_200_068: I think I might know someone who can help.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_MNAAGO_000_069: One of my men. He had an idea about how to get into the city─ Actually, it might be best if I let him explain it himself.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_070: (-Cynical Youth-)It's been a while. I'll not take offense if you don't remember. Might even be glad of it.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_071: Aye. Wiscar's the name. I was raised in the Peaks, but my mum grew up in the city.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_100_071: Er...anyroad, I reckon we can get inside the Ala Mhigan Quarter by way of Loch Seld.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_072: It was a story my mum told us which made me think of it. She was always going on about what life was like when she was a girl, see...how they used to have to boil the water from the well before they could drink it, since it was full of salt─
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_073: They were drawing saltwater from the lochs! Which means that there must be an underwater tunnel or something.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_074: Aye, that's it. But it won't be as simple as going for a swim.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_075: The well was closed, see. Apparently, Theodoric decided one day he wanted to control the water supply and forbade water trading. So even if you come up through it, you'll find yourself on the wrong side of a locked gate.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_076: At the time, my grandfather, being an enterprising sort, befriended a guard and lifted the key from his belt. He made a copy and carried on selling water until the imperials invaded, and he ended up working at the Saltery...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_077: In short, we need your grandfather's key. Assuming he still has it.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_078: I'm certain he does. And I can take you to him. But it'll be dangerous.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_079: Don't you worry about that. We're used to dangerous.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_080: Naago and Arenvald will assemble a squadron while the rest of us go and get that key.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_085: Had I judged it possible to rescue her myself, I would have. But there were too many guards; too many ways it could have ended badly. I knew at once I would need your help.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_MNAAGO_000_090: Meffrid told me about your time in Ala Gannha─how a certain someone gave you a piece of his mind when you first met. Try not to hold it against him.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ARENVALD_000_095: If there's a chance we can rescue Krile, I want to be involved. I owe her that much.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_105: We couldn't've had more than a few days' training when the imperials attacked the Reach, but I've seen my share of combat since! I may be no hero like you, but I can hold my own against imperial regulars─you'll see!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_110: Let's not waste any more time, then, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_111: My mum said Grandad kept the key with him at all times as a lucky charm. If he hasn't got it, then, well...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_112:
Then we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
Ready, ? We may have to deal with a few imperial patrols, or worse...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_113: This is it. This is the monastery. They have to be around here somewhere...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_114: Watt! Watt! It's me, Wiscar! Your grandson!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WATT_000_115: ...Wiscar? By Rhalgr, is that really you?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WATT_000_116: ...Oh, it's good to see you alive and well, lad! But who are these other ones?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_117: The Resistance, Grandad. My, er...my comrades-in-arms.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WATT_000_118: She told you all about me thumbing my nose at the mad king, did she? Heh. Daft sods never caught me neither...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WATT_000_119: It wasn't much, but it was my way of rebelling against his rule. Glad to see you've got higher aspirations. Here─make our family proud.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_120: I will, I swear! Rhalgr as my witness!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_000_125: The revolutionary spirit runs in the family, I see.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_130: I'll make him proud. I'll make them all proud!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_000_135: We should go. Arenvald and the others are waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WATT_000_140: If I were ten years younger...but I'm not. Look after my grandson.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_150: I was worried when he wasn't at the Saltery. But we found him in the end.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_151: Now that we've got the key, it's time to find that underwater tunnel!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_155: The Saltery's not far. Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_156: We're here, but...this isn't right. Where is everyone?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_000_157: Word of the Alliance's advance has surely reached their ears. Mayhap they sought refuge elsewhere? We should search the buildings for clues.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_160: In the wake of the ambush, you find a diary belonging to a laborer. The last entry makes mention of a plan to take shelter in Sali Monastery...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_161: The barrel appears to have recently been filled with fish packed in salt. Someone was hard at work less than a week ago...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_162: The crumbling masonry appears to have lain undisturbed for some time...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_163: The pot is filled to the brim with salt from the lochs...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_164: The lumber appears to have lain undisturbed for some time...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_SYSTEM_000_165: The magitek device suddenly springs to life, flashing brightly and emitting a shrill sound. It's a trap!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: All right, which one of you triggered the obvious trap!?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: On your guard! Magitek drones approaching!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Mayhap...half a dozen? ─keep Wiscar alive, would you?
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_BATTLETALK_A: Seven hells! I could do with some help here!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Now then, where were we? Ah, yes, looking for clues as to the whereabouts of our erstwhile water merchant and his key...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_166: Sali Monastery! That's to the south. I'll lead the way!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_167: Not after that ambush you won't! It's too dangerous! , we'll follow you. Keep your eyes peeled for more magitek!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_BATTLETALK_N: The monastery is just past that gate. Keep going!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Hm. Something tall, dark and imperial appears to be blocking the entrance.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_000_168: Godsdammit! I don't think there's a way round...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_169: Then we'll just have to go through him!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Look! I think those two devices are shield generators!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: I will keep the machine occupied. , be a  and destroy the generators before it rips my head off.
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: 'Tis done! See how it falters! Belabor the brute!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_LYSE_000_170: He won't be getting up after that! Now, let's find our man!
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Ugh, that will leave a mark...
TEXT_STMBDA702_02549_WISCAR_BATTLETALK_D: Just when I was getting the hang of it...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_001: The revolutionary spirit runs in the family, I see.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_WISCAR_000_005: I'll make him proud. I'll make them all proud!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_010: We should go. Arenvald and the others are waiting.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_WATT_000_015: If I were ten years younger...but I'm not. Look after my grandson.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_020: We'll need to dive into the lochs and look for a tunnel leading beneath the residential district. That should be no problem for  and me, thanks to the Kojin's blessing, but for the rest of you...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_021: I will have you know that I can hold my breath for ten minutes!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_022: ...Hm. I think it best that I support M'naago and Arenvald's unit.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I am aware of that, thank you! But it is neither here nor there, given that I lack both the Kojin's blessing and Thancred's preternatural lung capacity!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_025: Right, right. Of course. I didn't mean anything by it. Nothing at all.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_100_025: So─, Thancred, and me. Let's head to the water's edge.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_026: Alphinaud and Wiscar can rejoin the others and wait outside the gates for us to let them in.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_030: You would be surprised what skills an urchin can pick up in a city of pirates.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_031: A knack for selling fine leather waistcoats being one...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_040: This looks like as good a place as any...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_041: Ere you dive into the briny deep─
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_042: Urianger! What are you doing here?
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_043: Master Alphinaud informed me of your plan, and thus did I hasten to your side.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_044: When Mistress Alisaie unfolded to me the tale of her defeat, I was much intrigued by the apparent ease with which Fordola, a theretofore unexceptional warrior, defied my lady's every attempt to do her harm.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_045: After some few days of deliberation, I subsequently contrived what I believe to be a solution to the problem of her preternatural prescience. 'Twas in hopes of furnishing you with the fruits of my labors that I came.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_047: Her aetheric siphon formed the basis for my design.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_048: Should my hypothesis prove correct, you need but activate it in her presence. To say more would endanger the plan, for ignorance is your shield.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_URIANGER_000_049:
It was...Moenbryda's time. It is not yours, my friends.
May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal...and return.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_050: We will─for you and for her.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_051: Right! I'm going in. Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_060:
The tunnel leads east. Thancred's already gone ahead.
Let's not keep him waiting!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_065: That tunnel was much longer than anticipated. I would rather not make the trip again, if it's all the same to you.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_071: Yes, yes. Tremendous fun. Who needs a beastman's blessing anyway?
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_072: I still can't believe you managed to hold your breath the entire time. It felt like we were down there for hours!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_073: Anyway, it's time we let our friends in.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_074: Once we head up these stairs, we'll need to make our way to the main gates, which are...somewhere to the west of here?
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_075: Forgive me for stating the obvious, but it bears repeating that until we open the gates, we three are on our own. 'Twould be in our best interest to avoid guards and easily startled smallfolk.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_076: Obviously. But once our guests have arrived, we'll be free to head towards the research facility where Krile's being held as loudly as we like.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_100_076: Since you've been here before, will you lead the way?
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_077: Of course. But I will move quickly, so see that you do not fall behind.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_LYSE_000_078: Nothing left to say, then. Let's get to it!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_THANCRED_000_080: Saved once more by Urianger's ingenuity. I look forward to learning why it was so imperative that we remain ignorant of the device's precise function.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_KRILE_000_085: They used medicines to keep me in a torpor for much of the time. I...fear I am still recovering from their effects. But I will be fine. I will.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_MNAAGO_000_090: Can you believe it? Not only did we secure the residential district, but we captured Fordola! Wait till the Flame General hears about this!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_WISCAR_000_091: <pant> <pant> Looks like it wasn't my day to die. I owe you one, Meffrid...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_100: What a relief to have finally found her! Though our greatest challenge yet lies ahead of us, on the eve of this final battle, I find myself overcome with joy...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_101: We could not have saved her without everyone's help. Thancred, Lyse, Urianger─and of course, you.
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_ALPHINAUD_000_102: But yes, there is still much and more to be done. I should be very interested to learn the meaning of Fordola's ominous words, for one...
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_FORDOLA_900_010: I reckoned you lot would come, but I didn't think you'd have the nerve to break the bloody doors down! Makes no difference to me, though─time to die!
TEXT_STMBDA703_02550_SYSTEM_900_011: Use the Aetheric Siphon to weaken Fordola, and defeat her in battle!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_THANCRED_000_001: Saved once more by Urianger's ingenuity. I look forward to learning why it was so imperative that we remain ignorant of the device's precise function.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KRILE_000_005: They used medicines to keep me in a torpor for much of the time. I...fear I am still recovering from their effects. But I will be fine. I will.

TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_WISCAR_000_011: <pant> <pant> Looks like it wasn't my day to die. I owe you one, Meffrid...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Lyse has gone to deliver Fordola into the custody of the Alliance, leaving M'naago and her men to hold the residential district and stand ready.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Once the Alliance has breached the main gates and commenced their assault, the Resistance forces will push through the entrance here and join the fray.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_THANCRED_000_022: In that case, I will remain here. My search for Krile took me into the city proper, and my familiarity with their defenses may prove useful to the Resistance.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Understood. I shall instruct Arenvald and his unit to render support as well.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_024: They were tasked with securing the aetheryte, as I recall. With me, .
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_THANCRED_000_025: Brave though they may be, these freedom fighters will need every advantage if they are to defeat their oppressors. I will do what I can to tip the odds in their favor.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KRILE_000_030: I didn't know what had become of Arenvald and the others after I was taken. It's such a relief to see them hale and healthy.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_035: This aetheryte is perhaps the most strategically important landmark here, as it can serve as a gateway for attuned troops with sufficient anima. Such tactics are not without their risks, however...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Were the imperials to discover that the aetheryte was being used in such a fashion, they might turn their artillery upon us─destroying the beacon and the better part of the district, at the cost of countless civilian lives...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_WISCAR_000_046: Don't you worry─I'm under no illusions. I was lucky to survive back there. I'll have to work harder and train longer if I'm going to stay alive.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ARENVALD_000_050: Gods, Krile... It's so good to see you. I feared the worst...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KRILE_000_051: It wasn't your fault. You saved me─all of you. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_052: We will be departing shortly for Porta Praetoria to rejoin the main host.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Arenvald, I would have your unit remain here with Thancred, that you might support the Resistance troops in the coming battle.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ARENVALD_000_054: Understood! We won't let you down.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_055: ...I trust you will refrain from doing anything I would not. We are both far too young to die.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ARENVALD_000_056: Right, right─no noble sacrifices! Got it!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ARENVALD_000_060: Thank the Twelve she's all right. I don't know what I would have done...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_STORMOFFICER_000_07: Well done securing the residential district! Ala Mhigo is nearly ours!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: The Matron smiles upon us this day with the safe return of you and your captured comrade. Such tidings are sure to raise the men's spirits.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_VMAHTIA_000_076: Krile is safe, and the Ala Mhigan Quarter secure. We could not have hoped for a better outcome.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_JMOLDVA_000_077: It is far, far too early to celebrate. Zenos is not finished with us yet.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_URIANGER_000_080: I prithee proceed with the utmost caution, . If there be truth in Fordola's words, and the viceroy is indeed possessed of a power “echoing that of the eikons,” then still greater strength shall be required to bring about his defeat.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_085: As I said, there is but one path forward. We take Ala Mhigo, and with it, Zenos's head.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_STORMOFFICER_000_09: Heh heh, I can't wait to see Marshal Slafyrsyn in action! His Maelstrike is the stuff of legends!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I must admit, my Lominsan counterpart's enthusiasm is...infectious. I find that I too am eager to see this so-called “Maelstrike” firsthand.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_100: If I may, General─is there aught  and I can do to assist with final preparations?
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_101: I'm glad you asked. Pipin informed me moments ago that all forces are in position and that we are ready to commence the assault.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_102: Naught remains but to notify the Alliance commanders. If you've no objections, I should be glad to have you do the honors, .
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_103: You were instrumental to the success of Operation Archon. You helped bring an end to the Dragonsong War. You are a hero to the people and a symbol of hope.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_104: Some might judge it an empty gesture, or worse a waste of your talents, but I know it would mean much to everyone here.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_105: 'Tis one thing to hear the tales, another to look upon the . Now is the time to remind our comrades that they are not alone.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_110: The General makes a good point. The Warrior of Light's worth may be measured not only by what  does, but by what  inspires others to do.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KANESENNA_000_120: All is ready? Very well. Though many will fall in the coming battle, how many more shall know liberty for their sacrifice.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KANESENNA_000_121: There is a time for peace, and a time for war. Even the Matron understands this. We who have received of Hers and the elementals' blessings go now to stand for Eorzea and her children.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_BODYGUARD01623_000_: The Elder Seedseer saw fit to grant me mercy at Carteneau. Perhaps, if the opportunity allows, we may offer the same to my former comrades...but if not, then so be it.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_KANESENNA_000_126: Matron forgive us for what we must do.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_MERLWYB_000_130: It's time, then. Though this is not my theater of choice, we will play our part. Our cannons care not either way.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_MERLWYB_000_131: That battery has sunk enough ships to fill a fleet. 'Tis not like to be bested by a gate.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: 'Tis rare these days that I am granted leave to take the field. Mayhap I should have brought my mask...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_MERLWYB_000_136: They are fine gates, no doubt. And they will make fine slag.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_AYMERIC_000_140: Hah! That you should be the one to bring me word. By the Fury, it is good to see you, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_AYMERIC_000_141: You, who stood with us in our direst hour, will ever be an inspiration to my countrymen─and to me. Though Ishgard's debt can never be repaid, it is my hope that our deeds this day shall go some small way to redressing the balance.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_LUCIA_000_145: Zenos has never cared a whit for politics. He lives for war and war alone. Kill him, or he will kill you.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_AYMERIC_000_146: Several times you defended our gates. Let us return the favor by demolishing theirs.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_150: It is done, then? Thank you, ...for humoring an old bull.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_STORMOFFICER_000_15: Maelstrom, Adder, and Ishgardian forces are in position, General!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Resistance forces in the Ala Mhigan Quarter are ready and await our signal.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_RAUBAHN_000_153: Naught left to do but the deed itself.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_ALPHINAUD_000_155: I have asked Urianger to look after Krile. He will keep her out of harm's way. Though, after what she has endured, her physical well-being may be the least of our worries...
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_URIANGER_000_160: Worry not for her safety. Look thee to the east.
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_STORMOFFICER_000_16: Hah hah! Till sea swallows all!
TEXT_STMBDA704_02551_SERPENTOFFICER_000_:
We have done all we can to prepare.
For serenity, purity, sanctity.
For serenity, purity, sanctity...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I have asked Urianger to look after Krile. He will keep her out of harm's way. Though, after what she has endured, her physical well-being may be the least of our worries...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_URIANGER_000_015: Worry not for her safety. Look thee to the east.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_020: Right, then. I must go to my men. I shall be leading the first charge through the breach.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Then we shall head to the front.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_022: Pipin has command of our artillery outside the gate. He'll not be hard to find.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_023: Ah, but before you go, I have a final favor to ask.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_024: Give this to my son. He will understand.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_025: There's no need for explanations. When he sees it, he will know.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_030: 'Twould seem our position here is secure...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_040: , Alphinaud. Hm? What is that you've got there?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_041: By the Twelve, this is...this is Tizona!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_042: The Bull of Ala Mhigo's legendary sword, forged from two cursed blades...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_043: This sword is a symbol of everything my father fought to achieve. A weapon claimed on the bloodsands, and with it fortune and glory. Its flames consume the unworthy, but by fire was he reborn.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_044:
That he should bequeath it to me now...to carry on his legacy...
Well, I shall endeavor to deserve it. But I'll be damned if this is his final battle!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_050: Once we begin, there will be no respite until it's over. Are you ready, my friends?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_051: Very well. Brace yourselves. This should be quite a specta─
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_FLAMEHERALD_000_052: Vice Marshal! Vice Marshal! Imperial unit approaching from the north!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_053: Aiming to destroy our artillery, are they? How many?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_FLAMEHERALD_000_054: Total numbers unconfirmed. At least one squadron. But sir─they're wolfmen!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_055: Ferae Domitae. Bloody hells, that's all we need. Call up the Bloodsworn. Tell them to make ready─
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_057: These “wolfmen” of whom you speak hail from Doma. They were coerced into fighting for the Empire─spirited away to a foreign land and told that if they disobeyed, the lives of their kin would be forfeit.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_058: But their homeland has been liberated. They have no reason to continue serving their imperial masters!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_059: Ere you engage them in battle, I beseech you: grant us a moment to go and attempt to convince them to lay down their arms!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_060: I am loath to gift our enemy more time to prepare...but if there is a chance that this conflict might be avoided, I suppose we must take it. Go then─but be quick.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_065: I dream of a day when people accept my words as truth without demanding that I prove them through feats of strength. But come, we must away.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_100_065: Our scouts report that the wolfmen are advancing on our position from the north of the city. Convince them to retreat, or we will have no choice but to engage.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_066: We will wait here for the Lupin to arrive. Steel yourself, my friend. Though I hope to resolve this without resorting to violence, it would seem wise to prepare for the worst...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_112: Honorable warriors of Doma! My name is Alphinaud Leveilleur, and I come before you with news of great import─
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_100_112: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)Silence, boy! You stand upon a battlefield. Begone, or be cut down!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_113: Doma is free! Lord Hien has returned and driven Yotsuyu and the imperials from your lands! We were there─we helped him! There is no need for you to fight for Zenos!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_114: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)Lord Hien is dead, and you are a liar! What could a boy such as you do against magitek? Throw stones and spit curses!?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_100_114: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)Invoke my lord's name again at your peril. We will suffer no falsehoods!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_200_114: I speak only the truth! Put up your weapons, I beg of you! Let us speak as friends and not shed blood in vain!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_300_114: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)If your claims were true, we would gladly sheathe our blades and embrace as brothers.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_115: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)But since they must surely be false, we would be traitors to accept! Our lives and those of our loved ones, forfeit!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_116: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)Words are air! You will prove the truth of your tale on the battlefield, or die in dishonor!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_117: (-Ferae Domitae Centurion-)You are no strangers to battle, that much is plain...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_118: I am the White. I am Hakuro! And I will be your opponent! Have at you!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_070: You fought with honor and restraint. You could have killed my men, and perhaps even me...but you did not. For this, I thank you.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_071: Warriors brave and true. I pray you tell us of the battle for Doma's liberation.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_072: We should be glad to do so...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_073: ...Lord Hien, returned! Such joy this news brings us.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_074: But for Lord Gosetsu to perish in the keep's collapse...to be taken from us by such treachery... There is no justice...
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_A1_000_076: Eyes forward, Hakuro. He wished for no better death.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_078: You knew him well. Aye, he would not suffer us to mourn with so much undone. And so we will not. Duty comes before all.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_000_079: But I knew the man, and he would not suffer us to mourn on the eve of this great battle. Duty comes before all.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_100_079: All Lupin shall know of Doma's liberation, and of your part in it.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_200_079: When you breach the gates, we shall turn on the imperials as one. With fang and claw shall we rip open the throats of our masters. This the White swears.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_300_079: Thank you. When our war is ended, I am certain that your lord will help us to return you all to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_400_079: Such a curious thing, destiny, to see us meet with friends of Lord Hien in this distant corner of the world. But we shall not keep you─your day is not yet done.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_500_079: Come, let us not keep our comrades waiting. We have a nation to liberate!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_PIPIN_000_090: Impeccable timing, those Domans! Come, comrades! The enemy's gate is down! Forward!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_000_095: You do not think he would actually wait until the last... No, no. Of course not. He's no Vidofnir.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_AYMERIC_000_100: By the Fury... Did that man just bring down flying armor with a single stroke in midair?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_LUCIA_000_105: The vice marshal's strategy for breaching the gates was most ingenious. A pity he did not account for the magitek armor─but to be fair, they did not account for the Domans either.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_RAUBAHN_000_106: In entrusting Pipin with Tizona, I've entrusted him with command of the Flames. This time I fight not as a general, but simply a soldier.
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_WOLFMAN_BATTLETALK_: If you die this day, then we shall know you for liars!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Truly...? Must we fight to prove that we need not fight!?
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_BATTLETALK_1: Until I am satisfied, we shall fight on! Give me your all!
TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: On your guard! His strength far exceeds that of his brethren!

TEXT_STMBDA705_02552_HAKURO_BATTLETALK_1: Enough. You are every bit the warriors you claim to be.

TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_PIPIN_000_021: , Alphinaud. May I ask you to be part of the first charge?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_104_021: I will join them, as but another soldier.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_114_021: The command of the Flames, I leave in your capable hands, Pipin.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_101_021: I don't suppose we could come along too?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_103_021: Naago and the others told me to go with you, . To bring Zenos to account, for everyone.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ARENVALD_105_021: I'm Ala Mhigan too, in case anyone's forgotten. My place is in the thick of it, and it doesn't get thicker than where you'll be.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_106_021: Let us sally forth, then! Together, we make for the Royal Palace, there to find and strike down Zenos!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_PIPIN_000_023: As we fight our way through the city, the Flames will also aim to reach Zenos. Godsspeed, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Not only the General, but Lyse and Arenvald besides... This mission means everything to our friends─we must not let them down.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_AYMERIC_000_030: The battle is joined! Give the order to advance!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_FLAMERECRUIT_000_04: What in the seven hells are you doing down here!? Bah─no matter! Come with me! You're needed at the Royal Menagerie!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ELIDIBUS_900_002: (-???-)My condolences for your loss. A father should not outlive his son.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ELIDIBUS_900_004: You do not mourn his loss? ...You surprise me, Your Radiance. He was your son and heir...and an irreplaceable test subject.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_VARIS_900_005: I know what he was. Monsters are not made for thrones.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_VARIS_900_006: Nor are stars made to sustain false gods who sup on their very essence. Eikons summoned by desperate savages who hearken to the whispers of shadowless charlatans.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ELIDIBUS_900_007: Should you raise a hand against my black-robed brethren, I will not stop you. Our desires are one and the same. Preservation. Restoration.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_VARIS_900_008: Compression. Resurrection. All is in service to your “one true god.” And when the sundered shards are made whole, will there be a place for us mere mortals?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ELIDIBUS_900_009: Doubt my claims and question my motives if you will, Your Radiance. You will come to trust me in time. Until then, mayhap you will find this...reassuring.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_080: We did it. We liberated Ala Mhigo. I don't know what to say... I don't even know how to feel about it all...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_081: Relief, I suppose. Pride...and hope, too. We did it, Father. Yda. Papalymo. Conrad, Meffrid... Minfilia... We really did it...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_082: Hey, don't feel like you have to stand here listening to me mumble. Everyone else will want to talk to you.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_083: You beat him, after all. You're the real hero of this story. So run along and take your plaudits!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_085: Go and talk to the others! I'm not going anywhere.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ARENVALD_000_120: A'aba, Aulie... I wish you were here to see it...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_JMOLDVA_000_125: I did not know how or when, but I knew in my heart that I would return here one day. Here's to the ones that didn't.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_VMAHTIA_000_130: I know it's different for him and the other Ala Mhigans. For us, it's a great victory, but for them, it's a homecoming.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_WISCAR_000_135: We did it! We bloody well did it! I have to send word to Ala Gannha─ No! I have to go and tell them myself!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HAKURO_000_140: When I awoke this morning, I thought Lord Hien dead. And then he lived. And now he is here. It has been a wonderful day.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_THANCRED_000_145: Minfilia...no. Ascilia, Warburton─it will never be enough, I know, but I hope...I hope this makes up for it, if only a little. I hope this brings you both joy. You deserve it, and so much more...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_URIANGER_000_150: Our convalescing comrades have been informed of our victory. Thou mayest be assured that there was much rejoicing.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HIEN_000_155: It feels like only yesterday that we were celebrating the liberation of Doma, and now look where we are! A thousand malms apart our nations may be, but in spirit we are one and the same.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_000_160: The hero of the hour! I suppose we'll have to add “liberator” to your titles.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_000_161: With their commander fallen, the remainder of the XIIth chose to surrender to our forces. After twenty long years, it's official: the occupation is ended.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_000_162: But now the hard work starts. Though the people have had their fill of kings, there is no clear consensus on what sort of government they would prefer instead.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_PIPIN_000_163: Indeed, Father. Momentous as this achievement may be, the road which lies before us is no less uncertain than the one we have walked.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_000_164: Aye, aye. Yet if we can overcome two decades of oppression, I've no doubt we can find a way forward. Thank you, , for helping to make this dream a reality.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_RAUBAHN_000_165: I expect many of the Ala Mhigan refugees in Ul'dah will have to decide whether or not to return home...or to remain in their new one.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_170: After all we have been through, I really should know better than to worry, but─as ever─the relief I felt upon finding you hale and whole in the Royal Menagerie well-nigh reduced me to tears...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_171: "The Warrior of Light,“ victorious again... Hm. I should be surprised if some small part of you had not come to resent the title and the responsibilities which accompany it. You must forgive us if we call you ”hero“ when you accomplish heroic feats...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_172: But as the Warrior of Light goes, so goes the world. You should take pride in the good you have done, and in the good you have inspired others to do.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_THANCRED_000_173: You are a natural-born leader of men, . All these people weren't just following their commanders─they were following you.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_174: And you led them to victory. To freedom! ...Alas, not everyone could see the journey through to its end. But history shall remember them, and the glorious future they made possible.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_ALPHINAUD_000_175: Alisaie will surely regret that she was unable to join us for this battle. I, meanwhile, will not.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_180:
Can you believe it? We won! We beat the bastards!
Ala Mhigo! Ala Mhigo!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_181: Heh heh... Sorry, got a bit carried away there, didn't I? It's hard not to, you know?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_182: We owe it to the friends we buried to shout and scream and cheer with all our hearts. I want them to know it wasn't for nothing─that it's finally over, and they can rest in peace.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_183: You...you hear that lads? <sniffle> We'll be all right! We'll...we'll be... <sniffle> Oh bugger, not again...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_184: I'm so...I'm so bleedin' happy, I could cry! <sniffle>
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_MNAAGO_000_185: Sorry, sorry. <sniffle> Must be something in my eye. <sniffle> Or both eyes. Seven hells...
