TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_YUGIRI_000_190: For you to best Zenos, even after he had harnessed the power of a primal, is a testament to your ever-growing strength.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HIEN_000_191: Not bitter to have had your vengeance stolen from you by another?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_YUGIRI_000_192: There is some small regret, perhaps, but that is outweighed by the satisfaction I find in his death. I commend you, .
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HIEN_000_193: As should we all. Zenos was a monster and a tyrant─the man who killed my father and countless other of my countrymen. The world is a better place without him in it.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HIEN_000_194: I should also praise Master Alphinaud for his foresight and restraint. Had he not intervened, I might never have had the pleasure of being reunited with Hakuro and his Lupin brothers!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_HAKURO_000_195: 'Twas a timely intervention, aye. Full glad am I not to have been burdened with the guilt of killing my lord Hien's most trusted allies.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_YUGIRI_000_200: Lord Hien must needs return to Doma with all due haste, but I have yet to decide if I will accompany him. I should like to visit my people in Revenant's Toll, for one...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_210: Finished your rounds? Great. In that case, I'd like you to come with me. Back to Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_211: Not for a rematch or anything, sadly. I want to call all the Scions together. I'll explain later.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_LYSE_000_215: I...I don't even know where to begin...
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_CID_900_020: ...Hm. This is indeed the work of either Shinryu or Omega.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_CID_900_021: ...And since there is undeniably something down there radiating a massive amount of energy...which cannot very well be the late viceroy's lapdragon... Yes, I think we have our suspect.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_CID_900_022: Well. This is a mess of our own making, so it falls to us to clean it up. It won't be easy...but is it ever?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_JESSIE_900_023: And now comes the part where you say you've got no choice but to divert company resources and employees to this pet project of yours. Lost profits and belligerent clients be damned.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_CID_900_024: I...er... Financial considerations notwithstanding, you have to admit there is an unquantifiable benefit in giving our people the opportunity to study such advanced technology─
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_JESSIE_900_025: Oh? Is that before or after you blow it up or seal it away? Fine, fine─but the moment I judge this little venture an unsustainable risk to the Ironworks, I'm ending it, savvy?
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_JESSIE_900_026: And to keep you honest, using my authority as deputy president, I've gone ahead and brought in a consultant─a master engineer and mechanical genius!
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_NERO_900_028: (-???-)Come now, you mustn't build their expectations too high! It will be less dramatic when I surpass them.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_CID_900_029: Oh. Oh no. Absolutely not. This is not happening.
TEXT_STMBDA706_02553_NERO_900_030: Nero tol Scaeva, eager to begin his first day as a loyal member of the Ironworks team! Looking forward to working with you, Garlond!
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_LYSE_000_000: So, um, what kind of place is the Azim Steppe?
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_ALPHINAUD_000_005: A pity we have no time to speak at length, but there is no rest for the righteous. Godsspeed!
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_ALISAIE_000_010: We both have long roads ahead of us. Good luck to us both, eh?
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_GOSETSU_000_015: I should not be surprised that he sought refuge in the Steppe. We were separated during a skirmish in the northern mountains...
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_020: If all are ready, let us depart for Reunion in the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_021: Our route will be somewhat circuitous. We will need to return to the Ruby Sea and head north along the coast, past Isari...
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_030: From here we will turn north until we arrive at a cave, through which we must pass in order to reach the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_031: Lyse and Gosetsu have already gone on ahead. We should carry on as well.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_LYSE_000_040: The people of Isari seem to be doing well. That's a relief...
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_GOSETSU_000_045: Ah, there you are! This is the cave. After you, !
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_LYSE_000_050: It's very...flat. Except where it's not, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_GOSETSU_000_055: Othard is vast and filled with many different peoples. I know next to nothing about the Xaela and their ways─but we shall learn together, shall we not?
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_060: I give you the Azim Steppe, . Though I should say that this is but one small portion of it.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_061: Despite the close proximity, Domans rarely venture this far north. Most find these lands and their people strange and foreign...
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_062: Fortunately, those who frequent Reunion are more welcoming than most. Come─it is not much further.
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_LYSE_000_070: Is it just me, or is everyone here Xaela?
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_GOSETSU_000_075: I must confess that this is my first time on the Steppe...
TEXT_STMBDA324_02630_YUGIRI_000_080: Welcome to Reunion, my friends. Here is where we will begin our search for Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_000: I-I-I beg your pardon? The  who bested Gaius van Baelsar wishes to offer me  assistance!?
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_001: I say, this is highly irregular...though I have heard it said you had a penchant for aiding the common man. In which case...
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_002: Before the occupation I was a humble historian. While my duties leave me scarce time for aught else, I think it important that these momentous events be recorded for the benefit of future generations.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_003: Primary sources are indispensable, and I had a mind to question a number of my fellow freedom fighters─ask them their motivations for taking up this cause and so forth.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_004: You may take down their statements in this log. And......thank you for your service. Now and ever after.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_005: It matters not what their reasons are, only that they are honest and forthright. This is for posterity's sake, after all.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_HROTMAR_000_010: Why'd I join the Resistance? Well, if you must know...it was to avenge a friend the imperials butchered before my very eyes, back in Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_HROTMAR_000_011: We owned a stall in the markets, and a passing soldier snatched up a piece of fruit. He spoke out before I could stop him, only to get a fulm of steel in the gut for his troubles. I found my way here, and that was that.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_ORELLA_000_012: Why? Why indeed... To save lives, perhaps. Or to make amends for the ones I couldn't.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_ORELLA_000_013: My father and my brothers were worked to death while building a castrum. What did it matter to the Garleans, eh? More where that lot came from. After that, I couldn't keep on doing nothing.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_HUGHOC_000_014: Hm? Aren't you the eikon-slayer? Damned if I know why you'd bother asking someone like me why I joined the Resistance, but it's simple: if I wasn't fighting for Ala Mhigo, I'd be fighting for the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_HUGHOC_000_015: You're either with 'em or not, and if you're with 'em, you may as well make the most of it. Food, training, citizenship if you live long enough. You'll die stealing someone else's land, like as not, but that's the choice. But me? I'd rather die here.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_AHELISSA_000_016: I was just a cook before all this. Simple fare, really. Had a chance to lend a hand and help feed some refugees one day...
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_AHELISSA_000_017: I took a liking to the fighters. They...believed, you know? And there's always a need for cooks─or at least people who can work with whatever the foraging parties turn up...
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_030: Well met, . Have you spoken with the freedom fighters as I asked?
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_031: Hmm... As fascinating as they are varied... You have a knack for convincing others to bare their hearts to you. I could not have done better myself.
TEXT_STMBDZ001_02635_BEVES_000_032: Many years from now, when these tempestuous times pass into memory, their accounts will serve as a window into the struggle. We must never forget, my friend. Never.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_000: You want to help, do you? Hmm... Seeing as how I'm in no position to leave the stewpot unattended, could you go and ask Tebbe for a variety of herbs? Six sprigs or so of whatever he's got on hand should suffice.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_001: It's not as haphazard as it may seem. Depending on the recipe, it doesn't really matter what sort you add, so long as you add something. I'll be here when you get back.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_002: If you'd rather not, it's just as well. I can assure you that the folks around here will eat it regardless.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_TEBBE_000_010: Herbs, is it? Six sprigs of whatever's on hand? 'Fraid I can't spare that much. You'll take two, and be glad of it.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_TEBBE_000_011: The remainder you'll have to gather yourself. Shouldn't be too much of a bother, though─you'd be surprised what you can find growing underfoot, even in the Reach.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_TEBBE_000_012: Sorry, friend, but you'll get no more from me. Rules is rules.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_013: Tebbe can be a bit of a stickler, but he means well. I hope he didn't give you too much trouble.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_031: Ah, there you are. Got those herbs I asked for?
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_032: Thanks, that'll do nicely. And, uh...sorry to impose upon you, . Thought you were another new recruit. Didn't realize until after that you were, uh...
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_033: But to answer the question that's probably on your mind, yes. It's always like this. Never enough food or supplies to go around.
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_034: All the more reason to be grateful when our countrymen can spare some for the cause. Though that comes at a cost, too. Too many villages, too many children more deserving than us...
TEXT_STMBDZ002_02636_AHELISSA_000_035: But a man can't fight on an empty stomach, can he? So we partake, as we must. And we never lose sight of the dream.
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_ANANTASOLDIER02637_: You look like a ssstrider in sssearch of comrades in need. If ssso, I have a tasssk for you.
I am a trainer, and I was told to expect new recruitsss thisss , yet nary a one has come. Perhapsss they were given the wrong time or location. I do not know.
They number five in all, these would-be warriors. Sssend them unto me, should you chance to find them.
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_ANANTASOLDIER_000_0: With time, I can turn even the most haplesss milksssops into whirlwinds of death. But I cannot do thisss if sssaid farm boys do not come.
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_SOWASOWAUSOLDIER026: Oh bugger, you were sent by the snake, weren't you!? I heard one in four recruits doesn't live through their training. That can't be true, right? Oh bugger, oh bugger...
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_SINGANSOLDIER02637_: Ah. A thousand pardons. So preoccupied was I by the question of whether Ala Mhigo should be a monarchy or republic that I neglected to attend my training. How silly, I know─until we drive the imperials from our lands, the question is moot.
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_BRAVESOLDIER02637_0: I know, I know. I'm late. But I had to say a prayer for my sister first. After what the imperials did to her, death was a mercy...
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_YOUNGSOLDIER02637_0: Huh? Training? Gah! I was so busy practicing to impress the others that I completely forgot! Thank you!
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_YANGSOLDIER02637_00: The teacher calls for me? I see. We were discussing strategies for disabling magitek armor, you see, and... Ah, yes, of course, there is no time. If you would excuse me.
TEXT_STMBDZ003_02637_ANANTASOLDIER02637_: All recruitsss are presssent and accounted for. My thanksss to you, ssstrider.
Not all appreciate the rigor with which I train my recruitsss. Sssome favor a gentler approach. As if the imperials will be ssso kind.
'Tis a thanklesss job, to teach, sssome sssay. But I sssay their sssurvival is thanksss enough. Fare you well.
TEXT_STMBDZ004_02638_BURLYPRIVATE02638_0: Damn it all! Where could it have got to!?
Oh! Um, pardon me, fellow lover of freedom and justice. You haven't seen a ward of the Destroyer anywhere, have you? Maybe on the ground, as if a certain bloody fool had dropped it?
Aye, I'd been him. I had it this morning, that much I know for certain, and I've not left the Reach since, so it's got to be around here somewhere.

Hmm... If you've got a moment to spare, would you be willing to help me search? I spent some time near the Temple of the Fist earlier, so it might be there. As for me, I'll look around near the officer's pavilion.
They're hardly rare, I know, and I could just as easily buy another, but even so... Please, help me find it...
If it's not here, then it's got to be somewhere near the Temple of the Fist. At least, I think it's got to be one of these two locations...
I swear, I've searched high and low, but it just won't turn up...
Seven hells, that's the one! That's my lucky ward! You're a godssend, !
Before I was born, my mother made a pilgrimage to the Temple of the Fist, where she, like many others, received the blessings of the monks.
And then Theodoric came and burned it all to the ground, the mad bastard. And after him came the Garleans, who cared even less for our beliefs.
But I still keep to the old ways, as do many others. And when my son is born, I'll teach him the stories and the scripture, as my mother taught me...
TEXT_STMBDZ004_02638_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Assisting one of your fellow freedom fighters? I will leave you to it, then.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_000: You there─aye, you. Have you seen a bumbling clod of an Au Ra? A new recruit I ordered to patrol the northern edge of Onokoro. He is late in returning.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_001: A strange boy he was, quiet and brooding. Reluctant to speak unless spoken to first. Better that than a fool who never holds his tongue, perhaps.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_002: Much as I would enjoy dragging him back by the ear, I cannot. Duty compels me to remain. You, on the other hand, have no such obligations...
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_003: I sent the boy to patrol the region northwest of Heaven-on-High. If he is not there, then I know not where else he could be...
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_SYSTEM_000_010: You cast about for the Confederate recruit, and at last spy a young Auri man lurking behind the rocks to the west...
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_SYSTEM_000_011: You cast about for the Confederate recruit, but see no one matching his description.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_020: If you find my recruit, tell him to return to me at once. I have no shortage of tasks for him.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_NEWCOMER02679_000_0: Who...who are you? You do not look like a  of the Confederacy.
...Forgive me. 'Twas but yesterday we bid farewell to one of our own, and I worried that she might have lost her way.
We laid her to rest in a boat and pushed her out till the current claimed it. For the sea is our home, now and ever after.
But those sent thither with burdened hearts may drift back to shore, it is said...
Out of concern for her comrades, she strove to earn far more than her keep. She hunted rare and deadly game in treacherous waters, and lost her life for it.
But my vigil is ended─her vessel has not returned to Onokoro! She has made peace with this life and placed her faith in us to live on...
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_040: So, what of my recruit? Did you find him napping on the beach or some such?
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_041: What? All this time he was standing watch for the funerary vessel? Huh...
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_042: So rarely does he give voice to his thoughts. I had no idea our comrade's death had affected him so. Too quick was I to judge him.
TEXT_STMBDZ207_02679_ARANAMI_000_043: It is good that you went in my stead, else I might have misspoken and made a fool of myself. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_000: Kami take me! What kind of pirate cannot suffer the sway of the ocean!?
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_001: Hm? A new recruit from far-flung shores? Listen well─I have a task for you.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_002: Go first to Aokumo below and receive of him medicine for men of the earth.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_003: Then to Quickscape Pier and the hapless Doman bemoaning his wretched fate. Quickly!
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_004: The wind carries his cries to my ears, and I can stand them no longer. Bring the would-be pirate his medicine!
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AOKUMO_000_010: Come at the behest of Afumi for medicine? My very best is yours for the taking.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AOKUMO_000_011: How pitiful the lot of this Doman unable to stomach the sea. A true Confederate could raid a dozen ships while in his cups. Mayhap this one should return whence he came.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AOKUMO_000_012: I have done my part, and you have your medicine. If you tarry, Afumi will hold only you accountable.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_SEASICKNESSMAN2681_: Uuugh... Why does it shift and shudder still...
Medicines!? Give them here! They may look down on me for resorting to such measures, but I would do aught to render the world stable and motionless once more.
You are kind, as is Afumi. You may tell her that I will return to my duties as soon as I am able.
I will not soon forget this kindness. Thank you, my friend, thank you.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_030: ...The Doman was raised in the mountains of his homeland. The first time he saw the sea was after he fled his homeland and came to us.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_031: He tosses and turns in his sleep, and when he takes to the water, it is not long before he can no longer stand.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_100_031: But he will grow accustomed to this life. He is hardly the first, after all. The captain too was once of Doma, though he cast all aside twenty and five years ago, when the imperials took his lands and the lives of his parents and brothers.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_033: Perhaps you too will renounce your ties and join us someday? Aye, I mistook you for a recruit before, but I know your tale now. Tansui unfolded all.
TEXT_STMBDZ209_02681_AFUMI_000_034: Think on my offer, Westerner. You may find small joys in the land, but the sea holds salvation.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_100_000: I...I require but a moment to catch my breath...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_RESSIANGATEKEEPER_0: You are , are you not? We were told of your coming.
Heroes of Eorzea, we of the Doman Liberation Front are honored to receive you. If you would be so good as to follow me...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_SYSTEM_000_006: Enter the House of the Fierce?
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_010: Though our resources are limited, our stronghold is secure. You may rest and recover here in safety.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_RESISTANCE02492_000: To think that warriors such as you journeyed across the seas to aid our cause... We cannot thank you enough!
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_ALISAIE_000_020: As you can see, they went to great lengths to disable the aetheryte. Apparently, in the twilight days of the rebellion, they feared that Zenos would be willing to risk sending unattuned conscripts.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_ALISAIE_000_021: That said, it is hardly irreversible. They have the necessary materials. It would be a challenge to repair it alone, but mayhap with my brother's help...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_ALISAIE_000_022: Moenbryda could have done it with her eyes closed. What little Alphinaud and I know of aetheryte technology, we learned from her when she came to visit Grandfather.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_030: Mayhap a brief respite is in order. Were I twenty years younger, these wounds would not warrant a second glance. Alas, no samurai has the strength to defeat that villain Old Age.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_031: But what say you to the House of the Fierce? Compared to your Rising Stones, I concede it may seem somewhat lacking...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_032: But it has been a haven these past ten years to all who would set Doma free.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_033: Regrettably, our efforts in that time have come to little and less...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_034: <sigh> When the Emperor died, we were so sure the hour of our liberation was at hand. But Zenos soon put paid to that, with the aid of Yotsuyu and the secrets she sold.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_GOSETSU_000_035: Before the might of the XIIth Legion, our forces were as cattle to be slaughtered. Not even the shinobi escaped their wrath. Yet somehow our sanctuary remained undiscovered, and we few lived to fight another day.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_LYSE_000_040: You should hear this, . He was just telling me about Zenos and the rebellion.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_RESISTANCE02492_000: What you have to understand is that it was not a simple matter of numbers. The bulk of the XIIth never even took the field. It was Zenos's stratagems that won the war. They were unlike anything we had ever seen.
His formations were unorthodox─bewildering. We honestly thought we had him on the back foot. One moment we were pressing home our advantage, the next we were surrounded and at his mercy.
And then he stood before us, his cornered prey. Alone and unarmed. He beckoned us to come forward and fight for our lives.
One by one, my comrades charged. Fearless and unflinching, he would dance amidst their blades for a time, and then draw close, as if to embrace...
One...after...another. He made us watch. Do you understand? He made us watch.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_LYSE_000_046: What kind of monster enjoys killing people?
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_RESISTANCE02492_000: ...I do not think there was any joy in it. Nor justice, nor morality, nor meaning. To him, the weight of one life is no different from that of a thousand.
A challenge had been issued and was accepted. But on finding us no challenge at all, his objective changed.

There were tales of imperial soldiers being flayed for slaughtering families. For breaking brave men's spirits. Only later did I come to understand why. He did not desire obedience. He desired hate...and men consumed by it.

A new battle. A new enemy. A new challenge.
The hunt, I am told he called it. A hunt without end.

And when all our best lay dead and broken, he left.
He left, muttering that we had “bored” him.
But our weapons, at least, held his interest. For he took a fallen samurai's sword, having grown...fond of it.

Since that day, he has ever wielded Far Eastern blades. He is said to be fascinated by ones with storied histories, and so soldiers who seek to curry his favor often present those of defeated enemies as gifts.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_LYSE_000_054: It's like it's all a game to him. People are suffering─dying─and he's collecting swords?
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_RESISTANCE02492_000: ...We all feel the same. But my lady, you must understand...
On the battlefield, reasons do not matter. The victor is not the just, but the strong, and the strong become the heroes of the tale. We were not strong enough.
It is not sufficient to be right. To be just. Without strength, our path has but one end...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_LYSE_000_058: If it's strength we need, then it's strength we'll get. We can't lose to him again...
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_060: . I do hope you have taken this opportunity to rest and recover.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_061: It is well that you spoke with one of the survivors of that massacre. To defeat one's foe, one must first understand his true nature.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_062: As the Ala Mhigan Resistance has struggled, so too has the Doman Liberation Front. More so, perhaps, given the precarious position in which we find ourselves in the wake of our doomed rebellion.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_063: We are few, and our enemies legion. We are weak, and they strong. Yet with your help, I believe that there is little we cannot achieve... I only hope the depth of our predicament has not shaken your commitment to our cause.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_A1_000_066: No, no. I relish the challenge.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_A1_000_067: Not so long as I can expect a suitably generous reward.
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_068: Aye, that it will. With the hero of Eorzea on our side, we cannot lose!
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_069: You...relish the thought of facing that monster again? But of course─the hero of Eorzea fears no foe!
TEXT_STMBDA325_02934_YUGIRI_000_070: ...Of course. It may take time, but rest assured you will receive due compensation.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_GOSETSU_000_000: I will not pursue her. It is for her to think on our master's words and recognize the futility of her course.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_GOSETSU_000_001: Those, at least, are my thoughts upon the matter. Yours may be different. Should you wish to give chase, I will not bar your path.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_GOSETSU_000_002: ...We each have but one life, and it is not to be spent recklessly in pursuit of our goals. I pray she realizes this soon...
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_GOSETSU_000_010: Zenos will fall, but not to a desperate knife in the dark. We will need to plan and prepare, and she has done neither.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_020: ...Did Gosetsu send you to stop me?
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_021: Then you came of your own free will? I should be surprised if you agreed with my chosen course. No one else did.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_022: But it is not as fanciful as they would have you believe. Scant moments ago, I received the crown prince's itinerary from one of our spies in the castle.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_023: 'Twould seem that Zenos has no desire to remain in Doma any longer than necessary. He wishes to inspect the Moon Gates this very eve.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_024: His impatience is to our advantage. He arrived without warning and gave Yotsuyu no time to prepare. The whole castle is in state of upheaval.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_025: To avoid any delay, he has declined a full escort, and will be traveling with no more than a handful of soldiers. The kami could not have blessed us with more auspicious circumstances. I will kill him, . I will.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_A1_000_027: You mean we will kill him.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_029: ...Or die trying. You understand the risks.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_030: Forgive me. Of course you do. Mayhap better than I.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_032: I know the odds. I know what he is capable of, and that in an open confrontation, I will likely die.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_033: But if I do not─if I succeed, then countless lives will be saved. Doma, Ala Mhigo─everything will change! One life for that world is a price I would pay a thousand times over!
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_034: ...What? What is it? Why are you looking at me like that?
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_036: Thank you. Thank you. I...I cannot well express what this means to me.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_037: We have much to discuss, but we can do so on the way.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_038: Yuzuka Manor is some distance from here. We must hurry!
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_ISSE_000_039: ...Stay calm. No one knows you were here. No one knows you saw anything.
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_ISSE_000_040: No one knows you overheard two rebels plotting...to kill the crown prince...
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_ISSE_000_041: Gah! Stupid, stupid, stupid! You know how this ends! And they only have themselves to blame! You have to tell them. You have to...
TEXT_STMBDA326_02935_YUGIRI_000_050: This is far enough. Let us discuss our plan of attack...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_ALISAIE_000_000: I suppose I ought to go and take stock of our supplies. We'll be needing a lot of weapons...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_010: You're here for the parcel Cid sent, right? Wait a moment, and it will be right out!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_011: It arrived not long ago. A porter delivered it to our offices, along with various other knickknacks from Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_012: Cid regrets that he couldn't come here in person. Apparently his hunt for the dragon and Omega demands his full attention, you see...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_013: Still, he was reasonably confident that the documents he provided would be enough for Alphinaud to do the work himself. So as soon as that parcel gets here, we can open it up and see what's inside!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_014: Pardon my interruption, but the parcel in question─was it the one you placed on the shelf in the back for safekeeping?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_015: I believe so, yes. Why do you ask?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_016: Well, you see, on closer inspection, said parcel appears to have been addressed to the Sekiseigumi Barracks.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_017: Though it does indeed bulge with a quantity of paper reminiscent of a rather large instruction manual, the lingering scent of lilac leads me to conclude it is in fact a sizable collection of love letters...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_018: What!? Impossible! That porter was carrying a parcel addressed to us! I saw the writing with my own eyes!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_019: Oh, I do not doubt that in the least. However, as he was tasked with a number of deliveries, I can only presume that he handed you another parcel by mistake.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_020: This is a disaster! We have to find that porter right this instant!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_021: My, she can move quickly when she has a mind to do so. So quickly she neglected to take these love letters with her. They too must be redirected to their rightful recipient.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_022: They should also aid you in tracking down the right porter. They keep records of their deliveries and so forth, after all.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_023: The man in question was of middling height and build. Not unlike myself. Black hair, short─terribly helpful in Kugane, I know. A cheery sort. Wearing bright colors, as I recall?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_024: I will send a few of my men out to search, but in the meantime, why don't you take the parcel and see if you can't track him down yourself? I will wait here, on the off chance he realizes his mistake and returns.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_030: Short, black hair, light-colored garments. In all other respects, not unlike myself. But then, I am so terribly unremarkable, am I not?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_035: Hey, you! Yeah, you! You came by the Ruby Bazaar earlier, right? Where's my parcel!?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MAND02946_000_040: Why are you yelling at me!? Who are you!?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANA02946_000_050: Hm? Who are you? You seek company? For an hour or an evening?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANA02946_000_051: Ugh, how it reeks of perfume and desperation. I know naught of it, nor do I wish to know.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANB02946_000_060: Oh dear, oh dear... I misplaced some most important documents, and if I do not find them quickly, there will be dire repercussions...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANB02946_000_061: No, no, it is nothing so scandalous and base! <sigh> My lord is a man with singular dietary restrictions, which I have detailed in my notebook. I cannot purchase produce without it!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANC02946_000_070: A good  to you, , but I have no time to chat! I have to head to the Bokairo! ...Or was it the Hostelry? Bah, no time, no time!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANC02946_000_071: Hm? Aye, I recognize that parcel. I delivered it to the Ruby Bazaar not long ago. What of it?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANC02946_000_072: Eh? A mistake? For the Sekiseigumi, you say?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANC02946_000_073: Bah, you're right! How stupid of me. Fortunately, I have yet to visit the barracks. This is for you, yes? I will take the other in exchange.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANA02946_000_052: Oh, if only I could relax like this every day...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANB02946_000_062: I suppose I could try to buy produce without it. What is the worst that could happen? He could...get very sick, or perhaps die...and the Sekiseigumi could judge me a murderer and execute me... Oh dear...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_MANC02946_000_074: I must remember to be more careful! The last thing I need is to be cursed by my customers...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_080: Back already? Tataru is as well. She couldn't find the porter, in case you're wondering.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_090: I'm sorry, I couldn't find him. I guess we just have to hope he realizes his mistake and returns soon...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_091: That's it! That's the parcel! You found him!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_092: Though, knowing our luck, Cid put the wrong papers in here...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_093: Nope, this is it! These are the documents detailing the operation of the magitek field generators Alphinaud requested!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_094: I can only imagine what would have happened had we sent  back to Doma with a parcel full of love letters. The look on Alphinaud's face when he reads the first page... On second thought, I'm a little disappointed we didn't.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_095: Everyone's working so hard to fight for Doma's freedom, and here I am, making the same silly mistakes...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_096: It won't happen again, ! And I'll keep working hard to bring you and the others useful information!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_097: If we hear anything new, we'll contact you straightaway!
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_098: Oh, and you may be pleased to hear that we have brokered an arrangement between the company and the Confederacy. They require armaments, we provide. Discreetly, and at a reasonable price.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_099: I'm sure Lord Lolorito was pleased to hear it.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_100: Ahaha! Indeed he was, indeed he was.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_101: Well, it seems our time together is at an end! Give Alphinaud and Alisaie my regards, will you?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_TATARU_000_110: We've got eyes on the Garlean embassy, just so you know. If we notice anything suspicious, you'll be the first to hear about it.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_HANCOCK_000_115: I can see it now. Confederate ships sailing up the One River, equipped with the finest Lominsan-made cannons, provided by the East Aldenard Trading Company. The world is not as big as it once was, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_ALISAIE_000_120: So much to do, and so little time to do it...
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_YUGIRI_000_125: You are returned from Kugane? How fares Tataru?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Oh! It seems like just yesterday you were here. Our plans proceed apace. Do you have the documents?
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_ALPHINAUD_000_131: Excellent! This looks to be exactly what we need.
TEXT_STMBDA509_02946_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Assuming our shinobi escort can see us safely inside the Moon Gates, I should have no trouble deactivating the barrier. Good, good─that is one less thing to worry about...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_LYSE_000_000: There's something odd about this man...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ALPHINAUD_000_006: The Dairyu Moon Gates have guarded the approach to Doma Castle since long before the imperial occupation.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ALPHINAUD_000_007: We do not anticipate any great difficulty in gaining entry to the gatehouse as our Doman friends know its every nook and cranny. The challenge will come in preserving the element of surprise. But I am confident the shinobi will rise to the occasion.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_YUGIRI_000_008: During the rebellion, the imperials turned to their agents among the shinobi, and through their treachery were many of my comrades slaughtered.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_YUGIRI_000_009: We few who survived have not forgotten that day. The memory of it has spurred us never to neglect our training, that we might be ready to administer revenge.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_010: Eh? Say again? You would have me fashion armor for villagers who wish to fight imperial regulars?
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_011: Bwahahaha! Mad fools charging boldly to meet their deaths! Bring me steel and I shall give them shells to shield their soft bellies.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_012: Yes, yes, plates of steel, all that you can carry. The better to shield them from blade and bullet!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ISSE_000_013: If only it were so simple, Master Tsuranuki. Steel plates are not so easily procured─
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_014: Blind, deaf, and dumb you are, boy! We are awash in broken steel. Magitek, great cylinders come crashing to the earth from on high!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_015: Shatter them to bits with my explosives. They will not fail you, for I made them to kill imperials, heh heh! Bring me my steel, and you will have your armor.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_LYSE_000_016: ...Well, it's not like we know any other armorers who can help. At least we get to blow things up!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_020: Of course, the imperials have explosives too, and there is no armor which can protect you from that. Bwahahaha!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ISSE_000_035: We're lucky no patrols overheard the explosions...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_040: Eh? Eh!? You have the many plates of steel I demanded? Show me!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_041: Bwahahaha! Then you are committed to your cause! Dressing villagers as soldiers and marching off to war...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_042: Stupid, stupid fools! Doma is dead, and so are her people!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_043: Lord Kaien, Lord Hien─all dead! Their blood is on our hands!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_044: 'Twas Lord Kaien who saved us. Who spared us the worst when the Garleans came.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_045: Every shred of pride and honor he cast aside, without a second thought! All to win their trust. All to serve as their puppet. Restored to his throne years later, a paper tiger.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_046: Such shame he must have felt, but no matter! He would suffer it for his people. A life as slaves is better than none at all, he believed. But not us.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_047: After my lady died, we began to whisper in his ears dreams of freedom and liberation. We pushed him to take action, if only a little...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_048: Ten years of preparation, of machinations. So careful we would be, and yet...and yet!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_049: Doma burned for our foolishness, not for that of Lord Kaien. Monzen, the enclave─they were razed for our sins! We murdered them all, don't you see? We murdered you all!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ISSE_000_050: ...You're wrong, Master. We are still here. We are still alive.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_ISSE_000_051: Lord Kaien too lives on. In our hearts, and in his son, for Lord Hien has returned.
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_052: Lord Hien? Alive!? It cannot be. You lie. You lie!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_LYSE_000_053: It's the truth! Hien came back to Doma to help her fight for freedom!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_054: Could...could it be? My lord Hien yet lives? Oh...oh...
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_055: Bands of steel to bind the chest and belly, yes, yes! I must heat the forge and begin work at once!
TEXT_STMBDA510_02947_TSURANUKI_000_056: Ten? One hundred? How many do you need? All that and more you shall have!
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_000: You strike me as a strong and capable individual. I've a job for you, Westerner, if you are courageous as well.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_001: On the beach far to the west lies the carcass of a gyuki, feathered with arrows. I would have you go and retrieve those which may still be of use.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_002: While you are about it, I should be glad if you were to butcher its tail for meat. Very good meat in gyuki tails, you know.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_003: But I did say you would need be a courageous sort, and I meant it. The beast was young. Do not be surprised if an angry mother mourns its child.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_010: Retrieve what arrows you can from the carcass, and bring me the meat of its tail. Do this, and you will have my gratitude.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_SYSTEM_000_015: The rotting carcass of the gyuki emits a powerful stench that fills the air...
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_020: You have been away for some time─perhaps in search of a young gyuki corpse?
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_021: I see I did not misjudge you! Thank you for your help. Would that I could have tended to my own kill, but such is life...
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_022: A pity the meat is not as delicious as it is nutritious. Under normal circumstances, we would not bother hunting gyuki as game, but as you may have heard, these are not normal circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_023: Arrows too must be reused when possible. A prudent measure become necessary, alas. With every passing day our future grows more uncertain...
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_024: But this day we shall have full bellies, and in that must we take solace. And wayward travelers need not risk the ire of vengeful gyuki by wandering near my neglected kill.
TEXT_STMBDA327_02953_KAJIKA_000_025: A strange sigh passes your lips. Have I said something odd? No matter─ Thank you again for your aid!
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_001: You'd best keep your distance, if you know what's good for you. Say your piece and move on.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_002: Looking for folks down on their luck? Congratulations, you've found one. As you can see, my leg ain't what it used to be. Some days I can hardly walk for the pain.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_003: Mornings are the worst, especially after cold nights. Hard labor's right out─too much pain and trouble for others.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_004: There's a tea what helps with it, though...I'd need to grind a chapuli horn and a hornbill talon for the blend...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_005: Eh? You'll go and get some for me, just like that? You needn't trouble yourself so...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_010: ...I've no expectations of aid, mind, but if you happen to pass through the Last Forest and stumble into some chapulis and hornbills...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_020: You've been gone a while. What brings you back to Ala Gannha?
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_021: Oh, I never meant to... I mean, in times like these, you never think people will actually...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_022: This country's hard on people, but it's not just that. The imperials, they...they've made it known I'm not to be helped. A dead man's good for one lesson, you know, whereas a live one...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_023: You're with the Resistance, right? I suppose there's no reason not to tell you then.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_024: My father, gods rest his soul, was deathly sick at the time, and so I'd gone out into the forest, spear in hand, to gather herbs. And then I had the good fortune to run into an imperial patrol.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_025: My weapon marked me as a rebel, or so they said. Not that it'd've made a difference if I'd fought back. I knew what the lot of them were about the moment that centurion laid eyes on me...
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_026: Didn't matter in the end, of course. Some people just like to hurt others. And by the time I limped back to the hut, it was too late for my father.
TEXT_STMBDA127_02954_GRISELDIS_000_027: Too late for me too, aye, and many others I imagine. Help them too if you like─they'll be grateful and say thank you. But beyond that, I wouldn't hope for much.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_001: A new face in Ala Gannha? Huh... What would you ask of me, then?
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_002: A stranger and a generous soul besides? Bollocks. There's naught more suspicious than a good samaritan.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_003: ...On the other hand, if you were an imperial agent, I expect you'd go about your business with more discretion. Bugger me, you really are here to help, aren't you?
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_004:
Very well. I'll take you up on your offer, stranger...
My little brother's working the rocks by Grymm & Enid. He's got something for me. Can you go and get it?
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_005: Right, then. Frightened Coeurl is his name. Ask him for the leftovers─he ought to understand.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_010: You know where Grymm & Enid are, aye? West by southwest. Look for the bastard what looks like me, but less handsome.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_FRIGHTENEDCOEURL_00: Hm? Here for the leftovers, are you? Not like my brother to send someone in his stead, but so be it.
It's all in the sacks over yonder. They're bleedin' heavy, mind, so be careful when you pick 'em up.
The sacks you'll be wantin' to take back to Ala Gannha are over there. Hope you brought a pack bird.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_040: Ah, the new face. You have my leftovers?
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_041: Huh, well I'll be...you actually went and brought the whole lot. Much obliged, much obliged...
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_042: It's saltpeter for making firesand, in case you're curious what it's all for. The rocks by the lakes've got good deposits.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_043: 'Tain't hard for my brother to pass for any other plodding quarryman, all the while sweeping bits and pieces off to the side, to bundle up and sell to the sutlers what trade with the Resistance.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_044: It's a living, and a way of fighting back besides. Our way of spitting in the Garleans' eye for putting our father in an imperial uniform and shipping him off to some faraway province fifteen years ago.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_045: Dunno if he's dead or alive, even. Though, if he were alive, he'd not be long for this world if we were caught fighting for the Resistance. So this is the best we can do.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_046: ...That's the long and the short of it. We do what we can, though we know it's not enough.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_047: I think you'll find that most folks here ain't much different. Everybody's got a reason, but in the end, the result is the same.
TEXT_STMBDA128_02955_ANGRYCOEURL_000_048: I suppose I just...I just wanted you to know, is all. That I─that we know why you're here, and that even if we can't join you, we...we wish we could...
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALISAIE_100_010: Come to check on me, have you? Well, thanks to the excellent care I've received, I seem to be on the mend.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALISAIE_100_011: Not that that's stopped Alphinaud from insisting I continue my convalescence. I swear he decides to act the part of a concerned big brother at the most inconvenient of times...
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_010: Right then, let's go and find Master Leveilleur.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_011: Actually, leave that to me. I want you fresh for our little adventure. Wait for us by the aetheryte, and we'll be along shortly. See you there!
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Greetings, . 'Twould seem we are to accompany Arenvald on some manner of escapade. Have you any idea what we've gotten ourselves into?
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_021: Allow me to explain. It'll be something of a history lesson, but I'll try to be brief. No snoring, if you please.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_022: Now, the events I would speak of occurred before the occupation─back when Ala Mhigo was still a monarchy, and Theodoric sat the throne.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALPHINAUD_000_023: A uniquely brutal despot, by all accounts.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_024: That he was. The King of Ruin suffered no rivals, real or imagined, and his dispute with the monks of the Fist ended with Rhalgr's Reach being burned to the ground.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_025: In the latter years of his rule, he was seized by the unshakable belief that unseen forces were conspiring to steal his crown. And so he ordered that every soul with a claim to the throne be executed─including his own family.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_026: The wealth of the poor sods he put to death became the property of the king, and it's said that these royal treasures were hoarded somewhere in the palace. Thus was born the legend of the “mad king's trove.”
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Ah. I believe I see the direction our adventure is to take. I assume you have a mind to unearth this hidden bounty?
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALPHINAUD_000_029: And would I also be correct in assuming that this legend is widely known? Others must surely have gone in search of your prize, tempting as it seems.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_030: Well, of course we won't be the first to make the attempt. Following Ala Mhigo's liberation, more than a few eager soldiers turned the palace upside down in hopes of claiming an easy fortune.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_031: But even after scouring every room from dawn till dusk, they uncovered not a single coin. Their gold-lust drained away as quickly as it had come, and the legend of the mad king's trove remains simply that─a legend.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ALPHINAUD_000_032: But I see you have no intention of letting the story end there.
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_ARENVALD_000_033: What self-respecting adventurer would!? Imagine: the three of us, delving into a decades-old mystery! Tell me the thought doesn't set your heart to racing!
TEXT_STMBDB101_02962_SYSTEM_000_100: You have learned the emote Box!
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_001: If anyone can find that treasure, it's us─but even if we don't, the adventure will be reward enough, I reckon.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_002: The news of Doma and Ala Mhigo's liberation has kindled the flames of revolution in every corner of the Empire. I hear the imperial province of Dalmasca has already risen up in rebellion...
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_010: ...Which means the Garleans must surely have their hands full. What better time than now to indulge in such a diversion? Tell us, Arenvald─have we any clues as to where we might begin our search?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_011: Well, judging by how the other treasure hunters fared, nosing about the palace isn't like to get us anywhere, so...we'll probably need to, uh...ask around.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Would that be another way of saying no?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_014: I see. In that case, I shall pay a visit to the Allied archivists and request access to the records seized from the imperials.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_015: The Garleans are meticulous about such things. If they uncovered the trove during their occupation, the event is certain to have been recorded.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_016: In the meantime, the two of you can track down those who worked as palace servants and officials in Theodoric's day.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Given that they would have been at least twenty at the time, you will be looking for people who have seen forty summers or more. Anything they can tell you about the king and his bloody deeds may prove useful, so be sure to listen well.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_018: Arenvald, pray try your luck in the Fringes and the Peaks whilst  makes the rounds in the Ala Mhigan Quarter.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_019: Hah! And there I was thinking I was the party leader. Not that I mind, of course! Let's be about it, eh? We can meet afterwards at Gylbarde's Gate!
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_MIDDLEAGEMAN_000_03: Surely you've heard stories of the mad king? He used to hold public executions up on the Divine Audience. Anyone─and I mean anyone─suspected of conspiring against the crown was flung from the top of those steps.
Suffice it to say that I stayed as far away from the palace as possible.
No, ─I never set foot in the house of the King of Ruin. Who in their right mind would want to go anywhere near a man like him?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_MIDDLEAGEWOMAN_000_: You want to hear an old maid's stories, do you? Aye, well most of what I know of the mad king is common knowledge.
We'd only see His Royal Majesty when he deigned to attend the executions he'd ordered. And after a while, even watching his “enemies” die wasn't enough to coax him out of hiding.

They say he started seeing assassins in every shadow, and wouldn't set foot outside the palace walls. I was offered work there as a royal servant once, but the mere thought of it left me in a cold sweat...
I was never desperate enough to accept a job at the palace. No amount of coin is worth your life.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_MIDDLEAGEHELLSGUARD: ...Aye, I served at the pleasure of King Theodoric, and lived to tell the tale. One of the palace guards, I was.

Truth be told, it was a dark chapter in my life, and one I'd sooner forget. Hardly a night went by when we didn't hear bloodcurdling screams echoing from the inner chambers─which, of course, we were under orders to ignore.

So we'd stand still as statues, trying not to imagine what horrors were unfolding within...
<sigh> If you're hells-bent on finding out what happened in the palace, head down the street here and ask old Ernold─he was the king's head scribe.
You'll find Ernold down that way. If any man was privy to the king's secrets, it was him.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_060: Yes, I am Ernold. ...What do you want with me?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_061: Hmmm, you would have me dredge up some decidedly unsavory memories. Yet if Ala Mhigo is to move forward, we must needs acknowledge the misdeeds of the past.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_062: Very well, I shall tell you what I remember. I take it you know of Theodoric's paranoia and the public executions of his kinsmen?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_063: Those were terrible enough. But in his last days, the king's fevered mind settled upon an even grislier method of “disposal” which only a chosen few were unfortunate enough to witness.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_064: His Majesty ordered the court thaumaturge to unleash a vile curse upon the remaining members of the royal family─a magic which transformed them into fiends of hideous aspect. The resulting...monstrosities were then cast into the darkness below the palace.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_065: Even now, my sleep is troubled by nightmares. If others of Theodoric's blood were prone to share his madness, then mayhap it is a kindness that the monarchy ended with him.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ERNOLD_000_070: It is my hope that Ala Mhigo shall never again suffer the likes of the King of Ruin. We forget at our peril...
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Ah, excellent timing as ever. We have but this moment returned from our own intelligence-gathering efforts.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_080: Since we're all here, why don't we share what we've learned?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Allow me to begin, then. As promised, I scoured the imperial records for any mention of fantastic treasures...and found precisely none.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_082: It is just possible, I suppose, that a corrupt official deliberately hid the fact of the trove's discovery, hoping to enrich himself─but I find it rather unlikely that so valuable a find would stay secret for long. I conclude that our prize either does not exist, or that the imperials somehow overlooked it.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_100_082: But what of you, ? Were your investigations any more fruitful?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_083: ...Turned into monsters? And what could he mean by this “darkness beneath the palace,” I wonder...
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_084: I met an old man in Ala Ghiri who spoke of the palace's subterranean prison, but he said naught of cursed abominations!
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_085: The imperial archives were also silent on the subject of fiends inside the palace grounds.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_086: Could this scribe fellow have been spinning  a yarn, do you think? Did you believe him, ?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_088: If he was afraid, that does lend credence to the tale─though I'm not sure how that helps us in our search.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_089: Then we're back where we started...
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Do not be so hasty─Ernold's anecdote may very well have told us where the trove is hidden. But ere I share my theory, there is a matter I would clarify.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Arenvald, you spoke of light-hearted adventure, but I sense a deeper motive for this expedition. Why are you so intent on finding this treasure?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_092: ...It wasn't all pretense, I swear it. But...you're right.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_093: My father was in the imperial army, a man of Garlean blood. I trust you know what I mean when I say that my Ala Mhigan mother did not welcome my arrival?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_094:
As I grew, she would check my brow over and over, convinced that a spot on my skin was an emerging third eye─like the kind you see in pureblood Garleans. My mother did not care for this taunting reminder of my heritage, and took up a knife...
War paint serves to cover the scar.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_095: In the end, she turned me out into the street, and I was left to haunt the alleyways of Ala Mhigo, a feral child who got what he needed through begging, cunning, or worse.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_096: The best I can say about the years that followed is that I survived. But I hated the animal I'd become. Eventually, I left the city behind me, and joined a group of refugees bound for the other side of the Wall. It was then that I turned to adventuring, and that road led me into the company of the Scions.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_097: I tell you this so that you understand: I know all too well what poverty and hunger can do to a person.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ARENVALD_000_098: I drew steel on ordinary folk for a measly crust of bread. With Theodoric's gold, I could spare my countrymen the shame of living like that.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_099: Thank you, Arenvald, and I apologize─that cannot have been pleasant to recall. But I felt it best to be clear in our intentions.
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Well, ? Are you content to surrender the treasure to Arenvald's noble cause, and claim the thrill of adventure as your reward?
TEXT_STMBDB102_02963_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Then I should be glad to tell you my theory on the resting place of the mad king's trove...if you are minded to hear it?
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_001: ...Well? Out with it! What's this theory of yours?
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_010: ...Actually, mayhap it would be better if we first adjourned to a more suitable location.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_011: ...In case a rival treasure hunter overhears our plans, you mean? Good thinking!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_012: That...was not exactly the reason, but 'tis certainly a valid concern. Let us reconvene on the southern edge of Loch Seld.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_015: Come now, Alphinaud, don't leave us in suspense! Let's hear this theory of yours!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Forgive me. 'Twas not my intention to draw out proceedings. I simply wished to have the loch in sight while I explained things.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Prior to the great flood of the Sixth Umbral Calamity, the salt lakes you see before you were yet dry ravines. And this, believe it or not, was the site of the ancient city of Skalla, which rose and fell during the Fifth Astral Era.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_022: From what we know of the period, the city was already deserted by the time the waters began to rise, having been all but destroyed by war. Yet its ruins remain to this day at the bottom of Loch Seld.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_023: It is my belief that the “darkness beneath the palace” mentioned by Theodoric's former scribe was not a reference to the prison, but to a place still further below: the ruins of Skalla.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I further surmise that the mad king's unfortunate kinsmen were cast down there not simply out of a desire to punish them, but to discourage exploration. Theodoric wanted to keep the ruins secure...
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_025: Wait...you're saying...they were meant to guard the mad king's trove!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Precisely. And since we know the court thaumaturge was involved, we can safely assume that any entrance into the old city will have been magically concealed.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_027: ...Which would explain how a legion of imperial soldiers and the gods know how many Ala Mhigans never found a trace of the trove.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_028: We, however, have certain advantages which they did not enjoy. ─would you be so good as to swim down to the bottom of the loch and search for an underwater route into the ruins? While you do that, Arenvald and I will seek out an ensorcelled portal within the palace.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_SYSTEM_000_030: You discover a passage that appears to lead under the palace foundations. Press on, and find out where it goes.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_SYSTEM_000_040: You come to a worn stone door, standing temptingly ajar. It would appear you have found an entrance into the subterranean ruins.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_041: (-Alphinaud's Voice-)─it's Alphinaud. We have searched the prison beneath the palace, and found a teleportation portal concealed by enchantments. The markings indicate it leads to an underground cavern.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_042: (-Alphinaud's Voice-)...And you believe it leads into the ruins? Then I daresay we will be able to meet within. Go on and head through the door.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_043: (-Arenvald's Voice-)By the way, I took the liberty of calling on a friend for help. I guarantee she's both dependable and discreet. We'll see you soon!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_050: Gods, but what a dark and treacherous trek that was, with abominations waiting for us at every turn... In other words, it was a proper adventure!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Arenvald and I tried to do our fair share, but I fear you ended up bearing the bulk of the burden as usual. You truly led the way with your adventuring prowess, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_061: Aye, without your help, I reckon we'd still be fumbling about in the dark. I'm glad I called on you!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_062: I must say, I am still reeling at the sight of that mountain of riches...
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ARENVALD_000_063: What, like how you reeled at the sight of that floating specter, you mean? I wish you could've seen the look on your own face, Alphinaud!
TEXT_STMBDB103_02964_ALPHINAUD_000_064: M-Must we dwell on such momentary lapses!? We found the mad king's trove, and that is all that matters!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_001: First Estinien, and now Arenvald... 'Twould seem there is much amusement to be had at my expense. Honestly, I might as well go adventuring with Alisaie...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_010: All jesting aside, we must tell people the good news. And I think Lyse should be the first.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Seconded. She is bound to be delighted.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_JMOLDVA_000_012: If I am no longer needed, then I shall take my leave.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_013: Of course, don't let us keep you. Thanks again, and say hello to V'mah for me.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Now then, there is to be a meeting of representatives from across Ala Mhigo, so Lyse is sure to be in the city. Shall we seek her out?
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_020: Oh? You three look pleased with yourselves. What've you been up to?
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_021: I'm glad you asked, Lyse. And I'm pretty sure you're going to like the answer...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_022: You're joking... The mad king's trove!? I thought it was a myth!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_023: So did plenty of people. But they didn't have  and Alphinaud in their party. The credit for finding it should really go to them. As for what to do with it all...I vote that it go towards alleviating the suffering of Ala Mhigo's poor.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_024: Gods... If there's as much as you say...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Arenvald did not exaggerate, I assure you. We could not hope to carry even a fraction of it out on our own. I have taken the liberty of sketching out a rough map of the ruins─if you will assemble a squad of your most trusted freedom fighters, they should be able to follow the route to where the treasure lies.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_026: Understood. I'll make sure every coin is accounted for, and that goes for the spending of it as well!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_028: Oh, there is one other thing: when the time comes to draw up a plan for distributing the spoils, I would ask that you consult Alphinaud.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_029: I don't have a head for details. I'm not...educated. I see that simply handing out sacks of gil won't solve everything, but I couldn't rightly tell you what to do instead.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_030: Oh, I know the feeling! I'd welcome any advice you could give us, Alphinaud.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Of course. I shall be at your disposal.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_033: Deep breaths. Tell me what's happened.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_RESISTANCEWARRIOR_0: A mob's gathered outside headquarters, and they've started making demands. You'd best come and see for yourself!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Fordola and her Skulls may have aspired to be imperial citizens, but they were born Ala Mhigan. To their countrymen, they are traitors of the worst kind.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_040: The Butcher has much to answer for...but to simply drag her from her cell and slaughter her in the street...? General Aldynn is right.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_RAUBAHN_000_045: After twenty years of imperial rule, 'tis no surprise that people should seek a target for all their pent-up rage and grief... I only wish I knew the solution.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_050: Thank the gods General Aldynn arrived when he did. Any later and we would've had a riot on our hands.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_CAMPGUARD_000_055: No one goes in without the commander's permission─not even you, .
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_060: My thanks, Raubahn. Listening to their anger, I could feel myself being swept away...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_RAUBAHN_000_061: 'Tis a difficult tide to stem. 'Twas that same rage which brought us to our feet, and carried us to victory. But now the war is over, all the unspent fury is being channeled into vengeance.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_062: Aye, and it's not just here─we've reports of mobs forming all over.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_063: They've been targeting folk known to have cooperated with the Garleans. It starts with insults most often, then someone picks up a stone...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_064: Some industrious souls even thought to seek out the graves of Zenos and his officers. It was...grim.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_065: I want to build a country where everyone, regardless of race or origin, can live side by side in peace. But maybe the time isn't right. Maybe people just aren't ready...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_066: But that doesn't mean I'm not going to try. The representatives will be here soon, and I'll be damned if I'm going to give up before I've even begun.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_068: Oh, village elders, refugee leaders and the like. It wouldn't be right for us to dictate the nation's future on our own, so we've planned a summit of sorts.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_069: We've even invited the Ananta and the Qiqirn to participate.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_RAUBAHN_000_070: Ala Mhigo stands at a crossroads, and this meeting will decide which path it takes. The matter of Fordola's sentence cannot be suffered to disrupt proceedings.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_071: Then let's execute her and be done with it. She herself asked to be put to death.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_072: Naago! I already explained why we wouldn't do that!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_073: Sending her to the gallows might satisfy people right now, but where would it end? Should we round up everyone who collaborated? And everyone who didn't resist? There would be no one left! And we'd be no better than Theodoric and Zenos!
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_074: Begging your pardon, but...might I be allowed to speak with Fordola? Only, I caught a glimpse of her past. A moment of it, anyway─during the fight.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_075: She's done terrible things, aye...unforgivable things... But...in some ways, she's a victim of the circumstances in which she was born. And that's something I can understand...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_076: All right. Speak with the prison guard when you're ready, and I'll come and join you. I want to talk to her too.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_RAUBAHN_000_077: I'll return to my other duties, then─we've barely begun to investigate the facility where they gave Fordola her powers. Be fairly warned, friends: she will test you. Don't let your emotions color your judgment when she does.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ALPHINAUD_000_080: If you will have me, I have a mind to attend this interview as well.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_ARENVALD_000_085: I've no great wish to save Fordola, even if I could. But there's more to her than meets the eye, I'm sure of it...
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_LYSE_000_090: Speak with the guard, and we'll all go in together.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_MNAAGO_000_095: I think it's best if I stay outside and keep watch for troublemakers. After what that woman did to Meffrid and Commander Kemp, I'd struggle not to throttle her.
TEXT_STMBDB104_02965_CAMPGUARD_000_100: You've the commander's permission to enter, then?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_001: The capacity to experience such visions of the past had always seemed to me to be a most desirable talent, but I see now that it is as much a burden as a blessing.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_005: Sorry about that... I let my emotions get the better of me. It's just that she and I are of an age, and we're neither of us one thing or another... I can't help but feel like she's my problem to solve.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_020: I don't know that we solved anything exactly, but we've given Fordola something to think about at least.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_021: Aye... And I've found something new to think about too.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_022: I don't know about you, , but the visions only come to me every now and then. From the way Fordola kept wincing, though, I get the feeling she's having them almost all the time. That's a lot of bad memories to deal with...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Hmmm... I wonder... Could there be some fundamental difference between one who is born with the Echo and one who has been artificially imbued with it?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_024: Well, the Immortal Flames have been scouring that research facility ever since the liberation. There's a chance they might have some answers for us.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_025: General Aldynn's there overseeing the investigation. Let's go and pay him a visit, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RESONATORIUMGUARD_0: General Aldynn is inside, aye. Will you be joining him?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Seeing this facility, I am reminded of what they did to Krile...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_040: Eurgh... They should burn this place to the ground and be done with it...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_045: Come on, let's talk to Raubahn.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_050: What news? You spoke with Fordola, I take it?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_051: Yes. As expected, she didn't say very much, but it wasn't a total waste of time. Arenvald noticed something odd about her. He thinks she might be having visions almost constantly, which is not how the Echo normally works. Have you found anything here which might explain why it's so different for her?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_052: Hmph. We've been hard-pressed just to organize the research materials, let alone study them. To be frank, I'd welcome the Scions' expert assistance, if you have time to lend a hand.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_055: For a race with no innate capacity to manipulate aether, the Garleans have conducted some exceedingly elaborate aetheric experiments...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_060: These bastards would fiddle with a man's very soul if it served their purpose. Nothing is sacred to them. Nothing.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_070: Bring whatever you discover to me, and I'll put all our findings together.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_IRONWORKSENGINEER_0: We received a request from the Alliance to analyze these devices, and I've been recording everything of interest.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_SYSTEM_000_080: The device in which Krile was held seems even more ominous now you know its purpose. The surrounding pods are marked “Supply Subject” while this one bears the label “Master Subject.”
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_IRONWORKSENGINEER_0: The Ironworks received a request from the Alliance to analyze these devices, and I've been recording everything of interest. Did you notice the labeling?
All the pods are designed to drain the aether of the occupant...save that one right there.
Unlike the others, the interior's been fitted with an array of sensors to measure aetheric waveforms. To what purpose, however, I couldn't tell you.
All the pods are designed to drain the aether of the occupant...save that one right there.
Unlike the others, the interior's been fitted with an array of sensors to measure aetheric waveforms. To what purpose, however, I couldn't tell you.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_FLAMEDOCTOR_000_086: So many bodies... Every one of them a victim of these “experiments.”
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_FLAMEDOCTOR_000_087: Few show any signs of external injury. From what we've been able to determine, they perished from forcible aether extraction. Such a miserable way to die...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_FLAMEDOCTOR_000_088: We've recovered scores of bodies from those devices. What could possibly justify the deaths of so many...?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_SYSTEM_000_089:
“Idle conversation prohibited.
Eating and drinking prohi─”
The fallen scrap of parchment appears to list facility regulations, but nothing of any interest.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_100: I know little and less of science, so any light you can shed on this facility's operations would be much appreciated. , shall we start with you?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Taken in combination with the testimonies of Krile and Thancred, I do begin to see exactly what the imperials were attempting here.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_102: The enhancement procedure entailed infusing a single candidate with aether siphoned from a multitude of “supply subjects.”
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_103: As for the “master subject”─in this case, Krile─the patterns of her aetheric activity would provide the model upon which they would artificially engineer the candidate's aura.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_104: ...In other words, they were trying to recreate Krile's Echo?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_105: I believe so─which would explain our prisoner's present state. Krile is possessed of an unrivaled ability to hear the whispers of the soul, and it seems probable that the procedure engendered the same acute sensitivity in Fordola.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_106: The soldiers who guard Fordola...many of them lost friends and family to the Skulls.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_107: And there's a sentry at her door, night and day. If she can't help sensing their thoughts and seeing their past─
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_108: But you don't just see their past─you live it. All the emotions; all the pain. Imagine what it'd do to you. You'd never be the same again.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_109: Indeed. As you may recall, Ysayle was completely transformed by a single glimpse of Hraesvelgr's past.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Fordola has been forced to experience the agony of those whose lives she destroyed. The guilt must be unbearable.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_111: That explains her request to be executed...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_112: Sounds to me like a kind of justice. Regardless, she can suffer on for now. We have more pressing matters to consider.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_113: If the results of these experiments have been relayed back to Garlemald, there will be naught to stop the Empire from repeating the trick. They could give the Echo to anyone─to an entire legion.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_114: We must be ready. We must learn all we can of these godsforsaken procedures─and Fordola remains our best source of information. She'll not be getting her wish. Not yet.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_RAUBAHN_000_116: Keep faith, lass. If you're to convince others to follow you, you must believe what you're telling them. People will respond to passion─but not if it's feigned.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_118: We should leave the Flames to it. Let's go.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The forcible extraction of aether from a living subject is invariably fatal. How many died that Fordola might gain her new abilities?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_125: I've never known why I was given the Echo...but this makes me want to put it to good use.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_130: <sigh> I go looking for answers about the Echo, and end up getting schooled by Raubahn. Yet more evidence that I don't know what I'm doing. It's no wonder people listen to him and not me.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_131: General Aldynn is a veteran of countless campaigns, Lyse. You cannot compare yourself to a commander of his experience.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_132: I know. But I also know that I couldn't have convinced that mob to give up and go home. It makes me realize how much we rely on his authority...and how much I still have to learn.
