TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ARENVALD_000_133: I wonder what he'll do when everything here is settled... I mean, it's his homeland. After going to the trouble of winning it back, might he not want to stay?
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_134: 'Tis a quandary which countless refugees now face: to continue the life they built in Ul'dah, or start again in the land of their birth...
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_PIPIN_000_136: I am newly returned from Ul'dah, with a message from the sultana.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_PIPIN_000_137: Her Grace desires an audience with you. She understands that you have responsibilities here, but asks that you visit the palace at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_PIPIN_000_138: Well, I must away and attend to other business. Until next time, my friends!
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_ALPHINAUD_000_139: An audience with the sultana! Depending on the nature of her consultation, this might be the perfect opportunity to inquire about the General's future plans.
TEXT_STMBDB105_02966_LYSE_000_140: Yes, we'd all like to know about those, Alphinaud─but not everyone's as comfortable interrogating royalty as you. Take no notice of him, .
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_ARENVALD_000_001: In case you're wondering, I'm not planning on staying in Ala Mhigo. Too many bad memories. And besides, I like my new life.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_LYSE_000_005: I know I could learn so much from Raubahn if he decided to stay. But it's his choice, and I'm not about to try and persuade him. Ul'dah needs him too.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Well, the question of how to put the mad king's treasures to good use shows no sign of answering itself. Shall we be about it, Arenvald?
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_ARENVALD_000_011: I am at your beck and call!
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_LYSE_000_012:
...And I should be getting back to my own tasks. I'll organize a squad to head down into the ruins, and then start preparing for the big meeting...
Oh, send Nanamo my regards, !
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_ALPHINAUD_000_013: And ours too, if you please. We shall see you on your return.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_BARTHOLOMEW_000_020: My ! It was an honor to face you in the tournament. Since that day, I have spent my every spare moment in the practice yard, striving to attain some fraction of your skill with the blade.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_BARTHOLOMEW_000_021: Ah! Forgive me! You are here for your audience with the sultana! Please proceed.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_BARTHOLOMEW_000_022: You are expected, my . Please proceed.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_BARTHOLOMEW_000_023: Your audience with Her Grace is concluded, then? Safe travels, my .
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_03: What do you think of “Lilira, the merchant's daughter”? This is the disguise I don when I wish to leave the palace and observe my subjects unnoticed.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_100_03: Perchance you remember “Lilira, the merchant's daughter”? This is the persona I assume when I venture beyond the palace walls to observe my subjects unnoticed.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_03: Ordinarily, Papashan would accompany me, but for this particular outing I need an advisor─not a minder.

And that is why I requested your company. Over the course of your many adventures, you have met people from all walks of life, in every corner of Eorzea, and I would make use of your worldly experience.
Now, let us be on our way. Our first destination is Stonesthrow, just beyond the Gate of Nald.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04:
Look upon this procession of tattered tents...
These refugees camp in squalor, at the mercy of the elements and Thanalan's predators both.
The city's mighty walls offer safety, but the streets overflow with people as it is. And unless blessed by the hand of Nald Himself, no refugee could ever hope to afford a dwelling in Ul'dah.
Twenty years have passed since the fall of Ala Mhigo and five since the Calamity, yet the plight of the poor has grown more desperate, not less. As sultana, the blame falls upon me.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_A1_000_001: You have done your best, Your Grace.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_A1_000_002: Your hands have been tied, Your Grace...
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: ...Then my best has not been good enough.
Yes, my authority is limited. And that is an obstacle I must work to overcome...
Shall we press on? I would follow the road to the Unholy Heir.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: It was here, in this wholly unremarkable place, that my mother and father met their doom.

I was but a child at the time. My parents were returning from an inspection of our interests in eastern Thanalan when an untimely rockslide crushed their carriage. To this day, it is not certain if the incident was simple misfortune or an expertly planned assassination.
Raubahn once offered to reopen the investigation and bring me the truth he assumed I must surely crave. But I refused.
Even if my parents' deaths were orchestrated by the Monetarists, we could only have brought their hirelings to justice.
The true villains─those who plotted to put me on the throne as a biddable puppet─were ever beyond our reach.

Thus did I plan to strip the merchants of their power and place our nation in the hands of its citizens...quite unaware of the consequences my actions would have for you and yours... I shudder to think how many goodly souls paid the price of my naivety...
But I am no longer a child reciting words with witless obedience, and I will not be used as a pawn in the Monetarists' damnable games!
<sigh> Forgive me my outburst. You are one of the few people to whom I feel I can speak my mind.
Come. Let us return to Ul'dah and visit the Coliseum.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06: From the moment I became sultana, I found myself thrust into an endless parade of document signing and ceremonies.

For years, I simply signed where I was told to sign, and sat where I was told to sit, blissfully oblivious to what any of it meant. Yet one good thing did come from that ignominious chapter in my life. For it was during an “official” visit to the Coliseum that I first met Raubahn.
The match I had been invited to attend was not at all what I expected. They had pitted the Bull of Ala Mhigo against some dozen or so rival gladiators...
Blinkered though I was, I would not stand for so obvious an injustice, and demanded to see a fair fight, one man against another. And my royal wish was duly granted.
It was not until later that I learned of the gambling ring which had arranged for Raubahn to die on the sands that day.

Regardless, my intervention meant that Raubahn had but a single opponent to dispatch─which he duly did. And when he knelt before me to receive the winner's purse, he swore that he would one day offer me his blade in service.
Surrounded as I was by liars and manipulators, I confess I dismissed it as a pleasant piece of theater.

But as you know, Raubahn is a man of his word. Though it took him another five years of fighting on the bloodsands, he amassed a fortune so great as to buy not only his freedom but a seat on the Syndicate. And then I had my blade.
TEXT_STMBDB106_02967_NANAMOULNAMO_000_07: Words cannot well express what that man means to me.
There are others who care deeply for my well-being, of course─Papashan's love for me is as that of a grandsire for his grandchild.
But upon matters of governance, I cannot turn to bodyguards and maidservants for counsel.
Raubahn, with the authority of his Syndicate position, was the first sword I could wield. His was the only edge which could cut the strings that bound me...
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_00: We must make haste. My absence will not go unnoticed by the Sultansworn for long, and there are other places I would visit.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_01: When the Calamity threatened, Raubahn led the Alliance forces into battle on the plains of Carteneau. And I remained here.
I prayed with all my heart that Archon Louisoix would have the power to rouse the Twelve.

Since that day, I have made a custom of visiting this shrine during each of my little excursions. Here, I seek the blessing of Thal, reflect upon my choices, and ask myself if I am fulfilling my duties as sultana.

You are rightly celebrated as a champion because you have led the line in a hundred battles for the good of Eorzea. In much the same way, I believe the measure of a monarch lies in how she leads her people in times of adversity.
If I am to be a sultana worthy of the name, I cannot turn a blind eye to the troubles facing Ul'dah.
I have chosen my path, . With Ala Mhigo now freed from imperial chains, I finally see a way to aid the refugees.
Already, many displaced Ala Mhigans seek to begin the long trek home.
And as you well know, our artisans' school shall be waiting to accept any who wish to learn new trades. Realistically, however, it will take years for such training to yield tangible benefits.

To facilitate that process, I have made a small contribution─an artisans' school in Rhalgr's Reach for any who wish to learn new trades. Realistically, however, it will take years for such training to yield tangible benefits.
But we do not have years. These people will need shelter and employment if they are to survive, and this time the Ul'dahn treasury shall provide!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: Precisely where and how to allocate the necessary funds is, of course, another question...
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_A1_000_001: Might you ask a member of the Syndicate for advice?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_A1_000_002: Why not seek the advice of one who employs refugees?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: A wise suggestion. Mayhap a visit to the Gold Saucer is in order. Its proprietor is a member of the Syndicate, and he is one of the few who pay refugees a fair wage.
...Nothing? Hmm... If even one of your worldly experience is at a loss, it would seem I have no choice but to seek out someone more well versed in monetary matters...
I wonder, are you acquainted with Godbert Manderville?
Then I need not explain his eccentric nature. Let us make our way to the landing, and I will see that word is sent to the Gold Saucer. Godbert should be only too glad to receive us.

Ah, well he is a most generous man...if something of an eccentric. Let us make our way to the landing, and I will see that word is sent to the Gold Saucer. Godbert should be only too glad to receive us.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_SYSTEM_000_027: To gain access to the Gold Saucer, you must first accept (or have previously completed) the quest “It Could Happen to You,” available at level 15 in Ul'dah on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_ULDAHNCITIZEN02968_: I've never had such fun! That Manderville chap certainly spared no expense with that saucer of his!

Have you ever experienced the delights of the Gold Saucer? No!? Oh, you absolutely must! I believe there's a youth on the Steps of Nald who might have a spare ticket for anyone willing to listen to him boast of his good fortune.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_SYSTEM_000_029: To gain access to the Gold Saucer, you must first accept (or have previously completed) the quest “It Could Happen to You,” available at level 15 in Ul'dah on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_03: I have ridden aboard a public airship before, but this shall be my first visit to the Gold Saucer. I must confess to some excitement!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_SYSTEM_000_031: To gain access to the Gold Saucer, you must first accept (or have previously completed) the quest “It Could Happen to You,” available at level 15 in Ul'dah on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: I had heard descriptions of its splendor, yet I never dreamed it would be so bright and inviting...
N-No! I couldn't possibly─! We did not come here to fritter away the royal coin!
Godbert will be expecting us. Come, let us head directly to the lounge and ignore these...these...gaudy temptations!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: I believe this is where we are to meet Lord Manderville. Shall we sit while we await his coming?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_051: My apologies, Your Grace, I have kept you waiting!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: No apologies are necessary, Godbert. My request was sudden, and you were kind to make yourself available at such short notice.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_053: When the intrepid  and the sultana herself come calling, there is no more important engagement!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_054: When the sultana herself comes calling, there is no more important engagement!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: As to the purpose of my visit, I would have your thoughts on how the crown might best aid the refugees residing in Thanalan.

You are aware, I am sure, that many of Ala Mhigo's displaced sons and daughters long to return to their newly liberated homeland. And you are also aware of how they will suffer without shelter and work to sustain them.
I would use our nation's wealth to spare them that suffering. What advice have you for me on the matter of how it might best be distributed?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_058: ...The unusual circumstances of our meeting, and Your Grace's choice of companion, would suggest to me a desire for an honest and unvarnished opinion. I shall give you one.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_059: My advice to you is: “Stop.” Taxing Ul'dah's wealth to save Ala Mhigan refugees is a terrible, terrible idea.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_061: Most emphatically. I agree with Your Grace that the refugees must have housing and employment, but what profit is there for Ul'dah in this arrangement?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06: Profit? After all you have done for Gyr Abania's displaced, I thought you the very last person to seek to benefit from their misfortune!
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_063: Forgive me, Your Grace, but you appear to be laboring under a misapprehension.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_064: It is a fine endeavor to support one's fellow man. I fear, however, that your stance is one born of pity─your intent is to “save” the refugees, is it not?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_065: For all our potential, we are indolent creatures by nature. If unconditional charity is all we know, then we begin to rely upon it─to expect it.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_066: And then we must consider Ul'dah's own poor and downtrodden. Should they hear of you spending the nation's coin─not to improve their lot, but to nurture the distant citizens of Ala Mhigo─it is unlikely they will applaud your generosity.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_067: Surely it is not Your Grace's intention to foster new resentments, but to spread goodwill?
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06:
Indeed.
...Then any support I pledge to the refugees must promote self-sufficiency, whilst also serving the interests of the people of Ul'dah.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_GODBERT_000_069: Exactly so! Such an arrangement will create a far more equitable relationship with the returning Ala Mhigans, even as it generates the revenue required to win the approval of your subjects.
TEXT_STMBDB107_02968_NANAMOULNAMO_000_07: You have given me much to ponder, Lord Manderville. I thank you for your candor.
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_NANAMOULNAMO_000_00: Profit... The thought never even crossed my mind.
But standing about lamenting my naivety will not do anyone any good. I shall consider my lesson learned, and press on.
─are you perchance acquainted with any successful merchants? If my attempt at philanthropy is obliged to reap a profit, it would seem wise to consult someone with a knack for business.

Hm... Ordinarily, I would not trust any agent of the East Aldenard Trading Company─but if you hold this Hancock fellow in high esteem, I am content to be led by you. You may repay my faith by journeying to distant Kugane and speaking with him on my behalf.

Eager though I am to visit those shores, I have not the leisure for a lengthy sea voyage. Now, assuming you will travel as adventurers are wont to do, I shall await your report by the aetheryte in Ul'dah. A fair journey to you, ─and a swift one, if you please.
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_010: ! To what do I owe the pleasure? Or are you here on business?
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_011: ...I beg your pardon? Her Grace the sultana would have my opinion on how best to invest the wealth of Ul'dah?
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_012: My dear ... I have you to thank for this...recognition, I am sure. And I am flattered that you came to me. Truly flattered.
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_013: But why settle for a lowly apprentice, when you could have the master! Upon matters of profit, there is no living soul better-qualified to advise Her Grace than Chairman Lolorito─a man whose morning “exertions” are said to fill his garderobe with gold!
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_014: I should be happy to arrange a meeting for you...say, at the Scions' former headquarters in Thanalan? The Waking Sands would seem a suitably neutral venue for negotiations, don't you think? Fare you well, , and may your dealings prove fruitful!
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_HANCOCK_000_015: You will not find a shrewder merchant than Chairman Lolorito. Would that I could be present to witness the back-and-forth of your coming negotiations!
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: Welcome back, . Did your merchant friend have any useful advice to share?
...With Lolorito!? And you agreed to this!?
I am well aware of his standing in the field of business. But I had hoped to keep the Monetarists at arm's length, and him in particular...
...Nay. I cannot live in fear of the man. I must learn how to treat with him if I am to rule Ul'dah effectively.
Very well! I will meet with Lolorito. Let us go on ahead to the Waking Sands, and prepare for his coming.
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_NANAMOULNAMO_000_03: So this is where the Scions first congregated... I have heard many tales, but never had occasion to visit.
To work, then. The hour of the meeting draws near, and I would gather my thoughts. Pray see to it that we have the appointed room to ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDB108_02969_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: <sigh> I fear it will be many years before I feel comfortable taking part in such negotiations.

But I shall not complain. We have piqued Lolorito's interest and secured his invaluable expertise.
Thank you, . I could not have done it without you.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_NANAMOULNAMO_000_00: Our course is decided. I shall return to the palace and have my ministers begin work on implementing the particulars of the plan.
If I could prevail upon you one more time, , I would ask that you convey the details of our negotiations to Commander Hext on your return to Ala Mhigo.
My thanks again. Together, we have laid the groundwork for an endeavor which promises to benefit the peoples of Ala Mhigo and Ul'dah both.
You need not accompany me back to the palace─I will have Papashan arrange an escort. That is, if he hasn't already organized a search party... I've been absent for rather longer than intended...
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ARENVALD_000_010: Welcome back, . How was your audience with the sultana?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_015: In your absence, I have kept myself busy cataloging the riches of the mad king's trove and calculating its worth in gil. I have some way to go, but the figure is already quite staggering.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_020: Oh, uh...greetings, ! I'm actually in the middle of reporting to the commander here, so...
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_030: ! You're back! What did Nanamo─ Oh! Sorry... Are you allowed to talk about your audience with the sultana?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_031: So...Raubahn says he's going to return to Ul'dah...but she isn't sure he wants to.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_032: Hmph. Tell us something we don't know... But I'm pleased to hear she's committed to helping our refugees come home.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_033: And this plan to revitalize the Saltery does make a lot of sense. Quite how you convinced her to seek Lolorito's help is another question. After all that has happened, he is the very last person I would expect her to turn to for advice.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_034: But on a more practical note─Lyse, assuming the interim government elects to accept Ul'dah's proposal, I have one caveat I should like you to include in the bargain.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Ala Mhigo must be permitted to cover a portion of the investment. We have a fortune at our disposal, after all, and allowing Ul'dah to provide the entirety of the capital will afford Lolorito too much control.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_036: Honestly, Alphinaud─it's like Kugane never happened. What exactly does a ruthless profiteer have to do to earn your trust?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_037: But yes, you do make a good point. First things first, though, we need to discuss this proposal with the Saltery's residents.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_038: Wiscar─how do you fancy explaining the sultana's plan to your grandfather? I'd like to hear what Watt thinks of the idea before agreeing to anything.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_039: Right away, Commander. Would you mind coming along, ? I might need you to fill in the details.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Then I shall come as well. Should Watt wish to discuss figures, my knowledge of the nation's finances may prove useful.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ARENVALD_000_045: I'm leaving the business of dividing up the treasure to those who know about such things. I'm not proud to admit it, but every time I see a column of numbers, my eyes glaze over. One of these days, I'll have to ask Alphinaud to explain it all to me...
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_LYSE_000_050: I'll have to give Nanamo my thanks next time we meet. With this and everything else that's been happening, it really feels like things are gathering pace around here.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Ideally, one would want Ala Mhigo's stake to match Ul'dah's gil for gil... In combination with a cast-iron contract, that should serve to prevent Lolorito from making off with all of the profits...
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_060: Let's go and see Grandad! He's going to want to hear this!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_070: What manner of mischief brings you young'uns to old Watt this time, eh?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_071: They want to rebuild the Saltery, Grandad! , tell him about the deal!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_072: Well bugger me... We've never had the coin or the hands to put the place back to how it was─but it sounds like that's about to change!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_073: ...There's just one small wrinkle in your plan: it doesn't account for all the nasties queuing up to eat anyone who goes near the shore.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_074: The king used to send soldiers to cull the buggers, but the imperials weren't about to help the likes of us.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_075: Don't worry, Grandad─we'll take care of all that. Commander Hext has been talking about starting up regular patrols, and I'm sure she'd assign me to the loch if I asked.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_076: I'd appreciate that, Wiscar, my lad, truly I would. So, does this mean you've gotten better with that blade of yours?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_077: I've been training, aye...but mostly to kill imperials.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_078: You've some experience hunting monsters, don't you, ? Think you could cast an eye over a few of the local beasties and teach me how to deal with 'em?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_079: Let's not waste any time, then! I'll see you by the loch!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Whilst you are busy attending to the local fauna, I shall have Master Watt explain to me exactly what is required to restore the Saltery to its former glory. Good hunting!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_085: Needless to say, I shall impress upon our friend here the singular importance of securing a fair contract with his Ul'dahn benefactors.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_090: It does my heart good to see youngsters like my grandson giving their all to rebuild the country. Feels like anything's possible.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_100: Right then, . I've got a spyglass here you can use to take a closer look at these pests. Once you've got their measure, you can tell me what to do, and we'll see how well I get on!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_SYSTEM_000_101: Search your surroundings for yabbies. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a yabby and inspect it with .
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_SYSTEM_100_101: The yabby's entire body is protected by a hard carapace, but the underside of the head looks soft and vulnerable.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_102: Ah, looks like you've found a yabby. They say hitting their shell's like smacking a rock. Any suggestions?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_Q1_000_000: What's the best way to defeat a yabby?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_A1_000_001: Aim for the soft underside of the head!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_A1_000_002: Just hit it as hard as you can!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_104: Vulnerable under the head, are they? R-Right then! Wish me luck!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_105: I... All right, then. I was hoping there'd be more of a trick to it, but brute force it is!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_110: Thanks, . I did just as you told me and the wavekin went down like a sack of popotoes! Let's find something else!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_120: I think I can handle the yabbies now, so we should try something different. What else is out there...?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_SYSTEM_000_121: Search your surroundings for phoebads. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a phoebad and inspect it with .
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_SYSTEM_100_121: The phoebad's hands are large and powerful, but destroying its crystallized core should render the salt golem inanimate. You sense power pulsating from behind its brow.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_122: Ugh...a phoebad. How do I defeat one of those?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_Q2_000_000: How should Wiscar defeat the phoebad?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_A2_000_001: Destroy the core within its brow!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_A2_000_002: Just hit it really, really hard! As hard as you can!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_124: Inside its head, is it? I'll try to stab it right between the eyes, then!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_125: As hard...as I can. Well, simple strategies are often the best! Here goes!
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_130:
<pant> <pant>
It's not easy...fighting with the liberator of Ala Mhigo watching your every...move. But I got the job done.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_131: Thanks for the advice, ! I feel a lot better prepared for my patrols now.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_132: Anyroad, we should head back to the Saltery before Grandad starts to worry I've been snipped into pieces and fed to a yabby's hatchlings.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_135: Let's hurry up and tell Grandad how the hunt went. It'll set his mind at ease.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_ALPHINAUD_000_136: For the merchants of Ul'dah, a well-constructed contract is both sword and shield, and Watt must understand this if we are to meet them on an even field. Speaking of battles, does Wiscar seem equal to the task of thinning the loch's monster population? He certainly seemed eager enough.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_140: I see you've returned in one piece. Dealt with those beasties then, did you?
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WISCAR_000_141: Aye, fought them myself...after a bit of instruction from  here, like. Once I've shared what I've learned with the others, we should have no trouble keeping the shoreline clear.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_142: Good lad. A fine young man you've become, Wiscar. A fine young man, indeed.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_143: Too often of late, I hear tales of folk over in the city, drunk on victory and hungry for revenge, their heads stuck firmly in the past.
TEXT_STMBDB109_02970_WATT_000_144: But we need to set our sights on the future─on things which'll improve our lot. Things like getting the Saltery ready to welcome our long-lost countrymen.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_WISCAR_000_005: Grandad and his friends are already hard at work─the rest of us can do no less, eh?
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ALPHINAUD_000_010: It seems Wiscar has the Saltery's security well in hand. I, meanwhile, have discussed the next steps with Master Watt, and completed my inspection of the site.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ALPHINAUD_000_011: With a little work, the vacant buildings here could be made into very presentable dwellings.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_FLAMEHERALD_000_013: Apologies for the interruption, , but the General would speak with you at your earliest convenience!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Do not feel obliged to wait around on my account. I will remain here to hammer out the finer details with Watt, and act as an intermediary with our business partners in Ul'dah. You should go.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_FLAMEHERALD_000_015: General Aldynn asked that you wait for him by the main gate in the Ala Mhigan Quarter. My apologies again, ! Fare you well!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_WATT_000_020: That Alphinaud's a bright lad, isn't he? I told him what we'd need to repair the place and he tallied up the total cost on the spot─and it weren't a small number, either!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_WISCAR_000_025: I'll ask Commander Hext to assign a squad to patrol the Saltery's harvesting and fishing spots. And I'll be sure to tell them what you told me!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Pray leave the administrative tasks to me. General Aldynn will be waiting.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ARENVALD_000_040: I was just on my way to the Saltery─it's lucky I saw you!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_PIPIN_000_045: Arenvald seems flustered. Something is amiss...
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RAUBAHN_000_050: That took longer than I intended, but at least you know where I stand.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ARENVALD_000_052: We may have a problem, sir.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ARENVALD_000_053: A group of Ananta has arrived at the main gates. And I don't mean the Vira. These are Qalyana─the ones that summoned the primal.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_ARENVALD_000_054: They're insisting they be allowed to attend the council. Lyse is trying to reason with them, but she may need help...
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_PIPIN_000_055: Hmm... An invitation was extended to all of the native beast tribes...but we assumed the Qalyana would refuse it out of hand.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RAUBAHN_000_056: We had best go and see for ourselves. Pipin, take command of our forces and be ready for battle.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RAUBAHN_000_057: ─you've dealt with these Qalyana before. I'd have you at my side.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_LYSE_000_060: ! Raubahn! Gods, it's good to see you...
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_QALYANAPATRIARCH_00: We have not forgotten how you sssinned againssst the Lady of Blisss...but we did not come here to shed blood.
You claim to ssseek harmony with all who call Gyr Abania home. If thisss is truly your wish, you will welcome usss as envoys of the Ananta!
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_LYSE_000_064: It is our wish, and you are welcome. But we cannot condone the summoning of primals.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_LYSE_000_065: If you want to enter the palace, I must ask that you first surrender any crystal jewelry. You have my word that it will all be returned to you when the meeting is over.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_QALYANAPATRIARCH_00: ...We will do as you asssk─but you will not have our weapons. We are not ssso foolish as to place ourssselves entirely at the mercy of our tormentors...
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RESISTANCEWARRIOR_0: I reckon that's the closest we're going to get to a compromise. And we will have people standing guard...
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RAUBAHN_000_068: Aye, let them keep their swords.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_QALYANAPATRIARCH_00: Then we have an agreement. Lead the way to your meeting chamber.
TEXT_STMBDB110_02971_RAUBAHN_000_070: Why do I have the feeling we've welcomed a viper into our midst...?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_001: Turning the Qalyana away now would've made a mockery of Lyse's promise to give everyone a say. She couldn't not let them in.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_010: This Qalyana elder's intentions seem at odds with all we know of her tribe. What think you, ?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_A1_000_002: Mayhap even the enthralled can learn to compromise?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_012: Aye, it is said that once a creature has fallen under the sway of a primal, there is no salvation. And I strongly doubt the Qalyana have suddenly broken free of Lakshmi's will.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_013: You believe an understanding can be reached? ...'Tis not entirely unheard of, I suppose: those who followed Saint Shiva eventually sought reconciliation with Ishgard.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_014: Whatever the truth, I would take no chances. The guard must be strengthened─ideally with people who know a thing or two about primals. Can we rely on the Scions?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_015: I'll round up our comrades, and send them to the Ala Mhigan Quarter. You can go on ahead if you like, .
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_016: My thanks. I will see you in the palace.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Arenvald told me of the arrival of our unexpected guests, and I agreed that it would be prudent to call upon Y'shtola and Thancred as well.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_YSHTOLA_000_022: One can never be too careful when dealing with the enthralled.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_THANCRED_000_023: I am not familiar with the Qalyana tribe myself, but Alisaie's report suggested that they shunned contact with other races. Despised it, in fact. Even compared to other Ananta.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Indeed. This apparent reversal in attitude is most curious. No one expected a response to our invitation, much less an envoy, and I imagine Lyse was forced to make some rather hasty arrangements in order to accommodate them.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_025: Speaking of which, how should we deploy ourselves?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_YSHTOLA_000_026: If the meeting is to be held in the throne room, 'twould seem wise to have eyes both inside and outside the palace.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_THANCRED_000_027: Y'shtola and I can stand guard without. That leaves the three of you to keep watch over proceedings in the throne room itself.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Understood. We should join General Aldynn inside, then.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_029: , do you know of the rear entrance to the palace? It's on the eastern edge of the city, at the top of the stairs. The guard there should have been instructed to let us pass.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_030: If we could somehow come to an understanding with the Qalyana, it would represent a great step toward resolving the primal dilemma in Ala Mhigo. I only hope they are sincere in their intentions...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_035: The rear entrance to the palace is just up these steps. The guard should wave us through.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_YSHTOLA_000_040: As fortune would have it, I was visiting Rhalgr's Reach to look in on Alisaie. She sends her regards.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_THANCRED_000_045: Leave external security to us, . I scouted around the palace quite extensively while I was searching for Krile, so I know the lay of the land.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: You're with the Scions, ? General Aldynn left orders that you were to be escorted inside. If you'll follow me...
Will you be entering the palace now?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_060: How do we fight her without leaving our allies wide open? We can't stay on the back foot forever...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_061: ...No, dammit, if I think like that we've already lost. I have the Warrior of Light at my side! W-We can do this!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_SYSTEM_000_063: Use the duty action Deflect to dissipate the aether spheres Lakshmi releases during the battle.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_SYSTEM_000_064: Be warned that allowing an ally to be enthralled by an aether sphere will result in failure.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_070: Well fought, . Arenvald. That was a near thing.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_071: Aye, our stand against the Qalyana would have been brief indeed had you not volunteered for guard duty.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_072: We'd be enthralled as surely as our sentries were. They must have planned this far in advance...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_073: Security was my responsibility, and I know how dangerous primals can be. I should have─ Gah! It's my fault. My stupid mistake.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_074: Nay, lass, we were all caught unawares. We will take this as a lesson, and watch our own more carefully in future.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_075: You can be sure that the lackeys who smuggled the crystals into the throne room weren't the only thralls in our ranks. The soldier who first spoke up in favor of the Qalyana keeping their weapons springs to mind...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_YSHTOLA_000_076: A primal's servant is betrayed by his aura. If you mean to conduct an investigation, I can identify any others acting under Sri Lakshmi's influence.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_077: Thanks, Y'shtola. We'd appreciate the help.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_078: Speaking of help, I almost fell over when Fordola turned up. What was she even doing there?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_081: It's sad, but Raganfrid was right: her victims will never forgive her for what she's done.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_082: But I don't think Fordola picked up that sword looking for forgiveness. She just...she wanted to fight for her country.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_083: If you say the world in which Fordola grew up is partly to blame for what she became, then as an Ala Mhigan, I feel responsible for improving that world.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_084: We can't ignore what's happening right now─we have to show people a better way than vengeance, or we risk giving birth to a new generation of Skulls...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_085: I know it's idealistic, but I want to help people to let go of their old grievances and make peace with each other. And I'll hold a thousand meetings and talk till I'm blue in the face if that's what it takes.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_086: 'Tis a long and arduous path you have chosen, but one well worth walking. Rest assured that I will do what I can to help you reach your destination.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_087: Thank you, Alphinaud. The first step will be to get our representatives back in the throne room. They're a little shaken, but not one of them seemed ready to run. We're all determined to finish what we started.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_088: I will see that you're not interrupted. ─you and the Scions are to stand down. Get some rest. You've earned it.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Arenvald is of an age with Fordola, both of them born Ala Mhigan. One never wanted his Garlean blood, and the other tried to become Garlean but could never be.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_095: Similar yet opposite─which would go some way to explaining the tension between them.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_100: I went to see Fordola in her cell again. She did turn the tide of the battle after all, and I thought it only right to thank her.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_105: But she wouldn't listen─said she neither wanted nor needed my gratitude, and that I should go away. I don't know if I'll ever understand her...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Lyse must be overjoyed to know that General Aldynn is staying...though I suppose I shouldn't call him “General” anymore.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ARENVALD_000_115: Raubahn is the veteran of a hundred battlefields. Lyse couldn't ask for a more reliable ally to have at her side.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_NANAMOULNAMO_000_12: I have asked enough of you, . My only words for you now are those of gratitude.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_PIPIN_000_125: I must assume Father's responsibilities without delay, lest our rivals─both inside and outside Ul'dah─treat his dismissal as a window of opportunity. Rest assured, they will find Tizona's edge just as sharp in my hands.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_RAUBAHN_000_130: It seems my road has come full circle. I appreciate the support you showed for my earlier decision, overruled though it was!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_140: I think it's about time I headed back to Rhalgr's Reach. What's next for all of you?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Alisaie will be eager to hear of recent events, so I shall join you, if you've no objections.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_142: I'd welcome the company! , why don't you come along to the Reach as well once you've said your farewells to Nanamo and the others.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_SYSTEM_000_143: Upon completion of this quest, you will be able to access the palace's rooftop gardens by speaking to the Royal Menagerie attendant.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALISAIE_000_151: Alphinaud has regaled me with a thrilling tale of hidden treasure troves, mid-meeting betrayals, unlikely alliances, and joyous homecomings. It would seem I missed...everything.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_MNAAGO_000_152: I was patrolling the palace grounds with Thancred and Y'shtola when we heard the report of a primal in the throne room. I honestly doubted my own ears.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_MNAAGO_000_153: As others have said, we were lucky to have our Echo-blessed champions nearby this time, but we'll need to keep a closer eye on the Qalyana...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_154: You can say that again. This whole episode has reminded me just how far apart our kinds still are. It looks like centuries of fear and mistrust really can't be washed away in a day. But someone has to make an effort at reconciliation if these conflicts are ever going to end.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_155: Naturally, a lot of people are crying out for vengeance, but I've been doing my best to calm things down. Violent reprisals will only lead to more summonings.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_156: Indeed. Violence will ever beget violence─as the Empire has learned to its cost in recent times.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_157: In any case, summoning Lakshmi was the broodmother's doing, and whoever replaces her might not be so keen on the idea. We'll just have to watch and wait.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_158: Which isn't to say we won't be putting the safety of our allies in the Vira and M tribes first. I plan to have Resistance scouts keep track of the Qalyana's movements at all times.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_MNAAGO_000_159: My parents will be relieved to hear that. What are your plans for the rest of the Resistance army, out of interest? Are we to prepare for imperial counterattacks?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_160: That would be a question for the Resistance's newest recruit─a military commander with far more experience than me!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_MNAAGO_000_161: What? The Bull of Ala Mhigo!?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_162: We call it an army, but the Resistance is really a collection of smaller, independent groups. And when Conrad passed his command on to me, that authority only extended to the freedom fighters based in Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_163: He just happened to be serving as the Resistance spokesman at the time, and needed someone to take over the role while everything was in disarray. But that time has passed.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_164: When I speak with the other leaders about reforming the army under the new government, I'll be nominating Raubahn as the overall commander of our forces. He has more experience than the rest of us put together, and we stand to learn a lot from him.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_165: Indeed. He is in all respects the ideal choice. Assuming he accepts the post, Ala Mhigo will have added a formidable weapon to its arsenal.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_ALPHINAUD_000_166: And given the progress of Nanamo's resettlement initiative, I see great cause for hope. The seeds which we so carefully sowed have begun to quicken, my friends.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_LYSE_000_167: I like that. We tend to our promises, and watch as Ala Mhigo blooms.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_170: I do give thanks to the kami that my makeshift raft withstood the fury of the seas...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_171: But there their generosity ended. Without coins in our pockets for new attire, we are doomed to look like so much jetsam. O, woe betide the poor man in a city of rich merchants...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_YOTSUYU_000_172: These dango are delicious! Will you have one?
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_173: Hm!? More sweetbreads!? I surrendered my blade to secure what few coins we have!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_174: Bah! 'Tis like talking to a child...
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_175: Why fate saddled me with this burden I shall never know...but I am alive, and I must return to my master's side!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GOSETSU_000_176: Come, Tsuyu. We shall find a ship to carry us across the Ruby Sea!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GARLEANLEADERD_000_: Have you read the reports? First Doma, then Ala Mhigo─and Lord Zenos put to the sword!
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GARLEANLEADERE_000_: Do not believe everything you read. I hear the viceroy was merely wounded, and that he has already returned to the capital. Naturally, the savages beat their chests, and boast loudly of taking his head, regardless.
Deplorable. That our own officers should be fooled by Eorzean misinformation...
Small wonder the provinces have begun rising up in rebellion. We must prepare an official, and above all accurate announcement to quell these pernicious rumors.
TEXT_STMBDB111_02972_GARLEANLEADERD_000_:
They would wage war with empty words...
Let them produce the viceroy's remains, then! We shall soon put the lie to their claims.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_000: ! Great timing! I was just about to send word to the Scions. I've got lots to tell you!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_001: The council has officially recognized the Resistance as our standing army. And I expect you can guess who's been appointed commander. Suffice it to say, we're in good hand!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_002: Having the Bull of Ala Mhigo at the helm's done wonders for morale. People were dancing in the streets when the announcement was made. And we have you and the sultana to thank for it. If you two hadn't worked your magic, he'd never have contemplated following his heart.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_MNAAGO_000_003: The council has also decreed that we're to maintain a presence at Rhalgr's Reach. Lyse will continue to lead our forces in the Fringes─a job she's been doing tirelessly. A bit too tirelessly, some might say. We're constantly having to remind her to rest before she falls over.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_004: That's an exaggeration─and I always get up again. Anyway, we can hardly afford to lower our guard now. Not after our latest brush with Lakshmi. Speaking of which, we've been keeping a close eye on the Qalyana, and it looks like they've chosen a new leader.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_005: It's, um...Shanti's daughter. You know, the half-dead one. For whatever reason, the Qalyana thought she was the best candidate. Which makes them leaderless, basically.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_006: As things stand, there's no prospect of engaging in talks, let alone coming to an understanding.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_007: But I won't let that stop me. I'll keep on reaching out to them until they finally see sense.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_008: Just like I've been reaching out to Fordola. She still won't meet my gaze, but she's given up trying to ignore me. It may only be the odd grunt, but at least she's responding. I'll get through to her yet.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_011: Alphinaud, Alisaie! Is everything all right?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_012: We've received word from Tataru. Hancock has apparently acquired information of great interest and urgency. More than that she didn't say─only that we should come to Kugane right away.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_013: I had a mind for the two of us to set forth together, but Alisaie is determined to make it a party of three.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_014: As I've told you more than a dozen times, Brother, my wounds are quite healed, and I would benefit from some fresh air. Besides, you may well need an extra pair of hands.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Worry not, Sister, I have quite given up trying to convince you.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_100_015: Whether we be two or three, we should depart as soon as possible. You will be joining us, I trust?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_016: Huh. I was about to say I'd come too, but I'll just have to settle for cheering you on from afar. Good luck with...whatever it turns out to be!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Thank you, Lyse. Rest assured, should this business prove to be of even tangential concern to Ala Mhigo, we shall inform you without delay.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_018: Let us be off, then. Hancock and Tataru await us at the Ruby Bazaar offices.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_LYSE_000_020: Give Tataru a hug from me, all right?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_MNAAGO_000_025: I hope all goes well in Kugane. Safe travels.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_EATCASSISTANT_000_0: Greetings, honored . May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_HANCOCK_000_040: The informant awaits your pleasure in the back streets of Sanjo Hanamachi. From its shining facade to its dark underbelly, few know Kugane as intimately as he.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_041: “One of the finest informants money can buy”... Why do I have a bad feeling about this?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_SOROBAN_000_042: Permit me to assist you in your quest, my friends. The sooner your business is concluded, the sooner we may speak of mine!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_SOROBAN_000_043: Should your search take you away from Kugane, my boat is at your disposal. I shall see that she is ready to sail.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_TATARU_000_044: I'll give Soroban a hand. If he's providing us a ship, the least we can do is supply the provisions. We'll be at the pier if you need us.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_045: A welcome offer and an excellent plan. Without further ado, then, let us seek out this informant in Sanjo Hanamachi.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_HANCOCK_000_050: As I mentioned, the informant awaits your pleasure in the back streets of Sanjo Hanamachi. I can confidently vouch for the quality of his intelligence...if little else.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Given the Empire's movements, it seems highly probable that Gosetsu and Yotsuyu were indeed in Kugane. Yet I can offer no explanation as to why they should be together.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_YUGIRI_000_055: You have had dealings with informants in this city, have you not? Perchance you are already acquainted with this one.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_060: This should be the place. Now we wait and see who comes.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_061: (-???-)I-It has been a while, my friends. Yes, yes, a long while indeed.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_063: Gyodo─any funny business, and you know what will happen, I trust?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_064: No, no! No funny business! Only loyal service and the finest-quality information! O-Of course...such quality does not come cheap...
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_065: ...No. But then Hancock already paid you. Honestly, you must think we were born yesterday. I've half a mind to call Lyse.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_066: No, no! No Lyse, I beg you! No boots! I will tell you everything I know─free of charge!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_067: The Empire searches for Yotsuyu. High and low, far and wide. Come to enlist my help, they did, promising rich rewards for decisive information.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_068: And have you decisive information? Were the two individuals sighted here indeed Gosetsu and Yotsuyu?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_069: Alas, see them with my own eyes, I did not. But the imperials are confident. Yes, yes, very confident indeed. Look at the size of their contingent!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_070: But here is something they do not know... A rumor which you will find most interesting, I think. They say an elderly Roegadyn samurai appeared on Kogane Dori with a beauteous maiden, and sold his katana to a pawnbroker. 'Twas no common katana either, but one of surpassing craftsmanship.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_100_071: Well, that is interesting─assuming it's true. Did you corroborate the rumor with the pawnbroker in question?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_071: Ah, er...no. Regrettably, I do not have a working relationship with the master of Shofuku Shichiten...
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_100_072: Now why would that be, I wonder. If I didn't know better, I'd think he'd lent you money...
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_072: Ahem! H-He will help you, I am certain! While you speak with him, I will make contact with my Garlean connections and learn what I can of their progress.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_YUGIRI_000_073: A glimpse of the blade is all I need to be sure. But is it wise to let the Namazu out of our sight?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_080: No other choice but this! And a fine choice it is! Though I am adept at gathering information, it is so much more efficient to share the work!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_085: No, no! No more betrayals! No more boots! To divide our forces is simply more efficient!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_090: D-Do not glare at me so, I beg you. To divide our forces is simply more efficient!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_095:
He's right. Given the urgency, we would do well to split up.
And so I will go with our friend here. Nothing improves efficiency like a little supervision.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_GYODO_000_097: You─ But─ Er...yes. Yes, yes. We will go together. And there will be no boots!
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALISAIE_000_098: Let's be about it, then. Good luck with the katana. Shall we reconvene at the pier later on? Fragrant as the Ruby Bazaar offices are, I prefer the fresh air.
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_ALPHINAUD_000_099: I believe Alisaie has her task well in hand. Shall we seek out the pawnbroker?
TEXT_STMBDC101_03022_SYSTEM_000_500: You have learned the emote Greeting!
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_100_000: Is it not strange that we should be compelled to turn to one who betrayed both you and Gosetsu to the Empire? I would say the fates made mock of us...had I not met Hancock.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Everything in order? Then let us proceed to Kogane Dori and find the master of Shofuku Shichiten.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Simply utter the word “pawnbroker,” and a score of them gather around you. Finding our man may not be quite as simple as I thought.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_015: I have yet to identify the pawnbroker in question. Have your inquiries proven any more fruitful?
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ROUGHPAWNBROKER0302: A Roegadyn samurai and a maiden? Never seen 'em. Now, if you don't have any business with me, make way for someone who does!
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_SYSTEM_000_021: This doesn't seem to be the pawnbroker you seek.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_SMILEPAWNBROKER0302: Hmm...we might have had customers like those you describe. So many people come through, it's difficult to remember. Perhaps you could jog my memory by making a purchase? ...No? Well, you can't blame a woman for trying! Heh heh!
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_SYSTEM_000_026: This doesn't seem to be the pawnbroker you seek.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_000: Welcome, good , welcome. Will you be buying or...?
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_100: Ah, so you have heard tell of the Roegadyn samurai's katana. Small wonder─it is a fine example of its kind. One moment...
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_100_030: Dare I hope you have found our pawnbroker?
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_101_030: Excellent work, . And that is the katana?
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_031: There can be no doubt. It is Gosetsu's blade.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_000: (-Master of Shofuku Shichiten-)The craftsmanship is exquisite, is it not? And you will be pleased to know that the pledge has just expired.

(-Master of Shofuku Shichiten-)I should be glad to sell it to you...assuming you have the coin. This is no ordinary weapon, you understand, and it is priced accordingly. But if you are serious, I suggest you act quickly, as several noted collectors have already expressed an interest.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_034:
Hmm... The blade represents conclusive proof of Gosetsu's survival. I suppose this could be considered a necessary cost in securing his safe return...
Yet it is not a decision I can make alone─least of all when our nation has scarce begun to rebuild.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_A1_000_002: I could lend you the coin.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_040: Nay, my friend. Grateful though I am for the offer, I cannot ask this of you. It is enough to know that Gosetsu is alive and well.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_045: Nay, my friend. Grateful though I am for the offer, I cannot ask this of you. It is enough to know that Gosetsu is alive and well.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Yugiri, wait. The Scions will buy the katana. Pray consider it a gift.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_057: M-Master Alphinaud, your kindness is touching, truly. Yet, in matters of coin, would Mistress Tataru not expect to be consulted?
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_058: Come now. Our friend would never have relinquished his blade were the need not great. And are we not bound by honor to help a friend in need? I say we are─and I am sure Tataru will wholeheartedly agree.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_000: (-Master of Shofuku Shichiten-)It's settled, then! You have made a wise choice, my friend─such pieces are few and far between! Now, if you would be so good as to come this way, I shall prepare the necessary papers.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_064: If I may ask, sir, after he visited your establishment, do you perchance know where the old samurai went? He is our friend, and we would return his weapon to him.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_000: (-Master of Shofuku Shichiten-)A friend of yours, you say? I see. Well then, I suppose there can be no harm in telling you. No sooner had I provided him with the requested sum than his pretty young companion began clamoring for dango. I duly recommended those served at the Umineko Teahouse, and thither did they set off.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_066: ...Clamoring for dango? Can these truly be the same people? It makes no sense.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_067: Some manner of code, perhaps. But it avails us naught to speculate. Let us go to this teahouse and see if we can pick up their trail.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_PAWNBROKER03023_000: If you're looking for your friends, you could do worse than try the Umineko Teahouse. I make no guarantees of course...
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_ALPHINAUD_000_073: This is the proprietor of the teahouse. Let us find out what she knows.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_075: The Gosetsu I knew had little time for teahouses... No wine.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_UME_000_080: But of course I remember! How could I forget a pair like that? The most beautiful girl you'll ever see, scoffing down dango as if her life depended on it while the old samurai looked on. Not quite what he expected, I'll wager!
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_UME_000_081: Far be it from me to gossip about my customers, but he was planning to spirit her away across the Ruby Sea─out of the reach of her family, no doubt. When the girl had finally had her fill, they set off in the direction of the Shiokaze Hostelry, presumably to find someone discreet with a boat.
TEXT_STMBDC102_03023_YUGIRI_000_083: But this woman who travels with him... The more I hear about her, the more I wonder if she can truly be Yotsuyu.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_100_00: For all our success in tracing Gosetsu's movements, how he came to be traveling with Yotsuyu remains a mystery─to say nothing of this dango business...
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_000: While doubts remain over the identity of Gosetsu's traveling companion, for now we can but follow the trail.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_001: Come, let us away to the pier, and make ready to sail. With luck, Alisaie will already have joined Master Soroban and Mistress Tataru there.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_010: The others all did their part. I am truly blessed to have such dependable comrades.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Apparently, Gyodo did his duty and then promptly excused himself. Couldn't bear another moment under Alisaie's withering gaze, I expect.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_020: I watched Gyodo meet with his imperial associate, and I have to say I'm impressed. He has sycophancy down to a fine art.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TATARU_000_025: While we were arranging the provisions, Soroban told me all about his many business ventures. Honestly, his nose for profit puts mine to shame!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_030: Excellent timing, my friends. Mistress Alisaie arrived mere moments ago.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_031: All went well at my end. Gyodo met with an imperial officer and wheedled his way to some new information.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_032: It seems the troops who recently arrived in Kugane came directly from Garlemald. The imperials based here have been kept in the dark.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_033: And that's not all. A contingent of the aforementioned troops are preparing for deployment to the Ruby Sea. If I didn't know better, I'd say they'd picked up Gosetsu's trail.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Then your information matches ours. We are quite certain that Gosetsu seeks to cross to the mainland.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TATARU_000_035: I'm sorry─did I hear that right? You used Scion funds to buy Gosetsu's katana...at the asking price?
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Aye, well, we were in some haste, and it seemed a worthwhile gesture. Speaking of which, here is the contract of sale. Pray see that the man is paid.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TATARU_000_037: Thal's...beard. You agreed to this? Give me strength...
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TATARU_000_038: <sigh> Well, it's not like the search can wait. You'd best be on your way.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TATARU_100_038: But Alphinaud─we need to talk. I want you to come straight to the offices as soon as you get back. Promise me.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Oh? Very well. I shall call upon you as soon as I return.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_044: First, let us go to the Ruby Price. If Gosetsu has already set sail, the sentries there are sure to have seen him.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_050: Judging by her reaction, Mistress Tataru is none too pleased. I apologize if the katana has caused strife.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_055: (What is the going rate for a priceless weapon, I wonder... And now I know who not to ask.)
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_060: Mistress Tataru seems in low spirits. Happily, my latest venture may prove just the tonic.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Tataru seemed rather vexed, did she not? Ever the melodramatist. I am sure our finances can stretch to a single sword.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Remind me to explain the value of such gestures when we next see her. Ah, but I digress. We have work to do.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_080: Few suffered more at Yotsuyu's hands than Gosetsu. If this is his wish, so be it.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_GOSETSU_000_083: With you and yours at our side, we have naught to fear. Thank you, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TANSUI_000_088: ...You still here? Do us a favor and take that damnable woman far away before she calls down more destruction upon us.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_RASHO_000_090: Word has reached me of the attack on Sakazuki. It seems we are in your debt yet again.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_HIUN_000_093: That imperial craft appeared like a bolt out of the blue. By the time we had gathered our wits, it was already above our heads.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SHIHOJI_000_095: Hmph, were I thirty years younger, I'd have made short work of the likes of them...
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUSUI_000_098: Things could've been a lot worse. The imperials could've come here looking for blood.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_100: As Tansui says, we should move on. It would not do for Yotsuyu to be seen here.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Now, if I know my sister, she will already be waiting with the boat at the nearby pier. Let's go and see if I'm right.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_105: Gosetsu lives. All other considerations should pale next to that. And yet...
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_GOSETSU_000_108: I understand I have the Scions to thank for my katana's safe return. A samurai's blade is his soul, and no words will suffice to express my gratitude for reuniting me with mine.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_113: Are we certain she is the real Yotsuyu?
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_115: And here she is, just as I anticipated. I am only surprised she agreed to hold off until the Empire withdrew.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_120: Gosetsu! Thank the gods you're safe! It was all I could do to watch the battle from afar!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_121: And it was all I could do to restrain her.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_123: Can you blame me for worrying? Strong as  is, anything could happen in the chaos.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_124: ...But enough about me. We need to talk about her.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_126: They tell me you've lost your memory─and that's fine. But I want you to know something: I won't be taking my eyes off you. Not for a moment.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YOTSUYU_000_127: These people are strange. Are you sure they're your friends?
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_GOSETSU_000_128: I am. They may behave...strangely, but I trust them with my life. You have naught to fear.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YOTSUYU_000_129: All right, if you say so.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_133: R-Right! 'Tis past time we set sail! I for one would not keep Lord Hien waiting without due cause.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_136: Aye, and the longer we tarry, the more we risk inviting trouble. Lest you forget, the Red Kojin bear no love for Yotsuyu either.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_137: I shall deliver you to familiar shores, near Isari but out of the villagers' sight.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_000_140: Let us make haste to the city. Lord Hien must know of this.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Though I only know Yotsuyu by reputation, this woman could scarce seem more different.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_145: We'd do well to give Isari a wide berth─for everyone's sake.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_GOSETSU_000_150: Another time, Tsuyu. Our path takes us in a different direction.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YOTSUYU_000_155: Are we going to that village? They might have dango!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_160: Here is where we part ways, my friends. I pray the remainder of your journey passes uneventfully.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_161: , when you are not otherwise occupied, I would speak with you about my next business venture.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_162: It promises to be extremely lucrative, and I do not say so lightly.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_SOROBAN_000_163: After the prodigious sum spent acquiring a certain sword, it would present a fine opportunity to refill the Scions' coffers and restore the smile to Mistress Tataru's face!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_164: Oh, come along─Tataru was overreacting. How much could a single katana possibly cost?
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_165: Far more than you think, plainly.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALISAIE_000_166: A blade like Gosetsu's is worth a fortune. Enough to buy a house and furnish it. Which you would know had you bothered to check the price.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_000_168: Th-This business venture of Soroban's─you will give it fair hearing, I trust? He has been good to us, after all! As for me, I...I think I shall look into drawing upon my personal funds...
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: No time to rest, Master Alphinaud! Our allies are sorely pressed!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TANSUI_BATTLETALK_0: Well, look who it is. I won't say no to the help, but I'm not best pleased that we need it.
You're here for the old man, yes? He's at the top. You'd best hurry.
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_LEADER_BATTLETALK_0: Focus on the enemy! We'll see to Lady Yotsuyu when they're dead!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Come, let us even the odds!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: That they should still have magitek armor in reserve... Steel yourselves!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_LEADER_BATTLETALK_0: Bah, we have no time for this!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_TANSUI__BATTLETALK_: Watch out! He means to blow it up!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_LEADER_BATTLETALK_0: Damn it! Reinforcements! I need more reinforcements!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0:
Two of them... We shall need a strategy.
, draw the armor this way!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_LEADER_BATTLETALK_0: Stubborn swine─you force my hand! Deploy the hexadrone!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Have care! We know not what we face!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_LEADER_BATTLETALK_0: Activate turrets! Fire! Fire at will!
All forces─to me! Forget the rest!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: There are too many... Draw them to me─I shall finish this!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: Mist and shade─take form and go forth!
, my shadows and I shall tend to half. The rest is yours!
TEXT_STMBDC103_03024_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL:
All right─brace yourselves!
Stars above...rain destruction upon mine enemies!
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_100_000: I confess, I have never had much cause to consider the state of my personal finances...until now. Confound it...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_105_000: He's absolutely mortified, isn't he! Well, maybe he'll think twice before making his next grand gesture. If he ever missed an opportunity to show me how much more mature and responsible he is, I'd sympathize. I mean, I do, to a point─but that doesn't mean I'm about to let him forget this.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_110_000: Another time, Tsuyu. Our path takes us in a different direction.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YOTSUYU_115_000: Are we going to that village? They might have dango!
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_000: We must meet with Lord Hien as soon as possible─though mayhap not at the enclave...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_001: I will send word requesting that he receive us at the House of the Fierce, where there are fewer prying eyes.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_002: If all are in agreement, I shall scout ahead and see that the way is clear. Pray follow as swiftly as you are able, and join me on the outskirts of Namai.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_021: Good. The others are hiding nearby. Let us proceed─quietly, if you please.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_040: Thank you for delivering Gosetsu back to us in one piece. We are lucky indeed to have friends who would journey to the other side of the world to help us─and repeatedly, at that.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_041: We have much and more to think upon, but as regards the Empire, we can but watch and wait.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_042: Now then, seeing as you've come all this way, you must allow me to show you around the enclave. I would not have you thinking we've been idle in your absence.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_100_042: The rebuilding effort proceeds apace, I'm pleased to say, and we are now ready to welcome home our countrymen who were displaced by the war. Should they so desire it, there is a place here for those who fled to Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_043: We should be delighted to accept your invitation, Lord Hien. And I have no doubt that your subjects at Revenant's Toll will be heartened to hear that their lord has not forgotten them.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_044: ...Hm? Oh, it's nothing. I just thought that Gosetsu and Yugiri would be back by now.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_045: Forgive me, my lord, but Captain Jifuya is nowhere to be found.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_046: Oh? He was here when I arrived.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_000_047: For now, we have taken Yotsuyu to a private chamber and assigned another to watch over her, my lord. But I find it passing strange that the captain should leave his post with nary a word.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_048: That does seem most unusual. If you mean to look for the man, we would be happy to assist you.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_049: We should be glad of the help. While I search without, mayhap you could ask our soldiers here if they know anything.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_051: With respect, my lord, you should remain here. Should the Empire move against us, you will be better able to coordinate our response.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_052: Hah! And there I was thinking I was in charge... But you have the right of it. Go on, then. I will mind the House.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_055: It should come as no surprise, but a number of the soldiers here were unsettled by Yotsuyu's arrival. Thankfully, Lord Hien was able to put their minds at ease. For now.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_000_060: We must find Jifuya, and quickly. His disappearance would be cause to worry at the best of times, but that it should coincide with our arrival is more worrying still.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_062: All here know Jifuya well. His movements will not have gone unnoticed.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HANAME_000_070: You seek the captain? He passed by a little while ago.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HANAME_000_071: I, uh... I wondered if I should tell someone, as it happens. He did not look well, you see. I asked if aught was the matter and he told me the past had caught up with him. But I doubt it was that. There are older men in our ranks.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_KAIDATE_000_075: Captain Jifuya? He was headed for the northern entrance when I saw him last. I was going to invite him to train with us, but he did not hear me call out to him.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_KAIDATE_000_076: If you need him, I daresay the sentry on duty will be able to tell you more. Indeed, I suggested as much to Mistress Alisaie when she came asking earlier. Is something amiss?
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HANAME_000_083: If Captain Jifuya is unwell, it has nothing to do with the past catching up with him, whatever he may think. I should have said as much when he passed by...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_KAIDATE_000_088: As I keep saying, Captain Jifuya was headed for the northern entrance when I last saw him. If you wish to know where he went after that, you could do worse than ask the sentry on duty.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_080: It should come as no surprise, but a number of the soldiers here were unsettled by Yotsuyu's arrival. Thankfully, Lord Hien was able to put their minds at ease. For now.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_085: All here know Jifuya well. His movements will not have gone unnoticed.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_090: I see the trail led you here as well. This man says he saw Jifuya leave.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_RESISTANCE03025_000: Aye, the captain went outside some few bells ago─and looking quite unwell, I am sorry to say. This I mentioned to Lord Gosetsu, who straightways struck out after him. I hope they will be all right...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_092: Gosetsu too? It seems everyone is bent on joining the search.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_093: That's all well and good, but someone has to stay behind. There's no telling what the Empire is plotting.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_094: You go on, . Alphinaud and I shall hold the fort.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Alisaie has apprised me of the situation. Leave the House to us and focus on the search.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_103: Yotsuyu appears to be behaving herself─for now.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_105: So Jifuya went for some fresh air, did he? Whatever his business may be, I hope you find him soon.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_108: The captain went outside looking quite unwell. Lord Gosetsu has since gone to find him.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_000_110: He does not appear to have come this way...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_112: So Jifuya did venture outside. Wherever he is, he cannot yet have gone far.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Have you not seen Yugiri? We need everyone present, and urgently.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_118: Jifuya can't be the only one here with a mortal fear of Yotsuyu. She tormented these people.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_120: Gosetsu told me Jifuya's tale. His past conduct was...regrettable. But the man has served the Liberation Front with distinction for years, and that should not be forgotten. He will have his new post.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_000_123: Hm? Was Yugiri not with you?
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_130: Forgive me, now is not the time for brooding. Come, let us rejoin the others.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALPHINAUD_000_135: Everyone is here. Good. There have been developments that demand our immediate attention.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_ALISAIE_000_138: Jifuya can't be the only one here with a mortal fear of Yotsuyu. She tormented these people.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_GOSETSU_000_140: That her mere presence should sow such strife...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_YUGIRI_000_143: Lord Hien and Master Alphinaud look troubled... Something is afoot.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_150: I thank you for your help in the search. Gosetsu has told me all that transpired.
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_152: I would not presume to defend the life Jifuya led before he joined the Front. Nor will I condemn it. Frankly, it is not my place to judge. I will only say this: the Jifuya I know has ever been a man of courage. That he should feel driven to flee bespeaks the depth of his terror. Even now, Yotsuyu casts a shadow over the realm...
TEXT_STMBDC104_03025_HIEN_000_153: But the question of what is to be done with her must wait. The Empire is on the move once more.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_100_000: It is as Lord Hien says. The Empire is on the move. And we, as ever, find ourselves on the back foot...
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_105_000: Jifuya can't be the only one here with a mortal fear of Yotsuyu. She tormented these people.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_GOSETSU_110_000: That her mere presence should sow such strife...
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_115_000: Lord Hien and Master Alphinaud look troubled... Something is afoot.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_000: While you were out searching for Jifuya, we received word from our shinobi allies: an imperial airship has been sighted over Doman soil.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_001: Our visitors' objective remains unclear. It may be another attempt to recover Yotsuyu...or a prelude to invasion.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_002: Either way, the craft reportedly advances at speed, and appears bound for Castrum Fluminis. I mean to go there and ascertain their intent.
