TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_003: If we ride out in force, it will only end one way, so we shall keep our numbers to a minimum. Yugiri, ─can I count on you?
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Alisaie and I would fain play our part as well. We will not stand idly by while a common foe threatens the lands of our friends and allies.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_006: We would be glad of the help. You are acquainted with Hakuro, I believe? Then I bid you seek him out and assist in maintaining order in the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_007: When the people see an imperial airship, they are liable to panic. I would have you reassure them, and, should it come to it, aid in their evacuation.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Very well. We shall depart at once. Do take care.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_010: The Empire may well be after Yotsuyu. You are to remain here and guard her until my return.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_GOSETSU_000_012: ...As you wish. Pray stay close to  and Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_013: Well, well... Guard duty and not a breath of protest. Now I have seen it all.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_014: To Castrum Fluminis, then. Let us find out what the Empire's game is.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_000_023: Doma is ill-equipped to deal with an aerial offensive. Should the Empire be so minded, the Xaela's flying mounts would be our only hope.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_030: The area is secure. Whatever our visitors' purpose, they plainly believe they can achieve it alone.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_031: The craft should come into view at any moment. Let us await them inside the castrum.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_000_040: Peace... After all they have done. Never has the word rung more hollow.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ASAHI_000_045: I say, do I stand in the presence of the fabled eikon-slayer? What an honor.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_MAXIMA_000_050: Lord Hien is magnanimous in victory. Given our nations' troubled history, we did not expect such hospitality.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_060: We shall escort our guests across the river to the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_061: Yugiri, pray go on ahead to the Yuzuka Manor docks and see that the ferries are ready.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_070: Upon disembarking, we will proceed directly to my hall, where we may enjoy some privacy.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ASAHI_000_075: Such scenes of devastation greeted us on our journey here... The bitter wages of war.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_MAXIMA_000_080: I have read much about the architecture and geology of Doma... Words do not do it justice.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_000_090: Lord Hien and I will accompany the imperial delegation on the first ferry.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_000_092: When you are ready, speak with the boatman and join us on the other side.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_YUGIRI_000_095: Lord Hien has requested that Master Alphinaud and Mistress Alisaie also be present at the negotiation.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_100_120: There you are, . So, first things first: what do you think of the enclave? I must say, I'm quite proud of what my countrymen have accomplished in the time.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_120: We even have an aetheryte now, courtesy of the Onishishu. Be sure and attune to it, would you? Once it has the Warrior of Light's seal of approval, people might actually start using the thing.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_100_121: But on to the matter at hand: the ambassador and his retinue are at my hall, taking their ease ahead of the negotiations. I want you there when the talking starts.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_121: It will serve to send a message to the Empire that Eorzea and Doma stand united. I am not normally one for hollow posturing, but in this game of nations, such gestures carry weight.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_122: Oh, and should you feel uneasy about speaking for the Scions, Alphinaud and Alisaie will also be there. You need only eat, drink, and look imposing. Say you'll come.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_125: I knew I could count on you.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_128: It promises to be a dull affair, to be sure, but you have survived far worse.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_130: When you are ready, come and join me at my humble abode, the Kienkan. The guardsman will see you in.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_140: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HAKURO_000_150: Whatever Lord Hien's decision should be, I shall abide by it. Yet...I would be glad to welcome my lost brothers back to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_155: The fact that there are two opposing factions at work in Garlemald complicates matters. Even assuming Asahi and his associates can be trusted, what of the others?
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_160: That the Empire should send Yotsuyu's stepbrother of all people... I wonder how he feels, a son of Doma returning home to speak for the oppressors his countrymen drove out.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_201: You can say that again. I still don't know quite what to make of it all. But on the surface, a prisoner exchange does seem a good way to begin. The question is, can they be trusted?
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_202: Hm. They had naught to gain by divulging the details of their internal divisions. As it stands, we have no reason to doubt them.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_203: But the ambassador's mention of Yotsuyu left me ill at ease. It made his grand talk of peace seem uncannily like a lengthy preamble.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_204: You think this might all be a ruse to facilitate her retrieval?
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_205: Perhaps. Though I cannot fathom why they would go to such lengths. Yotsuyu may have been the acting viceroy, but she is not Garlean, nor even highborn. Her value must presumably lie in what she knows...
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_206: ...Which brings us to the little matter of her memory loss. In her present condition, she would not yield any worthwhile intelligence. Nor is she worth much as a bargaining piece.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_207: Alphinaud, you are well acquainted with the Empire's methods. I would have your thoughts on this matter.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_208: My knowledge is at your disposal, Lord Hien. While the ambassador's proposal is appealing in principle, it would be remiss of us not to give it due scrutiny.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_209: Indeed. Though it seems to me I have little choice but to accept regardless. With so many of our brothers and sisters languishing in imperial camps, I cannot well turn my back on a chance to secure their repatriation. Only the kami know when I will be afforded another.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_214: ...But ere we continue, shall we excuse these two? I fear what follows will bore them to tears.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_215: I was just about to show myself out as it happens. Come on, ─let's leave Alphinaud to dispense his copious knowledge.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_216: Someone is still sore from being made to watch at Sakazuki...
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_217: Go on and keep Alisaie company. We are safe enough for now.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALPHINAUD_000_220: Worry not, , we shall take care of the rest. Go on and keep Alisaie company.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_HIEN_000_225: You've more than earned a rest, my friend. Leave the interminable bits to us.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_240: <sigh> A chance to relax at last.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_241: I know when I'm out of my depth, .
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_242: Though no weapons are drawn, a negotiation is no less a battle, and the stakes can be every bit as high. One misplaced word and people could die. It takes someone with a cool head, and I'll be the first to admit that's not me.
TEXT_STMBDC105_03026_ALISAIE_000_243:
So we're left with the eternal question...
What to do while they prattle on?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_000:
All right, for want of a better suggestion, what say you to a brief tour of the newly liberated Doma? I'd be interested to hear how the people are faring in their own words, and it's not as if we'll be missed here.
...Or will we?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_002: Ah, Yugiri. And...Asahi, was it? You have some business with ?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_003: Business? No. Pleasure, my lady. I merely wished to exchange a few words with the famed slayer of gods and champion of Eorzea. It is truly an honor.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_004: Such heartfelt admiration. One could almost forget that you're an envoy of the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_005: Oh? Is that so strange? We may have stood on opposing sides in the past, but I see no contradiction in lauding the  who would do battle with our common enemy.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_006: And lest you forget, this is my homeland. It would be remiss of me not to at least thank  for containing the threat posed by the Kojin's vile eikon.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_007: Now, if I may continue─as we speak, Lord Hien deliberates over my proposal, and I would take this time to see the land I once called home.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_008: Though Lady Yugiri is certain to be a jovial escort, the excursion would be all the more enjoyable for your company─and safer besides.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_009: ...The ambassador has the right of it. He is not like to come to harm with you at his side. Will you join us?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_A1_000_002: I am quite sure he will be safe with you, Yugiri.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_010: In that case, I will join you as well. There is naught else to do until Lord Hien has reached his decision, and I can think of no finer way to learn more about the current state of Doma.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_015: Come now, . There is naught else for us to do until Lord Hien has reached his decision. And were we not this moment discussing how best to learn more about the current state of Doma?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_021: It's settled, then. The four of us shall make a brief excursion through Yanxia.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_022: Might we start at the town of Monzen? I would see what has become of Doma Castle.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_023: Very well. If you will follow me.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_030: I'll admit, I was hoping for a more leisurely trip around Yanxia. But if it's a choice between this or listening to my brother rambling on, well...here I am.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_035: Would that something could be done about these mechanical soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_040: Nay... Can this truly be Monzen, home to the cream of Doma's samurai? I had heard that Yotsuyu intended to send some few of our automata here, but only by way of warning. It should not have come to this...
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_041: Indeed, her savagery served only to incense the people and spur them to rise up in protest. It was folly to think such methods of governance could ever prove effective.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_042: <sigh> The sooner we can begin to make amends for this senseless destruction the better. Securing supplies and support for the reconstruction effort should not prove difficult─once our nations are formally at peace, of course.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_043: ...Yes, of course. If you would have a better view of what remains of the castle, we must proceed through the ruins.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_050: I don't believe for one moment that he came to see the sights of Yanxia. The question: what did he come for?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_055: Lord Hien would often come here to gaze at the castle. He was but one of many to take inspiration from its majesty.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_060: It is a travesty. A travesty. I remember the keep being so beautiful. In the light of the setting sun, one would swear it was aflame...
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_061: It is indeed a doleful spectacle. Mayhap we will rebuild it one day...when we have finished helping our people to rebuild their lives.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_062: Spoken like a true Popularis. The needs of the people must of course come first.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_100_062: Speaking of whom, would you be opposed to my seeing how they live firsthand? The village of Namai is but a short journey from here, if I'm not mistaken.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_063: By river, yes. If you will follow me, I will ready our boat.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_070: This excursion has proved to be more relaxing than I expected.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_075: It has been some time since I last visited Namai. Yet Isse often visits the enclave with young Azami, so we do not want for news from the village.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_000_090: Quite the swordsman, isn't he? I wonder, did the Empire train him to kill before or after appointing him ambassador...
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_000_095: The Red Kojin's presence here does not bode well. We must inform Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ISSE_000_100: You know I'm grateful for your help─but what exactly was that imperial doing fighting alongside you?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_AZAMI_000_105: Thank you so much for rescuing us. We weren't doing anything wrong, I promise.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_110: Dear me... I had hoped to convey my views on our nations' shared hopes under more peaceable circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_000_111: Yet this regrettable little interlude did afford me a chance to see the famed hero of Eorzea in action, and few imperial soldiers can say that. At least, few who lived to tell the tale.
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_BATTLETALK_00: I will not let you harm these innocents!
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_KOJINLEADER_BATTLET: I grow tired of these games. Where are our reinforcements!?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: All this for two children? What do they even want with them!?
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_BATTLETALK_00: They mean to overwhelm us. See to their reinforcements. Quickly!
Stand in front of them! We'll bear the brunt of it!
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: If they would call for reinforcements, then so shall we!
TEXT_STMBDC106_03027_ASAHI_BATTLETALK_00: Hold your ground! I will try to draw away their reinforcements.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_100_000: Quite the swordsman, isn't he. I wonder, did the Empire train him to kill before or after appointing him ambassador...
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_YUGIRI_105_000: The Red Kojin's presence here does not bode well. We must inform Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ASAHI_000_000: Well, after that little ordeal, I believe it may be time for us to return to the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_001: Return, my lord? But what of Namai? You seemed so eager to observe the villagers going about their daily lives.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ASAHI_000_002: To be frank, I still am. But I rather doubt the good people of Namai would take kindly to the sight of a man in imperial uniform with blood still dripping from his blade. Even in your company, my presence would only prove a distraction.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ASAHI_000_003: Fret not, however. Thanks to the three of you, I have seen a great deal more than I otherwise would. And with any luck, Lord Hien will have finished considering my proposal by the time we return.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_010: Did you see the sincerity in his eyes when he spoke with Azami? I feel strange saying this, but...what if he truly has come to sue for peace?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ASAHI_000_013: I trust you will inform Lord Hien of our encounter with the Red Kojin? If we are to deter them from encroaching on Yanxia, our response must be swift and decisive.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_MAXIMA_000_015: I understand you served as the ambassador's escort. My thanks.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_YUGIRI_000_030: Thank you again for agreeing to join me. If not for your aid, the Kojin may well have overwhelmed us.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_YUGIRI_000_031: Pray go on ahead. Lord Hien is expecting you. I will remain without and keep watch over our guest.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_032: Well, we had best not keep him waiting.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_YUGIRI_000_040: Lord Hien was quite insistent that you join him. Pray go on ahead. I will keep watch over the ambassador.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_043: Judging by the sparkle in Alphinaud's eyes, their discussion was riveting. How sorry I am to have missed it.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Feeling refreshed, I trust? We have considered the ramifications of this proposal from every angle, and I believe Lord Hien has reached a decision.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HAKURO_000_050: Master Alphinaud has shared with us his knowledge of the eikons, and reminded us of the threat they pose in so doing. It is strangely comforting to know the Empire shares our concern.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: You are expected, . Shall I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_060: Welcome back, my friend. Yugiri tells me you accompanied her and Asahi on a tour of Yanxia. I had hoped you might take the opportunity to recover from your exertions at Sakazuki...
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_061: ...But I gather your time was well spent. Until the ambassador affords Yugiri a chance to make a full report, however, I must rely on you to supply the details. So please─tell us how it all unfolded.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALPHINAUD_000_062: The Red Kojin? Here? Have there been any other such incidents since the liberation?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_063: Only one, that I am aware of. If they are planning some new venture here in Yanxia, we will need to increase patrols.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_100_063: Not that I am aware of. If they are planning some new venture here in Yanxia, we will need to increase patrols.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_064: In any event, I am indebted to you for fighting them off. But tell me─and don't be modest─was Asahi truly the first to leap to the youngsters' aid?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_065: He was. I was quick to doubt him when we first met, but his desire to save them seemed quite genuine. It's possible he truly believes what he's saying.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_066: In the time I've known you, you have always been an excellent judge of character. What do you make of the ambassador?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_A1_000_001: He may very well be an honorable man.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_A1_000_002: I still don't think he can be trusted.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_070: Oh, how I would love to believe that. An ally within the Empire could change everything. It could give us a real chance at peace.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_075: Then the question of what his true intention may be remains.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_080: He confounds you too, I see. And for that reason alone, we would be fools to underestimate him.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_081: Regardless of his aim, I am resigned to playing his game. For now, at least.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_082: Well, forswearing summoning should be simple enough, considering you never dabbled in it in the first place─which just leaves the somewhat thornier question of how to police the Red Kojin.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_083: It was with that very question in mind that I sought Alphinaud's counsel. Thanks to his knowledge of the eikons and the rituals used to invoke them, I believe we've identified a workable solution.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALPHINAUD_000_084: As you will recall, Susano was summoned forth using the power of relics locked away in the Kojin's treasure vault on the Isle of Zekki. Though said relics remain there to this day, it is all but certain that the act of summoning exhausted their stores of aether making subsequent summonings impossible.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALPHINAUD_000_085: Assuming that is the case, preventing the primal's return rests on denying the Red Kojin the means to amass new stores of aether, either via the acquisition of crystals or the relics they are wont to collect.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_086: For this, I plan to enlist the aid of our friends the Blue Kojin. Since Doma's liberation, we have forged closer bonds with Bunchin and his people, and with their support, I am quite confident we can keep the Red from obtaining what they require to call upon this Susano.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_088: They will be exchanged as agreed, and I will give full credit to Asahi for the success of the transaction. If there is aught we can do to help the Populares garner favor, I mean to see it done.
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_089: But first, I have some unfinished business to attend to. Would you all come with me?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_ALISAIE_000_090: Yes, of course, but...what manner of business?
TEXT_STMBDC107_03028_HIEN_000_091: A past mistake which I would see put right. One which has weighed heavy on my mind...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_100_000: I had no idea Yotsuyu's return weighed so heavily on Lord Hien's mind...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_105_000: I couldn't say if Yotsu─I mean, Tsuyu's predicament is the will of the kami, but Gosetsu certainly seems convinced.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HAKURO_110_000: It would seem Lord Hien has at last reached a decision. The uncertainty in his eyes has given way to resolve.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_YUGIRI_115_000: Please tell me Lord Hien is ready to speak with the ambassador. The residents of the enclave grow restless for want of news.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_120_000: Have you heard aught from Lord Hien? I had hoped he might have had sufficient time to consider my proposal.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_MAXIMA_125_000: The Empire works for the betterment of all. But I see the fear in these people's eyes... Mistakes have been made.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_000: With Yotsuyu safely in Gosetsu's care, all that remains is to answer Asahi's proposal. I realize other matters demand your attention, but I would ask that you stay awhile longer to see this business through.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_GOSETSU_000_048: Forgive me, my lord, but...has he not been gone overlong? Perhaps I should─
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_049: Calm yourself, Gosetsu. I understand your concern, but we have to wait. He deserves that much.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_050: I am sorry to have kept you all waiting. Thank you for your understanding.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_051: Long did I dream of this reunion, but never did I imagine it would be so joyless. A part of me hoped your stories of her condition were just that. But alas, it is as you say.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_GOSETSU_000_052: Tsuyu... Do you remember anything of this man? Anything at all?
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_054: I am a stranger to her. That much was clear to me from a single look. I leave her in your care.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_055: Now, if you will excuse me, my superiors are long overdue a report. They will be elated to hear of our agreement, of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_056: As for the exchange itself, once I have obtained the relevant permissions, I will arrange for your people to be relieved of their various duties, and sent here to Yanxia. This will take time, of course...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_057: Of course. You may rest assured your soldiers will be well cared for until your return. We will also begin taking steps to better counter the threat of the Kojin and their eikon.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_058:
Before you take your leave─there is one other matter...
I am informed it was you who took the lead in rescuing two young Domans from a band of Kojin sellswords. I have not yet had the time to thank you properly.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_059: Please, there is no need to thank me. I only did what anyone would do under the circumstances. Fortunately, I was in good company at the time.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_060: The blight of the Red Kojin is of the Empire's making. Were it not for our transgressions, those children would not have needed saving.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_061: The people of Doma have suffered enough, my lord. And I promise to do all in my power to spare them further pain, be it at the hands of the Kojin, or indeed the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_062: I pray the Emperor will see things as you do. There may yet be hope for us all.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_064: Gosetsu. As before, I leave Yotsuyu to you.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_065: I invite the rest of you to join me outside. Let's treat Asahi to a proper farewell.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Without the threat of imperial attack hanging over our heads, we may devote our energies to dealing with the Red Kojin. And then there will be nothing left to impede Doma's restoration.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_000_073: If only our previous encounters with the Empire had been this cordial. Here's to the future, I suppose...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_YUGIRI_000_075: I wondered if the sight of her stepbrother might bring Yotsuyu back to her senses...but mayhap nothing will. Nevertheless, we must continue to watch her until we can be certain that her condition is permanent.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_078: If my dear sister's memory does not return, I pray you will take good care of her.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_MAXIMA_000_080: Lord Hien has made a wise decision. Our superiors will be pleased.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HAKURO_000_083: If Yotsuyu is to remain in Doma for good, we cannot keep her confined to this manor. The people must be made to see that she is no longer the monster they remember.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_090: The ambassador's airship awaits at Castrum Fluminis. Let us be off.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Are you quite well? You looked as if you were about to faint in the ambassador's arms for a moment there.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_000_103: Why the frown? Did he say something to upset you?
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_YUGIRI_000_105: I thought perhaps now we could be at ease, but your expression suggests otherwise. What troubles you, ?
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_000_149: It makes no sense. Why would he bother keeping up the pretense for so long, only to drop it right before the very end?
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_101_149: Perhaps he no longer thought it necessary, having secured Doma's cooperation in the prisoner exchange.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_102_149: If he truly is a disciple of Zenos, 'tis possible emotions simply got the better of him. Remaining calm around the  who slew his lord will have taken its toll.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_150: Whatever the explanation, now is not the time for hasty reprisals.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_151:
We shall proceed as planned. The Red Kojin must be placed under surveillance and the Garlean prisoners made ready for the exchange...
But you need not concern yourself with the details.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_152: Leave the affairs of Doma to us. When the hour of the exchange draws near, we will call for you.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_153: I should certainly hope so. Whatever the Empire's true intent, we would be on hand to play our part, either to defend Doma, or to help usher in a lasting peace.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_154: I had thought we might use this time to return to Eorzea, but given the volatility of the situation, mayhap it would be best if we remained in Kugane.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_000_156:
Agreed. Between Yotsuyu's amnesia and Asahi's dubious agenda, I'd say we have ample reason to remain in the neighborhood.
If anything should happen─anything at all─you must send for us at once.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_157: Oh, I will. On that you have my word. Charting a path through this sea of troubles promises to be difficult enough. I am not so proud as to attempt the feat alone.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_158: To Kugane, then. Tataru and the others must know of what transpired here.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HIEN_000_160: If what you saw of the ambassador is an indication of his true nature, this prisoner exchange may not be what it seems. In fact, I'm beginning to wonder if your encounter with the Red Kojin was more than mere happenstance.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_YUGIRI_000_163: Soon we shall see if Asahi is true to his word. If not, I will be glad to cut out that silver tongue of his.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_165: Since we have naught else to attend to for the moment, perhaps this would be a good opportunity to look into the present state of Garlemald...? Though I should probably speak with Tataru first...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALISAIE_000_168: I don't envy Lord Hien. So much rests on his decision.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_TATARU_000_170: Welcome back, ! We heard the good news about Gosetsu! I knew you'd find him!
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_HANCOCK_000_180: ...My. It seems you're all in quite the predicament. Well, should we receive any urgent missives from Doma, rest assured you will be the first to know of it.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_TATARU_000_185: Yes, of course. We're pursuing a number of ventures to replenish our coffers, but I suppose that all can wait if any urgent news should come through the office.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_TATARU_000_190: Yes, of course. We're discussing ideas to replenish our coffers, but I suppose that all can wait if any urgent news should come through the office.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_191: Ah... Ahem. About that... I wish to apologize, Tataru. It was reckless of me to make such a purchase without first consulting you. You may be certain, however, that I mean to reimburse the Scions, even if it means drawing upon my personal funds.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_TATARU_000_192: That's very thoughtful of you, but I'm sure it won't come to that.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_TATARU_000_193: If Soroban's business proposition is as promising as it sounds,  should have no difficulty wiping the red from our ledger.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_194: Forgive me, . It would seem I have unwittingly heaped my financial troubles upon you. I swear I will pay you back.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_100_194: Though I fear I will struggle to cobble together anything of monetary value, knowledge I can gather in abundance. To start, I plan to investigate the divisions forming within the Empire. Mayhap Riol and his associates have heard something on the subject...
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_195: Regardless, the more we know about the politics of Garlemald, the better our chances of predicting the imperials' next move, which might yield you an advantage on the day of the prisoner exchange.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_196: Knowing what we do of Asahi's apparent resentment towards you, I cannot say what he hopes to gain from it.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ALPHINAUD_000_197: But if there is even the faintest chance that a lasting peace could be forged between Doma and the Empire, what choice have we but to try? Lord Hien had the right of it: Asahi may very well be a monster, but we must play his game. For now.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_400: Arranging the prisoner exchange proved easier than I thought.
TEXT_STMBDC108_03029_ASAHI_000_401: Yes, my lord will be most pleased. Everything is going according to plan.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Ah, , impeccable timing. We have just received a letter from Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_001: He writes that the Domans are coordinating their efforts with the Blue Kojin to maintain a constant watch over the Red.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_002: By staying on the lookout for signs of crystal hoarding and the like, they mean to nip any summoning attempts in the bud, thereby satisfying the conditions for peace set down by the ambassador.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_004: For the Garleans' part, the Populares have sent word that a vessel bearing Doman conscripts is soon to arrive in Yanxia. 'Twould seem that the prisoner exchange is to proceed as planned.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Lord Hien requests your presence, and I share his view that you should be on hand at this critical juncture.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_006: According to the letter, Yotsuyu's memory has yet to return, so it looks like she'll be living out the rest of her days in Doma─assuming the ambassador means to honor the agreement, of course.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_007: Before we get to that, however, I think it would be wise to assess her condition one last time. If the Domans have missed any change in her mental state, however slight, it would be better if Asahi weren't the one to spot it.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Agreed. Let us make straightways for the enclave, then. Lord Hien will be waiting.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_009: I trust you will cope in our absence, Tataru?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_TATARU_000_010: Don't worry about me─I'll be fine! Just be sure to come back safely!
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_TATARU_000_015: Alphinaud's been keeping a very careful count of his coins lately. I doubt he'd ask for a sip of water without asking the price first! Hee hee hee!
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HANCOCK_000_016: I am very much in favor of a peace agreement between Doma and the Empire. Loosen that imperial grip, I say, and let the trade routes breathe freely!
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_017: We know the broad strokes from his letter, but I would hear the details of our Doman friends' progress from Lord Hien himself.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_018: Ever since he drained our coffers dry buying that sword, Alphinaud has had his purse strings in a death grip. I can't even buy a cup of tea without him going on about the “dangers of frivolous spending.”
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_020: Ah, I see my letter reached you across the Ruby Sea! Thank you for coming so swiftly.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_021: Though I wrote at some length on the subject of the forthcoming exchange, there was one other matter I neglected to mention...
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_022: It concerns Gosetsu. As you may have observed, he returned from his ordeal rather the worse for wear, and despite his best efforts to conceal his condition─or perhaps because of them─he recently collapsed.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Good gods! Is he all right!?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_024: Confined to bed and grumbling without cease, but he has shown signs of recovery. He made me promise not to tell you, lest you worry unduly. Which was all very well when you weren't here.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_025: Now that you are, however, I think it high time he received some visitors. Might you spare him a moment? Yotsuyu has scarce left his side, and I imagine you are curious to see what has become of her as well.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_100_026: We will visit him at once. , Alisaie─shall we?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_030: They make a convincing pair, do they not? On first acquaintance, I would think him a doting grandsire and her a model grandchild.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Indeed. Had someone told me a year ago that I would live to bear witness to such a scene, I would have declared them mad. That aside, I am relieved to see Gosetsu has lost none of his spirit.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_032: But what a turn of events... I mean, for her to suddenly be watching over him. You couldn't make it up. Although I suppose Gosetsu is an old man. With the way he charges through life, it can be easy to forget...
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_033: Aye, he has resisted decrepitude with the same defiance he showed the enemies of Doma.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_034: But no matter how adamant his will, no man can carry on forever. He has pushed himself beyond the limits of endurance too many times─even if his health returns, the fact remains: he will never again be the warrior he once was.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_035: He has given his all for liege and land, and we will ask no more.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_036: And what of his nurse? If Yotsuyu is feigning that─well, she certainly has me fooled.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_038: Yugiri. Out of all of us, I would think you the hardest to convince. So...what makes you so sure?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_YUGIRI_000_039: I have been spying on Yotsuyu from the shadows─waiting for the misstep that would betray her charade for what it was.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_YUGIRI_000_040: But her mask has never slipped. Not once. She has remained in character from the first. One evening, I watched her as she sat in her chambers, unguarded and alone...
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_YUGIRI_000_041: She had taken the dishes from the cupboard, and was pretending to prepare dinner right there on the tatami. A child's game.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_YUGIRI_000_042: Even the wariest shinobi would not go to such lengths. I can but conclude that her mind is truly broken.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_043: ...Well, that's good enough for me─and everyone else, I would hazard.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_044: Aye, the matter is settled. Yotsuyu will become “Tsuyu,” and begin a new life here in Doma.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_045: Before that can happen, however, we will need to present her to the ambassador one last time, to prove that her memory is truly gone.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_046: But I would not risk parading her in front of our returning conscripts. Her presence at the exchange would only stir up mutinous thoughts.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_047: Understandably. She as good as fastened the chains around their necks.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_048: Aye─which is why I mean to conclude this business with Tsuyu first, out of the sight of my countrymen. Will you help me?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_049: We are at your service. There is no higher purpose than the pursuit of peace.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_050: My thanks. The Garleans are on their way, and we must prepare to welcome the ambassador. We will meet you at the docks with Tsuyu.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_055: The skiff will take us to our meeting with the ambassador. We will join you at the docks once preparations have been made.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_YUGIRI_000_051: Even after weeks of surveillance, it was difficult for me to accept that Yotsuyu's condition was genuine... But not as difficult as accepting Gosetsu's affection for her.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_052: Can you imagine Yotsuyu playing with bowls on the floor? I don't know that we can think of her as the same person anymore...
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Shall we wait here, then? Lord Hien should not be long.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_061: My friends! Have you seen Tsuyu!? She is nowhere to be found!
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALPHINAUD_000_062: What? But the Garleans will be landing in a matter of moments!
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_ALISAIE_000_063: If she's fled... Could it mean her memories have returned?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_064: I know not. Yugiri is scouring the streets as we speak, but it is possible Tsuyu has left the enclave altogether.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_065: Captain─a word. Did you perchance carry a fair-skinned woman across the river?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_DOMANFERRYMAN_000_0: A fair-skinned woman, my lord? I...I do not rightly know... I think─ Y-Yes! Yes, my lord! Now that you mention it, there was a lady among the passengers whom I do not recall having seen before.

Her face was hidden by the brim of her hat, but I remember taking her hand to help her onto the boat. White as new-fallen snow, it was... Was she someone important, my lord? Have I done something wrong?
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_068: Wrong? ...No. No, I was merely hoping to catch our guest before she departed. Be at ease, Captain.
TEXT_STMBDD101_03070_HIEN_000_069:
'Twould seem that Tsuyu has crossed the river.
Kami help me... No good can come of this.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Without Tsuyu, I cannot see how the prisoner exchange─or indeed the peace process at large─can proceed. We have to find her, and soon.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_ALISAIE_000_001: Her memory must have returned. Why else would she run?
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_010: It seems Tsuyu has gone unrecognized thus far, but kami help us if someone catches a clear view of her face. I must find her before that happens.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_011: The responsibility for her disappearance─for all of this─lies with me. But I would ask for your aid nonetheless.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_ALPHINAUD_000_012: We are at your service, Lord Hien, now as before. Let us make the crossing and begin our search.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_ALISAIE_000_013: You go on ahead. Someone should let Yugiri know what we've learned. I'll join you on the other side.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_014: We have no way of knowing where Tsuyu is headed, so we had best divide our forces. I will take Kusakari and its surrounds; Alphinaud, if you would take the road to Castrum Fluminis?
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_015: ─forgive me, but could I ask you to interrogate the residents of Yuzuka Manor? One of the Namazu may well have seen our quarry.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_016: If everyone is in agreement, let us board the skiff, and hope the kami smile upon our efforts!
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOSAN_000_020: Welcome to Yuzuka Manor. Yes, yes. If there is anything you care to know, you need only─ Hm? A pale-skinned woman?
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOSAN_000_021: I have seen no such traveler, I am sorry to say. Most sorry. Scaly-skinned Namazu, on the other hand, we have in abundance!
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOKU_000_022: ...Unusually pale skin? Yes, yes! I saw this woman on the way back from my fishing trip.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOKU_000_023: She had just crossed the shallows east of here, and was headed in a northeasterly direction...for the most part. Her steps did not seem certain. If you hurry, you might still catch her.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOSAN_000_025: No, no. Still no pale-skinned females here. Only grey.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_GYOKU_000_026: I thought you would be on your way by now. Did you lose interest in finding your friend?
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_SYSTEM_100_028: You see no sign of Yotsuyu to the north. Perhaps she is somewhere farther off to the northeast...
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_SYSTEM_100_029: Still no sign of Yotsuyu. Perhaps she is yet farther to the northeast...
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_SYSTEM_000_030: Yotsuyu is nowhere to be seen, but lying on the ground a short distance to the north, you spy a familiar-looking wide-brimmed hat...
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_SYSTEM_000_040: A cursory glance is all that is required to confirm your suspicions: it is the same hat Yotsuyu was wearing when you found her in Sakazuki.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_041: ! Before you ask, our search of Kusakari and its surroundings has yielded exactly naught─save this chance reunion with you, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_YUGIRI_000_042: Mistress Alisaie has gone to assist her brother at the castrum. It was she who informed me of the situation. I joined Lord Hien here shortly thereafter.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_043: How did you fare at Yuzuka Manor? Any sign of our missing guest?
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_000_044: ...Towards Namai? By the kami! If the villagers recognize her, it will not end well.
TEXT_STMBDD102_03071_HIEN_100_045: We must hurry. Yugiri and I will check the paddies; the village square is yours!
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YUGIRI_000_000:
All of this over a persimmon...
I failed to consider how she might endanger herself. Knowing she has the mind of a child, I should have continued my vigilance─not relaxed it.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YOTSUYU_000_001: I don't know why everyone is so angry, but I got the fruit Gosetsu wanted. I hope he likes it...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ISSE_000_002: I can't forget what that woman did to us, but I won't do anything to upset Azami.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_AZAMI_000_003: I'm not scared of her. Not anymore.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_010: <sigh> That...would have been better avoided. But at least it did not end in bloodshed. And judging by Tsuyu's reaction, she remains oblivious to the events of her former life. This was no escape attempt.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YUGIRI_000_011: Nay, it seems it was an offhand request of Gosetsu's which brought her to Namai. She came in search of a persimmon.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_012: Hah! And they say fruit is good for the health... I do hope Gosetsu finds the taste to his liking.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_013: Well, we have certainly taken the long way around, but let us continue on to Castrum Fluminis and our meeting with the ambassador. Alphinaud and Alisaie should still be there, conducting their search.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YUGIRI_000_015: The imperial airship has arrived. Whether our conscripts are aboard remains to be seen...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YOTSUYU_000_016: Do we have to stay here long? He'll be waiting for his fruit...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Lord Hien informed us of the uproar at Namai. Thank the Twelve you found Yotsuyu when you did. I dare not think what might have happened had you not.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALISAIE_000_018: I was sure Yotsuyu had fled, but it seems her memory hasn't returned after all. How foolish of me not to consider Gosetsu's craving for seasonal fruit...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_020: It seems our imperial guests have already arrived. 'Tis time to meet with the ambassador...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_021: I knew better than to trust Asahi, but that was a dirty trick.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_022: Still, unpleasant as it was, we have at least put the matter of Tsuyu's future to rest. I have sent her back to the enclave with Yugiri to give Gosetsu his precious persimmon.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALISAIE_000_024: You have that look, Alphinaud. What is it?
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALPHINAUD_000_025:
Oh, nothing of consequence, most like...
We can discuss it upon our return.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALPHINAUD_000_028: ...So, it would seem there will be one less prisoner at the exchange. I only hope Yotsuyu's presence here will not present further problems...
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALISAIE_000_029: I suppose “Tsuyu” is to become an official Doman citizen. But what then? Will they keep her hidden here forever? Or might she one day be allowed to walk amongst her countrymen?
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_030: We should pay a visit to Gosetsu, and reassure him about Tsuyu's fate. He will want to know that the Empire has finally relinquished its claim on her.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALPHINAUD_000_031: So Yotsuyu has returned to the bosom of the Empire after all. I cannot say I am surprised. But what I struggle to fathom is Asahi's aim in all of this.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_ALISAIE_000_032: So Asahi got his way in the end, and at an unspeakable price. He really is a vile little worm, isn't he.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_YUGIRI_000_033: Yotsuyu hid her recovery well─I had no inkling that her memory had returned. I keep asking myself when it could have happened. At the meeting with her parents, perhaps? But then why would she─? Nay. There is naught to be gained from such conjecture.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_040: We have recovered the Naeuris' remains, and will hold the cremation anon. <sigh> Would that they had never again set foot in Doma.
TEXT_STMBDD103_03072_HIEN_000_041: I broke the news to Gosetsu myself. He was...quiet. I think it best that he be allowed some time alone with his thoughts.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALPHINAUD_000_000: So Yotsuyu has returned to the bosom of the Empire after all. I cannot say I am surprised. But what I struggle to fathom is Asahi's aim in all of this.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_001: So Asahi got his way in the end, and at an unspeakable price. He really is a vile little worm, isn't he.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_002: Yotsuyu hid her recovery well─I had no inkling that her memory had returned. I keep asking myself when it could have happened. At the meeting with her parents, perhaps? But then why would she─? Nay. There is naught to be gained from such conjecture.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_KIENKANGATEKEEPER_1: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_010: So, my friends...that which we feared has come to pass. Yotsuyu has regained her memory and returned to the imperial fold.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_011: It is, by any measure, a cruel twist, not least for Gosetsu...but one which does not invalidate our agreement. According to the terms of the contract, we were bound to surrender Yotsuyu into the Garleans' hands should her condition improve prior to the hour of the exchange. By that reckoning, all is...if not as it should be, then...as it must be. This I can accept.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_012: But what I cannot accept are the unconscionable lengths to which Asahi went to achieve this outcome.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_013: Given his recent conduct, and his apparent admiration for Zenos, it is plain he cannot be trusted. And that is to say nothing of the unexplained containers he insists on bringing to our meetings. Whatever the ambassador is planning, I think it unlikely our negotiations will end peacefully.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_014: In the event of hostilities, the safety of the conscripts must be our first concern. As such, I would have an escape route in place before the meeting begins.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALPHINAUD_000_015: A wise precaution. If the main structure of Castrum Fluminis is to be the stage for the exchange, then I believe a thorough inspection is in order...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_016: The citadel has stood empty ever since the imperial withdrawal─while we took steps to ensure that it could not be defended by an occupying force, it is entirely possible that the ambassador has arranged things there to his advantage. I will slip inside, and make certain we have an unobstructed exit.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Pray allow me to join you. I have some experience of imperial facilities. And should matters take a turn for the worse, I would hope to be of at least some use...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_018: Very good. That should be enough to guarantee us a way out of the castrum. Beyond that, however...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_019: We will need a ship to ferry the conscripts back to the enclave. Even with every skiff we have, it would take several trips to evacuate everyone.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_020: ...A Confederate sekibune, on the other hand, would require only a single run, and leave us far less vulnerable on the water. Assuming, of course, Rasho can be convinced to part with one.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_021: Might I take the lead on this? I've had dealings with Rasho and his pirates before.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_022: And I won't be alone, will I, ?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_023:
Much appreciated.
I quite fancy parleying with pirates again. It's just a shame Lyse won't be there to reprise her role.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_024: Well, that was enthusiastic. Were you hoping to join Yugiri and Alphinaud on their skulking mission, by any chance...?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_025: Hm! I am certain you would make a persuasive pair─but I think I will accompany you to these negotiations all the same.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_026: My lord, the ruler of Doma should not be seen consorting with common brigands...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_027: Come now, Yugiri─they stood with us against the Empire. If we would ask their aid once more, we must treat with them as equals. My presence shall serve to demonstrate our sincerity.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_028: ...Indeed, my lord. Pray forgive my presumption. By your leave, Master Alphinaud and I shall be about our task.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_029: And we should be on our way to Onokoro. Time is short, and Rasho may take some convincing.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_030: Now there is a face I did not expect to see. What brings the noble lord of Doma into the company of bilge rats such as we?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_000_031: If you've come to offer Doman chains in place of Garlean ones, then I'm afraid you've wasted a trip.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_032: Ahahaha! And what fine subjects you would make! With your fleet at our disposal, our restoration efforts would be hastened tenfold.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_033: But let us speak seriously. I stand before you not to demand your fealty, but to request your aid once more.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_034: Mayhap you are confused. Doma's liberation was but a means to an end. We aided you only to save ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_035: Now we have no such incentive. We have sworn no oath to you, and will not come running like hounds at their master's whistle.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_036: And I would not presume to treat you thus. I come to petition your cooperation as an ally of equal standing.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_000_037: Equal standing, you say? Seems a bit lopsided to me. Where's the profit for us in all of this?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_038: Profit! Must you always think in such shortsighted terms? Have you ever heard of doing the right thing?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_000_039: Have you ever heard of pirates, little miss? You'll find we're simple souls: you pay our tithe, you sail in peace; deny us our due and we take it by force. We'll pull you out of the water if we see you drowning, but we are not in the business of doing something for nothing.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_040: Calm yourself, Mistress Alisaie. We did not come here to moralize. We came here to talk. And there is more to be said.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_041: According to records recovered after the liberation, relatives of your Doman-born brethren were among those conscripted into the imperial army. And as you may be aware, we recently negotiated the return of said conscripts. Many, alas, will arrive to find no families waiting for them, no homes to grant them shelter.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_042: I would ask that you offer them a place in the Confederacy. You would not be rescuing strangers, but welcoming brothers and sisters into your ranks. And has not the Confederacy been in need of new recruits...?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_043: You seem well-informed of our affairs, Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_000_044: The losses we suffered at the Garleans' hands are no secret. But since we drove them out of Doma, the Ruby Sea has come alive with traders and travelers. So many vessels to tax, so few pirates to tax them.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_100_044: We could do with some more hands on deck, and doubly so if they're familiar with the inner workings of the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_045: Very well. The Confederacy agrees to your request. You will have your ship.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_046: ...But before that, you must do something for me. The vessel I have in mind was damaged during your battle with the Empire. Though we have mended her, she has yet to be declared seaworthy.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_047: She is sound enough down below, but when you load her up with conscripts and the waterline rises...those upper planks had best be free of cracks.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_048: Assuming you want your people to stay dry, you will do me the favor of swimming around the hull to check for weaknesses. That is, if Doman lords are not averse to getting their robes wet?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_049: Not this Doman lord! If we each inspect a third of the ship, it shall be done in a trice.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_050: That is the spirit. The ship is moored at Quickscape Pier. Our apprentice shipwright will be on deck to hear your report. Look for a lad named Ihanashi.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_051: And I thought I had a knack for parleying with pirates... For the record, my previous attempt was an unmitigated success, and yes, I should have quit while I was ahead.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_100_052: Well, well. I'd thought the rumors exaggerated, but the young lord lives up to his reputation...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_055: The sekibune is moored at Quickscape Pier. Speak with Ihanashi when you have finished your swim.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_TANSUI_000_056: So Yotsuyu found her way back to the imperials, did she? I did warn you about being merciful...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_057: For once, I'm actually glad Yugiri isn't here. I doubt she would have taken kindly to a pirate inviting Hien to inspect his hull...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_058: The water is so invigorating! I have not swum in the Ruby Sea since─ Ah, but I should be concentrating on the task at hand!
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_059: ...Ihanashi? Aye, that's me. The captain said someone would be coming to inspect the hull. You...haven't finished already, have you?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_SYSTEM_000_060: You see no signs of damage here.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_SYSTEM_000_061: Upon closer inspection, you spot a small crack in one of the planks...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_070: Aye, I'm the shipwright─er, apprentice shipwright. Did you find anything that might need attention?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_071: The section I inspected seemed solid enough.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_072: ...On the port side, near the bow, you say? All right, I'll have a look and see what I can do.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_073:
My apologies, I seem to have lagged behind. I could float in that gentle sea all day...
Otherwise, I am happy to report no visible cracking or holes in my section of the hull.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_074: You─ Y-You─ You're Lord Hien! The captain sent you to inspect the hull!? Kami have mercy... Forgive us this discourtesy, my lord!
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_075: Hah! 'Tis quite all right. In fact, I rather enjoyed it. I take it you are of Doma?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_076: Y-Yes, my lord. The imperials took my father away after the uprising, and I had nowhere else to turn. The Confederacy became my family.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_077: But someone told me they're releasing the conscripts now. Maybe my father will be among them. Not that I can go back─there's no leaving once you've joined...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_078: (-???-)How fares our lady? Is she seaworthy?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_079: Captain! W-We've found a small crack in the port side, but I'll have it fixed before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_080: I see you have met the boy. Did he tell you his story? He babbles when he is nervous.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_081: Should his father be among the conscripts, as he hopes, I mean to give him the choice to leave this life. If he so chooses, I expect you to see they are provided for.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_082: I have heard that those who join the Confederacy forswear all ties with kin and homeland. Is that oath so easily put aside?
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_083:
If I allow it.
...I see in him the lad I was twenty-five years ago. You say the words, you mean them, but the yearning for home still lingers.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_084: My family is long dead, and I know this life is my lot. But he has scarce dipped his toes with us. If there is a life for him in Doma, he should have the chance to live it.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_085: Well said. The Empire's conquest has uprooted many and more. Be it in Yanxia or out on the Ruby Sea, we have a duty to ensure that Ihanashi and others like him are free to dwell where they desire.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_086: Then the matter is settled. I will make preparations to cast off.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_087: Well, my friends, it seems we have our ship. Let us return to the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_RASHO_000_090: The sekibune is set to sail. We will be ready when the time comes.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALISAIE_000_091: Alphinaud tells me they had little trouble finding a suitable route out of the castrum, but he won't say much more than that. If I didn't know better, I'd think he was hiding something...though I can't imagine what.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_ALPHINAUD_000_092: The castrum was deserted. Quite deserted. 'Twas a simple matter to plot the surest path out. H-Hence our swiftness.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_093: We found the castrum's tower unoccupied, and betraying no signs of recent activity. Only shadows and echoes awaited us there. Alphinaud seemed oddly reluctant to linger, but I saw naught to concern us.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_IHANASHI_000_094: Thank you for being so thorough. My father may soon be boarding this ship, and I wouldn't want the hull to spring a leak...
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_100: It seems Yugiri and Alphinaud completed their task before us. They have been waiting.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_YUGIRI_000_101: We scouted the structure and determined the swiftest path to safety. In the event of hostilities, we will lead the conscripts outside with all possible haste.
TEXT_STMBDD104_03073_HIEN_000_102: From there, the Confederacy has pledged a ship to ferry us across the One River. Now we have but to attend the exchange, and pray to the kami these precautions were unnecessary.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALISAIE_000_000: Alphinaud tells me they had little trouble finding a suitable route out of the castrum, but he won't say much more than that. If I didn't know better, I'd think he was hiding something...though I can't imagine what.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALPHINAUD_000_001: The castrum was deserted. Quite deserted. 'Twas a simple matter to plot the surest path out. H-Hence our swiftness.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_002: We found the castrum's tower unoccupied, and betraying no signs of recent activity. Only shadows and echoes awaited us there. Alphinaud seemed oddly reluctant to linger, but I saw naught to concern us.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_010: While we were putting our contingency plans in place, I left Hakuro in charge of organizing transport for the imperial prisoners.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_011: He will see they arrive at the appointed hour, leaving us free to rendezvous with our Confederate allies. Come, they await us on the riverbank not far from the castrum.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_015: The tower rather spoils the view across the river, does it not. I concede, we might perhaps have chosen a less ominous place to conduct the exchange...
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALPHINAUD_000_016:
Would that we had some hint as to the ambassador's intentions...
Had we not prepared for the worst, I should be wary of going through with this at all.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALISAIE_000_017: No matter what Asahi throws at us, we cannot let that monster have his way.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_018: My only concern is the safe return of our people. That is what my lord wishes, and that is what shall be done.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_RASHO_000_019: Do not worry about the ship. It will be where it needs to be. And with Tansui at the helm.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_021: Aye, and ready for what lies ahead, I trust. Lest there be any confusion, though... The tower across the water is to be the scene of the exchange─that, and whatever else Asahi has planned.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_100_021: But regardless of the ambassador's intentions, we will bring our people home. Yugiri─you are to evacuate the conscripts at the first sign of trouble.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALPHINAUD_000_023: We, meanwhile, shall cover their escape, and lend what support we can.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_RASHO_000_024: Your ship awaits you at the castrum's loading docks. She will see you safely home.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_025: Then all stand ready to play their part. Come! Let us be about it!
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_BOATMAN03074_000_02: Are you ready to depart for the castrum, ?
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALISAIE_000_030:
Ah, Alphinaud...you impulsive fool.
I thought about trying to talk him out of it, but I know what I would say if the roles were reversed. Stubbornness is something of a family trait.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_031: Gosetsu dragged himself here from his sickbed, only to be greeted by the sight of Yotsuyu's corpse. I had not the words to comfort him...
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_040: I knew Asahi was planning some manner of treachery, but a summoning...? Thank the kami you were here, my friend. None of us would have escaped Yotsuyu's vengeance had you not intervened.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_041: She was a pawn, aye, but she still had a choice, and she chose to submit to the ambassador's plan. 'Tis little wonder Gosetsu departed in silence.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_100_041: I gather he left the same way he came: alone aboard a rowing boat. As for the conscripts, most made it to the sekibune before the battle began in earnest, but the vessel yet waits on the riverbank for those who did not flee in time.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_042: Then I suggest we put this doleful place behind us, and make for the enclave together. 'Twould be a shame to miss the joyous reunion!
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALISAIE_000_045:
It will be far too quiet without Gosetsu around. I wonder if we'll ever see him again...
Oh, speaking of reunions, have you spoken with Ihanashi? It turns out his father was among the returning conscripts.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_046: Gosetsu relinquished his duties with a grace befitting a samurai lord. I only hope that I can fill the void which he has left behind...
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_IHANASHI_000_047: Thank the kami you spotted that cracked plank! That ship ended up bringing my father home!
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_IHANASHI_000_048: And the captain said─ Well, let's just say I'm not a pirate anymore. I'm going to live in Doma with my father. We're free!
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_050: Ah, Gosetsu... Fair journey to you, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_051: A bittersweet occasion...but there is yet ample cause to be grateful! Pray join us in the Kienkan. I would thank you properly.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_ALISAIE_000_055: With all of that out of the way, Doma should be able to look forward to a period of relative calm. As for us...well, we have an intriguing story to tell everyone back at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_056: Lord Hien trained under Gosetsu from the day he was old enough to hold a sword. Though he smiled through all the farewells, none will feel his absence more keenly.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_060: Our brothers and sisters are returned to us, and the dream of Doma's restoration is that much closer to being realized. It is a day that will live long in memory, and one that would never have dawned without the courageous actions of the Scions. On behalf of Doma and her people, we give you our deepest thanks.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_061: Lest you think me complacent, I assure you, I have not forgotten the dark cloud on the horizon. That Zenos lives is a source of grave concern─mayhap the gravest─yet there is little to be done but wait for Alphinaud to send word. Until then, I plan to devote myself to fulfilling the promise I made to Gosetsu, by building a nation in which none need live in fear.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_062:
<sigh> I confess, I miss him already. But the thought that he has at last found peace goes some way to softening the blow.
I wonder, did you ever stop to ask yourself why he showed Yotsuyu such kindness?
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_063: I believe the answer lies in past tragedy─specifically, the death of his wife and daughter during the invasion. Though he hid it well, they were never far from his thoughts, and in Yotsuyu's childlike mien, I believe he saw not a fallen tyrant, but the little girl who was lost to him.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_064: After the loss of his family, Gosetsu devoted himself wholly to the service of his country. He suffered any hardship, strove beyond the limits of endurance without hesitation or complaint.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_066: Though Tsuyu could never truly replace his daughter, I had hoped that with her at his side, he might live out the remainder of his days in relative contentment...
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_YUGIRI_000_067: Would that the kami had been so minded. Even now, I labor to discern any meaning in Yotsuyu's fate. To deliver her from certain death, with no memory of her sins, only to leave her at the mercy of her stepbrother? Can that truly have been their will?
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_068: That I cannot tell you. The will of the kami is not for us to know.
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_069: But what I do know is that for a brief moment, a girl known as “Tsuyu” lived among us...
TEXT_STMBDD105_03074_HIEN_000_070: ...And that she brought with her a whisper of respite for a grieving heart.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_HIEN_000_000: Doma owes you a great debt, my friend. Thanks to you, we have everything we need to prosper. You and Alisaie must promise to visit us again soon. And Alphinaud, too, when he returns from the Empire. Know that my thoughts go with him...
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_YUGIRI_000_001: However far his pilgrimage may take him, we have not seen the last of Gosetsu. Of that I am certain.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_010: I think it's time we were going, don't you? We've done all we can here, and we have a lot to report.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_011: But before we head back to the Rising Stones, let's call in at Rhalgr's Reach. We should be the ones to tell Lyse about Zenos. After everything we went through together, we owe her that.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_021: It's good to see you, Lyse. As for my headstrong brother, he's off on what will almost certainly turn out to be a once-in-a-lifetime trip to Garlemald.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_100_021: It's a long story, but...we have evidence that Zenos might still be alive.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_022: What!? But that's─ If this is a joke─ Gods, this had better be a joke!
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_023: Look─I know what I saw, all right? We all saw it. And here you are saying he's alive and well and living the high life back in Garlemald!?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_024: I know how ludicrous this sounds. I'm still having difficulty believing it myself. But while I might doubt the word of an imperial envoy, I'm inclined to trust 's.  saw the crown prince through the Echo─in a meeting that could only have taken place in the recent past.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_A1_000_001: It was him. It was Zenos.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_025: No, it must have been─I don't know─some kind of...really convincing impostor. Zenos is dead. He had a great big hole in his neck! We buried him!
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_MNAAGO_000_026: Aye, and someone went to the trouble of desecrating the bastard's grave, remember?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_027: (-???-)Thal's gilded...halls. Whatever are you talking about?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_028: Thancred! What brings you to the Reach?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_029: Alphinaud had me lending a hand at the Saltery─keeping an eye on the rebuilding work and so on─just until operations were up and running. And now that they are, I thought I might look in on you before wending my weary way back to headquarters.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_030: Forgive me if I misheard, but is there some suggestion the late crown prince could have...gotten better? If so, might I suggest a quick look inside his coffin as our first order of business?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_031: Eurgh. As much as I hated the man, it doesn't feel right defiling his grave. But if it will put this rumor to rest, I suppose we have to. And when there are no curious eyes about, if we can manage it.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_MNAAGO_000_032: Zenos is buried up at Bloodhowe in the Lochs. His grave was set apart from the others and left unmarked, so as not to upset the locals.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_033: Then it shouldn't be too hard to find. Naago, you're in charge until I get back!
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_MNAAGO_000_035: You'll find Zenos's grave up at Bloodhowe, the burial ground in the Lochs. The stone isn't marked, but it's set apart from the others, so it should be obvious enough which one you're after.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_036: Most of the graves are grouped together, but they managed to find a lonely spot for Zenos, didn't they...
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_037: My money is on writhing snakes. Possibly spiders. Let's prise it open and see what comes out.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_040: This is it... Gods, he'd better be in there. Someone scrawled all over the stone a while ago, but I had it scrubbed off, and thought no more about it...
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_041: So no one thought to check if the coffin was still occupied? Well then, we are presented with but one course of action.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_100_042: And we had best be sure we are not observed in the doing of it. Shall we begin?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_050: If there's no corpse, then...are we to conclude the rumors are true?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_051: Not necessarily. We might still be dealing with a doppelganger of some kind. An agent could have been sent to dispose of the body in a bid to lend credence to the tale of Zenos's resurrection.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_100_051: More and more, however, I find myself siding with Alphinaud's theory of Ascian possession. Speaking from experience, I can tell you they have no qualms about taking a living host, let alone a dead one...
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_000_052: You're saying an Ascian is walking around in Zenos's body?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_100_052: It seems a distinct possibility. Once I have put this grave back the way we found it, I shall pay a visit to the people responsible for interring the crown prince.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_000_053: Before leaping to any conclusions, I want to know for sure if a body was ever buried here...and how certain we are that Zenos was properly dead.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_100_053: If he wasn't, that was some trick. He as good as cut his own head off. Anyway, Raubahn needs to hear about this. If you find anything out, send word to me at Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_054: <sigh> I don't know why I'm surprised─with matters settling down in Doma, we were due another crisis.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_055: Shall we make for the Rising Stones, then? It's past time we shared these developments with the others.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_LYSE_100_056: I've spoken with Raubahn, and we've decided to keep quiet about Zenos until we have undeniable proof. There's no sense in upsetting everyone if there's a chance we're wrong.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_MNAAGO_100_057: So the grave was empty. By Rhalgr... How many people did we lose bringing that bastard down─and now he might still be alive?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_THANCRED_100_058:
I have a question or two for the people in charge of burying Zenos...
You were headed back to the Rising Stones, were you not?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_060: While I was waiting for you to arrive, I spoke with Urianger over linkpearl and gave him a full report. Y'shtola is on her way, and should be here any─ Ah.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_YSHTOLA_100_061: Alisaie. . 'Tis good to see you safe and well. What news have you from the East?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_YSHTOLA_100_062: ...Disturbing developments indeed. Given all that we know, I too would conclude that an Ascian now inhabits Zenos's body. A doppelganger might fool the crown prince's subordinates, but ? Nay, Alphinaud had the right of it.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_YSHTOLA_100_063: Would that his wisdom extended to the question of his own safety. Capable though he has become, he ventures alone into the enemy's stronghold─and the shadowy web of the Paragons, like as not.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_063: When it comes to making rash decisions, I'm hardly in a position to criticize, but...
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ALISAIE_000_064: I'm worried. I just wish there were something I could do for him besides pray.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_VARIS_000_080: We cannot suffer eikons to exist. Was I not clear on this point?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ROBEMAN_000_081: (-Zenos-)More than clear. The eikon in question was summarily dispatched by the Warrior of Light. The summoner is dead, and the rite beyond repeating.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ROBEMAN_000_082: (-Zenos-)Everything proceeded according to plan─every party behaving exactly as required.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ROBEMAN_000_083: (-Zenos-)My methods may seem extreme, but there is no cause for concern. I work only to ensure the salvation of this star.
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_ROEGADYNSOLDIER_000: Hm? What are you doing fiddling with that thing?
I asked you a question, soldier!
What are you─ Have you lost your mind!?
TEXT_STMBDD106_03075_KATANASOLDIER_000_0: ...I have lost many things, but my mind is yet my own.
There upon the stage I stood, prepared to take my final bow, only to find that the finale was but an intermission...
Shall I use this chance to repent for my sins? Embrace goodness and mediocrity? Nay, I think not. While the one I yearn to face yet lives, the hunt must go on.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_100_000: Alphinaud will have need of all his wits if he is to survive his visit to Garlemald. We know precious little about life in the imperial capital.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_000: It's been an eventful few days, hasn't it. But I suppose all we can do now is wait for word from Alphinaud.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_001: Hmph. I don't recall the last time I had nothing pressing to be getting on with... We should probably make the most of it. Shall I put on some tea?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_100_002: Tea would be lovely. You may regale me with the tale of your adventures in the Far East─and of your encounter with this new primal especially.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_003: I'll put the kettle on, then. That table looks free if you'd like to take a seat.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_005: I'll take care of the tea─you can claim us a table.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_100_006: It is pronounced “Tsu-ku-yo-mi,” correct? A figure from Far Eastern mythology, no doubt...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SYSTEM_100_010: Upon sitting at the table, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SYSTEM_100_011: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SYSTEM_100_013: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 70 or above.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_010: ...Interesting. So this Tsukuyomi was summoned in much the same manner as Susano─via the medium of a sacred relic.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_100_010: That's right. They believe their gods─or kami─reside in physical objects.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_011: Given the danger they represent, it may behoove us to begin a catalog of such relics.
