But if we are to contain the threat, we will require a better understanding of the summoning method itself. I believe I shall pay a visit to Doma, and learn what I can on the subject.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_014: A fine idea. And I know for a fact that our friends in Doma would be grateful for any information which could help to prevent further summoning in the region.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_100_014: I will pen you a letter of introduction─Lord Hien will wish to welcome our resident expert on aetherology.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_013: Greetings! Could it be that I'm in time for tea?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_018: It certainly looks that way. Come on─sit down and tell us how your investigations went.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_015: After you left, I went about questioning Bloodhowe's gravekeepers. They all told much the same story: once Lyse and her officers had confirmed Zenos dead, his corpse was interred under strict supervision.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_016: There seems little reason to doubt their testimony on that point, but when I mentioned the defacement of Zenos's grave, accounts grew rather more vague.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_017: None reported having seen any suspicious persons in the vicinity, and all assumed the act to have been perpetrated by a vengeful Ala Mhigan. Crucially, however, I was able to confirm that when the offending scrawl was removed, as per Lyse's instruction, no one involved thought to check the contents of the coffin. By that stage, 'tis like that the corpse was already missing.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_100_017: Assuming Zenos has not, in fact, risen from the dead, we are left with two possibilities: either the body was disposed of to lend credence to the claims of an extremely committed impostor, or an Ascian has taken up residence within it.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_019: If Asahi was as fervent a devotee as you believe, he would not have been fooled by an impersonation, however committed. We must assume that we are dealing with an Ascian, and proceed accordingly.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_020: Agreed. The question is, how many more such monsters are waiting for Alphinaud in Garlemald?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_021: Their presence was his chief reason for going. He understood the risks. I only hope he did not underestimate the extent of the infestation...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SYSTEM_000_030: Meanwhile, on the Imperial Hypersonic Assault Craft L-XXV...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_031: Master Alphinaud, we are making good speed towards our destination. Is aught amiss?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Nay, 'tis just...I can see naught from my cabin, and was curious to know the land over which we flew.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_033: Ah. I am afraid our military craft are built with little thought for such niceties. I am happy to indulge your curiosity, however. We are presently passing over the Burn on the western edge of Othard. Even with the benefit of a porthole, your gaze would have been greeted with naught but malms upon malms of lifeless earth.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_034: I have read something of the Burn. It was described as a desolate wasteland, bled dry of every last drop of aether...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_035: Aye. It is believed that a succession of eikon summonings was responsible.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_036: When Emperor Solus first came to Othard and beheld this blight, he is said to have reeled at the scale of the devastation. He declared eikons a threat to our very star's existence, and issued an Empire-wide decree ordering the eradication of all such entities.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_IMPERIALPILOT_000_0: We're under attack, sir! Magitek armor─no visible designation.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_041: All cannons, return fire! Damage report!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_IMPERIALPILOT_000_0: The main reactor's been hit! Helm unresponsive! We're going down, sir!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_043:
Damn it! They knew exactly where to hit us.
All hands─brace for impact!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_044: Glad to have you back, Master Alphinaud. We have landed in one piece─more or less.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_045: But the air filtration system is damaged, and the ship is filling with smoke. We must gather the survivors and get out while we still can.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Confound it! Not here. Not like this!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_061: Wha─? Who in the Emperor's name─?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Enemies of our enemies. Introductions can wait!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_063: You are calm in a crisis, Master Alphinaud. Let us finish this, then!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_070: My thanks. Your intervention proved most timely.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SHADOWHUNTER_000_07:
(-Menacing Mercenary-)Well, well...
I did not think to meet an Eorzean in this place, let alone a Scion.
(-Menacing Mercenary-)I have some small...history with your order.
(-Menacing Mercenary-)But I would speak of the present. Know you your assailants? And the severity of your predicament?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_075: The soldiers bore the insignia of the Emperor's personal guard...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_076: And I could venture a guess as to their motive. But you yet have us at a disadvantage, sir─will you not tell us who you are?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SHADOWHUNTER_000_07: (-Menacing Mercenary-)Our names are not yours for the asking. And as for our purpose...let this be your answer.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SHADOWHUNTER_000_08: (-Menacing Mercenary-)We must away before more arrive. Come with us or stay, but make your choice now.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_MAXIMA_000_081: Even should we manage the long trek out of the Burn and secure passage to the capital, we would no doubt be greeted by the Emperor's guard...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALPHINAUD_000_082:
Indeed.
We accept your gracious offer, uh...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_090: Ugh, this is intolerable. But as much as I wish it were otherwise, there is nothing we can do for Alphinaud now but pray for his success.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_100_091: While your brother journeys to Garlemald from the east, I could make my way there from Ala Mhigo and find out what there is to be learned in the Empire's western provinces.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_092: Then I'm coming with you! I can't very well sit here sipping tea if there's action to be taken!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_093: Forgive me, Alisaie, but the provinces are hostile territory, and stealth is all important. It is safer that I go alone.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_094: I can sneak well enough when the situation demands it! Don't patronize me!
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_Q1_000_000: What will you say to Alisaie?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_A1_000_001: We should leave this to Thancred.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_095: I understand your frustration, Alisaie, but  has the right of it. We must defer to Thancred's expertise in this matter.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_200_094: And how exactly would that be any better?
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_100_093: Ahem. I must refuse your company as well, my friend. Formidable though you are, the success of my mission depends on moving unnoticed, and lest you forget, you have grown rather famous. I trust you understand...
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_095: Well, I had best put on my skulking boots. There will be no room for mistakes once I've crossed the border from Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_096: Alisaie and her brother bicker as all siblings do, but she worries for him nonetheless. 'Twould be a kindness if you were to visit from time to time, and distract her from her cares.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_100:
It seems that praying is to be the extent of my contribution after all.
...But I will stay behind, as I have been bid.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_THANCRED_000_101: We all have our talents. Mine just happen to involve a silver tongue and soft soles. I promise to send word the moment I learn aught of consequence.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_YSHTOLA_000_102: See that you notify me too. I mean to depart for Doma as soon as I find a suitable East Aldenard vessel to bear me thither, but I shall return if I am needed.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_ALISAIE_000_103: Be sure to drop in whenever you're next in the area, . With any luck, I'll have a painfully detailed report from Alphinaud to share.
TEXT_STMBDD107_03076_SYSTEM_100_104: You have learned the emote Ponder!
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_000: Oh, . If you've come here hoping for news, I'm afraid there isn't any.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_001: Everything is exactly as it was. Y'shtola is still investigating primals in the Far East, Thancred is still gathering intelligence in the imperial provinces, and Alphinaud is still...out there somewhere.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_002: There's been no word since his first scheduled report, nor does he respond to calls. And all the while, I'm just meant to sit around here waiting. It's driving me mad!
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALLIANCERECRUIT0314: Begging your pardons! I bear a message from the Eorzean Alliance!
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_004: Thank the gods for that. We have a visitor.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_006: Welcome to the Rising Stones. If you have a message, I should be most eager to hear it.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALLIANCERECRUIT0314: My lady! The Alliance leadership will soon convene to discuss the matter of Ascian interference, and they humbly request the presence of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

Having assessed intelligence provided by the Ala Mhigan Resistance concerning the whereabouts of Zenos's remains, they too suspect Ascian involvement, and wish to deliberate a suitable course of action.
As the foremost authorities on our foe, your order's counsel would be most welcome.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_010: Of course, we should be glad to assist in whatever way we can.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_011: With almost everyone else afield, I'd say this one falls to us. By which I mean, I'm not going on my own. You'll come with me, I trust?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_015: There you have it. We accept the invitation.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_020: If you would rather not, how do you think I feel? I despise formal occasions, as you well know. But in the absence of Alphinaud and the others, we'll just have to grin and bear it, won't we.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_021: Well, there you have it. We accept the invitation.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALLIANCERECRUIT0314: Thank you! The time and date of the meeting will be shared in due course, but I can confirm that the council will take place in Ala Mhigo. By your leave...
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_026: I somehow doubt we'll have anything useful to offer, but standing mutely at a meeting would still be better than the nothing I've been doing of late. Let's make ready to depart, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_RIOL_000_029: ...All right! Just be careful on the road back, ye hear!
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_030: Did I hear right, Riol? Is Thancred coming back?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_RIOL_000_031: Aye, that he is. Says he's acquired some important intelligence.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_RIOL_000_032: Bein' in Garlean territory, though, he couldn't risk sharin' the particulars in case the imperials were listenin' in. So he said he'd head back as quick as he could, and to make sure someone was waitin' for him in the Ala Mhigan Quarter.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_034: We're bound for Ala Mhigo anyway, and there's sure to be time before the council begins. Come on, let's be off.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_RIOL_000_040: Thancred wasn't in any danger, from what I could tell, but he did sound as if he'd been in a footrace with a chocobo. Whatever it is he's learned, he's in a hurry to share it. Ye'd best be on yer way.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_042: There's no doubting your talent for espionage, but the journey is long and the borders heavily guarded. You did well to make it back in one piece.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_THANCRED_000_050: You two are a sight for sore eyes. Now all I need is water for my parched throat. Fetch me a cup, will you? Traipsing through imperial territory is thirsty work...
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_THANCRED_000_100: I will leave the two of you to your task and see to my own.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_109: Loath though I am to neglect making preparations for the council, we must act swiftly before Alphinaud's trail goes cold.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_110: I propose we first pay Hien a visit. He's sure to want to hear about these developments, and he may well be able to advise us on how best to reach the Burn.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_THANCRED_000_111: A sound plan. And Y'shtola is in Doma, is she not? I daresay she'd join you in the search if you asked her nicely.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_THANCRED_000_112: While you see to all that, I shall go and report my findings to the Alliance. You may leave any preparations for the council to me.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_113: Thank you, Thancred. Right, to Doma, then. We have much and more to share with Y'shtola.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_THANCRED_000_120: As much as I would like to visit Doma, it will have to wait. Twelve speed you on your way─oh, and give my regards to Y'shtola.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_140: ...Hmm. That is curious indeed. While other matters demand my attention at present, I shall bear what you have told me in mind. Should you notice any change, do not hesitate to seek me out.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ENCLAVEMINER03143_0: (-Doman Miner-)Thank you, my lady. You are most kind.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_142: ...Well, well. Two faces from the dim and distant past.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_143: Come now, it hasn't been that long. Who was that you were speaking with?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_144: A local miner who supplies crystals for the rebuilding effort. Of late, he claims to have struggled to find a crystal with so much as a trace of elemental energy.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_145: Upon learning that I had some knowledge of aether, he came seeking my counsel. Just now he brought me one of his recent finds.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_146: It was precisely as he described─devoid of elemental energy...and eerily reminiscent of the deaspected crystals that manifested in Eorzea in the days prior to the Calamity. We would be wise to investigate this phenomenon more closely.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_147: Indeed... But on a more positive note, the locals seem to have taken a liking to you.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_148: More an interest in than a liking to, I think. The sight of a Miqo'te with a peculiar contraption upon her head has a certain novelty value in these parts. Any actual regard they may have for me, I owe wholly to you and the others who came before. Everyone here has been exceedingly cooperative, and I am pleased to report that I have all but concluded my investigation.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_149: Simply put, by focusing one's will upon an aether-infused object of worship, it is possible to conduct a summoning.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_150: ...So, the fact that they are objects of worship is the key? They are themselves suffused with the requisite belief?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_151: Correct. Such sacred relics as the Kojin collect obviate the need for religious fervor in the summoner─Yotsuyu being the most obvious example. She had but to associate the artifact given to her by Asahi with the divine, and it served to amplify her desires and give them form.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_152: A form nourished through the power of crystals, also provided by her brother. And thus was Tsukuyomi brought into being.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_153: Which brings me to the question of preventative measures─to which I have yet to find a satisfactory answer. At present, I know of naught that will avail us, save to keep watch over the movement of relics and crystals. As if we did not have enough to keep watch over already...
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_154: ...But I doubt you came all this way to hear that which may be perused in a report. Has something happened to Alphinaud?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_155: ...Hm. I shall join you in the search, of course.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_156: Thank you, Y'shtola. I should be glad of your help. Truly.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_100_156: Now, if there's nothing else, I shall go on ahead and request an audience with Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_157: Alisaie puts on a brave face, but she has little talent for concealment. We should join her at the Kienkan.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YSHTOLA_000_170: My report can wait. Finding Alphinaud must take priority.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_ALISAIE_000_175: There you are. I've apprised Hien of the situation.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_YUGIRI_000_180: I should not have allowed Master Alphinaud to leave without an escort. But it avails us naught to dwell on the past. We must focus on what can be done now.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_HIEN_000_190: Greetings, my friend. Alisaie has explained all to me.
TEXT_STMBDE101_03143_HIEN_000_191: Needless to say, you shall have our full cooperation in the search. Even if Alphinaud's trail does lead to the Burn, of all places...
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YSHTOLA_000_000: My report can wait. Finding Alphinaud must take priority.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_ALISAIE_000_005: If only he knew all the trouble he's caused... When we find Alphinaud, I'm going to give him such an earful.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YUGIRI_000_010: I should not have allowed Master Alphinaud to leave without an escort. But it avails us naught to dwell on the past. We must focus on what can be done now.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_020: The region known as the Burn occupies a special place in Garlean history. Every child in the Empire is familiar with the tale.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_021: In the distant past, it was a verdant land teeming with life, but successive summonings saw it bled dry of aether and reduced to a desert. It was upon beholding the devastation that primals had wrought that Emperor Solus was spurred to embark upon his crusade against their kind.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YSHTOLA_000_022: The Burn offers a glimpse of the future we seek to prevent. Know you of any reason why Alphinaud might have gone there?
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_023: Aye. Mischance. Though it lies on the route to Garlemald, it is no place to make a stop. My guess is they encountered some manner of trouble there.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_024: In any event, I am of the same mind as Alisaie─we have no choice but to take our search to the Burn. Given the considerable distances involved, 'tis best we went by bird.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_025: and I have our yols. Yugiri, will you ready falcons for the others?
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YUGIRI_000_026: I shall gather our swiftest birds.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YUGIRI_100_026: Near the House of the Fierce, there is an overlook. Pray join us there once you have seen to your preparations.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YSHTOLA_000_045: With such a steed to bear me to and fro, I could perform my fieldwork in a fraction of the time. Mayhap I shall try my hand at this “Bardam's Mettle.”
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YUGIRI_000_050: Having named him an emissary of Doma, Lord Hien considers himself personally responsible for Master Alphinaud's safety. Naught I could say would sway him from joining the search.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_060: If everyone is here and possessed of a bird, let us away.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_061: Remember, our destination is a barren wasteland. There is no civilization to speak of for a hundred malms in all directions. Take care you do not lose your way.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_070: Barren though it is, the Burn is said to be home to hardy beasts adapted to the unforgiving environment. And then there are the specters, if certain tales are to be believed... I expect we shall soon find out for ourselves what truly dwells there.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YSHTOLA_000_085: On present evidence, we have no reason to fear the worst. More than that I cannot say.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_YUGIRI_000_090: We are no closer to establishing Master Alphinaud's whereabouts, and the suggestion of an imperial plot only compounds matters. We have much to consider.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_100: Well, that was a decidedly uneventful journey. I almost found myself hoping for a sandstorm.
TEXT_STMBDE102_03144_HIEN_000_101: Joking aside, I'd say our birds are due a good brush down and a treat or two, wouldn't you?
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YSHTOLA_000_005: On present evidence, we have no reason to fear the worst. More than that I cannot say.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YUGIRI_000_010: We are no closer to establishing Master Alphinaud's whereabouts, and the suggestion of an imperial plot only compounds matters. We have much to consider.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_020: I had hoped to steal a moment's rest after our little outing, but it would seem duty calls. A foreign emissary arrived in my absence.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YSHTOLA_000_021: Do not let us keep you then.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_022: Actually...I was wondering if you might join me. I cannot think of a guest who could fail to be impressed by the presence of the Scions─at least, none I should be happy to receive.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_ALISAIE_000_023: Of course─if you think it will be useful.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_024: Thank you. Let us return to my manor, then.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_ALISAIE_000_040: Yugiri assures me the task of searching is best left to her comrades. I shall trust to their experience and focus on what I can do.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YSHTOLA_000_045: That the Alliance would extend an invitation to Doma bespeaks the depth of their concern. Nor are they misguided. If Garlemald has fallen under Ascian control, the threat we face is incalculable.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YUGIRI_000_050: While we are happy to cooperate with the Eorzean Alliance, there are many things that Doma must do alone.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_055: Don't worry. Alphinaud's been through countless trials and come out stronger every time. He'll be back, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_070: My advisors and I will presently convene to discuss the matter of Doma's defenses. You are welcome to stay, of course...
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YSHTOLA_000_071: Had you not offered, I would have requested leave to remain. Where the Ascians are concerned, naught may be left to chance.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_072: As ever, we would benefit from your experience.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_073: I thank you for coming, Lyse─even if it was on official business. I had hoped there might be time to show you the land you helped to save, but I will settle for a fleeting visit if needs must.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_074: There never does seem to be enough time for anything, does there... But I did get to see a little of the enclave. You've made excellent progress, I must say! And soon you'll have the chance to see how we're getting on too. Till the meeting, then!
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_075: ...Um, ? I was wondering if I might have a word with you before I go. In private.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_076: Go on, my friend. I will send for Hakuro and the others in the meantime.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_077: Great. I'll wait for you at the docks.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_ALISAIE_000_085: What does Lyse want to talk about, I wonder...
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_090: Go on and see what Lyse wants. I promise we won't begin without you.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HAKURO_000_095: So the Eorzean Alliance has invited Doma to attend a council. I had wondered if that might be the purpose of Mistress Lyse's visit.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_100: Thanks for coming. Knowing you, you've probably guessed what I wanted to talk about.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_101: Alisaie. She's acting as if everything's all right, but it's clear she's barely coping.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_102: The Alisaie I know is overbearing, willful, and reckless─and that's fine. It's how she deals with feeling weak. She has to keep moving, or she's afraid she'll fall apart.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_104: But the thing about people like us is that we need someone to keep an eye on us. I had Papalymo, and now I have my friends in the Resistance. And Alisaie has you and the Scions.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_105: Before you start, I'm not saying you're neglecting her. I'm sure you aren't, and I'm sure you won't─but she's a good friend, and when I see her like this, I can't help worrying. So please, make sure you give her all the support she needs, all right?
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_A1_000_002: You've nothing to worry about. Seriously.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_110: Thank you, . It goes without saying, but if there's anything I can do, you only need to ask.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_LYSE_000_115: Well, I'd best be off. See you in Ala Mhigo!
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_ALISAIE_000_130: Is everything all right with Lyse? I won't ask for details─I know you'd tell me if it were important.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YSHTOLA_000_135: I daresay I can guess the subject of your discussion with Lyse. She too was never one for concealment. Fortunately for you, the individual in question seems none the wiser.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_YUGIRI_000_140: Your return is most timely. We have just apprised those newly arrived of where matters stand.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HAKURO_000_145: We all had our suspicions from the start, but a part of me was credulous enough to believe the Empire's promises. Never again. The imperial court is a nest of vipers, and any peace they offer is laced with poison.
TEXT_STMBDE103_03145_HIEN_000_160: Ah, there you are, my friend. Everyone has assembled, so let us begin.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_000: The Azim Steppe... I always wanted to see it... <sigh>
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_YSHTOLA_000_005: In the field of aetherology, the Azim Steppe remains unbroken ground. Having missed your last expedition through injury, I mean to seize this opportunity with both hands.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_YUGIRI_000_010: The reigning Ruby Princess is more receptive to the outside world than her predecessor, it is true─but what we offer is an invitation to war. Though I will plead our case, I fear we can expect little of Sui-no-Sato.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HAKURO_000_015: We have fought long and sacrificed much to reclaim our freedom. I will die before I allow the Empire to take it from us again.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_030: It is settled, then. I will journey to the Azim Steppe with the Scions. Yugiri and Hakuro─I leave our other neighbors to you.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_031: My apologies, but I won't be joining you.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_032: I am no aetherologist, and what skills I do possess are unlikely to be of any great use to the mission. But more importantly, it seems to me that the ruins in the Burn warrant attention.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_033: And so, while you are away securing an energy source, I will engage our friends at Garlond Ironworks to undertake a complete overhaul of the field generators. We'll need them in good working order if our plan is to succeed. I trust there are no objections?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_A1_000_002: Come on, Alisaie... Could you not get Tataru to do it?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_040: Have care on the Steppe! From what I hear, the Xaela like fighting with friends almost as much as foes. Good luck!
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_ALISAIE_000_045: Hm! I'm sure she'd love the Burn. Joking aside, I was planning to enlist her help with organizing everything─but we'll still need a Scion on the ground. Don't worry, I'm sure you'll manage without me. Good luck!
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_050: Just the three of us, then. Very well. Shall we make first for Reunion?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_070: 'Tis a fine feeling to be back. Were it not for our mission, I would like nothing more than to lie on the grass and watch the clouds float by...
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HANCOCK_000_072: Greetings, my friend. If you are looking for Mistress Tataru, she has left with Mistress Alisaie to speak with the good people of Garlond Ironworks.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_YSHTOLA_000_080: So this is the Azim Steppe... The tales do not do it justice.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_081: If you think the view is impressive here, wait until we reach higher ground.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_082: Actually...seeing as it's your first visit, permit me to show you my favorite spot.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_YSHTOLA_000_100: An intriguing myth...though I wonder how Nhaama came to be woven into it. An Allagan hand, perhaps?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_110: From here, we shall travel to Mol Iloh. There we may ask Cirina about the particulars of the myth, and raise the matter of an alliance with the rulers of the Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_118: Tell me─do you notice anything different about the Mol? How they carry themselves? That, my friend, is pride. I do believe their victory in the Naadam meant more to them than I realized.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_YSHTOLA_000_120: So that is Cirina. Lyse told me something of the woman, but I did not think that we would ever have occasion to meet.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_TEMULUN_000_125: Strange... Amidst the radiance of your being, I sense a shadow. I pray it is but my imagination.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_140: Hien, . I am glad of your visit, and the opportunity to welcome a new friend. How may we serve you?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_141: There is a matter I would discuss with the Mol. It concerns not only the peoples of the Steppe, but of every land in the Far East.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_142: A shard of the shining moon left behind by a wayfaring soul... And you need this to protect our lands?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_143: I do. My friends and I wish to find the shard and ascertain the extent of its power. Will you tell me more of the place where it lies buried? This “northern crag”?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_144: ...If that is your wish. In the mountains to the north, there is a cavern called the House of the Crooked Coin. Inside this cavern are pillars of stone that legend holds to be the source of Nhaama's power. There, I believe, you will find what you seek.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_145: Ah, yes, I know the place. 'Tis a brisk walk from here. And what are your thoughts on an alliance?
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_146: Should the Empire return, our lands will be engulfed in a storm of conflict whether we will it or no. If we do not stand together, we will fall apart. This I believe with all my heart. However...
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_148: Among the tribes of the Steppe, there are those who revere Nhaama above all else. To them, the pillars are sacred, and not to be disturbed.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_149: Should you proceed as you propose, such tribes are like to spurn an alliance, prompting others to follow their example. That is my concern.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_150: But it is by no means certain that the pillars will provide the power you seek. Ere you risk the ire of the followers of Nhaama, might you not first visit the House of the Crooked Coin? If all is as you hope, we may then consider how best to earn their blessing.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_151: I thank you for your counsel. We will do as you suggest. I have no desire to give offense to those with whom I would join hands.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_CIRINA_000_152: Thank you for your understanding. Though the Mol may reign over the Steppe today, this decision will shape the days to come, and we would not force others into war against their will.
TEXT_STMBDE104_03146_HIEN_000_153: Nor we. A hundredfold stronger are they who choose to fight of their own accord.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_000: Cirina is quite right. Before we seek permission to use these pillars, we should determine if they are suitable for our purposes.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_020: It seems the time is come to put my skills to use. Pray lead the way to the House of the Crooked Coin.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_030: Well...it certainly looks powerful. But powerful enough? That, you'll have to ask the expert.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_050: Well, it looks like I was right about the pillars. Now all we need is permission to use them.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_055: That such an abundant source of aether should lie undisturbed for millennia... 'Tis a miracle made possible by the Steppe's long history of isolation.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_070: You found that which you seek, then? Great indeed is the Dusk Mother's power. If naught less will suffice to protect our lands, the blessing of the other tribes must now be sought.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_071: Of course. But to which tribes should we appeal?
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_072: There are many who worship Nhaama, but none are so fervent in their faith as the Dotharl. Their consent shall be the key.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_073: The Dotharl. Lyse spoke of them. A warlike tribe possessed of unique customs and beliefs. I sense their cooperation will not be easily won.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_074: Nay, but it will be well worth the effort. The Dotharl fear nothing─death least of all─and our alliance would be greatly strengthened by their presence. Let us go to Dotharl Khaa and treat with their khatun, Sadu.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_090: Great faith gives rise to great strength─for better or for worse. Whatever it is the Dotharl hold sacred, we would do well to accord it all respect.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_095: Despite her fondness for battle, Sadu is an astute leader. If we plead our case in earnest, I am certain she can be persuaded.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_100: While you meet with the Dotharl, I shall send messengers to the other tribes. If Sadu can be swayed, I am certain more will follow.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_TEMULUN_000_105: The Dusk Mother embodies love, but so too does she embody war. I pray that your meeting with Sadu will not end in blood.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_0120: You again? Other matters demand our time, khagan. Unless it is battle you seek?
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_121: Alas not. Quite the opposite, in fact...
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_122: Talking, always talking... You say the pillars hold great power? Of course they do. They are the source of Nhaama's strength.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_123: To the Dotharl, no place is more sacred, and we will make ash of any who would defile it. Though I see this is not your wish.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_124: You see the wisdom of our proposition, then? You will join hands with us?
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_125: I said nothing of joining hands. You wish to wield Nhaama's power to defend these lands, and this I will allow. But for leaving the Steppe to fight the men in iron I would have something in return.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_128: The Naadam ended ere it began. I would face you again, alone, without distractions.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_129: Defeat me─prove yourself the stronger─and you shall have the Dotharl as your allies. Surely, these are agreeable terms?
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_130: Well, this is a...not wholly unexpected turn of events─though I had assumed I would be the one required to fight. Alas, the khatun has made her choice.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_135: Ha! It shall be a battle the Steppe shall not soon forget!
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_140: So you say. But the fire in your eyes tells another tale. You want this as much as I do!
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_145: Ahhh, already my soul burns brighter! Prepare yourself, khagan, and await me outside the khaa. I will gather my witnesses and join you anon.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_160: When I was little, I would stride up to Gosetsu, wooden sword in hand, and challenge him. To his great credit, he never held back, and I had many a bump and bruise to show for it. <sigh>
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_165: Try as I might, I fail to see the logic in this arrangement. I can but conclude there is none.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_170: Why are you still here? Go. Wait for me outside the khaa. I will join you soon enough.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SYSTEM_100_200: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 70 or above.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_250: Magnai's unannounced appearance had me worried for a moment, but it was not his day to shine. Still...I cannot fault the man's bravery.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_YSHTOLA_000_255: ...Offended? Not in the least. I am no stranger to clumsy propositions, and that, believe it or not, was far from the worst I have heard.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_SADU_000_260: The Sun was quick to fade. After a few half-hearted swings, he shouldered his axe and sauntered off. But no matter. I was satisfied with our dance, khagan.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_MAGNAI_000_265: What more do you want? Leave this place, and take that woman with you.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_TEMULUN_000_270: On the matter of Nhaama's power and the alliance, the gods have remained silent. That is their way of telling us to choose with our hearts.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_DAIDUKUL_000_275: After eluding our brothers sent to Doma, Hien comes to the Steppe of his own free will...only to elude us yet again. Damn it all...
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_300: ...You had not only to contend with Sadu, but Magnai too!? Such a fierce battle that must have been. Yet here you stand, triumphant. Having passed such a test, they could not well deny you their allegiance.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_301: The Mol will make no such demands. Weak though we are, we will gladly stand with you. The Steppe is our home, and we will defend it with all our being.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_302: You have my heartfelt thanks! Of all the tribes of the Steppe, there is none I would rather have at my side!
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_CIRINA_000_303: Gods willing, many more will rally to our cause. I shall send you word when we have answers from all the tribes.
TEXT_STMBDE105_03147_HIEN_000_304: I cannot thank you enough, Cirina. None of this would have been possible without you.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_000: And so our alliance begins to take shape. Now, if we can just get that aether flowing again, it will have been a successful trip.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_020: We have the requisite consent. 'Tis time to put Nhaama's power to use.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_021: If the aether flows as planned, all that remains is to have the Ironworks' engineers do their work at the ruins. Come, let us return to the House of the Crooked Coin.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_030: I would not have the first idea how to awaken such a contraption, let alone control it. But then I'm not an Archon of Sharlayan.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_040: I shall begin at once. You may wish to step back.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_050: To manipulate aether in such vast quantities is draining to say the least. I shall take it slowly for a while.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_070: I do not pretend to understand what you did, Y'shtola, but you did it! Thanks to you─and , of course─we have taken a momentous step towards securing our defenses.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_071: Now, as much as I believe a rest is in order, we should probably make haste back to the enclave.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_072: Agreed. The others may already have returned from their missions, and I would know how things stand.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_073: As would I. Without further ado, then.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_090: 'Twould seem we are the last to arrive.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_095: Everyone has returned. Excellent. Time to take stock.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YUGIRI_000_100: Each of the factions lent an ear to our petition. As anticipated, however, many were unwilling to do any more than that.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HAKURO_000_105: My lord informs me you were instrumental to the success of his mission to the Azim Steppe. Though we hope to make many more allies, we could wish for no better than you and your fellow Scions.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HANCOCK_000_110: I'm reliably informed that Doma seeks to forge an alliance... The thing about alliances, of course, is that they can be so very expensive. While I daresay it's within the company's means to provide the necessary funds, it is for the chairman to decide whether such an investment would be worth the risk.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_120: Judging by your triumphant expressions, I take it all went well on the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_121: Indeed. We have secured a suitable source of energy for the barrier.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_122: Good. Tataru and I have commissioned Garlond Ironworks to ensure that the field generators function as they should. A team of engineers stand ready to set out for the Burn at a moment's notice. You need only say the word.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_123: I thank you for engaging their services on our behalf. The minutiae of the arrangement, you may leave to me.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_124: Which just leaves the small matter of our alliance. So, Yugiri and Hakuro...how fared you with our neighbors?
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YUGIRI_000_124: My lord. All of the factions we approached are in agreement that the Empire poses a threat, and many responded positively to talk of an alliance.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YUGIRI_000_125: From Hingashi and Sui-no-Sato, however, we received outright rejections. The former will not break its treaty with the Empire and the latter will not involve itself in conflict.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_126: Just as we expected, then. Well, there is naught to be done about it. We must focus on the rest. To each of the nations that were amenable to an alliance, I will personally send a missive.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_127: And once I have attended to that, I believe we will have done everything we can to fortify Doma's defenses─for the time being at least. All of which means I may leave for the meeting in Ala Mhigo with a lighter heart. Yugiri, Hakuro─if you would be so kind as to hold the fort in my absence.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_129: My friends, we could not have achieved so much in so little time without your help. For that, I give you my heartfelt thanks. Till the meeting, then.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_130: I took the liberty of asking Thancred to attend as well. He should have arrived in the Ala Mhigan Quarter by now.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_131: Then let us not keep him waiting. Shall we?
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HIEN_000_150: As I mentioned, I have missives to write and some few other matters to attend to ere I depart. See you anon, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YUGIRI_000_155: I knew full well how Hingashi and Sui-no-Sato would respond, yet it did naught to lessen the disappointment when they finally stopped equivocating.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_HAKURO_000_160: Are you perchance familiar with Nagxia? It is the region to the south and west of Yanxia, and home to several small nations. Such peoples well understand the value of an alliance, and thus did many of them receive our proposal most favorably.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_165: It occurs to me, this will be the first time I meet the leaders of the Alliance in an official capacity. More stiff greetings, pleasantries, formalities─does that sound about right?
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_170: Let us hope that the coming meeting passes more peaceably than the last such gathering in Ala Mhigo...
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_THANCRED_000_190: Y'shtola has told me all. And I duly told Urianger and Krile.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_THANCRED_000_191: Krile, in particular, was concerned about Alphinaud, but I assured her that everything that can be done is being done. She agreed to continue with her own tasks for the time being on the condition that I contact her the moment there is any development.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_THANCRED_100_191: So, that leaves four of us to attend the council. Arenvald is here to assist with security, incidentally, though the poor lad seems altogether too distracted for the task. Another one missing Alphinaud, I expect.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_THANCRED_000_192: Ah, but it's almost time. As soon as you are ready, present yourself to the guardsman at the palace entrance. I shan't be far behind.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_THANCRED_000_200: If you can spare a moment after the proceedings, consider seeking out Arenvald. A word from you would do wonders for the lad, I'm sure.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Ah, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, welcome to Ala Mhigo! The Alliance leaders have already arrived. May I show you to the meeting chamber?
Upon proceeding to the Royal Palace, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_240: If the Ascians are indeed responsible, we must take steps to protect ourselves. Though I know not how...
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_KANESENNA_000_245: Never have I encountered such a phenomenon. If this is magic, it is beyond my ken.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_LYSE_000_250: Don't worry about Thancred. I'll send word as soon as there's any change.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: The council has resumed, and the leaders offer their assurances that they have the remaining agenda well in hand. They bid you godsspeed in shedding light on the mystery.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_300: I just tried to call Urianger on his linkpearl. He didn't respond, but I dare to hope that he possesses some knowledge we do not.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_301: ...Ah, Urianger! Something happened during the meeting. Thancred's collapsed. A disembodied voice suddenly started─
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_302:
...What? But that's... We should talk about this in person.
...All right. We'll meet you there.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_ALISAIE_000_303: That was Urianger. He heard the voice too!
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_305: As we alone were afflicted at the meeting, I had my suspicions, but if the voice also spoke to Urianger, there can be little doubt: the Scions were targeted specifically.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_YSHTOLA_000_306: By whom and to what end is the question. One to which we must find an answer with all possible haste.
TEXT_STMBDE106_03148_SYSTEM_000_500: You have learned the emote Endure!
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_YSHTOLA_000_000: I shall be interested to hear how Urianger's experience compares to our own.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_KANESENNA_000_005: Never have I encountered such a phenomenon. If this is magic, it is beyond my ken.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_LYSE_000_010: Don't worry about Thancred. I'll send word as soon as there's any change.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_030: Urianger agreed to meet us at the Rising Stones. If any of the others heard the voice, we'll find out soon enough.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_LYSE_000_031: Good luck. I should get back to the meeting with the Elder Seedseer, but if there's anything I can do─anything at all─you must let me know, all right? Promise me.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_032: Right, let's be on our way.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_HOARYBOULDER_000_05: This is an unprecedented predicament for the Scions, but we must remain strong─the least of us most of all.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_RIOL_000_055: Didn't the selfsame thing happen to Thancred? Who's bloody next?
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_EPHEMIE_000_060: We had spoken earnestly of doing more to ease the senior Scions' burdens─but not under these circumstances...nor less so soon. I only hope I will be equal to the challenge.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_070: Forgive me, that was an unseemly display...
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: It happened before your very eyes, my lady. None here would have behaved any differently.
We have borne the two of them to a private chamber. But tell me, is it true that Master Thancred languishes in a like state in Ala Mhigo?
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_073: I'm afraid so. Though, given the circumstances, it would seem best to observe them together. I will send word to Lyse that he should be brought here.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: Take heart, my lady. The world is full of scholars and knowledgeable folk of every persuasion. Someone out there is bound to know what ails our comrades, and how it may be cured. Thus will we rouse them─no matter what.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_075: That we will, Hoary. That we will.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_076: But first things first─our comrades will have questions. May I ask that you explain the situation to them? I must attend to a private matter.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_077: Oh, I promised I'd visit someone in Limsa Lominsa. He's been waiting at Maelstrom Command for a while now.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_078: ...You know, you should come along too. I think he'd be glad to see you.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_HOARYBOULDER_000_09: Worry not, ─Ocher and Aenor are keeping watch over Mistress Y'shtola and Master Urianger. Pray keep Mistress Alisaie company.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_MAELSTROMOFFICER_00: With Mistress Alisaie, are you? She usually visits alone. Still, it'd make a welcome change for the little one.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_110: As you've probably guessed, it's Ga Bu we've come to see. The private here will bring him out to us.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_111: Ever since the Maelstrom took him in, I've tried to visit as often as I can. And after what befell our friends, I was taken by the urge to visit again. It's...difficult to explain.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_MAELSTROMOFFICER_00: Rest assured, the little one's safe with us.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_150: Let's return to the Rising Stones and take it from there.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_151: Thanks again for agreeing to come. It meant a lot to me.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_180: I did some thinking on the way back, and I think Hoary is right: we need to seek outside help. Ordinarily, we would turn to our own experts on such matters, but they're both among the stricken...
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_181: I will begin by reaching out to the myriad guilds and research institutions here in Eorzea. Additionally, Grandfather and Minfilia had a wealth of connections between them, and I mean to explore those avenues too. We'll find a way to save everyone, mark my words.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_182: Much and more has happened in recent days. Some of it for the good, some...not so. But all around me, people continue their fight.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_183: From the shinobi who search for Alphinaud to the Alliance members who make ready to move against the Empire, they march on in the face of great adversity, bearing heavy burdens. Everyone is playing their part...and so must I.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALISAIE_000_184: You have your own part to play, I know, and it's bigger than most. So I won't keep you. Just promise that you'll visit from time to time, and I promise I'll have good tidings to share with you when you do.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_SYSTEM_000_790: Meanwhile, at a resistance encampment, somewhere in the Empire...
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALPHINAUD_000_801: Dead... All dead. Yet I see no wounds, nor any evidence of battle...
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_SHADOWHUNTER_000_80: (-Shadowhunter-)The Empire developed an alchemical weapon in Gyr Abania. A gas. “Black Rose,” it was called, and to breathe it is to breathe your last.
(-Shadowhunter-)I thought the project abandoned, and its vile fruit destroyed. But naught else could have wrought such an atrocity.
(-Shadowhunter-)Fools... What do they hope to gain with this butchery? Can they not see that a rule won through terror will not endure? How many more provinces must they lose!?

(-Shadowhunter-)Nay...wait. This is not the work of men, but monsters. The Ascians. It cannot be a coincidence that their trail led us here. Their objective was never to rule, but to sow strife and discord.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALPHINAUD_000_808: Such a crime does indeed bear the mark of the Bringers of Chaos.
TEXT_STMBDE107_03149_ALPHINAUD_000_809: Black Rose cannot be allowed to kill again. We must find the Ascians and put an end to their plot.
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_KRILE_000_000: Please do keep Alphinaud's little speech to yourself. He can be awfully sensitive at times...
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_ALIANNE_100_001: Their souls have left their bodies, yet they still live? I didn't know such a thing was even possible...
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_ALISAIE_000_010: I'd heard Master Matoya was something of a recluse, but this seems...extreme. Still, I'll happily overlook her eccentricities if she agrees to help us.
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_KRILE_000_015: I'm sorry I couldn't do more. I've never seen a soul's thread end so abruptly before...
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_MATOYA_000_016: Don't look like that. Shtola survived being cast adrift in the Lifestream, didn't she? Her soul is nothing if not resilient─and the same goes for all of Louisoix's students. So stop worrying about whether you'll see them again, and focus on what can be done in the here and now.
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_ALISAIE_000_020: So that was the woman who tamed Y'shtola... I had the distinct feeling of being grabbed by the scruff of the neck and having the nonsense shaken out of me.
TEXT_STMBDF101_03179_ALISAIE_000_021: When Alphinaud is back, I'd like to visit again and ask her what tales she has of Grandfather.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_KRILE_000_000: I'm sorry I couldn't do more. I've never seen a soul's thread end so abruptly before...
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_010: I almost can't bear to hear what Maxima has to tell us...
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_011: But it can't be bad news, can it? Lyse would have said. Unless─ Agh, there's no point speculating. Lyse said she'd notified the guards of our coming, so we should head straight to the palace gate in the Ala Mhigan Quarter.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_KRILE_000_012: I'll be praying for good news. Learn what you can about Alphinaud's plight, and leave the search for our friends' lost souls to me.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_015: Alphinaud will be all right. He has to be.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Greetings, Scions─the commander told me to expect you. Shall I show you in?

So the Garleans make ready to move against us, do they? Well, I would sooner die than wear shackles again...
Commander Hext mentioned you carry a message for Lord Hien. May your road to the Far East be free of imperial curs.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_030: So, Alphinaud is safe─for the present, at least. Now all we need to worry about is a full-scale imperial invasion...
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_031: I'm actually glad Lyse tasked us with visiting Lord Hien─better to be dashing from place to place than sitting around stewing over things we can't change. To the enclave!
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_YUGIRI_000_035: . You have arrived in time to witness the beginnings of our new alliance. Our proposal struck a chord with many of our neighbors, I am pleased to say.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HAKUROU_000_036: Alone, Doma could accomplish little against the Empire, but in concert with the allies who have gathered here today, we might do much.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_TANSUI_000_037: The imperials have enjoyed the freedom of the Ruby Sea for long enough. 'Tis time they paid their dues.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_AOKORAHERALD_000_03: We of the Blue Kojin will not submit to the Empire's tyranny. If only our Red brethren would awaken to their folly...
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_CIRINA_000_039: After their humbling at your hands, Magnai and his Oronir have spent every waking moment upon the training fields. Defeat does not sit well with the Sun and his children.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_NAGUSAHERALD_000_04: I am come to represent the lands of Nagxia. Long have we struggled in defiance of the Empire, waiting for just such an opportunity as this alliance presents.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_DALMASCAHERALD_000_: The fall of Rabanastre was not the end of our nation. We who survived retreated underground, and have been gathering strength to mount a counteroffensive. Dalmasca will rise again.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: I see you have tidings for Lord Hien. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_TANSUI_000_044: The young lord of Doma has requested my presence. I do hope my garb is fancy enough for his hall.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_CIRINA_000_045: A war council for the alliance is about to begin, and I have been chosen as the voice of the Steppe. I shall do my utmost to represent the will of all the tribes.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_050: Greetings, my friends. I was just discussing future endeavors with the members of our newly formed alliance.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_051: The Kojin and the Confederacy you already know, and it was your own strength of arms that won us the cooperation of the Steppe tribes.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_100_051: We have also been joined by our neighbors from Nagxia, and the indomitable citizens of Dalmasca...though the scattered nature of the latter's resistance will somewhat delay their official induction.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_052: These proud peoples have united under a single purpose: to stand against the tyranny of the Garlean Empire.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_053: I am glad to see your alliance is coming together so swiftly. As things stand, I fear we shall soon have need of your strength...
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_054: I thank you for bringing me news of Alphinaud. His fate is never far from my thoughts─and not only because he is our emissary. As for this sudden deployment of imperial forces, I agree that Ala Mhigo would be wise to shore up its borders with all haste.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_YUGIRI_000_055: Every report we receive from our shinobi indicates a massing of troops in the western provinces. It seems all but certain that the Empire is poised to bring its fist down upon Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_056: And I would help deflect that blow. But I cannot risk sending reinforcements just yet. We will remain vulnerable to airborne assault until our wall in the Burn is in place.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_058: The...energy barrier, yes. I thought to call it something more auspicious. A name drawn from the Four Lords of legend, perhaps─“Seiryu's Aegis” or some such. Well, just a thought.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_YUGIRI_000_059: The Ironworks engineers report that they have finished calibrating the generators, and are ready to proceed to the testing stage.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_060: Have you time to attend the first test? You've seen the field which protected Azys Lla firsthand, and I would be interested to hear how you think ours compares.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_ALISAIE_000_062: I will come too, if you don't mind. Though I am no Y'shtola, I may be able to offer some insight.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_HIEN_000_063: Of course. Time being of the essence, it would be best if we made directly for the Burn. Yugiri, I leave you and Hakuro to bring the war council to a close.
TEXT_STMBDF102_03180_YUGIRI_000_064:
Understood.
Your mounts are saddled and ready, my lord. Ware the storms.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_000: You obviously have some idea of what to expect, having seen the barrier at Azys Lla. But having not had that pleasure myself, I'm exceedingly curious to see a wall capable of keeping out one of those massive imperial airships.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_YUGIRI_000_001: As expected, Sui-no-Sato failed to answer the call. Not that I blame the Ruby Princess. Enlightened as she is reputed to be, it could be no easy task persuading her people to relinquish their long-held isolation.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HAKUROU_000_002: If we can but block the Garleans' airships, the speed with which they deploy their forces will be greatly diminished.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_TANSUI_000_003: Out on the open sea, I would happily take on any vessel. But here on dry land is another matter. The Empire's iron monstrosities will ever have the upper hand.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_AOKORAHERALD_000_00: If only we could persuade our kin of the error of their ways. With the Red at our side, we would make a truly formidable force...
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_CIRINA_000_005: One after another, tribes from across the Steppe have come forth to pledge their warriors to the alliance. Many simply crave a chance to seize glory in battle, it is true, but their eagerness is most welcome nonetheless.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_NAGUSAHERALD_000_00: The jungles of Nagxia are dense and treacherous. The land itself prevents the Empire from ever truly conquering our nation. Long have we hidden behind bough and branch, striking where and when we can.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_DALMASCAHERALD_000_: When the Empire put down Dalmasca's bid for freedom, our remaining forces were splintered. Bringing the scattered pockets of resistance back under a single banner will be our first order of business.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_TANSUI_000_010: In case you were wondering, we won't be sailing off to fight in Eorzea in the foreseeable future. Our ships just aren't equipped for that kind of voyage. But you may be sure we'll do our part against the Empire closer to home.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_CIRINA_000_011: Many tribes have pledged their warriors to the alliance that they might protect the Steppe and our way of life. Perhaps an outside war is what is needed to end the conflict amongst my people.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_020: We will cross the Burn by yol and falcon, as before. Join me at the overlook near the House of the Fierce.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_025: Let us pray there are no sandstorms brewing out there...
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_030: Give the word when you are ready to take wing!
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_YUGIRI_100_035: What uncanny timing that Master Alphinaud should be returned to us just as we were testing the barrier. I only hope a cure can be found for his malady...
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_YUGIRI_000_035: Otherwise, the war council has ended in unanimous agreement. To forestall the Empire's expansion plans in this region, our allies are willing to send troops to fight in Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HAKUROU_000_036: Even should our alliance send a contingent to Eorzea, I will stay here in Doma with the remainder of our forces. As much as I would enjoy taking imperial heads at your side, we cannot leave our borders undefended.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_TANSUI_000_037: In case you were wondering, we won't be sailing off to fight in Eorzea in the foreseeable future. Our ships just aren't equipped for that kind of voyage. But you may be sure we'll do our part against the Empire closer to home.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_RASHO_100_037: The Confederacy bows to no one...but I see the wisdom in joining Lord Hien's alliance. The Empire threatens us all, and only by banding together can we hope to keep what is ours.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_CIRINA_000_038: Many tribes have pledged their warriors to the alliance that they might protect the Steppe and our way of life. Perhaps an outside war is what is needed to end the conflict amongst my people.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_040: Alphinaud is safely ensconced in a private chamber. My finest healer is examining him as we speak.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_041: I've spoken with the physician, and there are no outward signs of illness. Alphinaud is lost in a sleep from which he cannot be awoken...just like the others.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_042: It seems that even the lands of the Empire were not far enough away to escape that cursed voice...
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_043: I share your frustration, Alisaie, I do─but Alphinaud is returned to us alive and otherwise unharmed. All that remains is to find the means to wake him.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_044: Until then, you can but fulfill your duties as a Scion─yours and your brother's both.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_045: ...You're right, of course. There are arrangements to be made, and little time to make them.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_046: To business then, my lord─now that we know “Seiryu's Wall” works as intended, can we expect reinforcements for Ala Mhigo?
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_047: You most certainly can. As promised, we will send troops to bolster our allies in Eorzea without delay.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_YUGIRI_000_048: Pray be aware, however, that they will not arrive without delay. Save for some few who boast teleportation magicks, the bulk of our force must be transported by sea─a lengthy voyage for which the smaller vessels favored by the Confederacy are ill-equipped.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_049: Accordingly, I mean to enlist the assistance of the East Aldenard Trading Company in finding suitable ships. As for navigating the distances in question, we are in the happy position of being able to call upon those who plotted the course of my people's exodus to Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_050: Beyond the procurement of ships, I think it unlikely that our East Aldenard friends will consent to any involvement in military operations, but I am certain they will afford Alphinaud a berth aboard one of their vessels. I shall have a chirurgeon accompany him every ilm of the way to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_051: You have my thanks, Lord Hien.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_HIEN_000_052: Yugiri─I will go on ahead with our friends to Ala Mhigo. Enlist all those capable of teleportation, and put them at the disposal of the Eorzean Alliance as soon as possible. They will form the vanguard.
TEXT_STMBDF103_03181_ALISAIE_000_054: This is exactly what we'd hoped for. Lyse and the Alliance leaders will be glad indeed to welcome the combined strength of the East.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_YUGIRI_000_000: Go on ahead, . I will join you in Ala Mhigo with our advance party as soon as I can.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HAKUROU_000_001: While you and my lord Hien are away crossing swords with the Empire in distant Ala Mhigo, I shall be here with the remainder of our forces, watching our borders. Pray send the Garleans my regards.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_002: Come, let's return to Lyse and share the good news about our Far Eastern reinforcements.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_KIENKANGATEKEEPER03: Lord Hien is expecting you. May I show you in?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_010: We must leave now to convene with Eorzea's leaders, and it may be some time before I return to Doma.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_YUGIRI_000_012: I shall assemble an advance party with all haste, and join you in Ala Mhigo forthwith.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_013: I've just received word from Lyse. The Alliance has established a base camp near Ala Mhigo's northeastern border.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_014: Once we've arrived in the Lochs, we're to report to a Resistance officer stationed in Porta Praetoria who will point us in the right direction. Let's not keep them waiting.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HAKUROU_000_017: Seiryu's Wall is a formidable barrier, but we cannot afford to lower our guard even for a moment. Only constant vigilance will keep Doma safe from her enemies.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_018: Here we are again, ready to fight the same foe... Yet I would not be anywhere else. This conflict concerns us all. Come what may, we cannot allow the Empire to regain its grip on Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_019: Here. I think we've found the guide Lyse mentioned.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: Ah, you must be the Scion party I was told to look out for! If you'll follow me, I'll take you directly to Alliance Headquarters.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_Q1_000_021: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_025: Is Emperor Varis in thrall to the Ascians? That is the question.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_026: If Sharlayan could not negotiate peace with the Empire, I rather doubt war can be avoided here. But every moment we steal for our preparations will count in the final reckoning.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RAUBAHN_000_027: Should the Empire decide to ignore the rules of parley, we could be fighting far sooner than we'd like. Keep your weapons close.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_LYSE_000_030: Well, I don't suppose it's polite to keep an emperor waiting too long. Shall we?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: For years have we warred with the Empire, and with no end in sight. A parley such as this represents a unique opportunity, and I would not squander it with bitter words.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RAUBAHN_000_042: Varis holds fast to his ideals, just as I knew he would. He will not be swayed from this path.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_LYSE_000_043: Why do I get the feeling the Emperor is hiding something...?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_MERLWYB_000_044: 'Tis true that Limsa Lominsa's beginnings were not wholly honorable. But our old wrongs do not make the Empire's deeds right.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_KANESENNA_000_045: I do much wonder at Emperor Varis's decision to attend these negotiations... It is plain he has no intention of hearkening to our entreaties. But what then is his goal?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_046: For a moment, I feared our talks would descend into violence there and then. Alisaie speaks of her dislike for politics, but her honest plea may very well have prevented an early battle.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_AYMERIC_000_047: Whatever rebuttal I had in mind was lost when Varis mentioned my father. The man is certainly skilled at keeping his opponents off balance.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: Shall I escort you to the parley, ?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_Q2_100_047: Proceed to the Garlean Legion Tents?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: If you wish, I can escort you directly to the parley, .
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_Q3_100_049: Proceed to the Garlean Legion Tents?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_050: Phew. This is really not my forte.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_051: After His Radiance's little performance, it was all I could do not to swear at him. I honestly don't know how I ended up playing the mediator.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_052: I just asked myself what Alphinaud would have done, tried my best to do the same, and...by some miracle, it worked.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_053: But there really is no common ground to be found with that man─nor do I think he looked for any. So the question becomes, what did he come here to do─because you may be certain it wasn't to make peace.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_054: <sigh> ...Whatever it is, I can't make it out─not yet, at least. We do have a little time before the parley is due to reconvene, though, so why not try consulting our illustrious leaders? Mayhap they have some insight to share.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_058: The meeting isn't due to reconvene for a while yet. You might want to ask the others what they think the Emperor is after. It's not impossible one of them could have spotted something we've missed.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06: Twelve have mercy... But for Lady Alisaie's timely interjection, we might well have come to blows at the negotiating table.
Not that Emperor Varis left us a great many options. Is unconditional surrender all he will accept, do you think?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_RAUBAHN_000_062: Ere he arrived, I'd have said yes. But having heard him speak...I cannot help but think he came with some other end in mind.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_LYSE_000_063: Exactly! He's building up to something, I know it!
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06: Hmm... How then should we approach the rest of the parley? Have you anything to say, Warrior of Light?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_A1_000_002: Say nothing of Zenos or the Ascians.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_NANAMOULNAMO_000_06: You believe he is more apt to reveal the truth if we put him at his ease? ...Mayhap you are right.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_MERLWYB_000_070: I will say one thing for this Varis─he is well versed in Eorzean history.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_KANESENNA_000_071: His interest in our affairs is that of a beast in its prey. The conqueror would know his enemies.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_MERLWYB_000_072: All should know their enemies. Yet there is much and more we do not know of the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_A2_000_001: I'm sure Varis would be happy to tell you more...
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_A2_000_002: Then it's up to us to change that. Here and now.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_MERLWYB_000_073: Hah! You would have me ask the Emperor himself? Well, mayhap there is some wisdom in that.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_MERLWYB_000_074: If we can skirt the storm of his displeasure, we may yet come to our answers...even if it does mean sailing close to the wind.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_080: This parley was never like to bring peace, but I had hoped to learn something of Emperor Varis's relationship with the Ascians...
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_AYMERIC_000_081: As had we all. Yet if he is in league with them, he is not like to volunteer the fact─and if he is not...how much weaker would his position seem for their presence. If we are to broach that particular subject, we will need to be subtle... <sigh> Would that I knew more of the man... If you would indulge me, Lord Hien: you received an imperial education, did you not? Is it true that the Emperor's will is considered absolute?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_082: There is no higher authority in all of Garlemald, nor else in the heavens, come to that. Veneration of the gods is forbidden─the only worship permitted being that of His Radiance's own person.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_A3_000_001: That sounds suspiciously like a religion in itself.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_083: I share your disdain for their hypocrisy. Even as they denigrate the idea of faith, they revere their leader with a fervor others reserve for the divine.
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_HIEN_000_084: 'Tis a flaw common to much of the doctrine they fed us─logical on the surface, perhaps, but contradictory upon closer examination. I wonder if a discussion of the various discrepancies might prompt Varis to reveal something...?
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_ALISAIE_000_090: You've spoken with everyone then? Good. Now, all that remains is to await the pleasure of the Emperor, and hope we fare better at the second attempt...
TEXT_STMBDF104_03182_LYSE_000_120: I came back to find Doma's advance party ready and waiting for battle. So, as worrying as our little chat with the Emperor was, it did buy enough time for at least some of our allies to arrive.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_000: My duties as field commander demand I remain here at my post, but I have no doubt the front lines are in capable hands.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: Greetings, . I have instructions to escort you to Alliance Headquarters─assuming you are ready, of course?
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_Q1_100_002: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_HIEN_000_000: Alisaie is being cared for at the infirmary. Would that there were more we could do for her...
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_010: So the Garleans have been routed, have they? Well done.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_011: Though this exchange was no more than a test of our strength, like as not. They won't be taking any chances now that the Emperor has joined the fray. They'll want to take their time─whittle down our defenses...
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_012: Still, with your help, and that of our Eastern allies, we've passed the first test. Our line is unbroken.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_013: As for Alisaie...well, she's in good hands over at the infirmary.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_YUGIRI_000_014: My lord─the chirurgeons have completed their examination of Mistress Alisaie, and it is as we feared. She is locked in a slumber without any outward cause.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_HIEN_000_015: Just like the others. Damn it all...
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_016: Aye...the Garleans picked a fine time to come knocking.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_017: Five Scions incapacitated... And with the enemy on our doorstep, I cannot spare the men to assist in the search for a cure. The best I can do is see to it that Alisaie is escorted safely back to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_HIEN_000_018: Yugiri and I would return to our encampment. The main contingent of our forces from the Far East is under sail, and all must be made ready for their arrival.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_020: Judging by the Garleans' recent movements, or lack thereof, they won't be launching another offensive in the immediate future.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_021: You should return to the Rising Stones. Given the plight of your fellow Scions, I can understand if you feel on edge, but you'll be no good to anyone without rest.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_RAUBAHN_000_025: Go on, now─rest. You've more than earned it. We'll contact you the moment the Garleans show any sign of stirring.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: Ah, . Welcome home. Word has it you and Mistress Alisaie gave the Garleans quite a thrashing. Speaking of whom, where is Mistress Alisaie? I was certain she would have returned by now.
By the Twelve, not her too...
Ocher and I will ready the infirmary for her arrival.
We will also need to send a message to Tataru posthaste. <sigh> Would that I had something other than grim tidings to share with her...
And with you too, for that matter. It grieves me to report that the Archons' condition remains unchanged.
As we speak, Coultenet, Krile, and Master Matoya continue to explore every possible avenue. Alas, their efforts have yet to bear fruit.
But all is not lost. You are still hale and whole, after all. Though I suspect you must be tired from your journey. You should rest, my friend. Leave the worrying to us, for the time being, at least.
TEXT_STMBDF105_03183_SYSTEM_100_040: Meanwhile, at the border of Ala Mhigo...
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_HOARYBOULDER_000_00: Ah, . Yours is a welcome face indeed in these troubled times. Though if you've come to inquire about our stricken brothers and sisters, I am afraid I have naught to report.
Coultenet and the others continue their tireless search for answers, and I too have done all in my power to assist them. Alas...
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_002: (-???-)My apologies for the intrusion. I was told Master Alphinaud had been brought here, and wished to see if his condition had improved.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_003:
. I have heard about the part you played in driving back the Empire's forces...
...Thank you. That you were able to stop them, if only for a short while, gives me hope.
