TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_004: I realize how strange such words must sound coming from a Garlean's lips, but I speak them out of the love I bear for my homeland─because I wish to see an end to the bloodshed.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_005: That is why I chose to share all that I know with the Alliance. Though I will surely be branded a traitor, I am content to bear that ignominy. 'Twill seem a small price to pay if it helps to prevent this conflict from escalating any further.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_006: But enough of my prattling. The war is not what brought me all this way. I came to see Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_HOARYBOULDER_000_00: An acquaintance of  and Alphinaud, are you? Well, far be it from me to turn away good company. If you will follow me, sir...
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_008: When word reached me that Alphinaud had returned, it seemed only right that I visit him. Poor lad... It pains me to see him thus. But I take solace in the knowledge that he is safe and well cared for.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_009: He fought valiantly at the Burn. The Populares could not have wished for a more committed ally.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_010: I know not how he came to be so afflicted, but I pray a cure will be found soon.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_011: On an unrelated note, you may be interested to know that I traveled here in the company of another acquaintance of yours.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_012: He awaits my return at north Silvertear, and I am certain he would be glad to see you. Assuming you can spare the time, that is.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_HOARYBOULDER_000_01: Who do you suppose is waiting for him at north Silvertear?
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_020: Ah, there you are. I was beginning to think you would not come.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_021: It sounds like you've been through the mill. You should have called me.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_022: Though I must confess, tracking down missing souls isn't exactly within my field of expertise.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_023: As you may have surmised, I heard much of Master Garlond growing up in Garlemald. Indeed, he has long been a source of inspiration to me.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_024: Most Garleans would say he is a traitor, that he turned his back on his country. We of the Populares, however, consider him a revolutionary─a man willing to defy the Empire's dreams of subjugation, that his inventions might bring about a better future for all mankind.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_025: Please─“revolutionary” is a term best reserved for my work. I am but an imperial defector who thought to aid another imperial defector.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_026: Whatever Master Garlond says, I am humbled to find myself in such distinguished company.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_027: Speaking of distinguished company, we heard from Raubahn that you ran into an old friend in the Burn. Is it true? Gaius still lives?
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_028: Like most in the army, I never had the privilege of seeing the legatus without his mask. To think I walked halfway across the Burn in the presence of the Black Wolf...
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_029: And he claimed to have severed ties with the Empire to hunt Ascians, did he?
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_030: Hmph. After his humbling at the Praetorium, one would think he'd have the good sense to stay dead.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_031: Should we meet again, I shall be sure to tell him so.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_032: Commander Aldynn also spoke of the Alliance's meeting with the Emperor...though I still labor to believe what he told us. Did His Radiance really claim that Garlemald was founded by the Ascians?
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_033: But that is madness. The very notion is absurd! Every fiber of my being rails against it... And yet I see there is no escaping the truth. From the very founding of my homeland, my brothers and sisters have laid down their lives in service to a lie.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_034: The Ascians must be stopped. To save my people, to save all peoples.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_035: For all the Empire's many crimes, even I did not suspect. Had I known, I would have left a lot sooner.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_036: But that is in the past. Here in the present, we must apply ourselves to the problem of how the Empire's ambitions may be thwarted, not only in Eorzea, but in the Far East as well.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_037: The Ironworks will spare no effort to achieve that end. Seiryu's Wall was a good start, but we can do more─and we will. We'll show them what it means to achieve “Freedom through Technology”!
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_ALLIANCERECRUIT0318: Begging your pardons! I bear a message for the Warrior of Light!
Commander Aldynn requests your presence at Alliance Headquarters in Ala Mhigo. He would discuss matters of strategy at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_040: Ah yes. The inevitable messenger. I knew it wouldn't be long before duty called you away.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_041: Time no doubt being of the essence, could I tempt you to a ride aboard the Excelsior? If there's a faster way to Raubahn's side, I will personally apologize to the commander for keeping him waiting.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_045: I too will make for the border anon. If there is aught I can do to help, I consider it my duty to see it done.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: Commander Aldynn awaits your arrival. I am to escort you to Alliance Headquarters as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_050: I swear, every time you board my airship, you seem to be barreling headlong into danger. And every time, you somehow contrive to emerge victorious. Which, of course, is an admirable skill.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_051: But no one is invincible, . Not even you. So please, take care of yourself out there.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_MAXIMA_000_052: I pray you remain safe on the front lines. Though ill-equipped to join the fray, I shall do all I can to assist from headquarters.
TEXT_STMBDG101_03184_CID_000_053: My colleagues and I have been tasked with evacuating casualties by air. See that you aren't among them, eh?
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: Commander Aldynn is waiting, . It would be best if we proceeded to Alliance Headquarters at once.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_Q1_000_002: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_RAUBAHN_000_010: You're here. Good. I summoned you to discuss strategy, but first I would apprise you of the Garleans' movements.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_011: Upon speaking with Raubahn, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_012: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_100_013: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 70 or above.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_020: (-???-)Well, this is a most unexpected surprise. I thought you confined to bed.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_021: When I heard that you had collapsed on the field of battle, I confess I feared the worst. But with you standing here before me, I see now that the reports of your defeat were greatly exaggerated. Thank the Fury.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_022: As long as we have you,  , history suggests we have a fighting chance. Speaking of fighting, you may be surprised to hear that the war's effects can already be felt even here in Ishgard. In anticipation of a need for reinforcements, Artoirel will soon be departing for the front lines with a contingent of our finest knights.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_023: I would advise you to stay until your strength had returned, but I know it would be an exercise in futility.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_024: Indeed, I suspect you have already decided on your next destination.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_025: Dark days lie ahead, of that I have no doubt, but the light of hope shall ever guide our steps so long as we have the will to press onward.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_026: And press onward we must. Farewell, my friend. I pray our next meeting will be under happier circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EDMONT_000_028: You know that you will ever be welcome at House Fortemps. Now away with you! I dare not keep you any longer!
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_HANDELOUP_100_028: ! Finally up and about, I see. Everyone feared the worst when they brought you to the infirmary─but I knew you would pull through. Something tells me your part in this war is far from over.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_BUTLER02246_100_028: ! We did not expect to see you back on your feet so soon. Confined to bed as you were, Lord Edmont left for your quarters not long ago, thinking to keep you company. Did you perchance encounter him on the way?
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SAULETTE_100_029: ! My apologies, . I meant to go and visit you in the infirmary, but... Well, I'm glad to see you up and about!
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_EMMANELLAIN_100_030: , you're awake! Gods, you scared us half to death, old . Don't go making a habit of it, eh!?
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_HONOROIT_100_031: . Thank the Fury you are all right.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_HANCOCK_100_032: I must confess, the offices have not been quite the same since Tataru left... They're considerably quieter, for one thing. But don't tell her I said that, all right?
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_RAUBAHN_000_030: I knew you'd be all right. And to celebrate your return, I made you this─a brand-new traveling outfit! Oh, I do hope it fits...
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_RAUBAHN_000_031: <ahem> But now is not the time to fuss over your measurements. I must go and speak with the researchers of Saint Coinach's Find. You go and rest while we track down that beacon.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_040: You have completed the Post-Ala Mhigan Liberation chapter of the main scenario. In the following chapter, Shadowbringers, the events of the Crystal Tower quests play an important role.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_041: It is recommended that you play the Crystal Tower quests before beginning Shadowbringers.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_042: The starting quest, “Legacy of Allag,” may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_STMBDG102_03185_SYSTEM_000_043: You may review your progress under “Chronicles of a New Era - The Crystal Tower” in your journal.
